description:
Is infinite regression a blessing– or a curse? For Eunhyeon, it is a fate that he desperately wishes to escape. Seven beings fall into the world of cultivators. Each has rare talents, but Eunhyeon appears to have none and struggles to survive in this strange world. Yet after his death, he finds himself back at the start of it all, realizing that his talent is the ability of infinite regression. Here begins Eunhyeon’s relentless struggle to break free.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After twelve years, a former teammate—no, a thorn in his side—suddenly reappears. Eun-San isn’t thrilled to be working with Ian again, having long buried both his ice hockey past and any memories of him. 

Unlike Eun-San, who hopes their meeting will be a one-time thing, Ian insists on keeping him around with an offer he can’t refuse. With his beloved younger sibling caught in the middle, Eun-San reluctantly agrees, but he can't shake the feeling that Ian has an ulterior motive. 

Why does Ian keep pulling him closer? There’s no way this guy actually has feelings for him…right? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Fresh out of a breakup, game developer Woo-Jin has little going for him. So when he hears that the middle boss of their game is based on him, he can't resist adding a few traits to make his virtual alter ego a tad more noble. Little did he know, he would soon end up trapped in said villain's skin! With a 1 in 1,000 chance of survival, Woo-Jin now has to navigate the countless variables leading him to his impending doom. Will the tweaks he made to the character tip the scales in his favor?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: What a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!
description:
Who was that guy that once said, “An army marches on its stomach”? When hapless agricultural science student Jangcheol Kim starts playing the fantasy MMORPG “Paladins of Blood” to escape the stress of school life, he never imagined he would end up inside the game, much less as its final boss. How can a ruthless demon overlord win over his subjects? Perhaps with potatoes.

(Source: WEBTOON)

As a top-tier film star, Jae-Gyu is no stranger to the spotlight or the toxic rumors that follow it. Exhausted by the public eye, he has become a professional at pushing people away. That changes when he meets his neighbor, Cheong-Rok, a counselor at a psychiatry office. Cheong-Rok does not recognize the star and treats him like anyone else. Intrigued by this normal treatment, Jae-Gyu finds himself drawn to the one man unimpressed by his fame. Despite his long career, Jae-Gyu has never experienced romance, not even through a script. So is he finally ready for the real thing? 

(Source: Tappytoon) 

*Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.*

Max and Joy may sit just inches apart at work, but they're miles apart in every other way. Max prefers to be a fly on the wall, while Joy is the office's social butterfly. So when Max accidentally sees something on Joy's work laptop he wasn't meant to, he's pulled off the wall and thrown straight into the tangled web of workplace dynamics. Maybe this change is exactly what he needed... or is it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

One day, I woke up as a noble inside the game I used to play. Unfortunately, the game ends in an apocalypse. With ten years left, I track down the future villains while they’re still kids and decide to raise them myself, hoping that a better childhood could stop them from destroying the world. Now, with criminals dropping like flies, the kingdom thinks I’m the terrifying mastermind pulling all the strings. What on earth is happening? I just wanted to enjoy the sweet noble life!

(Source: WEBTOON)

As a first-year law student, Lee Yeon never expected to cross paths again with his middle school crush — the charming upperclassman Hong Ki-Hoon. But a chance reunion on campus leads to an even more unexpected twist: a spontaneous trip, and a strange challenge known only as the Red Thread Quest. 

Red Thread Quest, Round 1: Five Kisses on the Cheek!

Skeptical about soulmates and fate, Yeon finds himself drawn into the legend of the Red Thread of Fate — and as each round of the quest unfolds, his relationship with Ki-Hoon begins to take an unpredictable turn. 

What started as a game might just lead them to something real…if the Red Thread Rock has anything to say about it.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jang Baek-Hee is counting the days until he can escape Gicheon before his deadbeat father is released from prison. But then Yang Il-Woo arrives: a delinquent transfer student with a cheap perm, brassy hair, and a loneliness that mirrors Baek-Hee’s own. Slowly, their uneasy friendship deepens into something tender. But Il-Woo came to Gicheon with a secret that could shatter the fragile comfort they've both found in each other. And when the past comes calling, can two broken souls survive the truth?

(Source: Tapas)

To secure an alliance between the northern kingdom of Leracal and the southern realm of Arnata, the countries’ royal families agree to a political marriage. Tei, known across the frozen battlefields as the most fearsome warrior and monster hunter, volunteers himself as the kingdom’s hostage, trading his life as a warrior for that of a bride. In Arnata, Tei finds not the hostility he anticipated but the calm, steady gaze of Shuraka, the young crown prince destined to become both his spouse and future Padisha of the empire. For Shuraka to claim the throne, however, he must survive an uprising that threatens the kingdom - once that forces him to draw the blood of his own brothers. Moved by the courage and gentle integrity of his betrothed, Tei pledges to protect him at any cost…and in the quiet hours of a white night, two hearts caught between loyalty and longing begin to bloom.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*"Six months... Just six months, and it'll all be over."*

After a one-night stand Hollywood top star Chase Miller, Joshua finds out he’s pregnant. As a single father, Joshua raises their child in secrecy. But when he is forced to return to work as Chase’s bodyguard, the two are reunited in a cruel twist of fate. Relieved that Chase doesn’t seem to remember him, Josh’s comfort is short lived - something primal, something desperate, yearns for the touch of his former lover, and every time he sees this beautifully twisted man, Josh’s heart races in spite of his mind. The more time passes, the more boundaries blur as instinct takes over… Will Joshua be able to resist the lips of his former lover? Or are the strings of fate too strong to resist?

(Source: Lezhin US)

At 4, Groo is undoubtedly the youngest S-ranked awakened in the country. But as her kindergarten class's (self-proclaimed) ace, she can take a challenge! So when her first quest window tells her to find a grown-up who'll take her in, she marches down to the top guild in Korea and demands to be recruited. Sensing that this overpowered orphan shouldn't fall into the wrong hands, the guildmaster has no choice but to adopt her. But he has no idea this tiny girl is about to turn his life upside down!

(Source: Tapas)

In the quiet village of Feltham, Eloise Surbiton leads a peaceful life far from the hubbub of the city, tending to geese and secretly fawning over dashing war hero Lt. Col. Ryan Wilgrave from afar. When her father mentions that a certain military man named Ryan will be moving to the nearby town of Cambourne, Eloise is thrilled — only to have her hopes dashed when she meets her new neighbor Ryan Thornton, a gruff soldier who is the opposite of the Ryan Wilgrave she knows. Little does she realize, there may be more to Ryan than meets the eye…

(Source: WEBTOON)

If love is the ultimate prize, then the perils of courtship are the necessary trials and tribulations one must endure in its pursuit. It is a blessing for the society debutantes of London, then, that Cupid’s arrow should be guided by the dainty hand of Miss Laura Pendleton, granddaughter of Countess Pendleton and the city’s finest matchmaker. When Laura’s self-ascribed duties call her to befriend the stoic and saturnine Mr. Ian Dalton of Whitefield, however, she soon finds that when it comes to the grand contest of love, it may well be every woman for herself…

(Source: WEBTOON)

In a world where blue snow freezes everything it touches, humanity has long forgotten what warmth feels like. Seonu, a teenage boy with a prosthetic leg, carries the lifeless body of Iseo through the snow-covered wasteland, determined to bring her home one final time. The snow will soon erase his footsteps but not the promise that keeps him moving.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ajin Bae suddenly dives into Dear Dane, the world’s top MMORPG, using her brother’s account—who just happens to be the master of its number one guild. Tasked with keeping her identity secret, she tries to protect his legacy, but things spiral when she’s mistaken for a creep hitting on Bloomie, a popular female player who’s secretly a male idol. Trying to clear things up, Ajin sends a video with her voice in it. But that just gets Bloomie thinking: Wait… I know this girl!

(Source: WEBTOON)

I-Yeon wanted a quiet life as an arborist—but hidden upstairs is a comatose killer who once tried to murder her. When he wakes with no memory, she panics… and lies: "I'm your wife." 

Can she survive the man who doesn’t remember her—or what he did?

(Source: Manta)

Wuseong Dan, the man who ruled over the martial world with his fists alone. After unexpectedly losing a duel against two practitioners of the Demonic Way, he’s reborn into the body of the wild child heir apparent of the affluent Silver River Merchants. Not one to leave debts unpaid, be they to his benefit or detriment, Wuseong sets out on his path of revenge in the body of Jineon Lee. Using his knowledge of martial arts from his past life and the wealth of his current life, he only has one goal: get stronger and kill those who killed him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

One snowy winter evening, Chang-Deok spots a high schooler crouched in front of his favorite restaurant, blood running ice-cold in the falling snow. Lured in by the promise of meal made just like the restaurant's, Chang-Deok ends up inviting the boy—Jong-U—into his home; after all, Chang-Deok's life is as dry as day-old rice, and food is his only joy. So when Jong-U offers to cook him a delicious dinner every night in exchange for a place to stay, he reluctantly agrees. But as their unusual cohabitation begins, Changdeok can't shake this bloody feeling that Jong-U might be hiding something... Hopefully being a good Samaritan doesn’t come back around to bite him in the neck—er, butt...

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

Echineacea Roaz is graceful, beautiful, and impeccably dressed, even on the dueling grounds. Yet beneath the lace gloves and silk hats is a deadly swordsman with a dark secret. As the Demon of the Cursed Sword, she once slaughtered all she loved, including Captain Eurien, the one man who believed in her. Granted one chance to rewrite fate, she turns back time and joins the knighthood to protect those she once failed. Can this elegant swordsman bloom anew, or will she cut everything down again?

(Source: Tapas)

You know him as the legendary Ranker, Urek Mazino—but once, he was just another Regular, climbing the Tower alongside both teammates and enemies. What awaits him after charging into the Tower, chasing after Phantaminum? Whatever it is he desires... will he find it there?

(Source: WEBTOON)

When his grandfather is suddenly brutally murdered by a member of the Demonic Martial Alliance, Fu Enxue vows that he will stop at nothing to avenge his death. To find the perpetrator, he infiltrates the alliance armed only with his wits and thirst for vengeance. There, he catches the attention of the demonic masters, as his overwhelming bloodlust makes him a prodigy in the demonic arts. But will this thirst for blood help him in his pursuit of revenge, or will that same power be his undoing?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Demon King Overrun by Heroes
description:
Berje Deias was once a by-the-book Demon King, but after being reborn, he is determined to break every rule there is. His second attempt at life, however, takes a chaotic turn when a kidnapping of a princess doesn’t quite go to plan! Can he defeat an entire continent of heroes with his wild, untested methods?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

The path to greatness begins… tomorrow! It’s always a day too early for a great procrastinator like Yeonho Wi to start training. So how did someone as lazy as him become a great warrior renowned for his virtue, benevolence, and might? Follow the historian’s journey to uncover the hidden secrets of the lazy master of martial arts.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Witness the corruption of reason and divinity. Escape the nine hells of Fog Land. Driven by his conviction that everyone deserves education, science teacher Dante Kang agrees to teach in Fog Land, a mysterious international prison that houses the world’s most notorious criminals. But his very first class gets interrupted by a violent prison riot, after which, he finds himself in the cell of his mysterious captor. Dante must now travel through the nine circles of hell and escape Fog Land. 

Source: Webtoon

Geon-Yeong is a brilliant girl. Despite being underprivileged, her exceptional intellect allows her to enroll in the prestigious Pyeonghyeon High School. There, she meets new competitors and friends. She struggles to compete with all the other privileged students who have expensive lessons. Amidst these challenges, she is determined to succeed and become a judge. This is Geon-Yeong's journey to prove that despite the disadvantages life has dealt her, she is worthy of respect. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Having lived as a beta his whole life, Seo Yee-Hyeon never imagined his path would cross with a golden Alpha like Liu Weikun - someone so far above his world it, felt like fate would never even bother. But one day, Weikun catches an impossible scent adrift in the air: the sweet, addictive pheromone of an Omega…coming from Hyun. Stranger still, it’s a scent only he can perceive. As desire and instinct blur into obsession, Yee-Hyeon finds himself caught between disbelief and temptation, his world crystalizing into one he never thought possible…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sang-Hyeon Kim has the talent and the drive to become a K-pop star—but one thing keeps holding him back: a false school bullying accusation. After countless rejections, his dream feels more distant than ever. But when the head director of a major entertainment company hands him a mysterious bath bomb that transforms him into his past-life self, he's suddenly staring at an unbelievably beautiful... woman? Sang-Hyeon's second shot at fame is about to begin—in the most unexpected way!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yeo Eun-Seong has always been popular—too popular. With his striking looks, he attracts attention from everyone, regardless of age or gender. But constant gossip and misunderstandings have left him deeply distrustful of people. The last thing he needs is to be popular amongst ghosts too!

After moving into a new home for his job, Eun-Seong finds himself tormented by eerie paranormal activity night after night. One evening, while cowering outside his own apartment, he meets Seo Tae-Jeong, a passing office worker who—much to Eun-Seong’s surprise—can see and talk to ghosts. Desperate for peace, Eun-Seong enlists Tae-Jeong’s help to rid his house of its unwelcome guests. As the two work together, an unexpected and curious friendship begins to take shape… but is there more to Tae-Jeong than meets the eye?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes two side story chapters.*

display_title: Barbarian's Adventure in a Fantasy World
description:
Ketal the Barbarian never imagined that his dream of fantastical magic, epic kingdoms, and grand quests would start in the freezing, monster-filled White Tundra. After battling snow and fierce beasts, he reaches the wider world, only to find everyone is baffled by such a polite barbarian who asks too many questions and sends foes flying like ragdolls. Ketal just wants the adventure he's always wished for. But can a world that expects a brute handle a barbarian who refuses to be one?

(Source: Tapas)

Mysterious black circles have started appearing all over the world, and whoever falls in doesn't come back out. Then one day, a black circle swallows an entire school and everyone in it, turning it into a twisted maze of nightmares. Will Doyun and his classmates find a way out?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Elementary school teacher Gi-Jeong Go has lost almost everything: her parents when she was a child, her freedom when she had to support her shut-in younger brother, and now her very dignity as the class bully among her students and his mother threaten to turn her life into a living hell. Upon meeting the mild-mannered yet inscrutable lawyer In-Seop Oh, Gi-Jeong begins to find her life changing, though little does she know that wherever In-Seop goes, death follows…

(Source: WEBTOON) 

*Note: Includes three side stories.*

Ju In-Cheol had it all...sharp suits, political connections, and a rising career as the trusted aide to Assemblywoman Lee Myeong-Seon, a ministerial candidate destined for power. But politics is a knife's edge, and one wrong move can send even the best men tumbling. 

When In-Cheol loses footing in the ruthless hierarchy of the office, he's handed a near-impossible task: resolve the explosive redevelopment dispute in Songmun City's Jungang District. Failure means exile. He's ready to do whatever it takes – until he meets An Pyeong-Hwa, the quiet gym owner next door and the key to the problem. Pyeong-Hwa's price for cooperation? 

*"Hit me. That's all I want."* 

Behind that strange request lies something darker than bruises. And as In-Cheol sinks deeper into the deal, he realizes every favor, every blow, is pulling him into a world where politics and pleasure share the same shadow. 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

display_title: The Genius Swordsman of Mount Hua
description:
After being ambushed by the Demonic Cult, Goheon Dok and Hyeonjo, his close friend from Mount Hua, are cornered and on the verge of losing their lives. Before they're both killed, Hyeonjo hands Goheon the Plum Blossom Spirit Beads, a sacred relic of Mount Hua that causes Goheon to take possession of the body of Muhwi, an apprentice of Hyeonjo. Now, as a Senior Disciple of Mount Hua, Goheon Dok must fight to protect Mount Hua and fulfill his friend's dying wish.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Sick and tired of her mother's ruinous debts, Richelle accepts a post as tutor to the illustrious Otis family. But upon finding a letter with strict, eerie rules on how to survive within the manor of roses, Richelle senses that something sinister is lurking. Now, she must pay the price for her choice.

(Source: Manta)

Set against the backdrop of a wintry Seoul, Winter Breeze tells a story of second chances, hope, and the unexpected warmth that can bloom even in the coldest seasons. Two years after their fleeting encounter at Seoul Station, Hae-Na is reunited with Do-Hwa at a newly opened photo studio tucked away in her quiet neighborhood, and finds herself drawn to the mysterious photographer she hasn’t been able to forget. Is their reunion merely coincidence, or is it the beginning of something meant to be?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Youngest Sister-in-Law in a Tragic Reverse Harem
description:
One feverish night, 6-year-old Liliana Bercchio suddenly recalls the plot of a tragic reverse harem novel. Unsure if she's been reincarnated or has time traveled, her young mind struggles to make sense of it all. Her family is doomed to get caught up in the protagonists' mess—but there's still time… or so she thought. When she witnesses the female lead's death and the deranged male leads appear before her sisters, the story takes a turn. They seem different now, but is her family truly safe?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: How To Ride the Hero's Coattails
description:
Ever read one of those webtoons where an obnoxious male protagonist transmigrates into his favorite game, uses his knowledge of the plot to become ridiculously overpowered, and somehow gathers a harem along the way? Now, imagine reincarnating into that story! That's what happens to Nahyeon, but unlike the freewheeling teenager of a hero, she has no interest in becoming the main character. After all, it's way easier to stick right at his side and benefit from his grand plan! Or so she thought...

(Source: Tapas)

The dead no longer stay dead. They rise—not as monsters, but as aimless wanderers—plunging the world into chaos. Hope of immortality fades as disasters push humanity to the brink of extinction. Amidst the ruin, Pyo Guwon walks against the tide of fleeing survivors. On his path, he finds Heo Jinwoo, left for dead after an attack. Instead of passing by, Pyo offers a hand, posing a single question: "How does it feel to survive hell?" With that, he leads Jinwoo to a village where death holds no meaning—but in a world that refuses to let go of the past, survival is never that simple.

(Source: Lezhin)

A state-of-the-art operating room with pristine surgical equipment? No can do; just a rusty bone saw in front of a jeering crowd for you! Sound like a waking nightmare? Well, that’s the best that the finest 19th century British medicine has to offer Taepyeong Kim, a young student from Joseon who retains the memory of his past life as a surgeon in modern-day Korea. For Taepyeong, London’s supposedly cutting-edge medical education is nothing but one barbaric display of malpractice after another, and he vows to drag the profession kicking and screaming into the modern age.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ji-u Shin has been transported into her own dating game. Her life inside the game is now being broadcast live across the cosmos. If she wants the broadcast to end, she must win the game. The catch? The game is set to the hardest difficulty, and she’s been cast as the notorious villainess, Theresa. If she fails to win, she will lose her life. Can she avoid all of Theresa’s bad endings and bring this broadcast to an end once and for all?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: You Think It's Easy Rewriting a Story?
description:
Reincarnation stories are all the rage these days, but I never thought I’d be the one getting reborn! But still, life as a rich man’s beautiful daughter is pretty sweet... except for one thing. No matter what I do, where I run, or who I romance, this novel is dead-set on getting me hitched to the handsome duke destined to kill me! There must be some way to change my fate, right? I won't go out like this!

(Source: Tapas)

Picture this: It’s your final year of high school, and you can’t wait to get out there and live your best life. You blush at the popular kid, and eye the new transfer student with bruises on his face. You’re looking forward to the future… Until you wake up in the future, with no memory of the last six years. Suddenly finding herself as a 25-year-old aspiring actress, Miyeon Seo begins to unravel the painful threads of her forgotten past.

(Source: WEBTOON)

In 1960s America, stoic and solitary ranch hand Dennis is hired for a summer of shepherding under a strange warning: trust nothing but the sheep. A month in, a stranger named Tod appears, claiming to be a hunter passing through. Though Dennis is wary, he finds himself slowly drawn to the man, unsettled by the pull between suspicion and desire. As the line between threat and connection blurs, tragedy strikes when a coyote slips past his guard and kills one of the flock. With loyalty shaken and feelings he can’t name, Dennis must choose. Will he hold on to his doubt, or take a chance on the one thing he’s been told not to trust?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Wolf Who Stole the Sun
description:
Golden Toldran is the wealthiest realm on the continent. Princess Charlotte, after years of religious devotion, is thrust into a public courtship she never desired. When Skadi, a singular suitor from the distant land of Nuanar, enters her life, boredom gives way to something far more dangerous.

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

display_title: In the House of the Damned
description:
Albert Blake has lived with just one purpose: to avenge his father by killing the master of the cursed Valdez mansion. But when Albert infiltrates the mansion as a new servant, he begins to see through his father’s lies. Master Asha Valdez is nothing like the hideous monster his father portrayed him to be, but rather an immortal vampire whose beauty captivates Albert at first glance, just like it had for his father. As Albert soon finds out, he is far from the first Blake to come to Asha, as his blood has been drawn to the master for generations...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Little A travels to a rural farm to reunite with the uncle who raised him only to find the place eerily silent and his uncle nowhere in sight. What awaits him is a chilling "bible" detailing how to care for the livestock… but something feels off. Because on this farm, the "livestock" aren’t animals they’re humans.

Now thrust into the role of acting farm manager, little A is forced to manage Mr. A’s Farm, a facility that produces livestock products using beast-like humans creatures who think and act like people, but are bred for their byproducts. Dark secrets plague the estate in the uncle’s absence. Little A must do all he can to keep the farm safe and sound...at least until his missing uncle, Mr.A, comes back.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

A hungry tree, a shapeshifting rat, and a forgotten boy... These are just three of the 100 curses that haunt Illeston Manor. House Illeston thinks they'll be plagued by their curses forever until Simone the necromancer shows up to break them. All she asks for in return is a lavish life and protection from anyone who might harm her. But with every ghoul she defeats, Simone realizes that the true dangers lie within the manor itself. Can Simone save House Illeston? Or will she die trying...?

(Source: Tapas)

When Hwang Mok-Yeon’s friend-with-benefits Chae Sun-Hwa proposes a threesome, he’s only mildly intrigued until he hears who the third is. His target? Eun Nan-Jo: wealthy, polite, and perfectly presentable…but, according to Sun-Hwa, hopelessly boring in bed. At first, it’s just curiosity. But once the three of them are tangled in sheets, Mok-Yeon finds he can’t take his eyes off Nan-Jo...not even for a moment. And when he realizes Nan-Jo may be more interested in saving Sun-Hwa than claiming him, Mok-Yeon makes a quiet, dangerous offer. He leans in and says, “I want you. Do you think you could spread your legs for me?”

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

display_title: My Mad Fake Marriage to Maddie
description:
As the legitimate heir to the imperial throne, Yullikian kuhn Rondenez is desperate to find a way to keep his usurping uncle from killing him next. Frequenting the slums to make it seem like he's become a gambler, he crosses paths with Maddie, a notorious pickpocket who is willing to do anything for the right price, even kill. That's when he comes up with a crazy plan. Yullikian proposes to Maddie to get his uncle off his back, but will this fake marriage lead to mad love or just madness?

(Source: Tapas)

The Caretakers' Council is a group of dedicated servants with only one goal: to nurse terminally ill Arelyn Halbern back to health. But Arelyn is already resigned to her fate, knowing she's simply an extra in a novel meant to die young. That is, until Crown Prince Pession Allermand takes an interest in her. Now, Pession visits Arelyn daily, nagging her to eat better, play, and be more active. With the novel's male lead lending his strength, can Arelyn finally find the will to fight her illness?

(Source: Tapas)

Cheong-Yeon is an academic legend with a soul of ice. To save his college applications from a failing character evaluation, he agrees to mentor Su-Han, the school’s most notorious troublemaker. Su-Han earns nothing but zeroes and lives with zero motivation. While Cheong-Yeon only wants his college recommendation, Su-Han just wants to be left alone. As they clash over study habits and life choices, the top student begins to find his missing empathy and emotions in the most unexpected place.

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: The Black Leopard Family's Snow Leopard Baby
description:
The child of a black leopard and a snow leopard shapeshifter, 7-year-old Tiel escapes her abusive family to seek refuge with the father she never knew. All she wants is safety, but her father, the feared Duke Asterian, has other plans... to give his long-lost daughter a loving family and a wonderful home! Now, Tiel is set on protecting her family from the evil forces who want to take her away. Can she fight these foes to save her new home? Or will Tiel lose her loved ones once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)

Tae-Yang thought he'd never see Ji-Wan again after their messy breakup, but fate and the media have other plans. Now a heroic firefighter with a documentary deal, Tae-Yang reunites with his producer ex at the broadcasting station... except Ji-Wan is doing everything he can to avoid him. But then, why does he have a seven-year-old kid with the same name as Tae-Yang? Once he secures seven dates with Ji-Wan as "payment" for using his name, it's up to Tae-Yang to do some detective work and win over his reluctant ex in seven Sundays.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Woo-Ri Nam has always been the golden boy—wealthy, carefree, and untouchably lucky. But on the leap day of 2028, his 7th real birthday, everything changes. A seemingly harmless reunion with an old classmate, Su-Bin Shin, ends in a brutal murder. And then, inexplicably, Woo-Ri wakes up back in high school, right beside Su-Bin who has no idea that he just killed his deskmate. Trapped in a deadly time loop where almost every timeline ends with his death at Su-Bin’s hands, Woo-Ri becomes desperate to escape his fate. After multiple resets, Woo-Ri finally comes to the conclusion that the only path to survival may be ensuring Su-Bin’s happiness. With just one life left, Woo-Ri sets out to give Su-Bin the happiest life possible.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Baby Fairy Is a Villainess
description:
Since awakening as a fairy, Lichesia the Enchantress was constantly on the run from fairy hunters wanting to sell her. Now, hoping to learn who was really behind the hunters, she poses as 5-year-old Chesha to infiltrate the mysterious House Basillian... by getting adopted! But Count Basillian and his three sons are a peculiar bunch, and while they spoil Chesha, the count seems to be plotting something sinister. Can the Enchantress get her revenge and make it out of this strange house alive?

(Source: Tapas)

Minjun wished for the world to end-- until it did. When a zombie appears at his door, the bullied teen chooses to fight for survival. Teaming up with Yena, his sassy yet charming classmate, he flees the collapsing city. Hunted by the infected and haunted by enemies old and new, they discover that in a world without rules, trust may be their only chance at survival.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Mi-A was Tae-Su's first love, who suddenly disappeared one day. After five years of silence, she reappears as a freshman at his university. But she's not the girl he remembers. He plays it cool, trying to ignore her, but can first love truly be forgotten? Or will fate give them a second chance?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

display_title: The Prince Doesn't Cry Over Onions
description:
After the war, Anna’s restaurant held her village together. She took in strays and sowed farms from war-torn fields. When the lumbering bear of a man, Bertram, wanders into town, she puts him to work chopping onions. He doesn’t shed a single tear. Instead, he offers his services to repay a debt to her late father. Meanwhile, Bertram, stripped of his ability to feel emotion, is not immune to Anna’s warmth. As forces converge around the village, a charming tale of curses, loss, and love simmers.

(Source: Tapas)

To pay off his parents’ debt, Hyeon-Do is sold into an arrangement as the fake fiancé of a powerful conglomerate heir. His supposed partner, Yi-Sak, is an infamous alpha known for his volatility, a man others call mad. Yet when Yi-Sak realizes his uncontrollable pheromones only calm in Hyeon-Do’s presence, their dangerous charade begins to blur into something else. As secrets pile up and emotions tangle, Hyeon-Do must keep his true identity hidden long enough to survive the wedding or risk being devoured by the man he’s bound to marry.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After being killed by the obsessive male lead Killian, Ines finds herself back in the real world as Sum. Determined to live differently this time, Sum resolves to finally claim a happy ending. But to her shock, she meets Haewon Lee, a school celebrity who looks exactly like Killian. As Sum grows confused by Haewon’s kindness-- so unlike the arrogant and violent Killian she once knew-- Haewon hides his true intentions, carefully shaping himself into someone Sum would love. What awaits them in the future?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Rogue Producer Survives as an Idol
description:
Seo Hoyoon, the genius producer of a popular idol survival show, is infamous for his sharp tongue and coldheartedness. Cursed by a trainee for it, he wakes up as a member of a flop idol group called "The Dawn." To avoid being stuck in this parallel world forever, Hoyoon must make his group top-tier... but with the competitive industry and challenging tasks, it won't be easy. With his wits, know-how, and a little help from those around him, will this producer-turned-idol make it big?

(Source: Tapas)

*"Did that... just move?!"*

U-Jin, a totally average engineering student, accidentally buys an onahole that syncs with women around him.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Irae wakes up in the hospital, married but with no memory of the wedding or her husband. To everyone else, he’s the perfect man, but to her, he’s a tentacled cosmic horror! Bewildered by the gap between memory and reality, she wonders... Is this really just an aftereffect of her accident?

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Devoured: The Serpent and the Pomegranate
description:
In the blessed land of Trastasa, Na-in is the cherished companion of Amon, the great and omnipotent god. Though Amon treats him with apparent tenderness, his cruel and indifferent ways haunt Na-in's every moment. When a striking servant with rare pink features called Rhan Gwen arrives, Na-in expects to lose Amon's attention. Instead, he discovers something unsettling… Rhan Gwen shows no interest in Amon, only in Na-in himself. As this mysterious yet beautiful man offers the gentle understanding Na-in has always craved, he faces an impossible choice between familiar darkness and uncertain warmth.

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Crawling My Way to the Top!
description:
With money, looks, and a successful career, Seongguk has it all. That is, until he dies and is reborn as a baby! To make things worse, his new parents are dead broke. However, alongside his new loving family, Seongguk soon learns that perhaps some things are better than money... not! He's going to have loving parents and money in this life, and there's no better time to start than now. Armed with an adorable face and the skills of a business tycoon, can Seongguk take his new family to the top?

(Source: Tapas)

Sujeong writes romance novels but has never lived one. A proud homebody and a self-proclaimed loner, she's content on her own—until the sly and irresistible Seunghyeon crashes into her life and turns it upside down. His charm feels dangerous, yet impossible to resist. Now Sujeong must find out: is he the love that she's been waiting for... or the heartbreak she never saw coming?

(Source: WEBTOON)

For 10 years, Pyung-Hwa Gong and Sae-Byuk Shin have kept their love a secret from family and friends. But then, the alpha and omega pair invite their old classmates to their daughter's first birthday party, ready to reveal their unbelievable love story. Strap in for the romance of a lifetime!

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Diana's Dearest Is the Family's Favorite
description:
After traveling back in time, Lia finds herself in the orphanage where she spent her childhood just before Diana, the lost daughter of Duke Ellad, arrives. Remembering with regret how she once ignored Diana's mistreatment in the orphanage, she vows to protect her until her family finds her. The two grow close, and she sees her life unfolding in an unexpected way as she is welcomed into House Ellad with Diana. Will Lia find happiness in her second life, surrounded by love she's never known?

(Source: Tapas)

After a messy breakup with a trashy ex forces I-Hyeon Seon to take a three-year-long break from college, the last thing she wants to do upon her not-so-inconspicuous return is to dive straight into another relationship. But then comes Chan-U Nam, a notorious bad boy who finds himself having a vested interest in I-Hyeon. And suddenly, what was supposed to be a low-key senior year is looking like it's going to be anything but. The harder I-Hyeon pushes Chan-U away, the stronger he keeps pulling her back. But something’s gotta give – so who’s giving in first?

(Source: WEBTOON)

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

display_title: Destined To Be Loved by the Villains
description:
After a night of playing "Savior Rising," Daud Campbell wakes up in the game as an unimpressive minor character. Despite his plans to lay low and avoid trouble, he runs into both the final boss and the main hero on his first day at the game's academy. As Daud struggles to make it through the game, he only seems to attract more danger, including the attention of evil characters. Will the love of these powerful villains help Daud survive till the end? Or are they just too wicked for his own good?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Once the greatest mage and Grand Magus of the White Tower, Oscar Sage dies in a war against The Demon Emperor—only to awaken twenty years later as the disgraced noble, Oscar Crusian. The once-mighty White Tower lies in ruins, and rival factions hold control over military and resources. With his mana circuits sealed and former allies now enemies, Oscar must rebuild the White Tower, seek vengeance, and reclaim his power before the Mage Council exiles him for good. Will magic rise again or will it be buried forever?

(Source: WEBTOON)

For Olivia Madeleine, illegitimate daughter of a duke, her only hope of a better life away from her cold-hearted family is her betrothal to arrogant crown prince Leoford Franz. When the revelation of his tryst with another debutante comes as an unsurprising wake-up call, she has no choice but to barter for her freedom with Edwin Lowell Vikander, the ruthless, war-hardened Grand Duke of the north. As her dangerous dance with Edwin begins, Olivia seeks to leave her former fiancé with the coldest gift that vengeance can impart… A heart made bitter with regret.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Goh Yu-Min, the eldest son of an endangered black-footed wildcat clan, has never even met a female of his own kind and is doomed to a lifelong single status. Now freshly in heat and losing his mind to breeding instinct, he catches wind of a secret rumor: a male wildcat can perfectly pair with a human man and impregnate him without fail. Determined to continue his family line, Yu-Min sneaks into Hanguk University in search of the most beautiful and brilliant man he can find, and that is where he meets Beom Tae-Jun, a stunning senior with an irresistible body. Yu-Min sets aside his pride and desperately attempts to court him, only to end up pinned beneath Tae-Jun on his own bed. To his shock, Yu-Min realizes he is the one being “bred,” not the other way around. Even as he tries to escape, he finds himself addicted to Tae-Jun’s touch.

Can Yu-Min break free, or will he lose himself completely before he can secure the baby wildcat needed to carry on his family’s bloodline?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Struggling streamer Do-Yeon Choi downloads a mysterious dating sim game, Heart-Racing Ghost Dating Sim, only to find himself trapped in a deadly loop-- where the love interests are real-life ghosts with unresolved deaths. From haunted highways to murder cases, Do-Yeon must navigate a world where romance, horror, and mystery collide. Every wrong move could cost him his life...again.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Kim Isaac, once the all-powerful Skeleton King, is now a baby in a onesie. Tricked by the gods and sealed away, he’s reincarnated into a family of saints at the heart of the Holy Empire. He can’t walk or talk, but he can plot. And with his loyal demon followers working from the shadows and a grudge deeper than the underworld itself, this baby isn’t here to be cute—he’s here for payback. The Holy Empire has no idea what's coming… and the gods are about to regret ever crossing the Skeleton King.

(Source: Tapas)

Jo Ji-Won is just your average college kid—well, except for the part where he scams people by pretending to be a shaman. Thanks to his silver tongue and some lucky guesses, he gains a reputation as a spiritual powerhouse. Unfortunately, word gets around… all the way to Jeong Tae-Oh, a superstitious mob boss who actually believes in that stuff. When Tae-Oh shows up demanding help, Ji-Won pretends to take the job—then immediately tries to run. Too bad he gets caught. 

He wakes up in a sketchy motel, staring death in the face. Thinking fast, Ji-Won blurts out: "Y-you need me as a talisman! To stay alive, we have to… sleep together!"

He’s sure a tough guy like Tae-Oh would bolt at the thought. Instead, Tae-Oh just shrugs.

 *"You should’ve said so earlier. Is once enough or do we need more?"*

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jeong-Cheol is a gambler, a failure, and now a divorcé after ten years of a marriage that finally collapsed. Before he can even catch his breath or curse his miserable luck, the very person who started it all returns to his life. Ji Min-Yeong, the ex-lover who terrified him, chased him, and yet was the one he loved more deeply than anyone else, appears without warning. Standing before him with the same chilling certainty as in the past, Min-Yeong whispers the words Jeong-Cheol fears most:

*“I will stay with you until the moment you die, Cheol."*

(Source: Lezhin US)

120 years have passed since the First Emperor’s death. Venlyra, a powerful rogue and trusted herald of the Emperor, awakens from a long slumber to a crumbling empire that has strayed from the light. Once more, the Skeleton Messenger makes the rounds, bound for a decaying throne, and for the embers of a self long thought extinguished within. Hear ye, hear ye! Hark, and heed the Emperor’s words! The hour of reckoning is upon you!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Mysterious black towers have appeared all over the world. Inside them are monsters, danger, and the promise of power and fame. Only a select few are chosen to enter as players. Everyone calls it a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, but 25-year-old Ju-Hyeok Bong calls it a death sentence. He is a timid, anxious self-proclaimed “wimp,” perfectly content with staying under the radar… That is, until he is named as a player. Will he risk everything by entering the tower, or keep running from the one chance that could change his life?

(Source: WEBTOON)

In a world where you must steal or be stolen, kill or be killed, Ray, an orphan from the 50th sector, possesses the unique ability to see mana in the form of colors. However, despite the colorful sparks that fill the world around him, his existence has been numb detachment, completely devoid of emotions. But when a life-altering event shatters the cold, unfeeling life he once knew, Ray's journey might just unfold into a story richer in color than he could have ever imagined.

(Source: WEBTOON)

When a perpetually overlooked supporting actor dies wishing to be jaw-droppingly handsome, he's reborn as Ma Gongja, a ridiculously beautiful baby who was left outside an orphanage. After a famous actress adopts him, Gongja suddenly has fame, fortune, and everyone falling for his cuteness, but he's just getting started! Armed with acting skills, this charming child is determined to become the most dazzling star there is, but will his stunning looks cause more trouble than he bargained for?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Unorthodox Genius of the House of Darkness
description:
The world has ended. I was a genius hero, but my efforts were too little, too late—I couldn’t stop the Blood Demon Emperor. As I died, I prayed for a second chance... but this isn't what I meant! Of all people, I’ve become Christian, a rogue member of the House of Dark Demons. As if that wasn’t enough, the world is still ending in just five years. There's only one way to save it: I must become the emperor myself and stop the war! I know it sounds ridiculous, but I’m a genius—I can make it work!

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The S-Class Hunter’s Peaceful Life with Monsters
description:
Chimera hunter Number 17 has spent decades hunting monsters. On his latest mission, he’s ordered to ensure the human hunters’ escape and never return to base. In other words, he’s meant to die. As his body dissolves, his life flashes before him: kidnapped as a boy, forced into endless battles, reduced to a mindless weapon. But against all odds, his body reforms into his human form. No longer Chimera Hunter Number 17, he stands before a vast open land on his own two feet as Do-un Cheon, a human, ready to start his life anew, making friends out of monsters and building the family he never had. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

All Yun Je-Jin wanted was to succeed in life by climbing his way out of misery and misfortune - but his life takes a nosedive when he ends up a debt collector’s target, all because he co-signed a loan for a friend. With nothing to his name and revenge on his mind, Je-Jin decides to pay it off the hard way...by becoming a gangster himself. But unbeknownst to him, someone’s been watching his back: Choi Taek-Mu, a thug with a heart as big as his muscles, and a not-so-secret crush on the rookie mobster. As the two work together toward Je-Jin’s goal, vengeance might not be the only thing that’s coming in red hot…

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Youngest Has Much To Hide
description:
Amid the chaos of war, young Rubian realizes a shocking truth: she’s trapped in a novel where the hero dies suddenly, plunging the world into disaster. Luckily, fate leads Rubian to enter the hero's household—giving her the perfect chance to stick close, prevent his death, and leave once the crisis passes. Yet the warmth and affection she receives from his family are unlike anything she's ever known, making it harder to remember that she’s there to stop a tragedy… not start a slice-of-life!

(Source: Tapas)

Kim Hana is reincarnated as Wilhelmina, a fallen noblewoman whose fate takes a turn when she's married off to the wealthy House Layton. But there’s a catch—her husband is already dead, leaving her to become the Dowager Duchess. Younger than her new stepson and his wife, she must navigate the treacherous waters of high society and a daughter-in-law determined to make her life miserable. Will she find a way to remedy this family drama or be unfairly painted as the monster-in-law she’s not?

(Source: Tapas)

As an avid reader of romance fantasy novels, I wasn't that surprised when I transmigrated into one. But I didn't expect it to be a multiplayer VR game beta test! Luckily, the 99 other girls are super nice, and they caught me up: all we have to do is pick a male lead and reach a happy ending. Here's the catch... We're being ranked, and the more eligible our suitor is, the more money we'll get at the end. In this game that tries to pit us against each other, can female solidarity conquer all?

(Source: Tapas)

Once reviled as the wicked magician Hailey, the most hated woman in the realm, she was cast into a poisoned wasteland to die. But death never came. A year later, she’s alive and farming, bickering with a tree fairy, and somehow the new Marchioness Maron. As secrets of the contamination zone begin to surface and the ghosts of her past return, Hailey must decide whether to seek vengeance or build something new from ruins. When survival itself becomes the greatest twist of fate, who needs revenge?

(Source: Tapas)

Everyone dreams of knocking out their insufferable boss, but what if that boss is a war hero, a duke, and constantly breathing down your neck? For Chloe, enduring Curtis's relentless inspections was a daily struggle... Until a royal marriage decree offers her an unexpected way out. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

In a world where warriors are chosen to wield a holy sword and defeat the Demon Lord every hundred years, Kariel is only a guide, bound to support others from the sidelines. He dreams of rising beyond his rank, but the Demon Lord of this era has already been slain. Despite this, the world begins to unravel instead of heal. Monsters grow unpredictable, a mysterious knight hunts champions, and secret organizations move in the shadows. Traveling with his childhood friend Reina, Kariel is drawn into a dangerous mystery that may determine the fate of the world.

(Source: WEBTOON)

When Yuri Gable first pulled the young Ling Xinlu out from the ocean, he didn’t expect the two of them to ever meet again, especially not at gunpoint. Danger always seems to follow their encounters, though it isn’t until Xinlu messes with the wrong psycho and loses both his first love and an eye that the two men finally find the chance to open up to each other. But how will their relationship progress when Xinlu has no memory of Yuri saving him before and only recalls a man who seemingly left him for dead underwater?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Kang Hyo-in has been secretly in love with his best friend of eight years, Jin Ye-geon, nd he’s finally ready to turn that crush into something more. Armed with a meticulous plan to win Ye-geon’s heart, Hyo-in is determined to confess the “right” way. But one drunken night he can’t even remember throws everything off track, and suddenly they’re dating before he can make sense of what happened. Now there’s just one burning question he can’t ignore: what exactly did they do… and which one of them ended up on the bottom?! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

Love, money, fame… They all come to Paradise Island chasing different things, but what they find is a nightmare. Oreum joins 15 other participants on a reality dating show, hoping to win prize money that could save her sister’s life. But when a mysterious virus spreads, turning people into flesh-hungry monsters, trust crumbles, terror rises, and Oreum’s only goal becomes making it out alive.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Don’t judge a book by its cover! Eugene is a powerful mage whose appearance can frighten anyone out of their wits, but all this kind-hearted soul wants to do is teach Ain, the daughter of his master, so she can become the next archmage. Can his curriculum help her navigate through the world of magic and become the second-greatest mage of all time?

(Source: WEBTOON)

When Archduke Cesare returns from war, Eileen barely recognizes the man she once knew—he's cold, commanding, and burning with unspoken desire. But nothing shakes her more than his sudden proposal. As old feelings stir, Eileen must choose: take his hand, or flee before his fire consumes her.

(Source: Manta)

When Han Ina wakes up as game villainess Tulia Frasier, with absolutely trash stats and a garbage personality, a status window tells her she must reach Rank A or die. Determined to succeed, she starts making strategic moves, striving to gain the recognition of her grandfather, the grand duke, and earn the affection of the male leads in order to rank up and ensure her survival. But with members of her own family plotting to take her out, can Tulia clean up her act before it's too late?

(Source: Tapas)

In the game world of Pangaenia, Hyeon-Myeong is known as “the Phantom,” an anonymous legend admired by players. In real life, however, he is jobless and still getting over his recent breakup. When his character is killed and permanently deleted, his only remaining goal to become the first gamer to beat Pangaenia is shattered. Soon, however, Pangaenia begins to merge with the real world, and Hyeon-Myeong gets a chance to start over--this time, with 13 hidden traits. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Sanghyeon has the uncanny ability to absorb powers of magical artifacts—by devouring them. But it took him thirty years to master, and at fifty-five, it’s too late to escape mediocrity. Then one day, he’s miraculously sent back in time to the fateful day he awakened his powers as a monster-hunting player. With a chance for a do-over, he wastes no time using his ability to its full potential, rapidly absorbing incredible powers and rising through the ranks, determined to become the hero he always dreamed of being.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Olivia Liberty is the first commoner ever admitted to Herolington University. However, she cannot be properly recognized because she is a woman and must instead use the name of a man, Oliver, to receive credit for her creations. Meanwhile, Noah Astrid, Prince of Herod, takes notice of Olivia, who is beloved by the commoners of Herod. Noah seeks to involve her in royal affairs to raise the royal family’s popularity and asks for her hand. But while every other member of the royal family treats Olivia affectionately, Noah alone continues to treat her coldly. Will he come to regret it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

After his brutal death at the sword of a rival head merchant, Seoho Eun finds he’s been given a new opportunity when he reawakens in his younger body, decades earlier! Now armed with years of learned wisdom and first-hand knowledge of future events, the young master is determined to use this chance to right his wrongs, make better choices, and give himself, his guild, and especially his family, everything they deserve!

(Source: Tapas)

While pursuing a case, Detective I-Eum Kim of the Violent Crimes Unit rescues a man collapsed on a mountain trail. Stricken with amnesia, the man believes himself to be a child... Thus begins I-Eum's dangerous cohabitation with a mysterious stranger.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Shards of a Broken Glass Slipper
description:
Siché lost everything to her stepsister, Roena. Love, reputation, and family all shattered like a broken glass slipper. She was framed as Cinderella’s evil stepsister, hated for merely existing in high society. Her resentful last words should have been the end of her suffering... But the reality was far more devastating. Siché had traveled back in time to the day she met Roena. This time, Siché will quench her thirst for vengeance. After all, the glass slippers were never meant for her anyway.

(Source: Tapas)

Feared as the Divine Demon, Cheon Jeong lived and died on the battlefield, knowing nothing but violence. When death finally claims him, it should have been the end. Instead, he awakens thirty years later in the body of Mujin Hwa, the powerless heir of a ruined clan. His overwhelming strength is gone, replaced by a frail body and enemies closing in from every side. To protect the siblings now in his care and reclaim a clan on the brink of collapse, the fallen legend must begin again and build a future from nothing.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ilex Davenport had it all—a noble title, top grades at the academy, and a reputation as its biggest playboy. He was living proof the world wasn't fair. Tilia Ambrose hated him for it. While he coasted through life, she was fighting to escape her toxic family. So how did she end up in his bed?

(Source: Manta)

After 30 years in the other world and defeating the demon lord, Cheolho Kang finally returns to Earth-- only to find it overrun with monsters and hunters. Tired of endless battles, he opens a small restaurant and wishes to live in peace. With dishes to make and a baby dragon to raise, a heartwarming tale where every visitor brings a story is set to begin.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Shall I Write Your Love Letter?
description:
Employee-of-the-Month champion and service-industry all-rounder Lim Seongshik thought he’d seen everything, until he wakes up inside a bleak BL novel as none other than Elliot Brown, a minor villain doomed to die. In the original story, everyone meets their end at the hands of the protagonist, Arzen Theron. So Elliot decides to keep his past life as a writer hidden, lie low, and quietly avoid the one event that triggers the tragedy: ghost-writing a love letter. 

But life—and his cat—have other plans. A desperate situation forces him into becoming Arzen’s personal bed attendant, of all things. To make matters worse, his “secret identity” as a writer gets exposed to the novel’s original love interest. Before he knows it, Elliot is back to ghost-writing letters… this time for Arzen himself! But something’s off. The Arzen in front of him doesn’t match the cruel lead he remembers... 

Can Elliot keep faking those letters just enough to dodge his scripted death ending? Or has the story already started to change?

(Source: Lezhin US)

When orphan Rosie learns of her brother Julian and that they are a part of the esteemed House Noart, she gains both riches and the greatest treasure of all—the pure love of family. But after an accident causes Julian to lose all memory of recent years, including Rosie's existence, she discovers House Noart has many hidden enemies. Preventing her family from falling to ruin is one thing, but will these siblings be able to prove that blood is not just thicker than water but lost memories as well?

(Source: Tapas)

Radan should have lived a blessed life as a prince, but a dark curse doomed him to become a killer the moment he was born. And when his mission to assassinate the prince of an enemy nation goes awry, Radan finds himself at the mercy of his target, Crown Prince Leshak. Unaware of Radan’s true identity, Leshak shows him kindness instead of cruelty. Now that he's caught between his duty to his family and his blossoming feelings for Leshak, Radan must choose between being a lover or a killer...

(Source: Tappytoon)

In a world where only Guides can stabilize Espers, Wonwoo, a soldier and Purifier, is swept into a parallel world through a mysterious fog, where he faces his dying self and gets a second chance at life. As he starts anew, he encounters the ruler of the North, Yoon, who seems strangely familiar... 

(Source: Manta)

As an S-Class agent at the top-secret intel firm Vulture, Adrian "Killy" Rosebarton (Codename: Uno) is the master of seduction, able to charm secrets out of literally anyone regardless of age, gender, or profession. But when he sets his sights on his newest target, Lorenzo “Loren” Stefano, things take a rotten turn. No matter how hard he flirts, Loren just won’t bite - and Uno’s pride (and mission) are about to crumble. If one thing is certain, it’s that this is no ordinary mark. This one’s a bad apple: poisonous if swallowed, impossible to spit out, and dangerously tempting.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Minseok loses his daughter again and again in a world overrun by zombies. He’s been mysteriously given 100 lives to save her and has watched her die in 99 of them. On his final one, he dies before they even make it out the front door–except this time, he wakes as a zombie. But a zombie papa still has a father’s heart. Now stronger than ever, he’s ready to take on the world to protect his baby girl.

(Source: WEBTOON)

When Lily became the princess's maid due to their uncanny resemblance, she never thought she would one day be forced to impersonate royalty and marry a prince! What was supposed to be a one-time farce quickly spirals out of control, forcing her to leave behind everything she knows and plunging her into a world of secrets and schemes. As she finds herself at the center of a fierce power struggle between princes, Lily must decide what's more important to her — her identity or her life.

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

display_title: At the Lake Where Waves Crash
description:
Tensions are brewing in late 19th century Ireland, shortly before the Irish War of Independence. Author Raymond Ler Lyndon lives isolated in his romantic clifftop mansion, scorned by his fellow countrymen as a traitor while he waits for his long departed beloved to return. But when Owen, his first love's son, saves him from certain death, he is given a second chance at reclaiming the lover who abandoned him. Meanwhile, the rebellion is gaining traction and Owen's behavior grows increasingly suspicious. At the conflict's climax, which will they choose — love or freedom?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.*

Ji-Han Yoo played Hero of Legends but always lost to pro-gamer, Gamgak. Fed up, he jumps ship to a new game, but the guild master, Yoo-Chae, picks a fight over his gamer ID. But when Yoo-Chae finds out Ji-Han used to play HoL, he becomes obsessed. Can Ji-Han withstand Yoo-Chae's relentless pursuit?

(Source: Manta)

Yoon is a free agent, using his extraordinary strength and cunning for any job that comes his way—legal or otherwise. But when a crucial mistake plunges him headfirst into the world of a shadowy crime network known only as the “platform,” he enlists the help of a well-connected alpha named Kwon Shin-Woo. Together, these reluctant allies will have to uncover the mysteries of the nefarious platform… and each other..

(Source: Tappytoon)

Jinah has a secret habit: she can’t fall asleep without the explicit ASMR videos of a mysterious YouTuber named NA. It’s the only thing that calms her insomnia, even if the creator’s voice and trademark lip mole are hauntingly familiar. But when her company hosts a workshop featuring the internet's hottest star, Jinah’s digital fantasy becomes a physical nightmare. NA is actually Heo Jina, the high school "friend" who stole Jinah's first love and left her life in ruins. Now, it turns out the woman who ruined her is the only one who can make her feel alive...

(Source: Lezhin US)

The F12 Center is infamous for one thing—its dangerously high superhuman burnout rate. And that’s exactly where civilian diagnostics officer Baek Shi-Jin is suddenly transferred. On his first day, Shi-Jin is approached by Jeong Tae-Yool, an A-rank Guide with a reputation as sharp as his instincts, under the guise of an admin worker.

 *“Just stop giving Ham Geon-Woo your attention, and we’ll get along fine.”*

Shi-Jin only wanted to repay Ham Geon-Woo, the Esper who saved him a decade ago. But somehow, his highest match rate is with Tae-Yool—who sees right through him.

 *"Doc, are you really using seduction to request a scan?”*

From then on, Tae-Yool seems to appear everywhere—especially when Shi-Jin’s in danger.

 *“If this were a real emergency, Alpha Team would be here to protect you in under 60 seconds.”*

What kind of ending awaits a sharp-eyed Superhuman and a guarded civilian doctor?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Hot-to-Go Bakery: How to Tame a Wolf
description:
Chan-Woo's neighbors are all nervous when a scary wolf named Eun-Jae moves into their villa. Being a friendly big dog, Chan-Woo tries to be a good neighbor to the cold and gruff wolf, even giving him cream puffs from his favorite bakery. But when Eun-Jae goes into heat for the first time, Chan-Woo's about to get stuffed with a different kind of cream for trying too hard to help...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Min-U Seo, a struggling nobody, never thought he'd inherit anything, especially not from the mother who abandoned him. However, what he received was beyond anything he could have imagined... A kindergarten for divine beasts! Will Min-U be able to look after these magical children as their new teacher?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Lorena chose death to take revenge on the husband who ruined her life. Thrown back in time, she is determined to rewrite her destiny, protect her family, and destroy her husband. There’s only one way to win: a scandalous divorce.

*“I need a wild dog… because I’m going to hunt down a hound.”*

A dangerous alliance. A deadly deal. Will she be able to take everything back this time?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Lee-Hyeon, an intern, drops by the convenience store on his way home from work and there's something different about the part-timer.

*"She's not wearing anything right now, right?"*

I'm so confused...

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

display_title: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life
description:
Once a loyal hound to a powerful magic family, Aster was used, betrayed, and killed. But death wasn’t the end—it was a second chance. Back in the back alleys of his youth, Aster now holds the future’s secrets in his hands. This time, he won’t serve anyone. Can a man who once served power learn to become his own master? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Grand Duke’s Bride is a Warrior from Hell
description:
Alicia Sirius Rayne, a timid, stuttering spinster betrothed to the rumored "Grand Duchess Serial Killer," falls into Hell after opening a mysterious artifact. Now, she must adapt to survive. Years later, she has become a fierce warrior. But as she sets out to conquer all of Hell -- she wakes up in the past. Armed with a second chance at life and a new goal, Alicia must actively pursue the feared Grand Duke Reikart Tessen to secure her destiny. Can this fierce warrior from Hell win the heart of the man who has "killed" six grand duchesses?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Where does one find the top shamans and the most reliable fortune tellers in the country? Welcome to the stock exchange, where one prediction could make or break billions. This is their all-star match, world series, medal of arts, and olympics all rolled into one. Follow the story of Jiseung Cheon, as he breaks into the world of occult and finance, one shamanic ritual at a time.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Archmage Becomes the Swordmaster's Youngest Daughter
description:
Rosette was a mage and assassin who lived as a mere tool, mistaking control for love, until her choices led her to kill Duke Adrian, the Empire’s legendary swordmaster. Haunted by regret, she uses ancient magic to send herself back in time and fix everything that went wrong. However, although she succeeds in returning to her childhood, she ends up being adopted by the very duke she murdered in her past life. Will Rosette’s knowledge of both magic and the future be enough to rewrite a tragic destiny and change fate itself?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Everyone's talking about how troublemaker Demian Haxen's suddenly become a devoted son and brother. What they don't realize is that he's returned to the past after spending decades as the brainwashed death knight of Dorgo, the archlich who murdered Demian's family. Given a second chance at life, Demian's out to power up and protect his family to defeat Dorgo when he comes to conquer the world. But will Demian alone be enough to prevent the apocalypse? Or will his failure mean death for them all?

(Source: Tapas)

How is the reincarnated heroine supposed to survive as Enrica, a powerless noble lady who gets killed by her archduke husband on her wedding night? Fortunately, a mysterious but kind Count Belbrington hears Enrica's plight, suggests that she find another man to marry, and even says yes to her following proposal! Everything seems strangely smooth sailing from there. Not only is Enrica's power-hungry father surprisingly cool with her marrying a man of lower status, but the murderous archduke isn't retaliating at her for breaking off their engagement, either. Something's not adding up, but what could it be...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Hyeonsu's life took a turn for the worse when a fire left him covered in burns, his father in the hospital, and their family smithy in a blaze. But just as he was losing hope, his friend had an idea: If he can't be a blacksmith in real life, why not try it in Ares, the AI-powered virtual reality game? With a bit of luck, he might make enough money there to pay for his father's hospital bills. With so many irons in the fire, can Hyeonsu rekindle the flame of his passion and rise from the ashes?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Returned C-Rank Tank Won't Die!
description:
Betrayed by her team and abandoned to die in a dungeon, timid C-rank hunter Cho-i Hyeon discovers a cursed ring that keeps her alive by endlessly regenerating her body. Time stretches into years as she’s killed over and over, unable to escape. When she finally does, she’s no longer the girl who was left behind. Stronger, colder, and haunted by something growing inside her, she wants answers -- and revenge. But the ring may have a will of its own, and its true cost is only beginning to surface. Whatever it is, it may already be too late to stop.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Ha-Na runs into a suspicious saleswoman on the street who hands her a bath gel sample, saying it'll give her what she truly needs. Intrigued by this cryptic message, Ha-Na goes home and tries out the bath gel, only to be seized by tentacles that suddenly pop out of the water! Thankfully, her childhood friend, Won-Hoo, walks in and saves her, but Hana wants to die of embarrassment. Even so, she can't help accepting more weird "self-care" products from the mysterious saleswoman. Will her questionable samples be the key to helping Hana relax and get closer to Won-Hoo?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Once known as the White Night Witch, Alisia is reborn without her powers as a young princess neglected by her father, the emperor. When she regains her magic after hearing the news of his death in battle, she plans to rule the chaotic empire herself... That is, until the emperor returns alive. Now, Alisia must mend fences with her father while also handling schemes and secrets lurking around them. Will these two, so different yet so similar, make amends and work together? Or is it all too late?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Noble in Name, Vulgar at Heart
description:
Ariana, born into a politically arranged marriage, was nothing more than a tool, used and abused by her family her entire life. On her 28th birthday, she was tragically killed, yearning for a love that never came. Perhaps out of pity, a mysterious force sent her back to when she was 16. Reflecting on her painful past, she makes a vow:

*"I shall beg for love no longer. I will never love nor be loved again."*

(Source: WEBTOON)

Cheon Yu-Hyeon is so close to inheriting the family business when his ailing father presents one condition: he needs to give his father a grandchild. It shouldn’t be too hard for an omega like Yu-Hyeon, as long as he can find himself a suitable alpha that isn’t his childhood friend and company rival Lee Hyeon-Do. But Hyeon-Do has been suffering a decade-long crush on Yu-Hyeon and desperately wants to be his baby daddy. And Yu-Hyeon is finding it harder to resist his friend’s flirty tactics to get him in bed...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Uce, a down-on-his-luck young man, dreams of becoming the champion in the brutal and legendary War of Corpses—a sport where necromancers and their knights battle for supremacy. In a desperate bid, he revives Eleonora, an abandoned corpse who claims to have been the deadliest mercenary alive. There are two big problems, though. One, Eleonora is alive — a fact that cannot be revealed at any cost. Two, she and Uce can’t seem to coordinate their movements. Can this unlikely duo overcome all obstacles, win the War of Corpses, and prove everyone wrong?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Black panther Pyo Yoontae returns to So Jeongseo’s small town with one objective: to find his first love who had fur as white as snow. Being the school outcast, Jeongseo decides to help Yoontae in the hopes of finally making a friend. Besides, Yoontae’s first love surely can’t be Jeongseo himself, since he’s a weasel with brown fur. But something about Yoontae feels awfully similar to a forgotten childhood playmate, and there is one secret Jeongseo is keeping from him. Every winter, Jeongseo actually sheds his fur and turns snow-white! 

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: The Duke's Obsession With His Wife
description:
Anriette may look like an average noble, but she's actually a human who's been transported into the world of her favorite novel, cursed by its author for writing fanfics critical of the original ending. And as Anriette, her fate is to be slain by the very male lead she wrote her fanfics about! Can she use her inside knowledge to craft the ending she always dreamed of for her favorite lead?

(Source: Tapas)

Fresh out of the military and eager for a fresh start, Ji-Woo returns to university, ready to slip back into the rhythm of normal campus life. His plans hit a sudden, unavoidable roadblock when he is forced to enroll in a course taught by Professor Ha-Yeong. Ji-Woo absolutely dreads the prospect; he carries a deep-seated resentment toward her, stemming from a painful past where he was subjected to her blatant, unfair treatment. Forced to grit his teeth and endure her lectures, he prepares for a grueling semester of academic power games. However, the dynamic changes entirely when Ji-Woo makes a startling discovery: he accidentally stumbles upon a secret, private account managed by Ha-Yeong. Behind the facade of the strict, demanding educator lies a completely different personality, and as Ji-Woo peers into her hidden world, he finds his perception of his antagonist crumbling and his intrigue growing.

(Source: Lezhin US)

What does it take for an animal to live and survive? What would it choose to die for? A T. rex, washed ashore and stranded on an island for over 20 years, waits for the day he can take his final breath. But just when that moment seems near, hope arrives. 

A collection of stories about the great creatures that have roamed the Earth before us.

(Source: WEBTOON)

1-19. **Gaji Aneun Gil** (가지 않은 길, The Road Not Taken)
20-28. **Pokgun** (폭군, The Tyrant)
29-40. **Manghyang** (폭군, Nostalgia)

After being framed for bullying his bully, Seon-U is forced to transfer to a new school. All he wants there is a peaceful life, but that flies out the window when he meets Sion, who seems friendly on the outside but has a few glaring red flags. Despite Seon-U's efforts to avoid him, Sion becomes his friend with an odd persistence and is obsessive, touchy-feely, and manipulative. Even so, Seon-U wants to trust the only person who seems to see his true self... but can he really let his guard down around him?

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Must the Reincarnated Mother Always Die?
description:
Lilliana is a neglected princess with a single mission: do not get pregnant. Ever since she woke up in a novel where she will die giving birth to the main character, Lilliana has known that her pregnancy will be her death sentence. However, her mission’s greatest obstacle is her new husband, Emperor Helio. Although they have married for political reasons, the ruthless emperor's fondness for Lilliana drives him to decide that his mission is to win her over. Thus begins the battle of wills between wife and husband. Will Lilliana be able to defy destiny and Helio’s affections?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Jayna’s life is a parade of misfortunes: born to a dragon mother who dies early, bullied by other dragons throughout her childhood, disregarded by her human father, and murdered as a teenager. At least, according to the novel she’s been reborn in. At 10 years old, she’s given the chance to live with her father, the Master of the Magic Tower, Diamid. She’s aware her father and destiny will not be kind to her, so her only goal is to enjoy the small luxuries of life until she dies at 17. But will this life truly be the same tragedy?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Number is not your average serial killer. Equipped with the ability to identify future murderers, Number takes the law into his own hands. He believes in ridding the world of destined killers. Simple, right? One day, he runs into Ji-Hyeon, whose number changes constantly as she develops a special power of her own. Will the two work together to eliminate would-be murderers? Or will Ji-Hyeon's very existence threaten Number's moral compass?

(Source: WEBTOON)

When portals called “gates” opened in 1997, humanity was thrown into chaos as monsters ravaged the planet. Countless lives were lost, including Eunha Cha’s mother. Left to fend for herself, Eunha one day mysteriously awakens a new power. Drafted into the military to fight alongside other Hunters, she sets out on what was supposed to be a routine mission inside a C-rank gate. But when she becomes trapped inside, she’s forced to fight relentlessly against waves of monsters as the gate resets endlessly... until a voice calls out to her.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Baek Hwi-Soo has an embarrassing bedroom secret that has earned him the nickname “Cream Can.” But his uncontrollably big load of vitality is just what the starved incubus, Prince Amon, needs to come out of his century-long hibernation. Motivated by a reward of curing his cancer-stricken cat, Pancake, Hwi-Soo comes to the demon world to offer up all the cream from his can to fill the prince’s sweet tooth!

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: My First XXX: The Black Knight Under the Red Curse
description:
Ratan the mage is being pursued by the knights of the inquisition for studying the forbidden Red Curse. When he seeks refuge in The Black Forest, he runs into its deadly resident knight in steel armor who happens to be the curse's victim. Thankfully, Ratan's offer to lift the curse keeps the knight from killing him. But the solution involves some heated action in the bedroom, and Ratan isn't so sure that he'll survive to see another day... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Notes:
\- Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.
\- Includes three extra chapters.*

When Yul finds himself dropped into a BL novel, reincarnated as a stuffed toy that has ended up in the hands of an obsessive, tyrannical duke, he's sure he is done for. If the truth gets out, Yul will be burned at the stake! Can he find a way to get back to his real body or is he doomed to be stuck in this fantasy land?

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

*"Tae Seong-Jae... He’s the one who will take me back home."*

One day, without warning, I woke up as Seo Seung-Won, a character in a BL novel given to me by my younger sister. The aftermath of being transported into this world is brutal—I’m plagued with relentless nosebleeds, bouts of coughing up blood, and unimaginable pain. I discover that staying calm lessens the torment, so I desperately try to empty my mind and maintain my composure. But as my original memories start slipping away day by day, I spiral into despair. Still, I refuse to lose hope. To escape this nightmare and return to reality, I set my sights on the novel’s ending. Following the story’s flow, I resolve to become Tae Seong-Jae’s lover, face abandonment, and eventually fake my own death—all to achieve my goal of going home.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

When a former detective wakes up as Ordelle Kyris, the villainess and fake saint of the novel "Idella the Holy," she is entrusted with the task of saving the Sun God and this world from disappearing forever. However, being a fake, her divine power is close to nothing. And the only way to increase it is... money!
