From securing rich followers to starting a new business, Ordelle strives to gather funds and gain more power. Will this fake yet fiery saint successfully climb the ladder of holiness?

(Source: Tapas)

Sun-Woo Yoon thought he knew who his enemies were, but when he woke up in Yi-Hyun Choi’s home after a night out, it didn’t take him long to learn he was wrong. While he’s angry that Sun-Woo doesn’t even remember him, that’s not enough to change the situation. Yi-Hyun will have his revenge and make Sun-Woo pay for ruining his life. Now that he’s being held captive, the only way out is through. As he starts to remember what they went through as kids, will his reasons for keeping Yi-Hyun happy change?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Hyeong-Sik has one problem: The size of his dick. But he can't say no when he's offered a mysterious series of missions that promise to boost his size. With each challenge growing harder and hotter, will he be able to become a legend?!

*"Take a peek at the landlord's wife's naked body."*

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

As the son of the fallen House Anatold, Michel's only duty is to help his family's social standing by marrying the prominent Duke Shelleg of the north. However, upon his arrival, he is met with the servant Ain, who is acting as the duke's stand-in to teach Michel what it means to be a northern husband. To his surprise, his most important duties take place in the bedroom! Michel is determined to be a proper partner, but what will he do when his newfound feelings for Ain start to get in the way?

(Source: Tapas)

After easily beating the Abyss of the Maze on its highest difficulty, Kaleb faces a new challenge…surviving his favorite video game for real! Even as a powerful mage, Kaleb learns things won’t be as easy as foes pretend to be friends, allies need rescuing, and danger is always a turn away. Armed with an insider’s knowledge and a magic hourglass that allows him to plan devastating attacks, Kaleb must save his friends and prepare for a battle with the Maze Master if he ever wants to get home!

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Adopting the Hero Changed the Genre
description:
Nobody understands why the wicked Belinda Blanche is giving special treatment to her child servant. They don't realize she's actually from the modern world, and her servant's the hero of her favorite childcare game! All Belinda wants is to give the hero the love he deserves, but the game keeps twisting her words to make her sound like a third-rate villain. Can Belinda beat the game and figure out how to fangirl without saying a single kind word? Or will she be forced to play the bad guy forever?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Why the Villainess Wields the Sword
description:
No one knows how the pampered and wicked Erin Lisus suddenly becomes a top swordsman at Atenz Academy. That's because they don't realize that Erin was actually transported to the past after being killed by her stepmother and was reborn into different worlds. Now, with her past experience as a swordmaster, Erin's out to get revenge and rescue her allies from her stepmother's grasp. But with foes at every corner, can Erin save her loved ones? Or will her reason to wield the sword vanish with them?

(Source: Tapas)

Between looming war, fighting nobles, and an overbearing father, Prince Yuri Briol has a lot on his shoulders. He's also carrying knowledge of his past life while trying to change the course of history. This cast of characters includes a famed assassin, a powerful mage, a loyal maid, and a lazy knight among the character-filled kingdom of Briol. Yuri may be the third-born prince, but he could also be the most important factor in his family and kingdom's survival.

(Source: Tapas)

Sang-Nam lives by one unshakable dating philosophy: “before you commit to it, you must hit it.” If the chemistry isn’t right, he won’t even consider a relationship. The problem is, finding someone who actually meets his standards is harder than it sounds. That’s when he notices Da-Ol, a potential hottie with a not-so-sexy body. Sang-Nam casually suggests that he might consider dating Da-Ol if he can “fix” him to suit his tastes, and a nervous but determined Da-Ol agrees. What Sang-Nam doesn’t know is that Da-Ol has a secret preference of his own…and one he definitely hasn’t told anyone yet.

(Source: Lezhin US)

For weeks, a mysterious man has been setting Gyeol’s dreams on fire. By day, Gyeol lives a quiet life as a construction worker. But after locking eyes with a stranger at a job site, his nights are consumed by vivid, erotic dreams that leave him shaken - and wanting more. When he unexpectedly runs into the man again, reality begins to feel just as charged as his fantasies. The stranger introduces himself as Ye-Sung: handsome, magnetic, and impossible to read. His smile is too perfect, his gaze to knowing. He crosses lines without hesitation, drawing Gyeol into a game with no clear rules. As tension smolders between them, Gyeol finds himself spiraling deeper into Ye-Sung’s world, unable to tell where desire ends and danger begins. But play with fire too long, and one is bound to get burned.

(Source: Lezhin US)

At first glance, Yeong-Han seems like an ideal boyfriend, with stellar grades and good looks, but he’s actually infamous for his awful temper. On the other hand, Yae-Joon is mild-mannered and polite, and he loathes people like Yeong-Han. Unfortunately, they have to act as a couple for a college course that assigns pairs to recreate a dating relationship. Yeong-Han is displeased, and Yae-Joon even more so. As the two clash and bicker, they slowly wear down each other’s walls to discover their more vulnerable sides. Will this pretend relationship eventually turn into something more genuine?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Kwak Eun-Ho has spent 11 years as Ji Hyeon’s friend and 7 years as his manager, all the while hiding his huge crush for him. But his secret partially comes to light when the two of them shoot a variety show called “Check Out My Manager,” and Eun-Ho drops a bombshell during the interview: “There is someone I’m interested in.” This greatly irks Hyeon, who believes there is someone in Eun-Ho’s life that he doesn’t know about. But that “someone” would have been so obvious if only Hyeon could have checked out his manager just a little more...

(Source: Tappytoon)

At 29, Eun-Seong is told she’ll die by autumn. She skips chemo, quits her job, leaves her mother’s house, and dyes her hair for the first time in her life. Then, on a whim, she adds one last thing: a night with a stranger who prefers no-strings-attached encounters. She decides to stay with him until autumn—when her time runs out.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: My Rat Is an S-Class Awakener
description:
Soul is dropped into a dimension where everyone's screaming about a status window he can't see. On top of that, his pet rat, who also got dropped in with him, turns out to be a beastman and a powerful awakener... And in love with him?! Will Soul and Rio accept each other and make it back home safely?

(Source: Manta)

My first love... Reunited... However, she wasn't the girl I thought I knew.

(Source: Toomics)

When his partner was murdered and the killer went free, Yoonseok took justice into his own hands. Now he's the pawn of a prosecutor who sends him into danger, his body sexually violated by criminals as a way to gather information. He's little more than a husk, hoping for death, when he begins investigating the gangster Baek Gitae, whose violent sadism triggers something in Yoonseok. Is he seeking out the gangster's sexual aggression as a way to escape his pain? Or is he beginning to enjoy it? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Surviving as the Dang Clan's Handmaiden
description:
An ordinary woman who once dreamed of the Martial World awakens as Dang Sohye, a lowly handmaiden serving the Sacheon Dang Clan, a house notorious for its poison techniques. She thinks she’s possessed a doomed extra, but this body is anything but ordinary. As the clan’s fearsome grand elder takes her in and a young swordsman from the Namgung clan notices her, she’s swept into a deadly power struggle. Can she master the Dang Clan’s techniques and survive the schemes closing in from within?

(Source: Tapas)

Moon Ah-Rim has a secret. One accidental touch, and he can hear exactly what you're thinking. So when he accidentally brushes against his longtime crush, Tae-Hun, he expects butterflies…not full-blown NSFW fantasies! Sweet, gentle Tae-Hun isn’t supposed to have those kinds of thoughts, and especially not about him! Ah-Rim is horrified...and maybe just a little intrigued. Because no matter how much he tells himself not to feel anything...his body’s saying otherwise. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes seven extra chapters.*

*“How did I end up doing a strip show in front of a classmate I barely even know?”*

Baek Han-Yeong has lived his whole life as a perfectly ordinary No-Namer, someone without the fated mark of destiny. That is, until he gets to college and meets Ryu Cheong-Hyeon, a bold Namer with the name “Baek Han-yeong” etched right across his neck. Cheong-Hyeon, convinced fate is at play, starts tailing Han-Yeong everywhere, fascinated by the uncanny coincidence. Exhausted and desperate to prove he’s just a plain old No-Namer, Han-Yeong blurts out the wildest challenge imaginable… and ends up undressing right in front of him. Regret hits immediately. 

 *“If I could go back in time, I’d never throw out a stupid suggestion like that to this lunatic…”*

But now that the line’s been crossed, will fate keep dragging them back together, or was this one outrageous mistake just the beginning?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seo-Yul Ji is a sex columnist with a secret—she’s still a virgin! She ends up befriending the popular actor Joo-Heon Kang, who agrees to provide her with a new viewpoint for her column. Her only condition is that they not sleep together. But as they grow closer, will she be able to resist his allure?

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

From the creator of Hook, Line, and Sinker comes its hilarious sequel! 

Now that Kye-Soo and Myung-Tae are free of Kang Shin-Joo, he has his eyes set his next target - Myung-Tae’s older brother, Young-Joo. And while Young-Joo doesn’t exactly reciprocate the interest, he’s having a hard time forgetting the particularly…perky aspects of Shin-Joo’s undeniably flawless physique. Will the smarmy schemer Shin-Joo be able to use his charisma to reel in his bait this time? Or is this relationship dead in the water before it even begins?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Sheathe Your Sword in the Bedroom
description:
She was trained to kill. He was supposed to be the target. When assassin Yurian infiltrates the Argon Empire disguised as a princess bride, her mission is simple: murder Duke Larkan Blake on their wedding night and rescue her captive brother. But the notorious Duke is nothing like the monster she expected, and each night spent together makes it harder to carry out her revenge. Torn between duty and desire, will she choose love or vengeance?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Raised as the perfect assassin for her captor's revenge, Ayla finally learns the truth of her kidnapping as she takes her dying breath. When she wakes up again years in the past, she vows then and there to turn his own plan for vengeance against him. But as she begins to unravel his plot, she discovers that she was just a small pawn in an even greater scheme. With so much at stake, will Ayla succeed in her revenge? Or will she be dragged further into something she never wanted to be a part of?

(Source: Tapas)

In a world where werewolves live among humans in secret, Ji-u Han, a detective agency owner and a powerful werewolf, crosses paths with Yuseung Cheon, a famous actor, when he “accidentally” hits her with his car. And when they run into each other again “by chance,” one thing becomes clear to Ji-u: She must have him —whatever that may entail. Ji-u wants Yuseung’s rare ability to make werewolves stronger through touch. Yuseung, on the other hand, wants information on key figures in the werewolf world to eliminate them. Will they each get what they’re after? Or more importantly—will they fall in love?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Eun-Nam's got it bad for his best friend Ji-Dong's mom. So he throws out a filthy deal. He offers up his own stepmom. That's how their dirty pact begins. Two shameless punks, both plotting to get into each other's mom's pants.

*"It's only fair. We swap moms."*

(Source: DAYcomics)

With her weird talents and weirder personality, idol trainee Yoon Hyesung can't help but catch everyone's eye, even though that's far from what she wants. She's actually a fangirl from a different future with one goal in mind—help Na Yeonwoo debut as an idol! Now as Yeonwoo's friend, Hyesung is determined to get Yeonwoo the top spot on an idol survival program with the help of an oddly supportive game system. Can Hyesung help Yeonwoo debut, even if it means she will too?

(Source: Tapas)

Oh Seung-Pyo has always been at the top of his class, but once he enters high school, his spot gets stolen by Ryu Jae-Min. No matter how hard Seung-Pyo tries, he can't seem to reclaim his place and is stuck in second. For the first time in his life, he develops an inferiority complex and, without realizing it, he starts keeping an eye on Jae-Min. One rainy day, the two accidentally swap phones. Though it seemed like a minor accident, what Seung-Pyo discovers on Jae-Min's phone leaves him in shock, complicating their relationship beyond expectation. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Beloved Gardener of the World Tree
description:
The transmigrated Lilith La Noella does everything she can to avoid her fiancé, Duke Edrion La Arkshad, the cause of her death in the original story. She even chooses an unpopular job as a horticulturist in the rural South to get as far away from him as possible. But this choice backfires when the empress calls Lilith back to the capital to give her the nearly impossible task of flowering the World Tree. Otherwise, her entire family will be put to death. Can Lilith dodge another tragic end? And will she flower something more in the process?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Actor Geum Ki-Yool has been secretly in love with his roommate Seo-Moon Hyung since their school days. When Ki-Yool takes on an adult-themed music video, he tries to set the mood by experimenting with a toy, only to get caught in the act by Hyung himself! But instead of being shocked, Hyung unexpectedly offers to help him out. As the lines between fiction and reality begin to blur, both Ki-Yool and Hyung have to find the courage to step into the spotlight. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes seven extra chapters.*

display_title: Part Two of This Failed Fantasy Novel Begins
description:
I transmigrated into a novel, slayed the Demon King, and died—mission complete, right? I can go back to reality, right? Wrong! Turns out this flop story has a second part! Five years after I saved the day, I've reawakened in the same world as a haughty villainess. What's more, my old allies from Part One have all become awful people! I've got new rules and a new body, but it's still the same old mess...

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: How to Survive a Haunted School
description:
After her brother Raven’s mysterious death at the prestigious Saint Gloria Academy, Melody gets one impossible shot to infiltrate the elite school as a student by turning back time by a year. But beneath Saint Gloria’s gleaming halls lie chilling secrets. Students whisper lies, ghosts linger in classrooms, and worst of all, Raven keeps avoiding her. With time running out and Raven slipping further away, can Melody uncover the school’s dark truths? Or will she become one of its buried secrets?

(Source: Tapas)

Mint Limnades has clawed her way to the top of Niflheim Prison––a brutal, lawless jungle where only the strongest survive. Now the undisputed boss of the block, she’s offered freedom by the warden in exchange for one last job: turn the handsome, wide-eyed newcomer, Helios, into the next leader. The catch? She has to go undercover in a men’s prison. Will this kingmaker succeed in shaping her lost lamb into a boss, or are they both doomed to be crushed by the savagery of prison hierarchy?

(Source: Tapas)

For ten years, Seo-Jun has harbored a silent, unrequited crush on his best friend, Jae-Yun. But when Jae-Yun asks for a favor, Seo-Jun finds himself sharing a roof with his friend’s younger brother, Do-Yun. Living together reveals a different side of the family: while Do-Yun is quiet and unexpectedly tender, Jae-Yun’s perfect facade begins to crumble. Caught between a decade of devotion and a new, grounding confession, Seo-Jun must finally decide which brother holds the key to his heart. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

I woke up in a strange place, with only a phone to guide me. To recover my memories and return home, I had to raise my targets’ affection levels and unlock a special ending. But once a target has over five hearts, it triggers overheat—and a dangerous, unhinged ending awaits. It's a delicate balance!

(Source: Manta)

Kinemia Lyon's got two rules for surviving a novel: recruit talented geniuses to save her territory and don't get involved with Ayan Krotz, a dangerous mage. But when Ayan gets captured for trespassing on her land over and over again, she decides to hire him as her bodyguard instead. Unfortunately, letting Ayan into her life means dealing with his erratic magic and even more concerning personality! Can Kinemia come to tame this master mage? Or will she regret not kicking him out for good?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Villain's Daughter-In-Law Rules by Nature
description:
After six short, measly lives as insignificant items of a novel, Florine finally wakes up in the body of a shapeshifter. The problem? She's a tiny sable without enough power to turn into a human. While spending her days as a servant, she crosses paths with Kiraxus, the original novel's villain. She thinks her short life as a shapeshifter is over, but instead, he makes her the daughter-in-law of his family! Will Florine finally live the long life she desires? Or is it all too good to be true?

(Source: Tapas)

Azadin, a member of the cursed Messenger Clan, is born with the worst of curses. Lacking magical prowess, he becomes the lowest-ranking messenger, wandering the continent collecting gold coins in hopes of breaking his curse. But when his twin uncovers a great conspiracy, how will he face the impending doom?

(Source: Manta)

What if you could undo your dark past? Chaebom Yu, a burned-out office worker, wakes up as her 17-year-old self, given a second chance to rewrite her life. She enters high school determined to avoid the mistakes that once haunted her. But the more she tries to fix things, the weirder her life becomes. Money starts slipping away, and strange boys keep showing up… Her “do-over” begins to feel just as messy as before! Can Chaebom truly escape her past, or is she just trading one chaotic life for another? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

One day, Seon-Ho Kang lost consciousness in an accident, only to wake up to:

*"Alright, time to collect your semen, sweetie!"*

Wait a second... Men are rare in this world?! With women throwing themselves at him... Well, if this is how things are, guess I'll just enjoy the feast, one by one!!!

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

After being whisked away to another realm, Lee Kangjoon spent centuries defeating powerful foes, commanding armies of the dead, and bending entire realms to his will—becoming one of the greatest emperors and necromancers ever. Having achieved everything, he now only wants peace and quiet. Upon finding his way back home to Earth, he expects just that… only to face the most daunting quest of his life: raising a daughter. Can a man who once ruled kingdoms and overthrew rulers conquer fatherhood?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: How the Grand Duchess Returns to Her Tower
description:
Leicia is a famed genius mage who rules over the magic tower. However, when her own pupil betrays her, Leicia’s soul wakes up in the body of Grand Duchess Priscilla Eckhart. Unfortunately, Priscilla’s body cannot wield magic, so Leicia needs to take the long way around to getting her body back and restoring the Grand Duchess’s soul as well. The odd complication is Calix Eckhart, who is intent on finding out who is in his wife’s body, even if it means hiding his own identity to do so. Will this tag-team succeed in restoring their original lives?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Bonita is a pharmacist who works with rare ingredients that require foraging in dangerous places. She hires Ivan for a short-term contract as her bodyguard, but things take a turn on their first day when he is dosed with one of Bonita’s ingredients, which happens to be an aphrodisiac. Determined to help Ivan out of his hard circumstances, Bonita takes a heated approach to give him a hand. From there, coincidences keep leading to sexy encounters between them. Will this be a fling that lasts only until the end of their contract, or will this become something more?

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: How to Retire as the Disaster-Class Necromancer
description:
Enslaved by an archmage in another world for thirty years, Jihyeok is finally sent home to Earth with a pile of treasure. But when his riches disappear in transit, he’s left with nothing but his necromancy powers and a lazy attitude. Even worse, while he was away, Earth was invaded by monsters pouring out of gates. Posing as an Awakened, he summons armies of skeletons—not to hunt in the gates, but to start a business and earn his retirement funds with as little effort as possible!

(Source: Tapas)

After a once-dormant contract requiring descendants of House Morgana and House Kalakis to wed resurfaces, Meivia Morgana receives a shoddy proposal from the ever-miserable eldest son, Gilbert Kalakis. Determined not to settle for less, Meivia decides to marry the single and mysteriously alluring family head, Grand Duke Edis Kalakis. Between a volatile son always knocking at her door and an enticingly enigmatic father who leaves her wanting more, will Meivia be able to sign her way to happiness? 

(Source: Tapas)

Cavil Sernua is the bastard son of House Sernua and the male lead of this story. His story begins in an orphanage, but he soon grows up to be a respectable figure who's loved by all. The villainess is Cavil's wife, Elodi McClaire, the character I transmigrated into. Elodi is cruel and evil, and she met her tragic ending in the book. However, I will not follow in her footsteps. Instead, I will raise Cavil well and divorce him so he can end up with his true love. Well, that is... if he'll let me.

(Source: Tapas)

After years of being holed up in his room, Cheol-Jin finally attends his first college outing, and by chance, he discovers a lewd secret hobby of his gorgeous classmate.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

display_title: The Monster Dame Requests Maternity Leave
description:
Lucia is the captain of the imperial knights and a swordmaster famous for her extraordinary achievements. However, she regrets something on her deathbed: unknowingly aiding a nefarious group in their plot to sacrifice the saintess for profit. So when she wakes up in the past as her 25-year-old self, Lucia is determined to rescue the child saintess and keep her safe until she’s old enough to protect herself. But the formidable knight is completely clueless when it comes to raising a child... Will six months of maternity leave be enough time for her to figure things out? The following series contains depictions of child abuse that may be upsetting to some readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

After dying as an orphan unable to support her siblings, Siella Feiront is reincarnated as the villainess of a novel and the evil matron of Siella's Orphanage. Indignant at how poorly the children in her care have been treated, she immediately gets to work—repairing the rundown manor, buying the children clothes, and cooking nutritious meals—until she's left with next to no money. With her funds quickly deteriorating, Siella sets out on a mission: she must find a sponsor before it's too late!

(Source: Tapas)

Childhood friends Ju-Hyeok and Su-Ah once promised to stay together forever, but when their secondary genders manifest in reverse, their worlds drift apart. Years later, Ju-Hyeok’s dream of Olympic gold is on the line, and Su-Ah might be the only one who can help him reach it. What follows is a story of fate, pride, and a love that refuses to yield.

(Source: Lezhin US)

For his entire life, Chae Jeong-Hyeon has lived as nothing more than a shadow, an art restorer forced into the role of hidden ghost painter for his father, the celebrated Painter Chae. When the old master dies suddenly, Jeong-Hyeon’s long-nurtured desire for revenge dies with him, leaving only despair and the urge to abandon everything. But on the edge of surrender, a stranger appears: Yeom Tae-Hwa, a man caught between mortal and divine.

Tae-Hwa offers Jeong-Hyeon a bargain. Restore what has been lost and share his roof, and in return, he will grant Jeong-Hyeon the honor stolen by his father. Reluctantly, Jeong-Hyeon agrees, clinging to the fragile hope Tae-Hwa extends. Yet as the days pass, cold obligation begins to blur into fascination. Living side by side, Jeong-Hyeon is drawn closer to Tae-Hwa’s enigma… and to the haunting secret hidden within his 200-year-old silence.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Bratty Lady Throws a Tantrum
description:
Duke Heros Archeon slays the black dragon Sellus, thus freeing the world from calamity—or so he thinks. But then, Sellus transmigrates into the body of Daphne Archeon, the duke’s cruel, petulant daughter, and somehow... this improves the girl’s personality?! Sellus takes over Daphne’s life and vows to train her body until she’s strong enough to kill her father. However, when dark mages threaten her family and kingdom, a feeling of righteous responsibility flares in her bratty little heart.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Reincarnated as the Grand Duke’s Third Son
description:
Born at the bottom of society, Jake survives by leading Sabertooth, a mercenary group loyal to him. Yet he is ultimately betrayed and killed by the nobles he served. But instead of death, he awakens to a new life with soft, frail hands and the title of the third son of House Valdek, the most powerful family in the empire, rivaling even the crown. Surrounded by wealth and splendor, Jake realizes he has been granted a second chance to fulfill his ambition. So he sets off, determined to rise as high as possible. Look out, world, here comes Lucian Valdek!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Blessed be the devout who remain chaste among the tainted. A pious young debutante of the Kingdom of Brandt, Elke Eberhardt prays each day as she vies for the sacred title of Pontifex, which grants authority over the nation’s faith. Unfortunately for Elke, fate has other, crueler plans—as she catches the eye of Sir Reiner Mikhel, a notorious womanizer who has seduced countless noblewomen in Brandt. Despite her firm resolve to remain virtuous, Elke finds herself increasingly drawn to the temptations of this dark, ambitious nobleman, whose seductive gaze conceals his true intentions.

(Source: WEBTOON)

*“It’ll be six months at most.”*

Just like that, my ordinary life crumbled with a single sentence—a sudden terminal diagnosis I never saw coming. As if that wasn’t enough, my best friend of over ten years suddenly confesses: “I’ve loved you… for more than a decade.” Now I have half a year left. Just six months. A brief flicker of time where everything feels both too short and painfully long. What am I supposed to do with a love I never had the chance to notice? How do I hold on to a future that’s slipping away before it can begin? In these fleeting days, it’s just you and me—stumbling through borrowed time, trying to find meaning in the moments we still have. If our time together is limited… Can love still be enough?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Tangled Up With a Tiny Male Lead
description:
Marley is a half-baked witch struggling to make ends meet in the northern forest. When she captures a rare fairy named Prim, she plans to harvest his expensive "essence" and sell it for money. Unfortunately, Prim has never felt the urge to mate and doesn't know how to produce this ingredient, so Marley literally takes matters into her own hands. As they're navigating this awkward "extraction" process, a health scare and a desperate wish turn their transactional relationship into something much more intimate...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Giselle Florette wakes up in a grovel romance where the male leads and villains alike torment her until her ultimate death. To avoid meeting the same ending, Giselle decides to act out and show she's not one to be messed with. Little did she know, this would catch the eye of Duke Vientin Kallinos, the infamous "Bloody Mastermind," who proposes a contractual marriage. With her newfound audacity and unexpected supporter, will Giselle fend off those who wronged her and rewrite her tragic fate?

(Source: Tapas)

To Yoonha, a model student at an elite high school, romance has always felt like a frivolous distraction. But when four surprising choices for love appear, her pencil begins to waver. Will she choose the right answer and ace the ultimate test?

*Source: WEBTOON*

Branded a heartless and cruel sovereign, Emperor Herace of the Tevente Empire has lost three empresses to betrayal and murder. Into his life steps Eleanor Snow, the fearless daughter of House Snow, offering herself as his new empress to protect her family from ruin. In a world of assassins, treachery, and political unrest, their alliance is forged out of necessity but eventually tempered by trust. Together, they will fight to defend the empire… and each other.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: All I Want is My Dream Home
description:
Isabel lived and died as a doormat. After waking up in the past, she gets to work on dumping her terrible boyfriend and escaping her abusive household. However, financial and legal limits stop her from gaining total independence on her own. There is one potential solution: a policy that provides housing for newlyweds! This means Isabel has to find a man to marry. Enter Sir Dylan, the perfect catch. For reasons unknown, he volunteers to become her fake husband, and they earn Ishael’s dream house. But can they turn it into a real home together?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*“Death is only the beginning.”*

Truer words were never spoken for young Leon von Marbas, the heir to a once-great house of necromancers. Forced to execute his own father by the lord of a rival house, Leon suddenly finds himself the leader of a declining clan under threat from enemies within and without. The only way to restore the glory of his house? Leon must strike a pact with the demon Marbas, the original source of the powerful necromancy that House Marbas was once known for…

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

After beating "The Return of the D-Rank Hunter," the game, Seon-Woo wakes up as the game's NPC, kidnapped by the insomnia-ridden protagonist Jae-Hwi, who demands Seon-Woo become his Mentalist via a one-sided contract. To return to reality, Seon-Woo must unlock the game’s secret ending. Will he make it?

(Source: Manta)

display_title: I'm a Villainess, but I Won't Live Like One
description:
Bianca is just another noble lady with a simple dream: to marry into a dukedom and enjoy a life of luxury. But everything changes when she stumbles upon a book—one that casts her as the villainess, doomed to stand in the way of her real-life fiancé’s love story with a commoner girl. As Bianca realizes the book accurately depicts her own fate, she refuses to accept her tragic ending. Can she rewrite her story, or is she simply destined to become a villainess?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: A Single Dad in Another World
description:
OHis wife has gone missing. His baby daughter is terminally ill. But as Junhu falls to his death, he wakes up in his wife’s unfinished dark fantasy novel--a world infested with vile demons. Armed with knowledge of the story, he allies with powerful demon hunters to avert the tragedies to come. Yet every action rewrites the story in unpredictable ways, and Junhu must seek answers if he hopes to keep his daughter safe.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Regressed Genius Player's Mythical-Rank Weapon Creation
description:
With the death of Earth’s potential Constellation, the Crimson Eye is now bent on consuming the world. Simun Kim--an alchemist out of necessity, due to an inability to use magic--successfully transmuted the Philosopher’s Stone to stop this cosmic threat. But he still failed. As death closes in, the Philosopher’s Stone rewinds time, waking Simun in the past with one last chance to rewrite the end of the world.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Marriage of Convenience 2: The Unforgettable Song
description:
Cyril Ireon de Sevran, a young and powerless king, was betrayed and murdered after his only supporter, Alexandra de Arno, died in war. But when he opens his eyes again, he is shocked to see her younger self who doesn't recognize him. Cyril vows to protect Alexandra and her dream of becoming a knight this time. Still, threats lurk at every turn, including the very person who killed them both. Will Cyril save the one dear to him and change the future? Or will fate just repeat itself?

(Source: Tapas)

Despite her unquestioning loyalty to the emperor as his knight, Iona is left to die on the battlefield by her uncaring master. The last person she expects to come to her rescue in her final moments is her husband, Duke Leroy Hann, who was forced into a political marriage with her. Once she dies and wakes up as her past self, Iona decides to abandon the emperor and devote herself to making Leroy happy. Can she make this unlikely marriage work this time around, despite Leroy's distrust and the people determined to come between them...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

What’s a girl to do when a problematic fave ends up as the catch of the day? After a long hospitalization in her past life, Yuri is thrilled to wake up on a mysterious island feeling fit and healthy. She even gets a reprieve from lonely island life in the form of a handsome man fished out of the ocean! But when she discovers the charming prince is destined to become the tyrannical male lead from one of her favorite romance novels, it’s up to Yuri to keep him from going bad… no matter what it takes!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ju Yun-Seong thought getting a job at JH Soft was the start of a normal office life—until he noticed his cold, intimidating CEO, Baek Ha-Jin, glaring at him every time they crossed paths.

 *“Why is the boss always staring at me? Did I do something wrong on my first day?”*

Determined to avoid him at all costs, Yun-Seong keeps his head down… until he stumbles upon a mysterious employee ID and uncovers a secret: his boss isn’t just intense—he’s a nine-tailed fox. And to make things worse? Ha-Jin’s fox bead ends up lodged inside Yun-Seong’s body. Now the CEO won’t leave his side, and “normal” has left the building.

 *“Mr. Ju, you have two choices: stick close to me and do as I say, or I cut you open and take it back.”*

Excuse me?! Are those really my only options?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Viviana Lorentz, the Duchess of House Fortuna, becomes utterly displeased with her far-too-rigid husband, Alto Fortuna, the duke who rarely entertains her at night. When she finally snaps and clashes with him, she ends up tumbling back in time, exactly a month before their destined marriage. Determined to escape the marriage this time, Viviana requests to call it off, only to be taken aback by Alto's firm refusal. As a final measure, Viviana decides to make a rather lustful "deal" with her current fiancé, not realizing she will end up facing his unexpected secret.

(Source: Manta)

When Seong-Ho logs off Survival Life for the final time, the last thing he expects is for the video game to become reality. Worse still, the game is set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies and deadly monsters. Having awakened as a hunter with the ability to open dimensional gates, Seong-Ho rushes to build a hideout in another realm in order to survive as he works to level up his skills and abilities, preparing to save the world from impending doom. But with other hunters emerging and forming parties, there may be more to worry about than just monsters…

(Source: WEBTOON)

Fernan Fallenberg, heir to the Empire’s most prestigious household and a prodigy of the Imperial Academy, was infamous for valuing everything by money and keeping others at a distance. One day, he is struck by lightning, and a foreign presence tries to invade his mind. Resisting with force, he instead witnesses the Book of Prophecies reveal itself—foretelling the world’s end.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The world is destroyed by a demon invasion and Bigang Sa is forced to serve in the demon army for centuries. After a failed human uprising, Bigang transports himself back into his body, ten years before the arrival of the demons. Can he use his centuries of demon warrior training to create a new class of murim fighters powerful enough to ward off the coming invasion?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: If You Desire to Keep Me
description:
Keitha is an ideal woman: adored for her beauty, obedient to her father, and faithful to her fiance. However, when she sees her fiance wooing another woman, she realizes that her thoughts and desires are disrespected by the people around her. As she struggles to end her engagement, unexpected aid comes in the form of Seyard, a kind and thoughtful man who listens to her with respect. When Seyard offers her a contract marriage as an escape route, Keitha is delighted to take his hand. However, Seyard might not be the man she thinks he is…

(Source: Tappytoon)

The strongest god in the world craves just one thing: the thrill of a real fight. Tired of being unbeatable, Mu – god of Earth – possesses the body of a weak high schooler to relive the joy of combat. But when his divine form is sealed by his enemy, Mu must grow stronger in his new mortal body to fight back. Can fists alone satisfy a god’s hunger... or will his obsession be his downfall?

(Source: WEBTOON)

A demon from the underworld possessing a human?! 

Bella, the demon and monarch of the underworld, is possessed by the villainess Isabella Dunkeld, hated by her family and pointed at by everyone as a villainess. 'How did I end up in this body?' She has no memory of making a contract with the human Isabella, and when she came to, she was trapped in Isabella's body with all her powers sealed. She decides to act like a 'human' for the time being, but...

 *"So how many people have I killed with these hands? Hundreds? Thousands?"

"Huh... You didn't kill a single person?"

"You're calling me a villainess when you didn't kill a single person?"*

The demon Bella really finds humans difficult...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

In Eden City, no one slips through the shadows quite like Gemma Steele, the infamous jewel thief. So when the determined Inspector Raven Hunt finally catches her, she expects a jail cell, not a proposal. But Raven needs her skills to retrieve a priceless royal gem, and a fake marriage is the perfect cover. Now, the city's most wanted thief and its most straightlaced officer must team up to play newlyweds. Can Gemma and Raven pull off their act without getting caught in each other's feelings?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Baby Dragon to the Duke’s Rescue
description:
After the loss of its divine beast, House Moonreppe is on the verge of collapse. Desperate to save his household, the young Duke Edenver Moonreppe decides to summon a legendary beast to become their new divine beast. He’s prepared to take on whatever monster that is summoned, only to meet baby dragon Acille. Edenver is not sure such a small creature could be their new divine beast… until he discovers that this baby dragon packs quite the punch in terms of both power and loveability. Will Acille change Edenver’s life for the better in more ways than one?

(Source: Tappytoon)

After I-Han Jeong’s mother and brother died in a car crash when she was just 9 years old, she was raised by Chi-O Han and his parents, who lived next door. Now about to attend university, I-Han suddenly finds herself living with Chi-O under one roof, and she realizes that she feels more than just familial affection for her brother figure. While trying to deal with her trauma and the awkwardness of freshman life, I-Han meets Yu-Jin Seo, a champion judoka at their university who is the spitting image of her late brother. And now he's moving in next door?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Dante has lived his life hiding a secret—he is immortal. Working as a repairman, he one day witnesses a murder at the home of his client, Demis. Instead of running, he makes an unusual request: Kill me. Demis refuses at first, but upon discovering Dante’s immortality, he becomes intrigued. A dangerous promise is made—one that ties them together in a fate neither of them could have foreseen.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: My Once-Enemy Sister Now Cherishes Me
description:
After a life of misfortune resulting in death at the hands of her sister, Calista, Harper wakes up again as her 8-year-old self. Realizing she's been given another chance at life, Harper is determined to stay out of the way and avoid becoming her sister's target. Unfortunately, her plan to go unnoticed goes awry when the sister who once hated her seems to be interested in her instead! But maybe this is for the better... if Harper can make Calista like her, she won't try to kill her, right?! 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Regressed Doctor Just Wanted to Live Quietly
description:
In the operating room, Dr. Jin-Hyeok Lee is flawless—unyielding, brilliant, and untouchable. But outside, he’s a ghost to his family and loved ones. He misses everything, even his mother’s final moments. By the time he understands what he’s lost, it’s too late… until it isn’t. He wakes up 27 years in the past. Now armed with a lifetime of memories, Jin-Hyeok vows to live differently. But peace won’t come easy. Old rivals, new battles, and countless lives await. Scrubs on. Lights up. Scalpel ready. And this time, Primum non nocere.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: Woke Up as the CEO’s Dog
description:
After a rough day and a run-in with a missing dog, overworked office worker Umi Seo wakes up to a surreal nightmare: she’s trapped in the body of her boss’s beloved pet. By day, Umi is a dog. By night, she’s back to being human. Forced to live under one roof with the aloof CEO, Chahyeon Baek, the two begin to grow closer in the most unexpected way. But can Umi ever return to her normal life for good? Or will she be stuck living on a leash forever?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Succubus Wants to Be Naughty
description:
Cho-A is a succubus who sneaks into the human world with the hope of collecting enough life force to become human herself. Just when she reels in her first victim to consume, she becomes the one in trouble, as she ends up in the clutches of an archangel named Sa-Bin. But instead of immediately sending Cho-A back to the demon world, Sa-Bin offers to give the starved succubus exactly what she needs...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

After a prophetic dream foretells her sister’s death in a political marriage, Arasilla Hugo takes matters into her own hands and marries in her place. Her groom? Demian Vandermeer, the knights’ captain and the brother of her sister’s former betrothed. The only problem is that mages and knights are sworn enemies, and their sharp tongues and stubborn hearts turn every situation into a competition. Arasilla races to save her sister from a tragic fate, while Demian fights for the dukedom. Will their rivalry stay just that? Or will their contractual marriage burn into something more?

(Source: WEBTOON)

As if reincarnating into a whole new world wasn't enough, Lewin was reborn to a father so bent on having a male heir that he used dark magic to disguise her as a boy. Over 20 years later, she finds an unexpected ally in a freshly-transmigrated fellow Korean girl. However, this new friend delivers shocking news: they're in a tragic BL novel in which a love triangle will ultimately lead to the apocalypse! Still, if Lewin can seduce the male lead first, they may just manage to save the world...

(Source: Tapas)

Eveness wakes up as the wicked princess of a novel who's doomed to die on her wedding day. Determined to change her destiny, she rebuilds her reputation and convinces her cold fiancé Grand Duke Terence Lenz into a partnership to prevent this impending peril. However, as she alters the story, unexpected twists arise—Terence’s hatred turns to passionate love, and new dangers loom. Can Eveness navigate this altered fate and find true happiness, or will the unknown challenges consume her?

(Source: Tapas)

Growing up with a silver spoon, Rosa has lived a flawless life as the perfect modern-day princess. She’s always gotten everything she wanted - except for one thing: Kim Yeonwoo, the boy from the orphanage who once slipped through her fingers.Ten years later, starved for something to stir her restless heart, Rosa finally sees Yeonwoo again. But there’s just one problem...he’s now the man by her mother’s side. Though she knows it’s a dangerous love she can never have, Rosa can’t resist toying with her new father-to-be, both in body and in mind…

(Source: Lezhin US)

After three failed marriages, Archduke Theo de Phoenix has long accepted that love simply isn’t in the cards for him. After all, who could love a war-hardened monster like him? So when his fourth bride arrives, he greets her covered in blood, gives her a shabby attic for a room, and keeps his distance. Surely, this one will run too. But Yuelina is not like the others. To Theo’s disbelief, she welcomes his presence and fills his cold world with warmth and light. As the walls around his heart begin to thaw, will Theo finally allow himself to love?

(Source: WEBTOON)

It's been three years since Yeong-in and Seonghyeok parted ways. So why is Seonghyeok approaching her now -- gentler, and more intense than ever? Will their reunion end differently than before? Can they fill the emptiness in each other's hearts?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Her tenth year since debut, the two-time consecutive year-end grand award winner: Baek Nokha, the undisputed representative female soloist of South Korea.

On what should have been her greatest day—a day where she was to receive another grand award—the unexpected news of her mother’s death turned it into her worst.

“Do you want to save your mom?"

A mysterious cottonball appears in front of the sorrowful Nokha. It says that if she accepts its proposal and fulfills it, it will bring her mom back to life.

“I don’t know what kind of proposal this is, but I accept.”

To return to that moment before everything changed, Nokha accepts the proposal. After making a contract with the cottonball, she opens her eyes in another person’s body.

Then…

[System]
[Congratulations!
You have become "Yoon Chung."]

[From now on, you are a member of a girl group destined to fail.]

[You must save Still Blue!]

Can Nokha, now member Yoon Chung, save the girl group from its destiny of failure?

*“I have erectile dysfunction.”*

Not exactly the kind of confession Woo Hyeon-Woo ever planned to make, but a few too many drinks later, his biggest secret slips out to his classmate Ha Jeong-Yoon. Mortified, Hyeon-Soo braces for pity or laughter… but Jeong-Yoon just grins.

 *“Then why don’t we test it out? Who knows? Maybe I can fix you.”* 

Wait, what?! Before Hyeon-Soo can process what’s happening, he’s suddenly part of Jeong-Yoon’s “scientific experiment.” What started as drunken honesty turns into a very hands-on test of chemistry, curiosity, and terrible decisions. Now, every accidental touch feels like a loaded dice roll. Will it be a total flop, or a nat 20? Caught between panic and possibility, Hyeon-Soo wonders if maybe, just maybe, his biggest problem wasn’t physical after all… 

Because with Jeong-Yoon around, something else is definitely ""rising"" to the occasion.

(Source: Lezhin US)

As if being framed by her love for plotting a murder weren’t enough, Rinette learns that her stepsister, Kanna, is the true mastermind behind it all. As she’s burned at the stake, Rinette makes a desperate wish for another chance…and wakes up as her younger self. Determined to change her fate, she vows to stop Kanna’s schemes and protect her family this time around. But rewriting the past is far from simple. Each choice she makes brings unforeseen consequences—some more devastating than she could imagine. Can Rinette escape the shadows of her past, or will they consume her once more?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Rowan glimpses a dark future just ten years away. Unfortunately, he’s no powerful leader—just an orphan with an incredible talent for magic. Luckily, his potential won’t stay hidden forever. He joins Union Academy, which is filled with potential partners in the fight against dark magic… if only his teachers and classmates could understand magic theory on his level. But if Rowan can keep everyone focused, they might just stop their world from going up in flames.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Find Yourself Another Trainer, Your Grace
description:
After being reborn, all Litia wants is a quiet career training dragons. But when Duke Albarant’s temperamental dragon chooses her as its trainer, she's faced with an unexpected offer. She tries to refuse the persistent duke, but that's easier said than done when he never takes no for an answer. A dragon’s choice, a duke’s determination, and one very reluctant heroine—can Litia hold onto the peaceful life she's dreamed of, or will this second chance demand far more than she's ever bargained for? 

(Source: Tapas)

After losing his memories in an accident, Eun Jo transfers to a new school, convinced he's a model student—quiet, kind, and hardworking. But when he sees his classmate Bom being bullied, something in him snaps. His instincts take over—and so do his fists. As Eun rises against the school’s cruel hierarchy, he starts to wonder: Who was he before? And why does Bom feel so familiar? Packed with school drama, mystery, and unexpected fists, this is the story of a “good student” who may not be so good after all.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

The Trauma Center series returns! Uncover the gripping prequel to Trauma Center: Golden Hour and follow the emotional journey of Dr. Ganghyeok Baek. Every scar, every choice, every life saved... his story starts here. Witness the making of a medical legend as he takes his first steps into the chaos and courage of trauma care. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Once a year on a cold midwinter night in the Empire of Hartan, a fortress of frost appears, revealing the resting place of a blue-eyed demon said to grant any wish – for a price. When Princess Estelle of Hartan flees her abusive imperial family, she is encounters the otherworldly Frost Fort and makes a pact with Satael, the blue-eyed demon of legend. Pledging her body and soul to him, Estelle begins to plot for the crown.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Orphaned overnight, a boy is taken in by his parents' best friends. Years later, love and desire blur as he grows closer to them and their daughters.

(Source: Toomics)

The crazy princess and the barbarian of the North... Some would call it a perfect match, but neither is truly what they seem: Chloe was only branded as insane by her stepmother as part of a plan to assassinate her, and Callios is a fallen prince who cares deeply for his people. Chloe may have succumbed to her stepmother's schemes in her first life, but this time, she's determined to take revenge with the perfect ally at her side! Can these two make the empire pay for destroying their families?

(Source: Tapas)

My husband is hot on my trail! 

Eloise, a fugitive with a dark past, and Lord Johannes, the temple’s relentless hound, enter a marriage built on lies. With one year to live, Eloise must steal the Stone of Time from Johannes without revealing her identity. Can she survive this deadly game of deception? 

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Return of the Namgung Clan's Granddaughter
description:
Because she was kidnapped and raised by the Blood Demon, Seolhwa destroyed the Namgung Clan, unaware that she was its lost child. When she learned the truth only after being killed by the master who used her, she awakens eight years in the past and returns home to try and change fate. But a dark spell and forbidden seals keep her from speaking the truth. Can Seolhwa change the future of her clan and prepare Namgung for what’s to come? Or will her family's blood spill once again?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: My Desire is Not a Sin
description:
On their ninth anniversary, Ian receives what seems like a perfect gift, a building in the most coveted part of the city for the expansion of her art gallery. With the steamy night that followed afterward, it was set to become the most romantic anniversary ever… until her husband sneaks out in the middle of the night to cheat on her.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After a violent outburst in his first match, an amateur MMA fighter haunted by dreams of a past life as a gladiator is offered a chance to go pro, if he survives the fight. He’s untrained, unhinged, and utterly untamable.

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: The Reborn Prodigy of the Ducal Family
description:
Once the commander-in-chief of Earth’s resistance and a legendary monster hunter, Han-Seong was dragged into another world and enslaved by the Empire through a binding spell. For ten long years, he fought their wars, crushed their enemies, and was discarded like a weapon. But death wasn’t his end. Revived by the Stone of Reincarnation, he awakens as Dale, the heir to a powerful ducal house. With unmatched brilliance and a burning desire for revenge, Han-Seong begins his second life to destroy the Empire that once enslaved him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Chae Yeon runs a quiet little pension on a remote island—but with her painfully shy personality, dealing with guests is more stress than success. Just as she’s contemplating closing up shop, an unexpected guest checks in: Baek Sanho, her high school classmate…and the guy she once rejected. Now all grown up and annoyingly charming, Sanho seems determined to turn up the heat—on the island and in Yeon’s heart. With old sparks beginning to flicker back to life, this getaway is about to get way too hot to handle.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Betrayed by his guild and defeated by a top player, Hyrkan loses everything. Before he can get revenge, a fatal accident ends his life—only for him to wake up years in the past, back at the start of Warlord. Now, with his memories intact, he’s determined to rise to the top alone. But in a game where power means everything, can he truly survive without any allies? The Emperor of Solo Play is back, and this time, he’s playing by his own rules.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A blinding flash of light, and his village was gone. Lowe vows to reach the floating Island of the Gods, but first, he must venture into a world ruled by a ranking system and claw his way to the top. Trained by the world’s strongest knight, he embarks on a quest to become the top ranker, battling fearsome beasts and ruthless rivals to uncover the truth and save his loved ones.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After global warming destroyed the Earth, humanity set off for the uncharted planet paradise known as "Arcadia." Crew member Yeongsu Dong wakes up from stasis to find himself the lone survivor, orbitting the planet in the debris field of the wrecked ship. He gets to the surface, where he is immediately attacked by wild creatures, and gets caught in the civil war among the native Arcadians. He must learn to communicate and survive in this strange new world, and find a way to stop an apocalyptic comet set to destroy his new home.

(Source: WEBTOON)

In a rural village where he was always ignored, Jun-Hyeon one day discovers a mysterious megaphone with strange powers. The moment he uses it, the villagers begin to flock to him...

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

display_title: Low-Level Civil Servant Wants to Climb the Social Ladder
description:
Namia, the magic-scroll-writing genius, gets taken advantage of by everyone—from her lazy boss to her greedy family. But when she uses her knowledge of this novel to save the life of Prince Kiaros, it’s time for her life to turn around. Those who used her will finally get what’s coming to them, while Namia’s skills and good deeds are finally recognized and rewarded. But little does she know that her new assistant is really the prince in disguise, and someone is still trying to kill him!

(Source: Tapas)

Yesol Kim has a celebrity crush. Okay, an obsession, but who doesn’t fantasize about getting intimate with movie stars? It didn’t mean anything was out of the ordinary—at least, not until a succubus interrupted her fantasies to tell her she could make men do whatever she wanted in the pursuit of some naughty fun. It couldn’t possibly have been more than a dream... But she doesn’t have anything to lose by testing it out either, does she? And if it is real, just how far can she take this power?

(Source: Tapas)

As the eldest daughter, I've always yielded to the whims of Meldor, my little brother and the future Duke Elton. But one day, memories of my previous life started flooding my mind, and I realized this wasn't my first time sacrificing everything for a younger sibling... That was my breaking point. Enough! I've done my time! Starting today, I'll meticulously reclaim everything I was ever forced to surrender to Meldor, and I'll give that spoiled brat a good lesson while I'm at it. Just you wait!

(Source: Tapas)

Luck has only been on Yeon-Woo's side twice in his life: when he and his brother were saved by an esper named Seo-Joon, and when he reunites with Seo-Joon as a 20-year-old guide. Unfortunately, Seo-Joon doesn't seem to remember saving Yeon-Woo. Not only does the older man see Yeon-Woo as a kid, but he also makes it clear that he doesn't want to get attached to any guide. However, there's no telling what'll happen when their sync rate is so high and Yeon-Woo has had a crush on Seo-Joon for years...

(Source: Tappytoon)

As the sole princess of the empire, Vishnahel had her life all planned out until she was brutally executed. Thanks to her family’s ancestral god, she’s sent back in time… to live as her 5-year-old self! In order to restore glory to the empire, she must raise hell, team up with her new adopted father (whom she met in prison), and gather the most unlikely allies. With this first-time dad under her thumb, she’s about to prove that sometimes the best way to win is to break all the rules!

(Source: Tapas)

*"Do it for me!"*

So-In Han, a gloomy and awkward virgin, suddenly finds himself back in his college days. But now he's got one outrageous new power: the moment he pleads for it, no woman can say no. Surrounded by gorgeous women, his long-buried desires start to boil over, and nothing's stopping him from indulging every last one.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

display_title: The Goddess of Abundance and Her Troublemaker Apostle
description:
Earth’s life force is depleted, and it’s dying. Humanity’s only hope lies with Dispatchers, heroes sent to otherworldly realms to retrieve energy for survival. Chan-Su Oh is one of them, but despite his legendary father, he has zero talent. However, things change when Chan-Su is sent to the Block-Style Territory Expansion World as the Apostle of a forgotten, weakened Goddess of Abundance. Armed with nothing but a modified harvesting skill and a desperate drive to find his parents, Chan-Su must reclaim his territory block by block. From wretched outcast to genius apostle, the hunt to restore his Goddess begins now!

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Sorry, I'd Like to Save the World, But I Have a Deadline to Meet
description:
Lee-Hyun, the “Lightning Lord,” is one of the Twelve Apostles, the strongest Hunters in human history. He’s got fame, power, and glory… and he’s given it all up to become a web novelist. But a view from the top is pretty skewed, and Lee-Hyun can’t seem to escape criticism of his writing being “unrealistic.” Luckily, Lee-Hyun's got the perfect solution: he’ll just hide his power, join a low-ranked guild, and farm his team for inspiration! Easy-peasy, right?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I picked up a mentally fragile princess at the junkyard
description:
Matt, a company employee in his 30s, was getting tired of the boredom of his lie. On his way from work, he finds Tessa who was all tied up in a junkyard and ends up bringing her home. Can two people full of wounds take care of each other and live happily ever after?

(Source: DAYcomics)

Yeonghyeon is a quiet and nice boy who is leaving school early when he runs into Daehan, an intimidating classmate rumored to have ties to a gang. Although Yeonghyeon tries to sneak past him, Daehan drags him to a cafe and asks him to be his boyfriend when they're both guys and have never even spoken before! Undeterred by Yeonghyeon's immediate refusal, Daehan walks him to school, buys him snacks, and changes seats to sit beside him. Eventually, his constant attention begins to grow on Yeonghyeon... They say opposites attract, but can these two very different boys find love together?

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: The Detective Agency for Regretful Male Leads Is Open for Business!
description:
After a lonely death from overworking, Selia Welfe finds herself reincarnated into another world... but not into a romance fantasy novel like she had hoped. Instead, she is the chief of a detective agency that specializes in tracking down runaway female leads! Immediately, she gets right to work, hunting for clues and risking her life to reunite couples and solve relationship issues. But when Selia rescues the life of a mysterious male lead, can she keep from getting too entangled in his story?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I'm Not Your Fated Guide, But...
description:
With a 92% match rate, the highest in the Center’s history, Esper Gye Joon-Min and Guide Won Yoo-Gyul were supposed to be the perfect pair. Instead, they clash relentlessly from their very first meeting. For years, Yoo-Gyul struggled with his unrequited feelings for Joon-Min, believing the esper could never be his unless he forgot the guide he had imprinted on nine years ago. Yet, as time goes by, he begins to realize that perhaps hope is not lost. Will Yoo-Gyul and Joon-Min ever experience the kind of tender, heartfelt guiding that other pairs take for granted?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Aubrey Sandalwood had one goal: to hide her past as a slave, and become the perfect lady in high society. But at her long-awaited debut party, she runs into a man from her past— the boy who rescued her from the island she was trapped on. Colhard Karnus, the only one who knows her secret.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After failing at both love and work, Dokyung returns to the stillness of her hometown, Mooyung, where a chance encounter at her mother’s old corner store brings her face-to-face with Doh Joon, a top actor with eyes like midnight. What begins with a bold proposition soon turns into something far more complicated: a fleeting summer affair between a woman afraid to love again and a man who wants forever. As their days grow hotter and their nights more intimate, Dokyung clings to the idea that it’s just a season, just a moment. But Doh Joon is already dreaming of something that lingers long after summer ends.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Uhyeon Baek logs into Reverse Planet expecting a VR game, only to discover that the world is painfully real. A decade of grief and experiments turns him into a superhuman contract killer, and he finally executes the director behind his suffering. But when he returns to his original life, the ghosts of his fallen companions follow him. Haunted and restless, he goes back to Reverse Planet, only to realize he's entered the real game this time. Paired with superstar streamer Soyul Kang, his lethal efficiency goes viral... and puts him on the conspirator's radar.

(Source: WEBTOON)

As the illegitimate child of House Flores, Irenea has been looked down on and mistreated all her life. When she learns that she is to marry the cursed "monster prince" Cesar, she quietly accepts her fate. However, Irenea is shocked to see that he is treated far worse than even a beast. Empathizing with Cesar and realizing that only she can help him, Irenea vows to give him a proper life—as a human. Yet with the whole world against them, can they ever find freedom and happiness?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Genius Midfielder with the Killer Pass
description:
I17-year-old Yujun Song lives for soccer. However, when he suddenly becomes color-blind, he has no choice but to walk away from his dream. 15 years later, after a car crash, Yujin finds himself on the brink of death and makes one last wish: to step onto the soccer field one more time. In the next moment, he appears to have been given this chance as he finds himself back in his 17-year-old body. On the pitch, strange bands of colorful light dance around him. With the colors as his guide, can Yujun become the midfielder he always dreamed of?

(Source: WEBTOON)

He wanted an heir. Not a heart.

Baek-Ryeon, a sacred dragon spirit, once took the human Ha-On as his mate, never realizing that love would be his undoing. When Ha-On discovers he was meant for nothing more than producing an heir, he vanishes, leaving Baek-Ryeon to face the centuries alone. Now, in the modern world, Baek-Ryeon meets a man with Ha-On’s soul and the same fire in his eyes. But with Ha-On having no recollection of their shared history, can Baek-Ryeon truly atone for the sins of the past?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Aika is a 7-year-old girl who can see the future, and after losing her beloved mother in an accident, she is sent to live with her notoriously bad-tempered uncle, Kassel.

Though he couldn't care less about her at first, Aika is determined to save his life after foreseeing his tragic future. But eventually, her uncle starts to get clingy, her sweet childhood friend becomes obsessive, and the father she had never known suddenly shows up and asks her for another chance. Will Aika be able to save her uncle with everything going on?

(Source: Manta)

Bom Yun is a shy and overworked high school ethics teacher who’s assigned to the most avoided class at Shinsu High School. The cause of its reputation is Jae-Gyu Seon, a confrontational guardian who terrifies the faculty. Yet as Bom gets to know him, she discovers a devoted uncle with an unexpectedly tender heart. Though Bom tries to keep her distance when Jae-Gyu openly pursues her, she soon finds herself hopelessly falling for this quirky but charming giant of a man.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Nina the cat lost the Zodiac Race by one spot, and she's held a grudge for millennia. When she forces a divine do-over, unlucky student Cosmo Lee becomes the reluctant referee. His mission? Gather twelve Zodiac Spirits for the ultimate competition. The catch? They've all possessed girls from his school. Can an ordinary boy survive refereeing an extraordinary battle between Heaven-sent superpowered heroines?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Rieul toils away at her office job until a sudden dungeon break ends her life. But instead of dying, she wakes up three years in the past with a second chance at life. Determined to change her fate, she reopens her late grandmother’s cafe. But the moment she gets to work, she awakens as a Cafe Owner-class hunter... with a talking cat agent named Mieum! Between brewing coffee and clearing system quests, Rieul’s new life is anything but peaceful. Has her quiet dream already gone up in smoke?

(Source: Tapas)

Being popular is nothing new for Hyeok Ji-Seung. He’s always had admirers, and Tae Eon-Ho is just another one, aside from the whole being a guy thing. Ji-Seung found it Eon-Ho's terrible attempts at hiding his crush amusing…until Eon-Ho took things a step too far. Cute is one thing. Breaking into his room and hiding in his closet? That’s another story.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

It all started with a retirement. A legend in the underworld of killers and assassins, Sihyeok Cha, otherwise known as “The Red Shirt,” leaves a life of violence behind for his loving wife Miju and their unborn child. Little did he expect, however, that bonds made in blood cannot be so easily erased. When tragedy strikes, Sihyeok is dragged back into the deadly struggle between mob factions… and the fight is far from over.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Chan-Hee is a fierce gangster who is unexpectedly hit with wisdom tooth pain after beating up a rival gang. When she goes to a dental clinic to get it removed, she falls head-over-heels for Ha-Jin, the beautiful dentist who happens to be on the night shift. Although Ha-Jin rejects Chan-Hee when she asks her on a date, it doesn't stop Chan-Hee from bringing her fancy lunches and gifts to woo her. One thing leads to another and they hook up at the clinic, but can their new relationship last when they're from two completely different worlds?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Bomtoon's and Lezhin's Jeonmunjing Ungni Danpyeonseon (전문직 웅니 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: The Runaway Extra and the Obsessive Duke
description:
In this world, a duke's full power can only be unlocked by uniting with his "phero," his destined mate. So, to undermine his rival, Krua's father sends her to Duke Arzenta disguised as his phero, hoping she'll take his innocence and his power with it. But Krua has no intention of playing along! If she can just convince her fiancé to join hands with her and keep up the enamored newlyweds act until his real phero appears, she'll be able to flee safely when the time comes... But will he let her go?

(Source: Tapas)

Verden, a first-tier mage with a genius intellect but no innate magical talent, is condemned to life as a secret test subject after a devastating betrayal at the Magic Tower. Driven by a thirst for revenge and survival, he develops the "Theory of Celestial Reversal," unlocking limitless potential. But with the tower’s dark forces still looming and mysterious organizations entwining with his fate, will Verden’s quest for vengeance and self-discovery lead to triumph, or will he be shackled once more by inescapable limitations?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Rolicia Roba’s world is turned upside down when her mother tragically passes away. And not only does her long-lost father come to fetch her, but he turns out to be the renowned Count Roward. Thrust into noble society as an illegitimate child, Rolicia is determined to secure her own future without relying on her newfound father. But her cunning stepmother and selfish half-sister are standing stubbornly in her path… and so is Lockhart Caidel, the wartime savior of the second crown prince. With razor-sharp wit and a will of steel, Rolicia refuses to go down—or fall in love—without a fight! 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Despite Earth's advanced space industry, Sa-Han's moonbound spaceship crashes, leaving him stranded out in space for a year. When he's rescued and brought back to Earth, he finds that 11 years have already passed there. While struggling to overcome his space trauma and adjust to the many changes on his home planet, Sa-Han finds himself leaning on Hee-Geon, the little boy next door who is now an adult and hasn't forgotten him. Hee-Geon might be the only one who can help Sa-Han find his place in a world that has long moved on without him...

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: The Baby Demon King Has Too Many Dads
description:
Reborn into a novel as the unawakened Demon King, Tatiana is imprisoned and exploited by demons who use her power for themselves. When her captors are killed by three heroes—Duke Siegfried Orleans, Archmage Kyrios, and High Priest Cesar—she nurses her saviors back to health, and they adopt her! Now, Tatiana is determined to awaken so she can be independent... But with three protective fathers watching her every move, can this 4-year-old keep her secret long enough to become the Demon King?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Welcome to the Abhuman Protection Bureau
description:
After discovering the count she served is half demon, Sera is kicked out and lands a new job at the “Abhuman Protection Bureau.” Tasked with recovering a heirloom stolen from the vampire Vlad family, she juggles day missions and night caretaking—all the while a rather suspicious prince draws near.

*Source: Manta*

display_title: I'll Change the Ending With Education
description:
Killed when her employer, the drunkard Timothy Reynold, is accused of treason, Agnes May Graham wakes up 14 years in the past. Eager to change her fate, Agnes becomes young Timothy's tutor in order to guide him toward a better path. However, she soon learns Timothy's misbehavior stems from the negligence of his guardian and her killer, the distant Duke Ethan Battenberg. Educating children is Agnes' expertise, but how can she solve this problem when it's her employer who really needs a lesson?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: My Little Groom, Even After I'm Gone
description:
Despite being bound by a political marriage, Livenia and Heinrich form a bond and slowly become the family neither of them ever had. That is, until Livenia’s sudden death tears them apart. After being reborn into a new body, she vows to shed the cruel judgment she faced as a young duchess, but seeing Heinrich still trapped in the shadow of her death even 10 years later shakes her resolve. Will she embrace her new life or return to her former groom's side to keep the promise she once made?

(Source: Tapas)

Cha Geon-Wu spent years nursing a hopeless crush on his classmate Lee Tae-Jun, ever since middle school, all the way into college. Tired of dragging around a first love that never went anywhere, he escaped into military service just to reset his heart. But the moment he’s back on campus, destiny laughs in his face, as a required course throws him right back into Tae-Jun’s orbit. Soon, one run-in turns into another, and somehow Geon-Wu ends up trapped in a new cycle he never saw coming. One where Tae-Jun isn’t just the crush he tried to forget…but the person he’s suddenly sharing a bed with.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Straight-laced honor student Jin-Woo decides to break the rules just once, and steps into a club for the first time in his life. One drunken mistake leads to him spending a passionate night with a strikingly handsome stranger - the next morning, he wakes up alone in an empty room…with a pile of cash on the nightstand. Shocked and humiliated, Jin-Woo assumes the worst, and buries the memory deep in his heart. Back at school, Jin-Woo volunteers for a student performance…only to lock eyes with someone on stage. It’s him. The man from that night, and the king of campus: Kwon Tae-Yeong. It’s then that, in front of everyone and with a glint in his eye, Tae-Yeong smiles and utters two words that will change the course of both of their lives forever: “Found you.” 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Simon's sister asks him to boost his account because she's busy. But it turns out the guild his sister belongs to is for women only.

(Source: Toomics)

In the mystical realm of Hoseon, protected by the tiger deity known as the Sable Tiger, Crown Prince Lee Hyo is born with formidable power but a cold, foreboding aura that forces the palace to hide his existence. Meanwhile, Seo Doram, a disgraced noble turned servant, is unexpectedly summoned to the palace with an astonishing decree: he is to become the Crown Princess. Confused and suspicious, Doram finds himself entangled in royal secrets, while the aloof prince oddly recalls a bond from their childhood... Just what could the Sable Tiger have in store for them both?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ceriniel is heartbroken when she learns her husband has been cheating on her with her best friend and secretly poisoning her for years. But when she dies and wakes up in the past, she's determined to get revenge on those who betrayed her. And so she bravely seeks the help of the bloodthirsty war hero, Duke Lexion Rosenvester, who was oddly kind to her in her past life. His only conditions are that she ditch her unfaithful husband and enter a permanent marriage with him instead...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Hans, a vassal who managed everything for the lazy Count Adrian, dies in an ambush and awakens 15 years in the past in Adrian von Kallista’s body. In this timeline, Hans no longer exists, and Adrian is a 15-year-old who once ruined his house through mismanagement. Determined to change that fate, Hans, now living as Adrian, sets out to properly rebuild and guide House Kallista through proper leadership and magic.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Ladies at Her Service: The Demon Princess's First Love
description:
As a child, Lulu the demon princess yearns for the love described in novels from the human world, but is scorned by the heartless demons around her. So she searches for love in the human world and meets Ha-Yeon, a cheerful girl who offers to draw her. Lulu instantly falls for Ha-Yeon’s supportive nature and artistic passion, which prompts her to seek her out again as an adult ten years later. Although Ha-Yeon is now a disillusioned ex-artist who barely remembers Lulu, the demon princess is determined to make her first love come true, no matter what!

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: How to Send Your Husband to Hell
description:
Helena Winston, the dazzling diva of noble society, is thrust into scandal when the crown prince unexpectedly confesses his love. To protect the Empire—and her own reputation—the Empress proposes a secret deal: marry a man of her choosing and expose his secrets. Her target? Count Benjamin Ischpern, a veiled noble rumored to be tied to enemies of the throne. As Helena begins her life in an arranged marriage, one thing becomes clear—there is indeed far more to this man than it seems. So she swears: she will bring her husband to ruin, no matter the cost.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hildegard is the best seamstress in Luminian, but her past life was different. Born in Korea, she was raised to work in fashion before she died in an accident. Now reborn in a fantasy world, she turns to sewing again, unaware that her talent has caught the eye of the crown prince. With an ambition to advance his empire through textile arts, he makes her a surprising offer to become the empress. As fate unwinds like thread from a spool, this choice will reshape her life—and the empire—for good.

(Source:Tapas)

After her sister turns up dead as the latest bride of a monstrous, exiled prince, Louanne is assigned to take her place and hopes to uncover the truth. The prince initially refuses her, but with her magical powers, she begins to heal his pain each night while concealing her own. Meanwhile, her evil uncle, who took advantage of her ability in order to run a medical scheme at home, begins to crumble.
