Has Louanne truly escaped her cursed family, or is she stepping into something darker at Sable Manor?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Struggling actor Hyeon-Su Kim suddenly gains a strange ability after an accident: he can dream the dreams of the dead. These aren’t hazy nightmares or random visions, but vivid relivings of emotions and experiences that don’t belong to him. When Hyeon-Su channels those experiences into his roles, his acting becomes terrifyingly real, as if he’s truly possessed. But how far can a haunted genius go before the dreams start consuming him?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Master swordsman Hyeon Dokgo was crushed after being branded as the public enemy of the entire martial world. Broken in body and spirit, Hyeon believes his days and his troubles are finally over… until trouble finds him in the form of Somi, an adorable and unusually gifted little girl who refuses to leave his side. Through Somi, the battle-obsessed warrior who once dreamed of becoming the most feared name in Murim begins to discover the warmth of a heart he never knew existed. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Demonic Frontline: The 13th Flying Dragon Company
description:
Once an embarrassment to his clan, Jin Seonu starts a new life after being sent to the frontlines, only to be killed years later by his very own brother! But what’s this? He wakes up only to find himself back where he was 10 years earlier? Armed with his knowledge of the future, he returns to the frontlines once again to prove himself for real this time!

(Source: WEBTOON)

On New Year’s Eve, a pink smoke bomb turns the city into chaos, infecting people with a virus that transforms them into animal hybrids driven by uncontrollable lust. Yeonwoo and her friend Dojin hide out at Dojin's house after she infects him, but hunger forces them outside... into a world gone wild. With no cure in sight and a mysterious woman watching it all unfold, the only rule left is: stay inside… or lose yourself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Tae-U and Ji-Eun are friends—just friends. Both of them were comfortable with this arrangement, with neither holding any romantic feelings for the other. However, when Ji-Eun returns from summer break looking noticeably different, Tae-U’s feelings for his friend begin to change, and new feelings of jealousy and confusion taking their place. When Ji-Eun develops a crush on a handsome classmate, things start to get even more complicated between the two of them as Tae-U begins to try to beat out his new competitor and take his longtime friendship with Ji-Eun to the next level.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Rai has been secretly crushing on her childhood friend Do-Gyeong for years. To hide her feelings, she pretends to be a die-hard fan of the K-pop group DIMPLE, especially of Neulchan, her "ultimate bias." It's all just fun and games to make Do-Gyeong a little jealous... until Neulchan suddenly transfers to her school. With her fake idol crush now a real part of her life, her friendship with Do-Gyeong starts to spiral. One fake crush, and one real crush—can Rai keep up the act, or is her secret about to come out? 

(Source: WEBTOON) 

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

display_title: A Hero Who Knows His Stuff
description:
For 20 years, Hyeonseok fought monsters in another world before finally managing to save it and be sent back to Earth as a reward. Now a former deliveryman named Chanseok, he looks forward to enjoying modern conveniences, only to discover that Earth is very different from what he remembers. Monsters have started appearing from Erosion Points that pop up at random, and people with innate abilities become Hunters to defeat them. Reluctantly, Chanseok applies to become a Hunter himself, mostly for the money. He saved the world once before, so how hard can it be the second time?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Moo-Gyum Kim, soccer superstar and troublemaker, takes a pay cut to join K-League's City Seoul, repaying a debt to his middle school teacher. There, he meets Ha-Joon Lee, a rookie coach who avoids him despite their shared past. Moo-Gyum soon uncovers Ha-Joon's strange secret.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: How to Win over Your Crush
description:
At our high school graduation, the rival who had tangled with me for years suddenly confessed that he liked me. It was completely different from the victory I imagined, but still, I thought I had won. I walked away believing the score between us was finally settled. That is, until years later, when he reappeared with a small child clinging to his hand. A son. Disgust and irritation flare up all at once. A shameless fool… If his heart was going to waver that easily, why did he confess in the first place? But fine. It doesn’t matter anymore. The past, his choices, the kid—none of it changes what I already know. If I wanted to drag him back into my bed, it would be the easiest thing in the world. 

In this bitter, twisted reunion, the line between victory and desire grows dangerously thin.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a world that brands Espers as monsters, B-class Esper Seung-Won keeps his head down, until a false accusation from a chaebol heir ruins him. Suspended from duty and desperate to support his family, he accepts a job guarding Cha Jin-Ho, an untouchable S-class Guide from the same privileged world he hates. Cold and dismissive, Jin-Ho refuses even the slightest touch - until a clash between them triggers an unexpected contact guidance, a resonance that leaves them both shaken. Bound by a reluctant contract, the two are forced together, and Seung-Won begins to dream of a man who looks just like Jin-Ho, calling his name from another lifetime ago…

(Source: Lezhin US)

I've been beaten and humilated all my life and I even lost my parents.

*"Now it's your turn. Don't expect to get out of this easily."*

(Source: DAYcomics)

When Kim Tae-Wun sneaks onto a film set to find his twin sister - an avid fan and fansite master of idol-turned-actor Lee Hae-Seo - he ends up running right into the star himself. The problem? Hae-Seo just happens to be in the middle of an uncontrollable rut cycle. In a whirlwind of chaos, Tae-Woon helps him through it, only to bolt like Cinderella at midnight. Now, with no idea who his mysterious savior was, Hae-Seo takes to social media to track him down… and Tae-Wun’s quiet life is about to get very, very noisy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After saving little Amber from an abusive foster parent, hitman Tennessee gains someone worth protecting for the first time in his life. But the older Amber gets, the more his obsessive love for Tennessee grows, despite his rescuer still seeing him as the same little boy from years ago. It isn’t until Tennessee gets into an accident that leaves him with face blindness that the lines between them begin to blur. Tennessee knows in his head that this is still Amber, but his impairment makes both the younger man’s face and Tennessee’s own feelings for him unrecognizable...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ten years ago, Yeon-Ju left Eun-Seong, the man she loved, to protect his budding career. Now a stylist and devoted single mom to her son, Han-Byeol, she's shocked to learn that the lead actor of her next film is the very man she walked away from...

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: A Spring Breeze in a Wasteland
description:
Esen's death was only the beginning. After saving Cliff from her father's cruelty and being forced to become his wife, her life ended while giving birth to her enemy's child. But fate wasn’t finished with her. When she wakes up in the past with knowledge of the future, Esen is determined to rewrite her fate and change her relationship with Cliff, who was once her enemy and is now her greatest challenge. Can love truly rise from the ashes of hatred? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ha Jun-Seo was once a rising star in the classical music world. Now, he manages the career of a more successful friend while drowning his own regrets in clubs and alcohol. After a drunken one-night stand with a stranger, Junseo blacks out, only to wake up in the home of a large, scarred man named Kang Wu-Jin.

*“You don’t remember me?”*

Something about Wu-Jin feels off, and Jun-Seo tries to run, but the man only smiles ominously.

*“See you soon, Ha Jun-Seo.”*

Days later, Wu-Jin reappears as Jun-Seo’s new boss. Trapped under his obsessive watch, Jun-Seo must figure out who Wu-Jin really is and whether escape is even possible.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Old Prisoner Living in Solitude
description:
In the jail known as Solitude of Karaisman, trillions of prisoners are kept in brutal conditions. Somehow, a blind man named Argel Lastos has survived for decades, despite being one of the prison’s first inmates. Now, he’s determined to protect and train a child named Cero to turn his unrealized talent into a fearsome power, all while defending his friends from the desperate inmates. But, is the old man only doing it to save Cero… or is it for a far more sinister purpose?

(Source: Tapas)

Among the numerous emblems to exist, only one is said to be cursed with the fate of ruin—the Emblem of Asura. After a man who serves an unseen will reduces Vahn’s life to ashes and casts him into a timeless abyss, Vahn endures 999 long years of torment before awakening the true power of ruin. Reborn as vengeance incarnate, his retribution begins.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hyeri Kang’s a screwup with a criminal record and crushing debt. After abducting a seemingly wealthy woman to pay off the loan sharks, she realizes that her victim is actually a cross-dressing man—and a serial killer fresh off his latest murder. The pair soon end up in a violent, sexual codependency that reveals a shared trauma and the grief that shattered both of their lives. Can they outrun the past and start over together? Or will karma catch them, destroying any chance of a future?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

After spending a lifetime drinking an absurd amount of strawberry milk, Song Seol-Ah thought the worst she’d ever have to face was a stomachache. Until her chest started leaking the stuff, that is! As strange new urges overtake her body and mind, she tries to deal with it alone…until an ill-timed encounter with Kim Yushin, her childhood friend turned national medalist, throws everything into chaos. When he offers to help relieve her unbearable desire, she’s thrust into a dangerously sweet arrangement that’s quickly spiraling out of control.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes nine extra chapters.*

Everyone knows the Cinderella story, but few know that her "happily ever after" only lasted 10 years. When the prince betrays her, a harvest mouse named Elodie is desperate to help her as her loyal friend. Elodie's wish brings about a miracle—she finds herself back in the past and discovers that she has the ability to shapeshift into a human. With this newfound power, she is ready to rewrite the ending of Cinderella's story. Will the two friends be able to find their own happily ever after?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Ladies at Her Service: Hungry Widow
description:
Cheong-Hwa is married off to a wealthy old man who starves her to "keep her figure trim." Once he dies, she's finally free to satisfy her raging hunger and eat to her heart's content. And now that she's been left alone with her pretty servant, Oh-Weol, food isn't the only thing Cheong-Hwa has a ravenous appetite for...

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.*

When Coco dies after five happy years with her owner Chloe, she thinks her tail-wagging days are over. But Coco can't bear to stay in the afterlife as she watches Chloe's world crumble. Taking pity on her, the Puppy God grants Coco's wish to return. Now, she's a human child who gets adopted into Chloe's family. Unfortunately, she discovers that reaching Chloe's heart is harder than any trick she's ever learned. Can she fetch the joy Chloe has lost, or has their bond slipped away like a leash?

(Source: Tapas)

When Han Jun-Woo discovers his favorite football player twins are going to play in the same match, he absolutely has to go watch them in person. But after his normal part-time job closes down, Jun-Woo desperately signs up for all the lucrative one-day gigs he can find. Little does he know, money won't be the only thing he gets from these quick and easy jobs. Will Jun-Woo be able to see his beloved twins play football? Or will his seven wildly different jobs leave an undeniable mark on his body?

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Taeseong, an actor past his prime known for playing gangster roles, accidentally switches places with a real-life gangster named Mun-gil. Taeseong’s life suddenly turns into a scriptless scene filled with dangerous thugs! One wrong move could mean the end for him. Will Taeseong be able to make it out alive in this world of real gangsters?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Omega Taekwondo star Tae-Hyun must find a “partner” before his final Olympics to help control his hormone levels. That partner is none other than Se-Jin, a fencer he took care of 4 years ago. As their relationship continues to develop in unexpected ways, can he break his jinx and finally win gold?

(Source: Manta)

display_title: My Older Sister is the Main Character
description:
When Helena was reborn into a novel, she was forced to grow up knowing that her sister was the main character and that a terrible life awaited her… unless Helena could stop it from happening. By learning how to take care of family matters, Helena took her sister, Callisto’s, place as the head of the house, allowing her to live her dream of being a knight. But she now finds herself hurtling towards both the terrible fate once meant for Callisto and the man who makes it come to pass.

(Source: Tapas)

I'm here to protect the lady of the Ruslan household... through all dangers and perils.

(Source: Toomics)

Born from a rose, Ariel is heir to the throne of the gods—but her feeble powers earn her the nickname "the foolish goddess." Then one day, she wakes up in the body of an adorable young girl! A 200-year-old goddess trapped in a child’s body… how will she ever return to where she belongs?

(Source: Manta)

After reawakening from a C-rank to the strongest A-rank Esper, Ha Jae-Il is pushed to the brink by insomnia and unresolved trauma, unable to endure even the slightest touch. His only match is Seung-Hyeon, an A-rank Guide with a 98 percent compatibility who comes from the lawless District 13 and lacks all formal guiding skills. With no other options, the Haon Division orders an extreme solution: the two must share a bed twice a week. But when Jae-Il wakes to unfamiliar hands in the dark and sees Seung-Hyeon looming over him, he realizes that something else has awakened as well - and it is already guiding him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After playing the game Guardian of Humanity for years and becoming an expert, Je-u Han finds himself dragged into a new server of the game and forced to play at the weakest level. The problem is, death in the game means death in real life too. As Demon Kings rise and imperial forces collide, even the routes he once mastered twist into unfamiliar danger. Can Je-u break free from the patterns that doomed every past run, or will a world that no longer follows its established routes prove too much of a challenge?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Sanho suddenly finds herself as the academy’s only commoner after her school transforms into the world of a romance fantasy novel. Armed with memories of reality, she’s thrown into chaos when a strange mission appears: win over three potential male leads and uncover the truth behind this altered world. Amid dazzling nobles and hidden dangers, can Sanho complete her mission and face the secrets waiting for her?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Do or Die: Work On Hold
description:
Ahn Si-Young has waited for years for the day he becomes old enough to ask out his crush, Seo Do-Hyun. That day finally comes when Si-Young starts interning at Do-Hyun’s company, albeit with a strange mission: “Have sex with your crush in the office, or you will die.” Even though this is Si-Young’s long-awaited chance at love, is this really the right way to go about it...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.*

Beauty was her curse. What others envied and longed for only brought her misery. Scarred and weary, I-yeon decided to hide her crafted-by-god looks. In doing so, she gained a new identity, the ugly secretary, I-yeon Yu. She endured the mockery and lived quietly in the shadows until one day... "Let's live together." Do-hyeon An, the only heir of the powerful Wooseung Group, suddenly proposed to her. No one can ever discover their contract marriage or her true identity. Under the same roof begins a thrilling and breathtaking romance of secrets and deception. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

He's mad. Rohshan, abandoning the pride of his Count family and his duty to continue the lineage, is addicted to his relationship with his slave, Kyle. Before the Nest Wedding, the grand finale of this year's Black Dragon Festival, Kyle relentlessly provokes Rohshan into intoxication, desperate to get him to confess. With Rohshan refusing to confess, Kyle loses his reason and goes mad with each passing moment.

 *"How long do I have to wait? If I keep this up, I'll go completely crazy."*

Secrets swirl around Rohshan's mansion: the suspicion of his parents' murder, the origins of his lustful nature, the identity of the slave who has captivated him...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Shi-Hu Lee has logged 20,000 hours playing Let's Kill the Demon Lord! for the past 5 years. But when the game takes a turn he doesn't like, Shi-Hu cancels his pre-order of the DLC in anger, only to find himself sucked into the game! Now in the body of Julian Kreipart Prason, the villain, he has to play the part perfectly to survive the many enemies around him while unable to use the moonlight blade, Julian's signature ability. Under the watchful eye of Eileen, the genius gold mage, and his family members who want him gone, can Julian make it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: This face genius is good at soccer
description:
One day a goddess asked Min-Jun, who loved football and chased his dream harder than anyone else, but was left behind due to slow growth and an unimpressive appearance.

*"I'm the goddess of soccer. What is your wish?"

"Sex"*

On that day, his ordinary life completely changed.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

What life is there for a creature forever trapped in a cage? Such questions ring true for Isabella Heloise, illegitimate child of an abusive count who uses her as a pawn for his political ambitions. When Isabella's betrothal to an influential noble is broken off, her value within the Heloise household plummets, prompting her to flee from her father’s violence. Isabella finds herself alone and destitute, only to be found by Ethan Holden, a dashing duke with a nonetheless ominous air. Can Isabella trust the handsome duke, or has she found herself in yet another cage?

(Source: WEBTOON)

I woke up one day to find a world where male and female values of chastity were reversed... From married women asking for penetration with cash in hand, to college girls offering their virginities... Am I in heaven. My fuck journey is officially about to kick off!

*"Who, the...? I've never seen such shamelessness..."*

(Source: DAYcomics)

The bond of family can be a star that guides us in the night, or a chain that drags us down. For aspiring hunter Seung-Hyeon Gi, both are true. He dreams of becoming a legendary hunter like his father, despite his bitterness at his family’s preoccupation with his comatose sister, So-Hyeon. Everything changes when So-Hyeon suddenly regains consciousness and reveals herself as a ‘Homecomer’, possessing powerful abilities from transmigrating to another world while comatose. Seung-Hyeon realizes that if he wants to protect his sister, he'll need to grow stronger, and there’s no better place than the Seong-Han Academy for the Gifted…

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: I Became a Swordsmanship Instructor at the Academy
description:
When a failing web novelist drops dead at his desk, he's granted a wish in the underworld... and uses it to enter a novel. But instead of becoming the main character, he possesses Kang Shin-Hyuk, a total extra! Now set to be the protagonist's future teacher, Shin-Hyuk's out to use what he knows of the original plot to borrow the hero's power-ups for an easy, carefree life. But in a world of monsters and danger, can Shin-Hyuk really rest easy? Or will he be made to buckle down and hustle once more?

(Source: Tapas)

After surviving a brutal childhood tragedy and awakening from a mysterious coma, Shinyeok Lee returns with the mind of a genius profiler and fifteen years’ worth of knowledge that no one can explain. Now, he reads the lies of the living and uncovers the truths of the dead, solving crimes no one else can. But every case brings him closer to the murderer who destroyed his family. Can Shinhyeok expose the ultimate villain, or will the darkness he studies consume him first?

(Source: WEBTOON)

When the manger brought in a dusty-looking board game, no one knew that... this is one game you can't escape.

(Source: Toomics)

The Myers are out of luck. Not only did the tyrant emperor strip them of their title and land, but Alexis, the head of the family, took his own life because of it... And no one's more shocked than his wife, Louise, when he suddenly wakes up a completely different person! But Louise doesn't realize that Alexis has been possessed by a hero from another world, one who's determined to save the Myers once and for all. Can the new Alexis become the family's savior? Or will he be rejected as a fake?

(Source: Tapas)

Cheol-Su is a loser in life and a loser in-game... until he’s suddenly promoted to Goblin Summoner. He’s shocked when he discovers that his goblin summon is a hideous, max-level monster capable of obliterating any foe with a single attack! There’s just one catch, though--his new buddy can’t be unsummoned, and it draws way too much attention. Now stuck with an overpowered pet following him everywhere, he has to get crafty and channel his inner goblin to manipulate and claw his way to the top in pursuit of greatness and riches.

(Source: WEBTOON)

In a world where adventurers raid dungeons for fame and fortune, Nagi is stuck as a lowly porter – overlooked, mistreated, and considered expendable. But armed with a mysterious magic bag and quick wits, Nagi begins to challenge the brutal hierarchy from within. Can he rise above betrayal, dangerous monsters, and a corrupt system – or will this ruthless world discard him like the baggage he carries?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Saintess is Stuck in a Wall!
description:
Saintess Liliana wants just one thing out of her second marriage: to finally be satisfied in the bedroom. However, her marriage to the kingdom’s biggest playboy, Prince Riverre, isn’t exactly welcomed by her modest first husband, the holy knight commander Altus. What’s more, Liliana’s unholy wish lands her a divine punishment of being stuck in the wall between her two husbands’ bedrooms. But perhaps this unconventional three-way might be just what the saintess needs to spice up her marriage!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Only a swordmaster can slay another. Arhan believed the tales of Liam Karavan, the founding father of his house, were nothing more than legend, until a deadly swordmaster slaughtered everyone dear to him. In his darkest hour, Liam comes to him as a guiding spirit, revealing the true power of their bloodline--the power to devour blades and inherit the strength and memories held within. With each sword consumed, Arhan draws one step closer to vengeance. To avenge his loved ones and restore House Karavan to its former glory, he must survive the perilous path to becoming a swordmaster.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: I Became the Ghost Duke's Daughter
description:
Unwanted as an heir, Theresia Oblen is sent from her noble home to live with the ghostly Duke Everdin. As someone who can see phantoms, the haunted rumors mean little, but the residents of Everdin Manor are no average ghouls. Despite their lively warmth, they live under a curse that turned them into invisible beings. Theresia hopes that by absolving the woes of the manor's true evil specters, she can restore the duchy and return home. Can she put these spirits to rest and finally live in peace?

(Source: Tapas)

Seconds before you self exit you hear that your divorced father has passed away, leaving you an unimaginable amount of money. But once you get to his funeral who he left behind, you realize that money isn't the only thing you can take...

(Source: Toomics)

He finds a risqué video on a hard drive he thinks is his. She takes the blame to protect her friend—and pretends to be into it. But as they keep up the act, neither of them is prepared for how real it starts to feel.

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: I'd Rather Live as a Villain
description:
After years of hiding his brilliance as a loyal executive aide, Taesik Yun finally has the chance to face the superiors who once stole his work and destroyed his reputation. He secures his seat as the new Division Director through a high-stakes, 10-billion-won contract marriage to his boss, Munjeong Kang -- the fierce legitimate heir fighting to keep her empire from her illegitimate brother. But as he steps into the spotlight to claim his revenge -- can Taesik survive the cutthroat succession war while navigating a fake marriage that feels increasingly real?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Seo Yeon-Woo is in love with his best friend, Cha Do-Jin, and he’s afraid of letting his feelings slip, knowing it could ruin their lifelong friendship forever. But when Yeon-Woo slowly distances himself from Do-Jin and makes friends with a new student named Baek Ha, Dojin starts developing feelings he’s never experienced before. Is it simple jealousy over losing his best friend? Or is it something more?

(Source: Tappytoon)

 *Note: Includes three side story chapters rated R19.*

display_title: Do or Die: Quest to Tame the Big Bad Wolf
description:
Ella never expected to be trapped in her own game, nor to be given a quest that could kill her. Within three days, she must kiss Lai, the leader of the Beastkin. But after she left him battered and furious, will he give her his lips or death?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: My Contract Husband Looks Like the Male Lead
description:
At the age of 8, Anya Lockhart realizes she's been born into a tragic dark romance novel she read in her past life. And unfortunately, she's the female lead destined to fall into the crazy emperor's clutches! So when his proposal arrives, she packs up and runs away from home. After years on the run, she meets Dale, a sweet mercenary living in a remote southern village. But is there more to Dale than meets the eye? The more she learns, the more he doesn't seem like an ordinary mercenary...

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Life Reboot for a Gaming Addict
description:
After six years, gaming nerd Lee Jinho finally finishes Reset Life, a brutal mobile game where you have to clear 99 different lives. Just as the thrill of victory fades and emptiness takes hold, a sudden message reveals the game has merged with reality. The true 100th round begins, marking the start of his real reset life. Now, armed with his knowledge from the game, Jinho sets out to reclaim all the skills he once mastered, living as a model, actor, chef, and more in his ultimate new life!

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I Ended Up Educating the Secret Villain Too Well
description:
Avel is a cute young girl who’s chaotic and a little violent. She couldn’t care less about social rules and polite society. Nevertheless, to avoid her tragic fate in the future of this novel at the hands of the cold first prince Chesa, she has to get to him while he’s young and teach him to be a good person. So what if she has to break some rules (and kick some butts) along the way? What matters is that the neglected boy learns to care for other people. What could possibly go wrong?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Guiding the Lead Out of His Trauma
description:
When the reader wakes up in a novel as Liliope, a guide who tragically dies because of the unstable male lead, Octaeon, she has her work cut out for her. Liliope's death traumatizes Octaeon in the original novel, but the female lead helps him recover, and the two fall in love. However, Liliope’s brother, Hyacin, despises Octaeon for killing her and morphs into the novel’s villain. Refusing to let her death drag him into darkness and despair, Liliope decides to rewrite her ending. However, as she weaves her new fate, she realizes her ending isn’t the only thing that's changing.

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Darling, You've Got It All Wrong
description:
Grace Oelin, plagued by a fear of sharp objects, faints whenever she meets Lucas Black, the kingdom’s most feared, sword-wielding duke. But beneath his cold exterior lies a hopeless romantic. Determined to break off their arranged marriage, Grace is horrified to learn Lucas has mistaken her fear for love. As he dreams of a sweet newlywed life, Grace plots her escape. Can she see past his fearsome image and discover who he truly is, or will the secrets of the infamous House Black pull her under?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: A Taste of Happiness for the Tragic Extra
description:
Once upon a time, a neglected princess died a tragic death, only to wake up as a child once more and find herself beloved by all. This is the novel Leivella wakes up in, but she’s not the princess. Instead, she’s a mere extra whose family was framed and slaughtered by the tyrannical emperor. Now serving as the princess’s food taster who tests for poison, Leivella must find a way to avoid meeting a tragic death of her own. The world may revolve around its protagonist, but the unmentioned extra might have a shot at writing her own fate!

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: To the Witch Who Forgot Her Bird
description:
Prince Alec, the troublemaker of the Royal Family, runs into some trouble himself when he discovers he is being hunted by assassins. With magic involved in this deadly scheme, the only one who can protect him is Victoria, the Witch of Bitter Cold, who offers her help in exchange for a “small” favor. But as her title implies, Victoria is devoid of human emotions and will stop at nothing to get what she wants. Although Prince Alec tries to maintain some distance between them, this proves to be difficult the longer he is stuck with his icy protector...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Feared by name alone, Shin Juhyeok never expected his toughest challenge to be... raising a kid? After rescuing a young hybrid named Lee Hae-on from an accident, Juhyeok planned to keep him around just until he recovered. But the once-scrawny stray grows up—fast—and now towers over his reluctant guardian, refusing to leave his side. Juhyeok can handle gangs and thugs, but nothing could prepare him for this: Hae-on’s first heat. Sweet, clingy, and completely unaware of personal space, Hae-on’s affection is anything but subtle. Raising a hybrid was never part of the plan—but neither was falling for one. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: A Dangerous Deal, and the Woman Next Door
description:
*"My wife... once she's naked, it's really game over..."*

A glimpse at CCTV footage reveals the neighbor woman - completely nude. Wracked with guilt he shouldn't feel, Scott is caught off guard when Harry makes a dangerous offer:

*"Wanna have her? On one condition... Do it right in front of me."*

(Source: DAYcomics)

Helltham is a crime-ridden city ruled by the Golden Bite Family, whose boss dies in a mysterious accident. When Seven, the family's degenerate third-in-command, is named as a promising candidate for the next boss, he plans to use his power to live it up even more. However, he gets stabbed in the back by his long-time partner, Felix, who turns out to be a spy working with the city's only law enforcement agency. Felix then offers him two choices at gunpoint: either work with him to take down the Golden Bite Family or sleep with the fishes.

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Caught in the Dark Navy Admiral’s Net
description:
Selah Cardi is a former marine biology student who woke up in a romance novel as an inconsequential extra. Eager to survive the plot, Selah manages to rescue Maria so that she and Duke Herbert, her fiancé, will be indebted to her. But then Admiral Ellaim notices her and her magical abilities that allow her to breathe underwater. Selah soon discovers that Ellaim is a merman called a siren, and that he needs her powers to recover from a mysterious illness. Will her dream of retiring by the sea in peace ever come true?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: I'm a Homebody, but I Transmigrated Into a Dark Captivity Novel
description:
After dying from overwork, a woman is reincarnated as April Salt, a minor character forced to serve the demanding princess. Doomed to another life of endless labor, her fate changes when she is accidentally kidnapped by the undeniably handsome Grand Duke Kaian Braille. Instead of dying again, she is confined in luxury, with every need met. What should be a prison starts feeling like paradise. If only everyone would stop bothering her and let her do nothing!

(Source: Tapas)

Vibia has served as a Vestal Virgin since childhood, sworn to chastity and charged with guarding the sacred flame of Vesta. Breaking her vow means death. Her ordered life collapses when she is pulled into the lethal intrigues of Emperor Domitian’s court. Behind its beauty and splendor lurks Julia, charming and dangerously manipulative. Drawn into a tense triangle with the mysterious freedman Leonides and the hardened centurion Quintus Sirius Aquila, Vibia must navigate a treacherous landscape where her vows of purity become political weapons, her every action is watched, and one misstep could mean death in the clash between holiness and the corrupting force of imperial power.

(Source: WEBTOON)

During a mission gone wrong, Yeon Yoo’s subordinate Ryoong is infected with the zombie virus — but he’s… different. He doesn’t hunger for flesh. He doesn’t turn mindless. The only thing he seems to be craving is... Yeon. If he’s not a zombie, then what could he have possibly turned into?

(Source: Manta)

Marrying your childhood best friend and first love may sound like a dream come true – but not for Renee. After marrying into a contract marriage with Alexander, Renee faces all sorts of trouble, but none can match her own husband’s cold shoulder. However, a magical wish might change everything. Can a simple wish save Renee’s failing marriage?

(Source: WEBTOON)

When a shady police inquiry causes Scarlet Crimson to have a mysterious memory lapse and unknowingly betray her cold and distant husband, Victor Dumfeldt, their fragile marriage shatters in divorce. To start anew, she returns to her family’s watchmaking trade to rebuild her life and her parents' legacy. But when Victor reenters her life, Scarlet starts to wonder if what was broken can be repaired. Between memories lost and words unspoken, can they learn from what they didn’t know the first time?

(Source: Tapas)

Sung-Yeon's long-time crush on her superior Jae-Yoon takes an unexpected turn when a night of drunken confusion leads her to wake up in his house. She uncovers a secret that won’t leave her mind and is left wondering if the man she thought was gentle and professional is hiding a much wilder side.

(Source: Manta)

Men were all losers, and women only existed to lie under me. I deserved to stand above them all. Until I got this damn curse…

*"Use your body to satisfy those men ❤️"*

(Source: TOPTOON)

Zed, a former MMA champion, wakes up in the body of a scrawny prisoner in a fantasy world. Reborn as a member of the once-feared Arahan family, he’s trapped inside a brutal magical internment camp. With no spells at his disposal, Zed trains his body to become a living weapon. He escapes the prison with his only ally Riu, a sharp-witted inmate. Now hunted by both a ruthless warden and a noble house, Zed must fight his way to freedom only with his fists. Can a man with no magic change the rules of a world built on it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

*"Is it really this hard, just because of me?"*

After finishing his military service, Gi-Chan develops a strange condition. Once he gets hard, he doesn't go down until he cums. And when he finally does? He releases an explosive amount of cum. With this dangerous condition, Gi-Chan returns to his hometown... where a seductive new family is waiting for him.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

display_title: The Strongest Lady Hides Her Strength
description:
The Hero guards the empire in times of war but is sealed away when peace prevails, making her life an incessant cycle of fighting and slumber. That is, until she wakes up as Roshanne Leilaten, a meek noble lady looked down upon by even her own servants. Unwilling to give up the freedom she so yearns, Roshanne conceals her true identity as she investigates how to permanently break the seal that binds her to the emperor. But can a girl who's used to leading with her fists navigate high society?

(Source: Tapas)

Ho Kim, an avid enjoyer of the RPG "Dragon Slayer Academy", is the single most powerful support in the game. After spending countless hours, he eventually manages to reach the major milestone of raising 1,000 heroes to S-rank and is presented with a hidden quest. Tempted by the possibility of raising his S-rank heroes to the more powerful EX-rank, he accepts the quest without a second thought, only to find himself trapped inside the game world...

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: There's No Such Thing as a Naughty Munchkin
description:
Korean childcare worker Boyoung awakens in a mysterious land and a bygone era, trapped in the body of governess Edith Bruissel. Thrust into a world of secrets, magic, and noble intrigue, she is determined to find a mage who can send her home. But her plans are quickly complicated by a secretive duke with a troubled past, a marriage contract, and children who need her more than ever. Can Boyoung find her way back to the world she came from, or is she trapped in Edith’s life for good?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The double life of a public official
description:
James Lee, a grade 7 official, is trying to make it through each day dealing with Amanda Shin, a grade 5 official. One day, James finds out about Amanda's double life that he can use for revenge.

*"Shall we do a roleplay? It's about forced sex volunteer."*

(Source: DAYcomics)

After years in the criminal underworld, Dao Tongda faces death with nothing to show for his life except a handful of coins. But the heavens grant him an impossible miracle when he wakes up in the body of his 18-year-old self. Reuniting with old friends at the Guanghua Road Fixer Agency, he sets out to claim the power and wealth that once escaped him. But in a world ruled by blood and betrayal, can Tongda rewrite his fate and claim the throne of the night? Or is history doomed to repeat itself?

(Source: Tapas)

“There are plenty of fish in the sea,” or so they say. Easier said than done for Gahi Kim, whose crush is rising K-drama star Yubin Choi. Despite going to the same university as Yubin, Gahi can only daydream and grumble to her bestie and roommate Sara, as there’s never any sign of her crush on campus. But then, while having drinks at a nearby pub, Gahi meets a boy who’s the spitting image of Yubin. Seemingly more outgoing and down-to-earth compared to her idol, this look-alike is just the beginning of Gahi’s campus drama…

(Source: WEBTOON)

Seung-Jo and Seo-Hee grew up like family in the quiet town of Haeyoung. That is until 6 years ago, when he told her he likes her — but not as a sister — and then left when she hesitated. Now he’s back, no longer a boy but a grown man. And he’s done holding back.

(Source: Manta)

Once a rising star in the popular band Rookie, Connie suddenly vanished from the spotlight after a fellow member stole one of his songs. He quit the band without explanation and disappeared from the public eye. Five years later, after constant persuasion from his longtime fan Louie, Connie reluctantly joins a band at his college called Dead Core, and instantly becomes the talk of campus. But things get complicated when his mysterious roommate Mika, who seems oddly familiar, begins inserting himself into Connie’s life. From day one, Mika insists they’d make the perfect graduation project partners…and he’s not taking no for an answer.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jun-Su, a public health doctor serving his mandatory term at Songhwa Prison, thought his assignment would be dull, routine checkups, a few minor injuries, nothing more. But on his seventh day, the world literally collapses. A mysterious nationwide sinkhole disaster swallows cities whole, cutting the prison off from the outside world. Now trapped inside a fortress filled with men more terrifying than demons, Jun-Su has only one thought: 

*“I have to get out of here.”*

Clutching a stolen keycard, his only ticket to freedom, he makes a break for it. But before he can escape, he runs into the infamous Lee brothers, Tae-Hyeong and Tae-Mu, cold-blooded criminals whose names alone strike fear even among inmates.

 *“What a feast. Lick it clean.”*

With monsters above and monsters within, Jun-Su’s fight for survival turns into a chilling game of instinct, trust, and the brutal will to live.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Baek Seung-Hyun has lived in the shadows his whole life, nothing more than the deadly right hand of yakuza boss Shin Jae-Il. But now, Jae-Il is married. And Seung-Hyun, for the first time in years, is left behind. Drifting through empty streets on the night after the wedding, Seung-Hyun crosses paths with Yuta, a delicate ghost from his time in Japan. But what should have been a quiet reunion over a drink turns sharp fast. Yuta’s sweetness curdles, his words cut deep, and before Seung-Hyun can make sense of it everything begins to burn. Uninvited and unrelenting, Yuta storms into his life, dragging with him the weight of the past and something far more dangerous. Seung-Hyun begins to fear that dawn, when it comes, won’t bring light. Only fire.

(Source: Lezhin US)

If you could get your dream house for a bargain under the sole condition that you keep it spotless, would you sign the deed? I sure did! I didn't expect it to come with a clean-freak ghost, but I figured I could just hire house staff. Except that's when the problems started... Why did a revolutionary leader, the master of the Magic Tower, a swordmaster, and a literal demon answer my job post?! I do need the extra pairs of hands, though... Oh well, what's the worst that could happen? 

(Source: Tapas)

Geon-Woo is a bodyguard who works on the security team for the idol group Magnum. He doesn’t really have any complaints about his job, except for one person who keeps getting on his nerves: Do-Yoon. Throughout his career in the industry, Geon-Woo has never met a more irritating idol who seems ungrateful to his fans. Do-Yoon is simply a brat with a pretty face, in Geon-Woo’s opinion, which is why he never intended to get mixed up with Do-Yoon in any personal way… So how did they end up in bed together? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.*

Shay, the S-Class Hunter everyone dreams of becoming. But Dennis, a man with the power to switch bodies, sets his sights on stealing everything from him... by taking his body.

*"You want my body? You'd be better off chasing youth."*

(Source: DAYcomics)

display_title: Regressed, but the World Didn’t End
description:
Humanity’s last hope just got a second chance… and a mountain of debt. Dohyeok, the champion of humankind, is sent back in time to stop the apocalypse. He then pours his time, money, and soul into preparing for an alien invasion that never comes. Now chased by creditors instead of aliens, Dohyeok turns to game streaming to repay his debt. Follow the ex-hero-turned-streamer as he hacks his way through popular game titles one epic stream at a time. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: I Don't Want to Be the Germophobe Villain's Guide
description:
Most espers can be guided by anyone except the villain of a popular dating sim, Claude Dunheartt. Claude’s allergy to guiding makes him prone to powerful outbursts. But when Rose Valentine transmigrates from the modern world, she becomes the only one who can guide him. Rose is a veteran player of the game and knows how evil Claude is. But after getting to know him, she wonders: is he really trying to kill her, or is he seeking the only comfort from the pain he’s lived with all these years?

(Source: Tapas)

Rejected by her family and betrayed by her fiancé and scheming half-sister, Efna gets a second chance at life when she wakes up before the accident that was meant to end her. Determined to live quietly as a teacher, she soon discovers that her mischievous Sunshine Class is only the beginning. Add a few politically feuding older brothers into the mix—a dashing captain, an emperor, and an archduke—and chaos is inevitable. Can Efna make it through nap time, or will she lose her sanity first?

(Source: Tapas)

Ku Yeon-Seo is AZ Company’s marketing superstar, blessed with perfect looks, sharp skills, and one very inconvenient secret: He is a nine-tailed fox who spent a mere two hundred years growing all his tails. And yet, despite his outstanding track record as a kumiho, he’s decided that being a regular human with exams, job hunting, and office deadlines sounded more appealing than becoming a celestial fox. Despite his carefully curated life, everything goes wrong when a single mistake exposes his identity to Yu Min-Hyeok, a straight-laced developer who, to Yeon-Seo’s horror, is completely immune to his magic. Determined to protect his peaceful “human” life, Yeon-Seo comes up with a questionable plan to charm his way into Min-Hyeok and his younger sister’s life regardless, magic be damned!

(Source: Lezhin US)

A deal with a girl I used to have a crush on... A rather... "haunting" deal.

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: What Happens When You Mess With the Original Novel
description:
After possessing a piteous side character in a novel who is fated to die, Seraphie doesn't waste any time lamenting her fate. Instead, she sets out immediately to change the original plot and save herself from an untimely end at the hands of her abusive father. She'll stop at nothing to save herself from any bit of suffering, even if it means messing with the lives of the main characters. But is it really that easy to change a story's plot? Or are some things just destined to happen?

(Source: Tapas)

SNayun, a college freshman, only approached the drummer of the campus band 3DAYS to help her best friend get closer to him. But when the band’s handsome vocalist, Seolu, unexpectedly confesses to her that same night, Nayun’s simple plan takes a surprising turn. Convinced that she’s not ready for a relationship, she tells Seolu she’s not looking to date anyone, though her racing heart suggests otherwise. Unfazed, Seolu suggests they just be “good friends” instead. Between his teasing charm and her own conflicted feelings, Nayun soon finds that staying just friends might be harder than she thought.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Je-Hyun, a beta researcher studying Alpha-Omega gene replication, is given a secret mission: lie low for a while and act as guardian for AP1, a dominant Alpha test subject. Moved by the experiment’s innocent eyes, he grows attached to the young subject and names him “Ian.” But the very next day, Jae-Hyun wakes up to find a towering man waiting for him…a man who turns out to be none other than Ian himself, now suddenly fully grown and overwhelming in stature. In this twisted tale of genetic experiments and forbidden bonds, who’s really taming whom?

(Source: Lezhin US)

If he didn't touch her constantly, she would die. Thus, Lyret's fate was sealed when Duke Balderion's name engraving suddenly appeared on her skin. Yet, he's the one who killed her traitorous father and cast her into ruin. Can Lyret escape the Duke and his smouldering glare?

(Source: Manta)

display_title: What Happens if a Driver Is Unmarried
description:
Hardy works as a proxy driver of magic carriages until a shady request sends him to the wedding of Hysterion's infamous young heir. Forced to crash the ceremony, Hardy is stunned when Abel Hysterion, the center of every scandal, points straight at him and declares, "Here comes my bride."

(Source: Manta)

Joo In-gong was dragged into the remake of a game he was playing called <Knight Saga:Re>.

However, something wasn’t right. The only playable characters should be Loch of the human side and Zephyr of the demon side. Instead, he awakens in the body of Shutra— the ninth prince of the Demon Realm, a character who actually didn’t exist in the game’s story.

Granted two mysterious powers, “Protagonist Setting Adjustment” and “Power of Conquest,” Joo In-gong now must alter the game’s plot to survive against Zephyr.

Yet, with every twist of the plot, he garners more attention…

(Source: MangaDex)

Elizabeth is the richest heir in the empire. But after her parents’ sudden death, she’s told she must marry her uncle to claim her inheritance. No, thanks. So she fakes an engagement with her maid, runs away, and sets out to burn through the family fortune. Simple enough... until a drunken one-night stand with a man who looks like her first love throws everything off. And now he won’t stop following her!

(Source: Tapas)

Listless and going nowhere, Jiwoo finds a flicker of purpose during his late-night shifts at the convenience store in regular customer, Juhee, a confident and captivating college student who treats him with unexpected warmth. But what begins as quiet admiration soon turns electric, as Juhee reveals a teasing, dominant side that awakens something deep in both of them. Caught between submission and desire, Jiwoo is about to discover just how sweet it can be to give in. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Death comes to Gwon Young by scent. Every ten years, the person Young loves most dies. Hoping to escape the curse, he moves away. But then he meets An Ji-Ho, a man who seems to be quietly waiting for the end of his own life. Their connection forms fast and deep, filling the emptiness they both carry. But with another ten-year mark approaching, Young can’t shake the scent of death on the air.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Suffering from a thirst that can't be quenched with a one-off encounters, I'm still hooked on these dirty confessions.

(Source: TOPTOON)

Hyunwoo wakes up to find himself buried under a million-dollar debt. But there's a way out. If he agrees to become a literal 'dog,' he just might escape paying it back!

(Source: Toomics)

After spending the night with Zion, a girl from a cult, Hageon finds himself worshiped as the cult’s Messiah—and he fully embraces it.

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: My Dead Lover Returned as a Tyrant
description:
As the black sheep of the royal family, Lise had been exiled to the countryside at a young age. While she found her own humble happiness with her lover, Destad, her quiet life came to an ugly end when she witnessed his death. Miserable years later, her kingdom is conquered by an infamous emperor and Lise is taken as his concubine. She resigns herself to a wretched fate, only to discover that the tyrannical emperor is none other than her long-lost lover. Is this miracle the start of a better life? Or is it the beginning of yet more despair?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Song Ye-eun is a bright and cheerful junior associate on the legal team at LX Pharmaceuticals, hiding a secret that has kept her from ever having a real relationship. When her colleague, the charming company lawyer Jeong Jaemin, accidentally discovers her most private insecurity, Ye-eun braces herself for humiliation. 

But instead of mocking her, Jaemin, who has always seemed like the perfect gentleman, makes an unexpected offer to help “fix” it. What starts as an awkward, impulsive promise quickly turns into something neither of them can control. Beneath Jaemin’s polite smile is a possessive, determined man who’s willing to tear down every wall Ye-eun puts up to win her heart and claim her completely. 

This sizzling office romance follows two people as lust becomes love, secrets turn into confessions, and a woman learns to trust a man’s gentle hands and unwavering devotion.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*"Am I a beast or a human?"*

This is the question that has plagued Leon his entire life. Born of a human mother and an ogre father, he has spent his days in hiding, away from those who would brand him an abomination. But after a threat to his village forces Leon to unleash the violent nature he had been suppressing, his existence becomes known to the world... With relentless hunters now on his tail, Leon must face his true nature and fight for his life against a world that demands his death.

(Source: Tapas)

A weak guy wishes to be stronger—and his wish is granted, but with a twist. Instead of raw power, he gains the ability to create clones, doubling his strength with numbers. But there’s an unusual way for him to grow even stronger… and it involves something far more intimate.

(Source: Toomics)

After waking from a long slumber, the vampire Isle discovers his home has been taken, leaving him with nowhere to go. Taken in by Loan, he puts his extraordinary talent for identifying counterfeit wine to use, while slowly recovering fragments of a past he thought was lost. As his memories resurface and their unequal relationship deepens, desire, power, and fate begin to intertwine in ways neither of them expected.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Reincarnated as the heroine of a dark fantasy novel who meets a tragic end, Ibelin is determined to avoid her fate. After being forced into a marriage with the cold and indifferent Dyffrin, she resolves that, no matter what, she would divorce him in two years, taking a hefty alimony with her in the process. However, as she begins to put her plans to take control of her destiny into action, controlling one’s feelings proves harder than expected for both Ibelin and Dyffrin as their relationship takes an unexpected turn. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Han-Seo is plagued by nightmares of a tentacle-being assaulting him, so he desperately seeks help online. To his surprise, Tae-Geon Lee, a famous CEO, responds. As if that weren’t odd enough, he learns his dream attacker belongs to a spirit race and turns Han-Seo into an omega. Tae-Geon, an alpha of the same spirit race, offers to protect him and help him manage his new reality. Despite some initial hesitance, Han-Seo finds comfort in Tae-Geon—tentacles and all! But are his nightmares truly over...?

(Source: Tapas)

Seeking a way back to her world, Anna becomes a maid at the infamous "Swan's Grave." When the marquis mistakes her for his vanished wife and offers a forbidden bargain, Anna is drawn into the haunting legacy of the Lorengreen house.

(Source: Manta)

Anna Shepherd’s life as a school teacher is up-ended in a single day when she’s fired after a drunk, steamy night with her school’s sponsor, Max Harpman. However, her unemployment ends as abruptly as it started when she’s invited to work as a child’s private tutor. Which is great, except for the fact that her student’s guardian is her handsome one-night stand, Max. Things are further complicated when Max requests her to give him private lessons on high society etiquette. As a series of sensual encounters ensues, Max learns as much as he can about Anna… including her mysterious past.

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Am I Too Alpha for You?
description:
Alphas belong with omegas. Everyone knows that. Songs, poems, and fairy tales all say the same: only love between an alpha and omega is natural. Love between an alpha and a beta? Unthinkable. But Geon-Woo can’t seem to help himself. Is Geon-Woo too alpha for love...or just too stubborn to give up?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Ju Cheong-Do, the thirty-first heir of the Yusim Ju clan, carries a curse cast on him in childhood. Everyone he grows close to meets an untimely death, and the curse is now threatening his own life as well. Desperate to hold on to the will to live, Cheong-Do seeks out Yu Chan-Ran, a man known for solving any problem for the right price, and places his last hope in him. When Cheong-Do asks what it would cost for Chan-Ran to act as his lover, the answer comes lightly but firmly.

 *“Hey, how much do you charge? For the boyfriend experience, I mean.”

“I start at 100,000 won per hour."*

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: I Tamed the Angsty Male Lead with My Fists
description:
When Duchess Delga Le Siegfried finds an abandoned boy named Asher, she takes him in so he can recover—but no good deed goes unpunished. As memories from her past life rush back to her, Delga realizes that Asher is destined to become a bloodthirsty killer. Between running the duchy and keeping her secret abilities in check, Delga has no patience for any of Asher’s mischievous schemes. 

Can Delga find a way to stop him from going down the wrong path? Or will she be swallowed by his obsessive love?

(Source: Tapas)

Divorce with a wife whom he wanted to give everything to. He started realizing how popular he was after he was freed from her grip.

(Source: DAYcomics)

display_title: Do or Die: You Got a Tentacle Too?!
description:
Childhood friends Nam-Ju and Yeo-Ju find themselves stuck in a dungeon, where the only way to escape is to lose their virginity to each other. They’re hesitant at first, until they end up spawning a tentacle monster to help get things started. And get started they do when Nam-Ju sees something squirming in Yeo-Ju’s pants that simply leaves her saying, “You got a tentacle too?!”

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: My Life Was but a Play
description:
With her beauty, power, and the position of empress, Vionne Rosa Ellient seemingly had everything one could want. But in truth, she endlessly yearned for love before ultimately dying in misery. Now, after waking up again as her younger self, Vionne calmly assesses her situation and past memories to avoid marrying Crown Prince Sirius and meeting the same fate. As different choices lead to a change in relationships and a turn of events, will Vionne prevent this life from being another tragedy?

(Source: Tapas)

Luce has had a huge crush on Kevin since their police school days, but hasn't had the chance to confess his feelings. Right when the two of them are about to wrap up an illegal aphrodisiac case, Luce accepts some donuts from a seemingly harmless admirer and gives them to a hungry Kevin. Unfortunately, these donuts are laced with the same aphrodisiac that's been plaguing the public! Poor Kevin has to climax ten times to get it all out of his system, and there's only one person around who can help him with the job...

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.*

The demons took his farmhouse, his wife, his peace. Now Vincent Burns lives to kill as many as he can. The excommunicated exorcist, along with Sister Beatrice and local sheriff Chloe, has found himself in the middle of a demonic plot to bring Hell itself to the United States, yet the biggest puzzle is the white-haired girl he found in a suitcase. Demons not only die upon biting her; flowers bloom from her wounds. Vincent and Beatrice must keep her safe until they know her purpose, while Chloe must keep her sanity against the demon horde.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ever since her life was saved by a kind, golden-haired mage, Piachel has dreamed of being reunited with him. So when she’s given an opportunity to become a “Sharing,” a partner who shares their power with a mage through intimate relationships, Piachel takes the chance in the hopes of finding him. But will she be able to find her savior among the mysterious mages of the Magic Tower? And how much does she really know about the man she wishes to devote her body and soul to?

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: The Mad Dog of the Duke's Estate
description:
After living and dying as a loyal blade for an evil emperor, Kyne Rator is killed by his closest friend, Halo Reston. Reborn as Caron Reston, Halo’s youngest grandson, he refuses to live another life bound by loyalty and devotes himself to becoming strong enough to never wear a leash again. But fate draws him back when he is chosen by the oath stone, and the evil emperor’s lingering power begins to stir once more. As the mad dog of House Reston, can Caron truly walk his own path?

(Source: Tapas)

Chiu Kang, known online as Kang Chi, is one of the best players in DC. To him, the real world feels dull and inefficient, so he pours everything into mastering the game. Yet... even at the top, life feels hollow. That all changed one day on his way home from the internet café. After a sudden accident, he wakes up not as Chiu Kang—but as Kella Caldern, the Demon King’s son.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Assistant Manager Kim Hates K-Pop Idols
description:
Assistant Manager Iwol Kim has spent five years working a day job—and five years doing “stand-in stanning” for his boss’s daughter’s favorite idol group, Spark. During yet another Spark-related overtime, he collapses… and wakes up nine years in the past with a second chance at life. But this chance comes with a cruel condition: to undo his sister’s death, Iwol must debut as a member of Spark himself. Thrown into the idol life he never wanted, he’ll have to survive fame, internal politics, and his own reluctant heart.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After-hours paperwork isn’t the only thing heating up at BL Corporation.

From HR to R&D, Secretarial to Marketing, a group of college friends all find themselves working under the same roof—and tangled in office romances no one saw coming. Whether it’s a shy developer revealing an unexpected secret, a longtime friend pushing the boundaries of “just colleagues,” or a bold assistant making a move that’s way above their pay grade, each story proves that love in the workplace is rarely by the book. Four departments. Four love stories. One HR nightmare waiting to happen.

(Source: Lezhin US)

1-5. **Gaebal Team** (개발팀, Backend Development) \[Dae Namueun x Samdukong\]
6-10. **Marketing Team** (마케팅팀, Bedroom Strategy) \[Dimang x Gugu\]
11-15. **Insa Team** (인사팀, First impressions) \[Dimang x Dansokgangaji\]
16-23. **Biseosil** (비서실, My Kinda Boss) \[Dimang x Jintae\]

Mouse was just a regular college student when her legs suddenly started to go numb. At first, she brushed it off, thinking it was nothing. But as the symptoms worsened and even walking became painful, a visit to the hospital revealed something she never expected. What do you do when your body begins to betray you, and nothing feels certain anymore?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Salaryman Jin-Taek ends up living with his 20-year- old niece after a request from his sister-in-law. She looks so much like her mother that Jin-Taek, who's lived a life of discipline and restraint, finds himself slowly sinking into a swamp of desire. To make things worse, she keeps calling him "Dad"... and sneaks into his room every night.

*"Dad, I want to do it with you."*

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Burned-out from his job, Paul rents a remote cabin, Hide Mansion, to get away from everyone and everything. However, his plan to numb out is derailed when he finds a strange, albeit cute, intruder raiding his fridge. But Gerard’s petite frame belies his supernatural strength and thirst for blood. Paul hardly believes this doe-eyed boy is a vampire until the fangs are in his neck and a warm rush rouses his senses. Can the two misfits learn to live full lives, or will they drink each other dry?

(Source: Tapas)

After being cast out from her wolf pack, Yeon resolves to survive on her own, but a chance encounter leads her to share a hut with a handsome young human named Hwan. Against all reason, Yeon finds herself drawn to the dashing human male, but it turns out... he’s a wolf, too?!

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The Extra Decided to Fake It
description:
A child shows up claiming to be Duke Maynard’s long-lost daughter, but he’s skeptical. However, Lilian came with proof, her best friend Swan’s locket, stolen from the orphanage’s headmaster’s office. After Swan died from an illness, Lilian heard the headmaster talking about Swan’s origins and his ruined plans to use her to gain the duke’s favor. She decides to stop living as an extra and live the life Swan was supposed to have.

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

After discovering he's an omega, Yoontae runs away when his mother tries to pimp him out. A seemingly kind man offers him food and shelter—then abuses him. With nowhere else to go, Yoontae ends up in the very life he tried to escape, trading sex for survival. He convinces himself love can be bought or borrowed, until an abusive relationship leaves him broken once more. When his ex attacks him in public, a stranger named Wooseok steps in. Is this the start of something real—or just another trap? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Upon waking up in a novel, Cheria Mayol is sold into marriage by her abusive family. Her betrothed is the main villain, Kivrin Nectarian, who has been locked up and declared a monster. But when Cheria sees how sweet and meek the boy is, she resolves to raise him into a good person. Using her wits and charm, she devises a plan to escape the manor where they are confined and wins the hearts of her new family. With her in-laws now on her side, can Cheria save Kivrin and find their happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Born to be the Grand Duchess
description:
Annette Fraise was supposed to die as the novel’s wicked villainess. Instead, she’s using her 21st-century charm to survive her marriage to the cursed Grand Duke of the North, Loic Blenheim. Between one awkward accident, a magical curse, and a one-year marriage contract, love might just become the plot twist that changes everything. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

A beautiful and successful news anchor, Yeo-Jin's life looks perfect from the outside. But in reality, she's trapped in an unhappy marriage. Not only did her husband have an affair with her close coworker, but he also murdered her parents and stole their company. Yeo-Jin thought her life was over, but when she opened her eyes, she found herself back on her wedding day. Watching her husband and his mistress flirt, Yeo-Jin swears to get her revenge. She will do whatever it takes, even if she must marry her husband's older brother.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Bastard’s Revenge in the House of Magic
description:
All Lucia wants is a family. But as an illegitimate child of the House of Lordvel, she is cast into the Abyss. There she meets the Evil God and makes a pact to take revenge on the Lordvels. Reborn 10 years in the past, will Lucia rewrite her fate in this second life or succumb to dark forces beyond her control?

(Source: Manta)

For years, Ho-Yeon has been targeted by creeps who mistake his gentle features for weakness. Somewhere along the way, he developed an unusual coping mechanism, turning the tables and forcing his pursuers into submission. The thrill of dominance becomes a habit, a preference, a dangerous kind of satisfaction. Then one day, Tae-Bum, a younger man with bold eyes and an even bolder heart, barges into his life with a straightforward confession. He is nothing like the others. No sleazy tricks, no clinging, just disarmingly pure affection delivered with calm confidence. Ho-Yeon, determined to scare him off, tries to push him away the only way he knows how, by attempting to take control forcefully. But Tae-Bum, already prepared, meets him without fear and gives himself over completely. Fine. If he wants to play that game, then Ho-Yeon will take him to the very end. Let him see if he can handle it.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Raising the Second Male Lead’s Son
description:
Our protagonist wakes up one day to find herself as Elia, the daughter of a bankrupt baron and a side character in a romance-fantasy novel. While on the run from debt collectors, she saves a child from an attacker -- only to be accused of being the kidnapper by the child’s guardian, Duke Kaiden. Taken to his mansion, she’s forced to live with them and be the child’s nanny. Can Elia clear up the misunderstanding and find her way out of this mess?

(Source: WEBTOON)

After her sister’s suicide, Bi-Do blames Mr. Shin, the man named in her suicide note. She approaches him at the funeral expecting a cruel monster, but instead finds he feels unexpectedly like her savior. He takes her from her suffocating small town to Seoul, the place she once dreamed of living with her sister. The more time she spends with him, the more conflicted she feels about the man she thought she was supposed to hate.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: That's Not What My Will Said
description:
Vivian wakes up as a dying villainess, engaged to a cursed prince feared across the continent. Her only goal is to escape the tragic fate she knows is coming, but the more she tries to stay out of the story, the deeper she's pulled into it. And the closer she gets to the prince, the more he misreads her intentions. Now caught between survival and obsession, Vivian must navigate a romance she never asked for.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

Newly-awakened hunter Habin Hyun is mankind’s only hope, but after many years of the minimum wage grind, all she wants to do is take a break. Unfortunately for her, her ridiculously broken stats catapult her into the spotlight in more ways than one. With every guild scouting her, the System’s bounty on her head, and love interests appearing from every angle, it seems Habin’s going to have to take her new friends and unlikely allies all the way to the Tower’s top, whether she likes it or not.

(Source: Tapas)

Yeon Hae-Geum, the nation’s one and only S-Class Guide, has been in love for years with Seo Moon-Hyeon - his guardian, mentor, and the man who raised him like family. From teaching him how to eat and read to mastering his guiding abilities, Moon-Hyeon has always been Hae-Geum’s everything. But just when Hae-Geum thinks he'll stay by his side forever, Moon-Hyeon suddenly announces his engagement… without even telling him. Crushed, Hae-Geum prepares to walk away... that is until fate throws in a twist: Seo Moon-Hyeok, Moon-Hyeon’s identical twin brother, shows up. Cold, blunt, and endlessly flirtatious, Moon-Hyeok needs Hae-Geum—not for love, but to power his climb to the top. Still, he’s not above using his twin’s face to seduce him. Now trapped between a possessive first love and a reckless new temptation, Hae-Geum must navigate a storm of emotions, pheromones, and dangerous attraction.

Will he remain loyal to the past—or give in to the thrill of something forbidden? One face, two destinies. One guide, caught in between.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Erencia Nobelita has been killed and reborn three times, each life ending in tragedy no matter how righteous she tries to be. So she throws caution aside in her fourth loop and decides to live selfishly, but every “evil” choice only wins her admiration and praise. Frustrated and desperate, she sets her sights on Euclid Grethelos, the empire’s most adored Grand Duke, and boldly asks for his hand in marriage. But instead of ruining her life, her audacious plan may have just set the stage for a fate far more unexpected… and irresistible. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Roznia Hill is the younger sister of the Magic Tower Master, the villain of "The Duke's Only Companion." Knowing that the male lead will kill them both in the future, she tries her best to stay out of trouble. But one day, Roznia finds a man collapsed at her doorstep... It's Duke Lewellyn Rasiane, the male lead she's been trying to avoid! But to her surprise, he soon starts showering her with sweet words and affection, which leaves Roznia torn—is his love genuine, or does he have another motive?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I Wish I Could Have Two Beds
description:
Their Royal Majesties Julia and Endymion married as children and grew up together as the best of friends. As their coming-of-age ceremony approaches, Julia begins searching for a concubine for her husband, oblivious to his feelings for her. Sharing the same bed these days is a bit awkward, and Julia has enough to process. She couldn’t possibly feel that way about her husband... could she? A jaded ex, shifting alliances, and magic aren’t helping matters either!

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Golden Days: A Collection of Short Stories
description:
Their story is simple yet delicate, and therefore even more addictive. A short story collection by Oh Gye, filled with infinite possibilities through various concepts!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

 *1-5. Nokteonui Momgap (녹턴의 몸값,The Cost of a Nocturne)
6-10. Geu Namjaui Recipe (그 남자의 레시피, His Recipe)*

An ordinary villager is tasked with accompanying a hero who smashes every crate and pot he comes across on his journey! Can this sort of hero truly stop the Demon King and save the world?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Reborn as the Forsaken Baby Princess
description:
Killed by her most trusted comrade, Assassin Agent Black is reborn as the baby princess of a historical novel. Immediately, she faces repeated assassination attempts and is even forsaken by the king when he refuses to give her a name, but she won't let anyone get her this time. As she uses her assassin skills to survive, she starts making allies, saves the prince's life, and even catches the king's interest. But with a target still on her, will that be enough to keep this little princess alive?

(Source: Tapas)

Eun-Seol unexpectedly runs into her high school ex, U-Hyeon, after years of separation. Their reunion quickly becomes awkward, but after some drinks, the tension fades, and a drunken kiss leads to a night at a motel. The next morning, Eun-Seol panics, unable to remember the night. As she tries to move on, she’s confronted by her past when she runs into her ex. Will she overcome the past and rekindle things with U-Hyeon?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Top Korean hunter Siu 'The Rabid Hound' Min defeated the Demon Lord with his disciples, only to be trapped in a monster-filled otherworld for 100 years. However, a century of struggles did not break Siu—it drove him to break his limits instead. Now, he returns to Earth with Pred, his mysterious partner, only to learn that his name and legacy have been erased, along with his disciples’... and that only 10 years have passed on Earth. As new conflicts arise, will Siu and Pred prevail and uncover the truth?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

A fateful mix-up brings an unexpected twist to a student's life at a cram school. When a mysterious package meant for his star lecturer, who shares his name, lands in his hands, an unusual relationship begins to unfold between them —one that blurs the lines between student and teacher.

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: My First XXX: The Marquess is Wild for His Princess
description:
Princess Elena is devastated when her hand in marriage is rewarded to war hero Marquess Lupus Bernardo against her will. Her dreams of marrying the kind Count Favio are dashed, and she has no choice but to wed the rumored brute who demanded her as a trophy. Trapped in a seemingly loveless marriage, both her heart and body ache for true love and warm affection. But as it turns out, Lupus may be hiding some heat beneath his cold exterior...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note:
\- Includes three extra chapters.
\- Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.*

A shy freshman girl has a crush on a charming sophomore in her class. She dreams of a relationship with him, but when he starts talking to her anonymously as "Anonymous7," she discovers his hidden promiscuous side. What happens when her innocent crush meets reality?

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: How to Escape the Clutches of an Obsessive Top
description:
Yeon-Soo wakes up as a doomed, bratty guide in "The Guide's Abyss." He avoids Seung-Hyuk, an S-rank esper, but one accident later, they’re involved. His careful plans are ruined, and though he pulls away, Seung-hyuk sticks to him more. Will Yeon-Soo survive, or will Seung-Hyuk's possessiveness prevail?

(Source: Manta)

*"We teach sex- Self Defense".*

Seong-Hyeon is a Master of a failing Hapkido studio. One day, he acquires a mysterious program. It says his studio will become a success if he completes the quests. However, the quest is... \[Quest\] Make a female member cum.

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

display_title: Ladies at Her Service: Mui, Alien of the Famous Pleasure Race
description:
Earth leaves a lot to be desired when Mui the Alien first arrives. She was promised a planet full of lustful women, only to end up learning humans are nothing but perpetual working machines. Just when Mui feels pressured to become a productive member of society herself, she meets Hayan, a timid recluse with an interesting way of relieving tension that Mui and her alien appendage can most definitely help with...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: The Knight of the Sightless Sky
description:
A consuming fire, a dead king, and a family in ruin. Ten years after witnessing her mother’s murder, a vengeful maiden returns to the palace as a deadly assassin. But her revenge plot shatters when she discovers an unlikely truth that makes her blade waver. Caught between the eyes of silver and violet, the barbed rose must decide... follow the treacherous path of vengeance or uncover the secrets that bind her fate to the kingdom’s fragile crown.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Villainess is Bothered By Male Leads
description:
All she wanted was an easy life as a noble woman. Instead, Laura Jay found herself involved with a series of drama and a number of courters. She didn't sign up for all the excitement. "Just leave me alone!"

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Every month, Suyeong’s mother receives one million won—money bound to a life-saving debt from years ago. After losing contact with the family behind it, Suyeong goes on with her life, unaware of how closely their paths will soon cross again. Transferred to a newly formed content team, she meets her new manager, Tae-eun—the same man she once saw publicly disgraced months earlier. Bound by an unspoken past and a debt neither of them chose, they keep their distance. But how long can that last?

(Source: WEBTOON)

It was late at night. The old-fashioned doorbell echoed through the run-down building, ringing on and on. Worried the noise might disturb the neighbors, Jee Heejin carefully opened the front door to see what was going on. 

 *“Who is it…?” 

“Hey… long time no see.”*
