Jee Hee-Jin and Jee Hyun-Woo, who once lived as step-siblings for five years after their parents’ remarriage, meet again after five years apart. Now a handsome medical student returning in triumph, Hyun-Woo approaches the drunken Hee-Jin and whispers that this time, they should become family not as siblings, but as husband and wife… and in this forbidden reunion, Hee-Jin is forced to make a life-altering choice.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ryugeom Cheok, a loyal Goryeo warrior, throws himself off a cliff with his enemy to protect his master—only to be frozen in ice for 900 years. Awakened in the modern era, the greatest swordsman of Goryeo begins his journey of vengeance…

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Male Lead Is Obsessed with Proposing
description:
Senelia, for having the powers of a Chloracaen Thorn, is puppeted by the paranoid Emperor Clifford in exchange for her life. To thwart the plot of the original novel and avoid his fated demise, Emperor Clifford forces Senelia to usurp the original female lead as the male lead’s lover. As a plant, Senelia is to weaken him so that he cannot challenge Clifford’s throne. But Senelia falls for the man, Veneruccia, whom she’s meant to undo. Can Senelia’s love, built on a foundation of fear, survive?

(Source: Tapas)

After the zombie outbreak, the boss's stuck-up daughters, who used to look down on him, showed up at his shelter.

(Source: DAYcomics)

I opened my eyes underwater, then found myself in a dazzling palace straight out of a historical fantasy. There is no doubt about it, I have been isekai’d right into the world of a novel. And lucky for me, it is even the genre I loved the most, so I know all the rules. Or so I thought. Because in this world, instead of gaining power through intimate encounters, anyone who loses their virginity becomes cursed. Yes, cursed. In a supposed mature fantasy. How does that even make sense? While I am still trying to wrap my head around this ridiculous twist, I receive my main mission: help the story’s second male lead achieve his destined romance. Avoid curses, dodge questionable situations, fix the love plot, survive the chaos, all with my purity intact. 

Can I possibly complete this mission without destroying the entire story, or myself, first? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Beast Won't Let Me Sleep
description:
Adele is a notorious villainess among the high society; rumor has it she married and murdered an old marquis, then allegedly seduced her stepson out of lust for power. As such, she’s shunned and ostracized at social gatherings-- until she meets the most sought-after man of the era, Count Vyce. However, this man turns out to be Chris, the poor boy she looked after before abandoning him long ago. The once-fragile boy now approaches her without hesitation. Does he approach out of past attraction, or is there something more underneath?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: The Mighty Teacher is a Roleplayer
description:
Waking up in a fantasy novel where the universe bans her from using magic is just the first of many trials for Chris Dotten, a new professor at the prestigious Bedallua Academy of Magic. Bombarded with quests that each threaten to penalize her with death if she fails, Chris must survive her tenure as the teacher of the novel’s protagonist using whatever means necessary. However, with no magical solution at hand, her sole strategy is to roleplay as the teacher who is so powerful that using magic is unnecessary. Will Chris and her act survive until graduation day?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Welcome to the Containment Zone, where every space is warped by anomalies and bound by deadly rules. From unholy hospitals to sinister arcades, the four-man team of Department 2 ventures in daily to study the spaces and bring back supplies. Things are always guaranteed to get bizarre, but the job has to be done... no matter how many deaths it causes.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Dr. V and His Three Lovers
description:
Devastated by his lover Henry's sudden death, Victor gets drunk and steals his coffin from his grave. The last thing he remembers is bringing it back to his lab before blacking out. But when Victor wakes up, he's confronted by three men who claim that he revived them from the dead using Henry's head, heart, and crown jewels! Although none of them are Henry, all of them are drawn to Victor in different ways... Can Victor's three new lovers fill the hole in his life that Henry left behind?

(Source: Tappytoon)

While working overtime, Ji-Chan Choi happens to stumble upon the 'Office Romance Registry.' Out of curiosity, he writes his name in the manager's column. From that day on, his life begins to change... 'Office romance is forbidden in our company. However, managers are excluded.'

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

*“Send me a DM at lunch. Pick the most secluded spot you know.”*

Jeong-Han was enjoying his peaceful life as a high school teacher until he and the new student teacher, Chae-Rin, came to share their dirty secrets

(Source: DAYcomics)

She was sent to spy on him. Falling for him was never part of the plan. Hye-Won Yun works tirelessly to secure her future, but loyalty comes at a cost. Vice President Ji-Seok Ha makes her track every move of his cousin, Executive Director Tae-Beom Ha. Tae-Beom knows she’s spying on him. But instead of pushing her away, he keeps her close. What begins as a cold arrangement shifts into something unpredictable. Their worlds were never meant to intertwine, but the more they fight it, the more inevitable it feels. Is it just proximity -- or something deeper?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Lohiriel is the second daughter of House Casyan, a family infamous for its virulent poisons, and she has only one year left to live. That is, unless she can procure a rare plant that's exclusively grown in the imperial gardens... To access it, she strikes a daring deal with the crown prince: If he enters a one-year contract marriage with her, she'll provide him with a treatment for the ailing emperor. That means Lohiriel's medical expertise will prove useful for more people than she thought!

(Source: Tapas)

Tae-Eun is an omega who relies heavily on his alpha little brother, Tae-Ho. It’s not just because of his fragile health; the only reason he was adopted from a children’s home into the wealthy Kwon family was because a young Tae-Ho claimed he wanted Tae-Eun. Ever since then, Tae-Eun has needed his little brother as an anchor in the unwelcoming sea that is the Kwon household. In fact, he wants Tae-Ho as more than a brother. However, what Tae-Eun doesn’t realize is that Tae-Ho has changed his life in more ways than he ever knew since their first meeting…

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Chaedam never planned to get cozy with the sexy CEO, but after discovering Yoowon’s secrets, Chaedam has no choice but to fake amnesia to keep himself safe. Suspicious, Yoowon ups the ante and tells Chaedam that they were lovers before his memory loss. Chaedam knows it’s only a ploy to keep him under Yoowon’s watchful eye, but he can’t reveal the truth without exposing himself to danger. So begins a cat-and-mouse game of deception and lust that sends them tumbling into bed together.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Women at Work: A Pinch of Love
description:
Ra-On is a top idol on professional hiatus after several scandals. During her time off, she’s tasked with training Ho-Rang, a member of a girl group on the verge of their debut. For reasons Ra-On cannot figure out, Ho-Rang is adamant on dropping out of her chance at stardom, and it’s up to Ra-On to get Ho-Rang’s singing and mindset back in the game. However, it isn’t easy to get Ho-Rang’s spirits and vocals high enough…until Ra-On discovers the perfect trick: pinching her in just the right place. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Bomtoon's and Lezhin's Jeonmunjing Ungni Danpyeonseon (전문직 웅니 단편선) Collection.*

After catching her fiancé cheating, all Seo-Ha wanted was to drink the pain away. Drunk and heartbroken, she shouted she'd sleep with another man too – only to wake up in a stranger’s room, in just her underwear. But the man isn’t a stranger at all… it is Do-Hyeon, her childhood friend turned longtime nemesis. What the hell is he doing here?

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

Jeonghwan, once a legendary mercenary, returns under an identity no one expected— a prosecutor. His mission is to uncover the truth behind his mother’s mysterious death, the tragedy that robbed him of his peace and future. To take his revenge, Jeonghwan must wield two weapons: violence for those who stand in his way, and the law for those who must be judged.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Monkey King’s Journey to the Murim
description:
The Monkey King’s journey was over. But a new story begins with an impossible crime -- his master, Sanzang, has gone missing. His new mission is to dive into the Murim, a world where mortals and their martial arts rival the power of the gods and unravel this mystery. The threads of fate reveal not only allies, but foes from his past. The Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal has been unchained, but this new arduous journey may yet prove to be his most challenging yet... 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Baek-Dan, drowning in debt and running a tiny udon shop in the red-light district, meets Moo-Shin—a wealthy yet dangerous man who shatters her bleak routine. He might be her salvation… or her downfall.

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters*

In a world where implanted neural chips allow investigators to interrogate suspects through their own memories, detectives Kim Jin-Yeong and Seo Ji-Su prefer the old-fashioned method of chasing criminals on foot. Officially, they are colleagues-turned-lovers who divorced years ago; but off the record, they continue to seek each other out after work, haunted by a tangled relationship that neither has fully let go of. Then, one chilling Christmas night, Jin-Yeong disappears without a word. Exactly one year later on Christmas Eve, he returns and stands before Ji-Su as if nothing had happened. Where has he been, and what truth hides behind the silence of that missing year...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*"I like you! Have sex with me!"*

Seon-Ung, a new hire at a large company, has come across a program that changes what constitutes common sense for the people around him. He decides to use his newfound skill to teach his team leader a lesson for giving him a hard time over the past 4 years.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Hwan Woon-Ryong and Beom Pung-Ho have spent their entire lives locked in a fierce rivalry. As the heirs to the world’s two most powerful crime syndicates, their hatred runs deep—and so does their competition. But just as they’re poised to seize the biggest opportunity of their careers, fate throws them a curveball: a toddler named Hwan Beom-Hae, who, according to advanced DNA testing, is the biological child of both of them. Caught between disbelief and chaos, the two enemies are presented with an absurd yet high-stakes mission: raise Beom-Hae together, lovingly and responsibly. The reward? Exclusive construction rights to the largest global development project in history, sanctioned by the United Nations itself. But co-parenting isn’t exactly easy when you’d rather strangle your partner than share snack time and diaper duty. As Beom-Hae’s giggles and tantrums slowly chip away at their walls, Woon-Ryong and Pung-Ho must navigate tantrums, toys, and a growing sense of responsibility—not to mention some unexpected feelings. Can two lifelong enemies become the world’s most unlikely dream team dads? Or will their stubborn pride and unresolved tension bring everything crashing down? 

Enemies-to-daddies has never looked this chaotic—or this heartwarming. 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

*"Sir, please bless me with your superior baby seeds❤️"*

He had clawed his way up from nothing, building a kingdom in his dusty hometown without any help from his parents. Having lived so fiercely, he left his company to his sons, in hopes to spend the rest of his life in peace. However, his naughty daughters-in-law were not going to leave him alone- not his dick at least.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Peace and nature are the only things Seyeon expects to enjoy while staying in the countryside with a family she knows. So she’s startled when she runs into the family’s son, Jeongwook, who was her childhood friend. The two of them haven’t seen each other since drifting apart in their teens, but that doesn’t stop Seyeon from checking out Jeongwook’s pecs. Once they catch each other in some suggestive situations, things heat up quickly between them. When the aloof Jeongwook suddenly confesses his feelings, it’s up to Seyeon to decide where to take their secret fling in the orchard…!

*Source: Tappytoon*

display_title: Becoming the Heroine Out of Spite
description:
One day, Ludia Mertens wakes up inside a romance fantasy novel as the best friend of Elian, the crown prince’s obsessive stalker. To avoid getting caught in Elian’s madness and dying like in the original story, she tries to keep them apart. But to her shock, she somehow ends up seducing the prince instead. Tired of Elian’s mean girl behavior and nudged by the prince’s cousin to date him, Ludia decides that if fate won’t protect her, she might as well steal the heroine’s role out of spite!

(Source: Tapas)

After botching a job interview, a man climbs a mountain to end it all, only to wake up in a world of half-human, half-animal creatures. Caught between disbelief and temptation, he must navigate this strange new reality.

(Source: Toomics)

After losing their parents, stepbrothers Won-Il and Ji-Yoon face further tragedy when their youngest brother commits suicide. Now having no other family left, the two brothers become dependent on each other for love and even intimacy. But little does Won-Il know that Ji-Yoon has a secret regarding their brother’s death that could change their relationship forever...

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

As a devoted servant of Artemis, the nymph Daphne has taken a vow of maidenhood and pledged to never give her heart to a man. However, she finds her loyalty to her goddess shaken when she meets Apollo and is instantly mesmerized, feeling things she had sworn never to feel. As Daphne falls into temptation, she finds herself helpless against the chaotic whims of the gods. Will her transgression lead to true love? Or will the consequences of breaking her vow be more severe than she ever imagined?

(Source: Tapas)

In a rough neighborhood where police rarely intervene, Nabi runs a quiet little hair salon. But behind her sweet appearance lies a deadly secret: she's a man-eating monster who only targets intruders, specifically sexual predators. With her "supply" running low, Nabi captures an unexpected trespasser, a contract killer named Kang Eunchan who was sent to assassinate her. Before he knows it, he's overpowered and locked away in her secret underground shelter. As Nabi begins to care for him in her own strange way, Eunchan finds himself reluctantly drawn to her and even offers himself up as her next meal. Between a beautiful predator and a killer too charming to eat, their twisted relationship begins to spiral, just as other men start appearing with their own reasons for wanting to fall under Nabi's control. A sharp, bloody love thriller with one hell of a bite.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: My Hot Harem Has Turned Cold On Me!
description:
What happens when you finally hit 100% for a character’s route in an otome game? You’d marry him, right? Wrong! Joo-ah isn’t here to commit to just one man. Ever since she woke up as the main character of an otome game, she’s been grinding her way through all four male leads–both in bed and with the game’s likeability scores. Now that she’s hit the finish line, Joo-ah is ready to settle down with her harem of hotties… But wait, why are they starting to give her the cold shoulder? The game might not be over just yet!

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: I'm a Beast, Not a Bunny!
description:
Born to a wolf-shifter and a lion-shifter, Chloe knows she'll be a predator like no other. So she's got no idea what to do when she one day shifts into… a bunny! Even worse, Chloe then realizes she’s also in a novel, one where her family’s to be killed due to a series of misunderstandings. Determined to save her parents, Chloe sets out to unravel the lies and bring peace to her family. But can Chloe uncover the truth while keeping her transformation unknown? Or will this bunny be bested by fate?

(Source: Tapas)

When infamous mercenary Leopold Gregory gets falsely accused of murdering Hareid Bakadi, the last thing he expects is to wind up working for the dead man’s wife, Hena! He uses a fake name to further avoid detection and even winds up getting close to Hena’s son, Daniel. Leo intends to figure out who framed him, but along the way, he finds himself drawn to the mysterious lady of the house who still has no idea he’s a suspect in her husband’s murder. Will his search for the truth end up ruining what he’s built with Hena and Daniel?

(Source: WEBTOON)

After leaving the city behind, Jeong-Won returns to his seaside hometown of Samcheonpo. There, he meets Do-Jin, a runaway college student with a bad first impression and nowhere to go. When Do-Jin ends up staying at Jeong-Won’s house under the pretense of teaching him to swim, the two begin an unexpected cohabitation by the sea. As summer unfolds, their awkward start slowly turns into something tender - like the calm waves that bring them closer each day.

(Source: Lezhin US)

War hero and army captain Fedele Aske is haunted by the ghosts of his past, preventing him from getting any sleep at night without a woman to warm his bed. When one of his nightly companions turns out to be an enemy spy, Princess Igraine forbids him from taking any more women into his tent as his military adviser. But the lack of sleep greatly impairs Fedele’s abilities on the battlefield, leaving Igraine with no choice. She’ll just have to be the one to ease his restless nights from now on...

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: A Winter Cabin of Serenity and Insanity
description:
Roelle’s life has been nothing but tragic at the hands of her abusive family. But the worst tragedy of all occurs when she kills her cousin after he tries to take advantage of her. In order to avoid being put to death for the murder, Roelle runs away deep into the winter forest, where she encounters the lone Kayden in his cabin. When Kayden allows Roelle to stay with him for a while, the hopeless cold quickly turns into passionate heat. Will this cabin become Roelle’s haven? Or will it be the start of a new hell?

(Source: Tappytoon)

After five years of devotion, Yu-Ju Han was dumped by her boyfriend for her best friend. With nowhere to vent her rage, she crosses paths with Tae-i Go, the nation's hottest and most controversial superstar. He’s wealthy, breathtaking… and terminally ill. When a fake dating scandal between the two sets the internet ablaze, Tae-i offers Yu-Ju a "golden ticket": a chance to turn her life into a masterpiece of revenge. The price? Just a little bit of love. Will Yu-Ju remain a victim, or will she finally get greedy?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: How to Reject the Perfect Marriage
description:
Evangeline O’Hara has it all—wealth, privilege, and the most coveted engagement in the empire. But when tragedy strikes her family, the future duchess can no longer ignore certain truths. She is alone now, and this marriage won’t change that for the better. Duke Decarno von These has no doubts, as no other woman could be more perfect for the role. Things may be complicated now, but the conclusion is inevitable. Once they wed, the rest of these problems will vanish. Why should he think otherwise?

(Source: Tapas)

Summer, 1994. Seo-Jin is hiding from debt collectors in the middle of nowhere, facing a fate worse than bankruptcy: manual labor. When a sudden stomach ache leads to a messy disaster in a neighbor’s field, Seo-Jin is caught red-handed by the hulking owner, Cheol. Cheol helps Seo-Jin handle his spicy peppers by day, and Seo-Jin returns the favor by night. Seo-Jin thinks he’s just using the local hunk for "farm assistance," but this country boy’s heat might be too much to handle!

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: A Happy Ending for the Young Villain
description:
When Ahn Dohwa finds herself in an unfinished novel as Archmage Reina Heart, she resolves to lie low until the story reaches a resolution. However, unable to turn a blind eye to the abuse inflicted upon the story's villain, Prince Kevenriak Heteroven, she takes the young prince under her wing and begins training him as her pupil, hoping to change his destiny. But when everything starts to deviate from the original story, Reina's resolve wavers... Can she protect everyone's happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)

Ye-Ju, an ordinary alpha college student, is cast into another world—mistaken for a slave and claimed by a nobleman. But the task awaiting him is not labor. As the nobleman’s true nature begins to surface, Ye-Ju finds himself trapped between desire, danger, and a longing to return home.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Do Not Throw Stones at the Stone Bridge
description:
For as long as he can remember, Ha Na-Deul has been tangled up with Ju Seok in everything he does. Tests, competitions, group projects, student rankings, you name it. And every single time, Na-Deul loses first place to him by just a hair. All Na-Deul wants is freedom, counting down the days until high school graduation so he can finally escape his infuriating rival. But fate has other plans. As a fortune teller once warned, “He is someone who will stick to you even in death.” Sure enough, the two end up at the same university. One night, while Na-Deul is working a part time shift at a convenience store, Ju Seok shows up looking teary eyed and suddenly confesses. From that day on, Ju Seok launches an all out, shameless love offensive. And the more Na-Deul tries to run, the more the two become hopelessly intertwined.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hae-Bum Shin and Ryu-Jin Jung have both suffered devastating losses at the hands of a corrupt government. Despite this, they find themselves on opposite sides of the coin—one as leader of the Disciplinary Training Corps and the other as a member of an anti-government organization. Now, revenge will require them to set aside their differences.

(Source: Manta)

A boy reborn as Nox, an omega noble, finds himself surrounded by men bound to him through blood, duty, and pheromones. With a hateful half-brother, a duke’s son drawn to his scent, and a loyal servant who watches him too closely, every relationship is charged with tension. When his uncontrollable heat awakens, desire and power collide, pulling them all into a dangerous, irresistible web.

(Source: Lezhin US)

One day, Jun-Hyeon finds out that his female coworkers have been making bets about him. So, he begins getting his revenge on his female coworkers pulling lewd pranks on him.

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

display_title: Women at Work: Teach Me, Mommy!
description:
Sua’s biggest dream is fulfilled when she is given the chance to costar with her lifelong role model, Seo-Hyeon, in a movie. But the line between professional and personal feelings starts to blur when the two women need to shoot a steamy bedroom scene. Unable to get her act together, Sua asks Seo-Hyeon to help her practice the scene. It should be okay since it’s just acting... right?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Bomtoon's and Lezhin's Jeonmunjing Ungni Danpyeonseon (전문직 웅니 단편선) Collection.*

After chatting with a flower shop’s mascot part-time worker, Do-Hui suddenly finds himself on the radar of the school delinquent, Yang-Hyeon. Seeking comfort, he confides in the gentle person inside the bear costume, never suspecting it’s actually Yang-Hyeon himself. As misunderstandings and hidden crushes collide, a shy first love begins to bloom in the most unexpected way. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jihun is pulled into Knight Defense, a game where he must lead the kingdom’s knights against endless waves of monsters. Weighed down by the scars of his real life, Jihun chooses not to fight and turns his back on humanity. But as soon as he does, the system unveils a new path: the Monster Faction. Defense is over. It’s now time for offense.

(Source: WEBTOON)

When Diana le Pereshte is convinced that sacrificing her vision will restore her daughter's lost eyesight, her blindness reveals the hidden truth of her home—her "daughter" is her husband's and best friend's lovechild. Cast aside and left to question the fate of her real daughter, she succumbs to her death only to find she's woken up in the past, her vision now restored. With a second chance, can Diana find her real daughter and exact revenge, or will she find herself lost in the dark once more?

(Source: Tapas)

Joo-Hong is a popular BL fan artist, but doesn't expect to see her fitness instructor, Neung-Geum, in full cosplay at her fan convention booth. Now that she's seen his glorious muscles in action, she has to recruit him as a model for her next spicy project. Despite the fact that both of them are inexperienced, their modeling session at a hotel leads to a surprisingly heated acquaintances-with-benefits relationship. Their hobbies and bodies are certainly well-matched, but will their nerdy yet passionate hookups lead to something more?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.n.*

display_title: Ladies at Her Service: Young at Heart
description:
Former actress Seon-Yeong is shocked when she finds out about her husband's affair with a younger woman. When a fortune teller says she needs to receive youthful energy from younger women to stop his cheating, the desperate Seon-Yeong concludes that she has to sleep with a younger woman to get what she wants. So when an innocent young housekeeper named Min-Seo comes to work for her, it's not long before their relationship takes a steamy turn...

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: Finding a Ticket Into Your Heart
description:
After a brutal breakup, Yubyeol flies to Spain alone where one wild, blurry night with a stranger named Seonu changes everything. Back in Korea, fate brings them together again… but this time, they only have 90 days before Seonu must return to Spain. Between unresolved heartbreak, unexpected chemistry, and a deadline she never asked for, can Seonu find his ticket into Yubyeol’s heart before the final boarding call?

(Source: WEBTOON)

The rift brought an end to the world humanity once knew. Monsters claimed the lives of countless people, and those with supernatural powers known as hunters became humanity’s last hope. For Ji-Ho Lee, becoming a hunter wasn’t a choice, but a result of losing everything. Now, in the aftermath, she begins forming new ties and gradually rebuilding a life on her own terms.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After spending his childhood in the countryside with his grandmother, Ji-Ho finally moves to the city to attend his dream university. Just one month into campus life, he accidentally walks back into a lecture hall to grab his forgotten wallet - only to stumble upon two men in the middle of a heated encounter. Hoping to slip away unnoticed, Ji-Ho is caught by one of them: the enigmatic upperclassman Yeong-Won. Ji-Ho tries to brush it off and return to normal, but Yeong-Won seems to have other plans…

Why won’t this guy leave him alone? And what exactly does he want from Ji-Ho?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Morae Jung had a drunken one-night stand with her mentor from hell, Kangjae Seo, the night before he left for America. 5 years later he’s back, but now he’s her boss! What’s more, he’s got his sights on Morae. Will she be able to survive working under this man?

(Source: Manta)

Arsinoe knows a few things about redos. Her first three lives all followed the same tragic script: born the scorned daughter of an enslaved queen, married to a crown prince as charming as he is cruel, and driven to death by the very man she trusted. But in her fourth, Arsinoe refuses to play the doomed princess. Determined to claim her own destiny, she forms an unexpected alliance with Walter Heibergh, the kingdom’s most formidable commander — one powerful enough to change fate itself.

(Source: Tapas)

Aranhrod assumes the throne as the 17th ruler of the Laincaster Empire through the sole support of Grand Duke Roark, her most loyal and dedicated servant. Yet his devotion is met with her cold indifference, which he accepts with grace — that is, until night falls, and he has her begging for mercy.

(Source: Manta)

*"He slept with his next door neighbor's wife whenever he went away on a business trip"*

A small town near Seoul that our family used to live in was a welcoming place. At least that's what I thought until the people of the town revealed their true faces. Our family was driven out of town due to their devious planning, but now that I've gained power, I will make my glorious return.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Elena, the only daughter of a wealthy family, accidentally witnesses a friend's intimate moment with her lover and becomes curious about sex. As she grows closer to her loyal chauffeur, Kale, their secret bond blossoms into a forbidden love her father can never accept. 

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

display_title: A Love Letter From the Future
description:
Ian Ferkus, a 3rd-year at the academy, one day receives a love letter from 7 years in the future. It refers to Ian as a hero, along with the warning that "the world will end if the future is not protected." Now Ian must discover what this future is and how to protect it with the help of his friends.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The Ice Queen and the Hound
description:
He hadn't seen Se-Kyung since they were nineteen—his first love, his old wound. She was still elegant, untouchable, and casually cruel. Still the most beautiful thing he'd ever seen. "Let's date. You and me. A contract relationship." The "contract" was the excuse. The "relationship" was everything.

(Source: Manta)

Choi Jae-Seung has spent years indulging in one-night stands with BDSM partners, always as a willing masochist. But during a model casting, he suddenly comes face-to-face with the very person who awakened that desire in him: his high school senior, Min Ho-Yeon. After 13 years, Ho-Yeon has returned as Eli, a mysterious top model from the U.S. - and he wastes no time forcing his way back into Jae-Seung’s body and life. What begins as unwanted contact spirals into a dangerous reunion where desire, power, and old wounds collide.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ever since he was young, In-Seong had been the cause of girls around him fighting, for some supernatural reason. So he started work at a company he thought was mostly comprised of men, but he was totally wrong. At this company full of women, he finds himself in charge of the well-being of his female coworkers!

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

After discovering her "friend" Min-Chae was only using her to clean up her own image, bullied high schooler Se-Yo’s life takes a dramatic turn when an accident leaves her in the body of a beautiful coma patient named Kkotbi! The deity responsible for the body swap offers her a deal: fulfill Kkotbi's destiny by becoming an idol within a year or lose everything. Now Se-Yo must learn the ropes of K-pop stardom while dealing with a jealous Min-Chae, who has no idea the gorgeous new girl is actually her former friend who knows all about her dark past.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yoo-Jin is bad boyfriend material. It’s partially because he never takes anything seriously, but it’s also because he’s never had a great time in bed with anyone. After being publicly dumped, he’s approached by Hyeon-Soo, an old high school classmate who also happens to be Yoo-Jin’s first love. After a round of drinks, they spend a heated night together that might have been a great time, but Yoo-Jin remembers none of it. Torn between denial and desire, Yoo-Jin has to decide whether he’s serious about Hyeon-Soo... which would be a lot easier if they could ever have a proper conversation.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Born the illegitimate daughter of a powerful tycoon, Soyeong Ji has spent her life sidelined and scorned by the Ji family. Believing marriage will be her escape, her hopes are shattered when she catches her fiancé in bed with her half-sister. Betrayed and alone, Soyeong chooses vengeance by seducing her sister’s lover and setting a calculated plan in motion to bring them all down.

(Source: WEBTOON)

As the heir to the ultra-powerful Noblisse family, Agatha has been a pawn in the emperor’s political game her whole life. He had her married off, not just once or twice, but six times! After her most recent matrimonial fiasco, Agatha seizes the chance to take control of her destiny and choose her next husband herself. Handsome, powerful, and a war hero, Enoch Aratus couldn’t be more perfect for the job. But nothing disrupts a political marriage faster than actually falling for your husband…

(Source: Tapas)

The dynamic and elite college life of a freshman who rolled up to an eco-friendly campus in their car.

*"Pull over... I want to do it right here."*

(Source: TOPTOON)

Lee Jae-Ha knows it’s absurd for him to ask for Jang Tae-Geon’s hand in marriage. While Jae-Ha is the heir to Korea’s most prestigious corporation, Tae-Geon is a violent gangster. But above all, both of them are dominant alphas. So when they inevitably do get married, Jae-Ha doesn’t dare to ask for anything more, instead drawing lines in the name of respecting the man he selfishly fell in love with. But these lines only end up aggravating Tae-Geon, who’s actually had his eyes on Jae-Ha just the same...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ji-Yu thought her first relationship would be nothing but happiness, until an uneasy suspicion takes root. Her boyfriend seems a little too attached to his female friend, and Ji-Yu can’t tell whether she’s being paranoid or not. Desperate for clarity, she downloads an AI dating advice app called Love Meddler. Instead of gentle reassurance, it hits her with brutal honesty. As the app starts “meddling” in her love life, Ji-Yu is left wondering how an AI understands her so well. The thing is, perhaps it’s not AI at all and rather someone who has recently re-entered her life…

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Girl from the PC Café
description:
At a local PC café, the shy owner secretly pines for his drop-dead gorgeous part-timer, Mina. But subtle details about her stir painful memories he can’t ignore, leaving him torn between fear and desire, especially when her bright smile makes his heart race all over again.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*"I wanted to meet you, master. Sincerely"*

Liam is a challenger who is as good as pro gamers, and a virgin. One day his friend promises him that she will set him up with a girl if Liam helps her boost her score in Legends of League. When he was playing the game at internet cafe, he ends up having a real life PK. Unexpected lucky encounters lead to game-like events.

(Source: DAYcomics)

display_title: The Mighty Delinquent of the Dan Clan
description:
Hongmun was a lowly warrior who secretly mastered the Dan Clan’s forbidden martial arts. In a battle against the Black Flame Sect, he met his death. But when he opened his eyes, he had become Wolbin Dan, the infamous fourth young master of the Dan Clan. Now blessed with a body perfectly suited for the martial arts, he is determined to rewrite the past and prevent the destruction of the Dan Clan with his own hands.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: I Swapped My Husband at the Wedding
description:
Despite her fiancé's infidelity just weeks before the wedding, Satinne Del Mare is forced to go through with the marriage for the sake of family ties. However, when the event is crashed by an old schoolmate, she accepts his proposal on impulse and marries him instead! After the adrenaline wears off, Satinne realizes something important she hadn't considered. Her new husband is her childhood bully! Did she just make a horrible mistake? Or will this turn out to be the marriage of her dreams? 

(Source: Tapas)

Doh I-Hyeon is the ultimate corporate workaholic, but he hides two secrets: he’s a somewhat defective omega and he suffers from prosopagnosia—the inability to recognize faces. After a blurry, drunken one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, I-Hyeon decides to keep the baby and brave single parenthood in secret. But his carefully constructed walls start to crumble when his superior, Seo Jeong-Un, begins a relentless pursuit. Jeong-Un is charming, persistent, and strangely familiar, but to a man who can’t recognize a face, his flirtations are just another workplace distraction. Can Jeong-Un break through I-Hyeon’s "iron wall," or will I-Hyeon’s condition keep the father of his child a mystery forever?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Ladies at Her Service: A Knight Addicted to Adult Novels
description:
Rosaline is a strong and noble imperial knight whose glowing reputation ironically makes her unapproachable. Therefore, she secretly turns to adult novels to satisfy her less noble urges. When Rosaline is captured by an enemy tribe on a mission, a part of her is excited about being stripped down and degraded by her captors like the heroine in her favorite novel. And her merciless punishment arrives in the form of Attila, the fierce tribe chief who seems hellbent on getting revenge...

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: Love Me Like You Owe Me
description:
In order to pay off his mother’s crushing debt, Woo Min-Jo finds himself delivering coffee in high heels to a construction firm run by the notorious gangster, Chu Gio. What starts as a misfortune spirals into a bizarre fate, as Gio quickly takes an interest in Min-Jo. And before he knows it, Min-Jo goes from a broke errand boy to the unlikely “bride” of a thug...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Grace and Henry are childhood friends and engaged to be married until Grace’s family loses everything after being charged with treason. With her parents dead and nowhere to go, Grace is taken in by Henry’s family to work as their maid. But with that comes the duty of serving her fiancé-turned-master at all hours of the day, even at night...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Taeryang wakes up in a world where men are treated as commodities. Could the power of his "thrust" be enough to save him?

(Source: Toomics)

Jiyeong has a secret: she’s got a full-blown finger fetish. And unfortunately (or maybe fortunately), her best friend Garam has the most perfect shands he’s ever seen. Long, slender fingers... veins in all the right places... yes, Jiyeong is quietly fangirling over them like it’s a full-time job. But now there’s a new problem: Is it just the hands she likes… or is it Garam too? After venting to a friend over drinks, Jiyeong blacks out—only to wake up to a shirtless Garam staring down at her.

*“Do you like me that much?”

“…I-it’s not you! It’s your hands!!”*

What started as a harmless little obsession is spiraling fast into chaos. Can Jiyeong separate love from... limbs?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Right after graduating high school, Yewon falls headfirst into an affair with the charming but married Han Ju-eon. She knows it’s wrong, but she doesn’t care. She’s in love.

*“I want to hear you say it. Are you having an affair with that guy?”

“Fine! We're having an affair. So what?”*

Things start to spiral when their classmate Jeong Hwa-ik catches them in the act and makes her an offer of his own. Whether out of spite, curiosity, or something darker, she agrees.

*"Even if I sleep with someone else, you’re not going to leave your wife, are you?"*

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ju-In Jeon, a depressed 17-year-old, is offered a ticket to heaven in exchange for her body. But, 13 years later, she wakes up—not in paradise, but in her 30-year-old body… and in the middle of a scam. Stuck for 108 days while heaven's agent searches for the fraudster, Ju-In crosses paths with Do-Gwon Ju, another soul-scam victim in the same situation. But what happens when the souls who bought their bodies come back? Will they return to their miserable teenage lives, or find a way to reclaim their futures? 

*Editor's Note: This series contains themes and depictions of suicidal ideation that may be upsetting to some readers. Viewer discretion is advised.*

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Jiseok hardly does any work, playing hooky and sleeping with the whole office. That is, until the new intern arrives...

(Source: Toomics)

Online, Yuni is a glamorous influencer. In reality, she lives in poverty with her timid, overworked mother, Deulre. After a horrific family tragedy leaves Yuni orphaned, she’s suddenly thrust back in time and finds her mother a teenager again. Determined to rewrite the future, Yuni enrolls in her mother's high school to protect her teen mom from her toxic friends and the choices that led to heartbreak, abuse, and death. But changing the past isn't easy—especially when your own mother sees you as the enemy. Can Yuni save her mother… and heal their broken bond in the process?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Ladies at Her Service: A Very Naughty Girl
description:
Despite being a pretty and talented film student, Yeo-Woo is brutally rejected after flirting with her cocky underclassman, Jin-Yeong. As if that wasn't humiliating enough, Jin-Yeong accidentally sees Yeo-Woo's racy video of herself wearing a dog collar when they're exchanging files for a film project! What Yeo-Woo doesn't expect is for this to turn on Jin-Yeong's dominant side and spur a series of secret BDSM hookups between them. *Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.*

Kang Seo-Rim dies from overwork, only to be reassigned as a grim reaper. Sick of taking lives, he stumbles upon Cupid at work and realizes there might be something better than death: love. After all, why reap souls when you could reap romance? Cupid, however, is far from thrilled about someone challenging his divine purpose, and before long, the two are locked in a strange dance of rivalry, irritation, and an attraction neither of them expected.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a quiet, remote countryside, a seemingly devout priest named Michael lives a peaceful life—until an incubus named Az appears before him. Az threatens to expose Michael's darkest secret unless he offers up his life energy. Left with no choice, Michael spends a night with the demon... only to discover Az's unexpected weakness in the midst of their sinful encounter.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yi-Hyun, beloved daughter of a wealthy family, has loved A-list actor Seo-An for years. When an arranged marriage lands her with him, she can't believe her luck! However, Seo-An insists on a temporary marriage and to divorce later. As secrets unravel, will their union stay "temporary"?

(Source: Manta)

After the fall of his noble family, Damon drifts from place to place until he hears of an open position as a private tutor for a sheltered young heir named Eden. From their very first meeting, Eden blushes easily and wears his emotions openly, a lonely young master who seems far too easy to manipulate. Damon convinces himself that if he plays his cards right, he can settle here comfortably for the rest of his life. But life in the mansion takes a turn Damon never expected, and he begins to suspect that his arrival was part of a carefully laid trap. 

As Eden longs for beauty and Damon clings to what never changes, the walls of the mansion close in, and the truth behind their bond slowly comes to light.

Bullied in school, and now reunited... Can I get my payback?

In a ruined world where the dead rise as monsters, Johan survives in the outskirts by baking bread and bartering at the local village. One day, he’s chased by undead monsters back to his home, and he unleashes a blazing fire upon them… only to find two scorchingly hot men alive and well. Calion and Alexis, returned to their human selves, spend their time testing Johan’s limits on curing the undead… and the limits of what he can take into his delicious buns.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Soo-Ha, with whom they have made countless memories together in the current, and Selen, with whom they share deep and fond memories from the past. As two people who never should have met collide, a dangerous and heartrending romance begins once more.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Drifting through orphanages, Mun-Young lives with a nameless fear and a longing he can't explain... until a black fox only he can see appears and quiets it. But once he's adopted—more like imprisoned—by the powerful Chunsung group, the fox disappears. Years later, it returns with one offer: freedom, for a price.

(Source: Manta)

Sa-Ha is a sexually frustrated office worker who constantly drools over her uptight but hot boss, Isaac. However, Isaac pulls Sa-Ha aside soon after and says he could hear her perverted thoughts about him since the closet incident! The timing couldn't be worse. So-Hui is pregnant, and her divorce from Ji-Hyeok is already in motion. She spent three years trying to earn his love before deciding that holding on was merely a selfish dream. Now, she must protect her unborn child from a marriage that was never meant to be. Or was it? As Ji-Hyeok faces the crushing void left by the divorce, his own family moves to sabotage his position at the company. Between corporate traps and a secret that could change everything, what is in store for this star-crossed couple?

(Source: WEBTOON)

A decade ago, Chae Songhwa and her friend Seo Hyunwoo promised to meet again as their best selves. Unfortunately, life hasn’t quite turned out the way Songhwa imagined. So when they meet again at their high school reunion, Songhwa is stunned to find that Hyunwoo remembers her and wants to reconnect. One meal and a little too much wine later, he asks her to take him home, where the night takes a spicy turn. Are they simply spicing up their bland lives? Or is this the start of a delicious romance?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Natjyeobami Danpyeonseon (낮져밤이 단편선) Collection.*

A new neighbor moved in next door—7 years younger, polite to the point of formality, yet with a gaze that was anything but innocent. From the very first day, his eyes lingered too long, too boldly. “Did you sleep well after kissing me yesterday, noona?” A casual fling for one month couldn't harm, right?

(Source: Manta)

Yu Misol never thought a breakup would sting this much, especially when her ex dismissed her with the cruelest line:

*“Your breasts are too small.”*

Small? Please. She’s a full A, thank you very much! Still, the insult lingers, leaving her with one nagging fear: what if she dies without ever experiencing real passion? Enter Yoon Chawon, her childhood friend of twenty years. The boy next door who’s always been by her side. One teasing dare later, Chawon leans in with a husky murmur:

*“Misol, take it off. Let me be the one to really see you.”*

But things spiral further when Chawon’s bold friend, Jang Taegun, joins in, grinning as he growls:

*“A body this gorgeous, and no one’s touched it? What a waste.”*

Suddenly, Misol finds herself tangled up with not one, but two men who are all too eager to prove her ex dead wrong.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Playtoon's Play Danpyeonseon (플래이 단편선) Collection.*

Business admin major Jae-Yoon Kwon returns to campus after a year-long break, only to run into her old crush, Seung-Won Shin. Though Jae-Yoon tries to avoid him, Seung-Won is drawn to her, and soon the two are studying together for his sports rehabilitation class, with Seung-Won's body as the model!

(Source: Manta)

Rebecca once believed her husband, Count Zeppelin Devonshire, truly loved her. However, that changed when he took in a second wife and left Rebecca to die. Now she’s back in the past, once again his beautiful countess that he meticulously trapped in a suffocating life for their entire marriage. Fully aware of how he drove her to isolation and ruin, she’s determined to escape his cage and exact her revenge on him. With the help of Duke Julian Johannes, Rebecca is about to teach her captor what it’s like to be captured and destroyed.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*"What will you do for me if I defend you?"*

Do-Yun is a successful lawyer. He is assigned to defend the family who left him when he was young. Taking the superior position this time, he goes into the mother and daughter's house. We're done with dinner. Shall we sleep together now?

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

Myeong-Ha’s beloved boyfriend Tae-On—her pride and everything—has died, leaving behind a will addressed to his friend Jeong-U: “I leave all my assets to my beloved girlfriend.” But there’s a twist—Tae-On had not one, but three girlfriends. Under Jeong-U’s supervision, a quiet yet intense battle unfolds. With 3 billion won at stake, only one can inherit it all. Who will emerge as the “beloved girlfriend,” and what truths will surface as each woman stakes her claim?

(Source: WEBTOON)

26-year old Hansol's finally got a place of his own! But on moving day, he opens the door to find an unexpected roommate: a little white griffin. Where did it come from? Is it lost? But just look at those fluffy bird paws and cute kitty toe beans! Maybe he can stay, just for a while!

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: How to Escape an Esper Harem
description:
Thrown into the world of a reverse harem novel, Lila becomes the guide every esper covets. All she wants is to break free from the chains of the cliché and carve her own life, but each man she tries to avoid seems only more determined to claim her. With the weight of destiny closing in, Lila must choose to either defy the tale itself or surrender to the bonds that refuse to release her.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: This work was pre-released in English before releasing in Korean.*

Dana, a Korean high school senior just days away from her college entrance exam, meets an unlucky end. Hit by the infamous "romance fantasy truck" and reborn in another world, she figures she might as well make the best out of it, but she suddenly stumbles across the Saintess's secret!

*"I don't want to die, so I guess I'll keep the cat in the bag, Saintess!"*

(Source: WEBTOON)

Once a revered war hero, Ezekiel is reduced to a tortured man when he is blinded by poison. Ezekiel seeks to regain his eyesight and get his revenge against the woman who poisoned him, but he is utterly blind to the fact that she is the new maid in his manor, Rose. Having been previously blackmailed into harming Ezekiel, Rose is resolved to spend the rest of her life serving him. However, complications arise as the two of them grow closer. Can there be a happy ending for a relationship that was poisoned from the beginning?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Byeolha wakes up as Rose, the female lead of a novel who is doomed to be betrayed by her unfaithful husband, Eric. The nightmare deepens when she discovers that her best friend, who stole her husband in their past life, has also transmigrated and is now targeting her husband again. However, Rose refuses to be the victim this time. She’ll gladly let her friend have her worthless husband while she plans her escape to a peaceful life. But fate has other plans when she keeps crossing paths with Arteum, the powerful Grand Duke…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ahn Cha-Woo is the ultimate magnet for terrible boyfriends. Every relationship ends the same way, and the latest one does not even last six months before ending in betrayal. Why is love never on his side? Is it really too much to hope for a boyfriend who is polite, handsome, fit, and, well, generously endowed? Cha-Woo cannot help feeling the universe is being unfair. 

 *“Forget it. I am done with dating.”*

But just as he swears off romance, someone catches his eye, Nam Do-Ha, who happens to be polite, handsome, fit, and…everything else on his list. Of course, Do-Ha looks like the definition of a straight campus golden boy, so Cha-Woo quickly crushes his own interest. Until Doha suddenly lights up and says, “Wow, really? Then could you buy me lunch tomorrow?” A throwaway comment, taken seriously. Maybe, just maybe, this time will be different.

Areum Ham can’t believe that one night of drinking to forget meant forgetting everything. But when Bumyeong Baek, soccer star and childhood friend, demands to know what they did the night before, one thing slowly becomes clear: neither of them remembers if things ended with a kiss. But just when she thinks things are complicated enough, he has another demand lined up for her.

Since when was he interested in more? Does she feel the same way, or has this tiger set his sights on the wrong prey?

(Source: Tapas)

Having lived in poverty all his life, Brian gets a second chance when he is offered the role of the sole heir to a conglomerate family's enormous fortune.

(Source: Toomics)

Yuriel thought she was trapped in a dating sim, but she soon realizes it's actually a happiness sim. To escape, she must heal the world's wounded characters and bring them happiness — without them falling in love with her! Can she do it? Or will more than one NPC fall head over heels?

(Source: Manta)

When skeptic Je-Hyeon and paranormal-obsessed Yeong-Hu become unlikely roommates, they think they’ve lucked into the deal of the century: a huge apartment for an unbelievably cheap price. But they soon learn why the rent was so low... You see, something else is living there, and it’s very interested in them! Now the two opposites must survive a nosy, perverted ghost and the bizarre mysteries of their new home…together.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hogil Byeon is a third-class killer in the criminal organization Glory Club, with no way up and only one way out. He pivots into law, but his knack for killing doesn’t disappear. Juggling courtrooms and bullets, Hogil starts redefining justice his own way. The law has limits, but Hogil doesn’t. When a lawyer has killer skills, justice is served… with a bang!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Seohyun is a Korean detective who was closing in on a serial killer when they both plunged off a building together. But then, she wakes up inside a novel as Himena Sylvester, a villainess doomed to a tragic end. Determined to change her fate, she sets out to repair Himena’s reputation, earning unexpected admiration along the way. But just as her new life begins to turn around, she uncovers something she missed—the serial killer fell into the novel with her, so a crime spree is about to begin!

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Swordmaster Who Leapt Through Time
description:
The Kingdom of Vanroah has fallen. Lansen, the last prince, flees with the remaining survivors to a faraway land. Vowing to one day revive the kingdom, he becomes a swordmaster at a young age, only for a treacherous incident to strip everything away. Powerless to protect those he loves, he uses an ancient artifact to travel 10,000 years back in time to the Age of the Arcane. There, its rich knowledge and wisdom help him avert disaster in the present. But each time he turns back the clock, new secrets emerge, entangling the past and present in ways he never foresaw.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: I Became the Target of the Male Leads
description:
Elze, the villainess, was Marquis Oppenheyer’s plaything, used and unloved, fated to die at the hands of the three male leads. Now, a reader finds herself in Elze’s shoes. In order to save her life, Elze must first ingratiate herself with the male leads. As the evil superintendent of a nefarious boarding school, Elze is pinned between embattled student Lucian, the kidnapped son of a duke, her own murderous marquis, and a guild master–one of whom may be her ticket to freedom from her doomed fate.

(Source: Tapas)

Three years after leaving home, Yunjae gets a call from his sister. “Father’s gone….” He feels no tears, no sorrow, because the man was never truly his father. Returning to his hometown under the heavy heat of summer, Yunjae finds his sister unchanged: fragile, beautiful, and heartbreakingly familiar. He knows what he feels must stay hidden, that some things are never meant to be spoken aloud. But the closer they grow, the harder it becomes to bury his forbidden longing, and the past they’ve both tried to forget begins to bloom again beneath the sunflowers.

(Source: Lezhin US)

20-year-old Choa ends a relationship after discovering her boyfriend mocking her for being bad in bed. Soon after, she learns her childhood friend and tutor, Seunghyeon, was dumped for the same reason. They decide to “study” together to rebuild their confidence, but these weekly “lessons” soon turn into something far hotter, and as bodies and boundaries blur, they must decide whether this chemistry stays in the bedroom or becomes something real.

(Source: Lezhin US)

At the slightest twitch to the brush of his delicate fingertips, a sharp thrill ran deep inside him, and it made him want to play a cruel little game. Without thinking about what that game might lead to.

*“I want to touch you here, too.”

Shy and lonely college junior Do-Rae Lee never expects to see her high school crush again until she runs into Hae-Won Cha, who’s just as handsome as she remembers. Because one, he already has a popular girlfriend who happens to be Do-rae’s friend, and two, he believes he’s still eighteen years old. After a car accident erased five years of his memories, Hae-Won is stuck in the past and determined to make Do-Rae his girlfriend. Now the two are confronted by the question: Can first love survive reality?

(Source: WEBTOON)

When monsters show up, espers rise as heroes. But to Do-Yeong, they're nothing but glorified weapons. However, when Do-Yeong is dragged into the United Esper-Guide Force Command, he is declared the perfect guide for the two most powerful espers alive: brothers Kang-Joon and Yi-Joon. Thrust into a love triangle shaped by power and survival, Do-Yeong has to choose who and what he's willing to endure.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Only Fence, a platform filled with sexual content. You know what? You can make tons of money on this site with porn. So come over here, dork! Take your pants off.

Thanks to his false bragging, Geon-Woo's friends think he has lots of experience in the bedroom when he's actually a virgin who hasn't even kissed anyone before. When Han-Eul, the pretty upperclassman Geon-Woo admires, asks to sleep with him, Geon-Woo is nervous but on cloud nine. However, Han-Eul's intimidating friend, Ji-Ho, is waiting for them at the place of their hookup. Not only that, but Han-Eul insists on having a threesome with Geon-Woo and Ji-Ho, claiming it's the only way he can be satisfied! And so, poor Geon-Woo is trapped in a dangerously filthy throuple with no way out...

Hong-Ryeol gets falsely accused and becomes a loner. One day, he gets to download a mysterious hypnosis app that lets him take revenge on the girls that looked down on him.

*I'll fuck all of you who looked down on me."*

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

display_title: The Returned Villainess Vows to Stay Single
description:
Lydia Evanzi’s first life ends in tragedy because of one reason: her awful taste in men! Vowing to stay single in this life, Lydia chooses the chaste path as a priestess, though it’s really just a front for her to get revenge on all those who once wronged her. But to help with that plan comes another man, Arsen Edith, who actually proves to be a far better partner than Lydia hopes for...!

(Tappytoon)

display_title: When the Archduke's Leash Is Pulled
description:
Jenna, a girl cursed to see others’ emotions as light, awakens as an extra in a novel. Yearning for a quiet life, she settles in a forest cabin—only to discover it belongs to Enoch Winchester, a cursed duke cloaked in an ominous black light. When Enoch realizes Jenna may hold the key to breaking his curse, he proposes a contract: she must spend time with him each day and come whenever he calls. Jenna agrees, but with one condition—he must appear in the form of a snow leopard whenever they're together.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Seong-Yul has spent years pining for his older brother’s friend, Seung-Won. But as a beta from a humble background, he knows a future with the elite alpha is impossible. When a sudden secondary gender manifestation turns Seong-Yul into an omega, his life spirals. Desperate for cash and heartbroken by news of Seung-Won’s engagement, he makes a reckless choice to enter the underground adult industry. His first night is a nightmare...until his very first client turns out to be Seung-Won himself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Include one extra chapter.*

Jipil is a recently divorced man with no major flaws, just a few lingering emotional bruises. One night, after drinking a bit too much, he picks up a stray cat on the street and brings it home. But the next morning, the creature in his bed is not a cat at all. It is Myohyeon, a runaway catgirl with ears, a tail, and her own share of complicated circumstances. Memories of the “dream” he thought he had, the night he spent with her, suddenly come rushing back. Myohyeon insists he take responsibility and let her stay with him. Before Jipil can even argue, his friend shows up at the door. Panicked, Jipil introduces Myohyeon, in her cat form, as the pet he is raising. And just like that, living together becomes unavoidable. With a few ground rules set, the two begin an awkward but strangely sweet cohabitation. Can they follow the rules and keep life peaceful, or will the unexpected feelings between them break every boundary?

(Source: Lezhin US)

When a junior boldly confesses his feelings and asks permission to stalk him, Jeong-Hyeon is intrigued by the audacity. Amused, he agrees on one condition, turning desire into a secret, physical arrangement meant to be nothing more than fun. But as the relationship continues, Jeong-Hyeon begins to develop real feelings, just as Ji-Wu starts pulling away, leaving them both caught between obsession, vulnerability, and emotions neither intended to face.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

Luciel the Paladin is sent to eliminate a demon who has plunged an entire village into debauchery with their powers. At the village church, he reunites with Risia, a beautiful and kind nun who was his first love as a child. But when Risia sheds her habit to reveal a seductive truth, a mortified Luciel realizes that she knows all about his unholy desire for her... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.*

When Detective I-Hwa goes undercover to dismantle a drug syndicate, his mission clear: get close to its cold-blooded boss, Tae-Gon. At first, the plan runs smoothly, until Tae-Gon sees through the disguise. But instead of handing I-Hwa over, he traps him with threats and twisted control, forcing him to stay at his side. As I-Hwa searches for a way out, fragments of a past he thought forgotten begin to surface, revealing that his connection to Tae-Gon runs far deeper than he ever imagined...

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a brutal battle, magical girl Ruby is torn into two separate bodies. Can Ruby reunite with herself before darkness wins?

(Source: Toomics)

When a prophetic dream shows her future stepfather killing her family, Emeline Wedgewood sets out to stop her mother's marriage to the duke at all costs. And what better way than to start a scandal with the duke's son, Eric Orleans? Suspicious of his father's intentions, Eric proposes that he and Emeline marry so their parents can't. But will the scandal of the century be enough to foil the duke's plans? Or will their sham marriage pit these unlikely allies into greater danger than ever before?

(Source: Tapas)

A gamer trapped in his favorite game must fix his mistakes to save a heroine stuck in a lowly role.

(Source: Toomics)

Shayla’s desperate bid to escape an unwanted marriage leads her to the Grand Duke. One night with him should’ve been fleeting, but a mysterious collar mark on his neck says otherwise. Once untouchable, he’s consumed, his fate tangled with the woman who dared to claim him.

(Source: Manta)

Watching over someone can be quite overwhelming... But what if you switched bodies with that person...?

(Source: Toomics)

Gyeong-Won Cha, who has Highlander syndrome, always wanted to look more like an adult. But one day, he hears:

*"We gotta use the only advantage we've got - to pretend we're kids!"*

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

display_title: Your Highness, It's Just a Novel
description:
To write a "mature" romance, clueless author Marianne LeBlanc targets a royal masquerade. But when a single kiss with Crown Prince Lucius binds them with a curse, their only cure is torturously close proximity. Can she write a bestseller while sharing a roof with the man who hates love stories?

(Source: Manta)

display_title: My First XXX: My Friend Turned into a Succubus!
description:
Becoming an adult brings many new experiences, but having his first wet dream was not on Joo Seong-Min’s bucket list. What’s worse is that he dreams of getting down and dirty with a devilish version of his best friend, Seo Gyu-Ri. He could just brush it off as a random wild fantasy, but why does this dream feel a bit too close to reality...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.*

Betrayed by their lovers on the same night, Seoin and Minho part ways—only to meet again years later. Now a pro golfer, Minho won’t stop chasing Seoin. But when Gitae and Muyoung resurface, the past they tried to bury comes back to life. 

(Source: Manta)

After being reborn into her favorite novel, Sarah Brant's role was clear. She's a maid, an extra with no other goal than to see her favorite pair from the story get together. Unfortunately, she's constantly walking on egg shells around the fussy prince Leonard who's determined to fire her. Can Sarah keep her job long enough to watch her favorite story's finale from the best seats in the house?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

Method actor Park Se-Ha and flop idol Sohn Ji-Eon are cast as lovers in a queer crime film. What begins as open hostility born from clashing backgrounds slowly transforms through forced rehearsals and intimate method acting. As Ji-Eon’s sincerity and relentless effort break down Se-Ha’s defenses, professional boundaries blur into dangerous attraction. Determined to call their growing closeness a “mistake,” both men struggle to separate acting from reality. Caught between obsession and devotion, they must decide whether their connection is merely part of the role… or something real.

(Source: Tappytoon)

All things in this world have a price. But what if people did too? With the mysterious "Social Coin" app appearing on phones all over the world, people are now "priced" according to their reputation and character. While those worth high prices thrive, those worth low prices are in danger of facing ostracization, discrimination, or even death.

(Source: WEBTOON)

As old feelings resurface and tension builds, the path to a reunion seems possible—but it won't come without its challenges.

(Source: Lalatoon)

Ko Woon-Ha lives in constant pursuit of stimulation, yet his dulled senses leave him unable to truly feel pain, let alone pleasure. That changes after a single night with Cha Gyu-Won, the younger brother of his FWB, when Woon-Ha is able to experience genuine desire for the first time in his life. The problem is, Gyu-Won is everything Woon-Ha claims to despise: younger, inexperienced, and sworn to remain chaste until marriage, he seems to cling to a naive fantasy of a first love that will last forever. Convinced he’s made the worst possible mistake, Woon-Ha tries to brush it off as nothing more than a lapse in judgment…until the reality of his situation hits him harder than he though possible: Gyu-Won might be the only one who can make him feel anything - both physically and emotionally.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A fiery married couple dives into the streaming world when the wife, a rising VTuber, makes her husband her manager. Between chaotic broadcasts and suspicious fans, his secret past with a top streamer slowly comes to light…

(Source: Toomics)

Choi Hyeon-Gyeol is trapped in a hellish temporal prison. Every time the clock strikes midnight on the 15th, he is ripped back to the start of the previous day. Forced to repeat the exact same university assignments twenty times over, his sanity has worn dangerously thin. Pushed to his absolute breaking point by the monotony, Hyeon-Gyeol decides to abandon all caution and indulge in a wild, impulsive escape from his scripted life. This leads him to an unexpected, heated one-night stand with his fellow classmate, Lim Yeon-Jeong.

He falls asleep expecting to wake up to the same familiar nightmare once again. However, against all odds, the loop finally breaks. For the first time in what feels like an eternity, Hyeon-Gyeol opens his eyes to the fresh, uncharted morning of the 15th... with Yeon-Jeong right beside him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Serpent in the Empress’s Chamber
description:
Despite devoting her body and soul to Emperor Laxus and helping him rise to power as an illegitimate son, Empress Lenisha loses her family and is cast out of the palace due to the Emperor’s paranoid suspicion that she might betray him. Now, Lenisha has only one goal: to bring him down. To do so, she chooses a new husband and ally in Kassius, a war hero brimming with fiery vitality. And so begins their tale of revenge… and perhaps love.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Following an intense session of physical intimacy, Dojun is blindsided by a statement from his girlfriend that defies all logic and expectation. Instead of the usual post-coital whispers, she drops a bombshell that leaves him reeling in shock: “Babe, have you ever thought about getting a fuck-buddy?” Far from being a test or a trick, it turns out to be the opening act of an extraordinary "Harem Project" specifically designed to handle her boyfriend’s inexhaustible stamina and high libido. 

The ambitious goal is set: seven different women to fill every single day of the week, ensuring he is never left wanting. As the boundaries of their relationship dissolve into a provocative new reality, his girlfriend even takes the lead in scouting the candidates. With a mischievous glint in her eye, she suggests the perfect starting point for their scandalous venture: "First... how about the girl next door who always masturbates while eavesdropping on us?" 

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a wasteland where the dead hunt the living, Jay Lee’s only light is Won. For seven years, they have wandered together, bound by a love that Won has carefully kept hidden. When a single night of intimacy finally breaks the tension, it feels like a new beginning. Instead, it is the beginning of the end. When a sudden crisis exposes Won’s true identity, it triggers a violent separation that neither saw coming. In a world defined by hunger, the most dangerous thing Jay ever did was lose his heart to a mystery.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Dukedom's Men Interfere with the Divorce
description:
I transmigrated into my favorite novel — as the doomed villainess Ione! To survive, I must protect my beloved stepson Edwin and play the perfect duchess in a contract marriage. But when it’s time to break the marriage contract, my newfound family won’t let me go. What happens when the villainess is no longer the villain?

(Source: Manta)

Nicole killed the man who she thought destroyed her life: her husband. However, the truth was revealed too late. Given a second chance, she returns to a past where love is not an option and marriage must never happen. To protect the man she once vowed to kill, Nicole must risk everything. But can a love born from regret ever be returned?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Judith, a war orphan with supernatural powers, survives thanks to an anonymous benefactor. He showers her with gifts but never replies. When she finally receives a reply, she travels to meet him. But who is her benefactor out of the charming rogue, successful businessman, and snarky gang leader?

(Source: Manta)

When Wu-Shin moves into his new place, the last person he expects to run into is Jae-Hyeok, the same guy who made his school days a living hell. Out of work and behind on rent, Jae-Hyeok ends up crashing at Wu-Shin’s apartment, turning his peaceful new start into pure chaos. Instead of the terrifying bully from his memories, Wu-Shin now finds a lazy freeloader who trashes the house and drives him up the wall. But the Jae-Hyeok he remembers wasn’t always like this; he used to shine so brightly it hurt to look. What could have happened to turn him into such a mess, and can Wu-Shin survive living under the same roof as the one man he swore he’d never see again?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

In middle school, Cheol Im was a living legend for his fighting prowess. Years later, he learns that his childhood friend from the orphanage, Sol Kim, was bullied to death. Determined to get revenge, Cheol returns to school. But his plans take an unexpected turn when Ha-yun Seo, a fellow orphan who was like a sister to him, is assigned as a teacher at that very same school. Now, Cheol is forced to choose between his thirst for revenge and his loyalty to the person who once protected him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

For Sehyun and Yumi, taking sexy pictures was just a side gig. That is, until Hannah came into the picture...

(Source: Toomics)

A doctor disgraced by a false accusation survives by practicing medicine in the shadows, only to be claimed by the ruthless boss of a powerful mafia syndicate. When the boss loses his memory after a serious injury, cracks begin to form in their twisted relationship, hinting at a hidden past that may be more dangerous than the truth itself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

It's Juho Doh's first day of college, and it's like an unbreakable curse has been lifted at last. After a childhood of being overlooked and ignored, he's finally starting to make friends! But attracting attention is a dangerous game when hungry ghosts start to take notice. And if running from spirits wasn't enough, there's a strange man who just can't get enough of him. Will Juho be able to live a normal life? Or will he be devoured by those closest to him?

Ru-Min is an acting prodigy with a Newtube channel that often goes viral. As it happens, she is also the spitting image of her favorite A-list actor Ha-Jin Jeong. A shocking turn of events reveals that Ha-Jin is actually Ru-Min’s biological father. The cold-hearted actor reluctantly takes her in, but pointedly vows no affection. However, as Ru-Min’s raw talent shines, Ha-Jin finds himself becoming an unlikely mentor. Having long fantasized about Ha-Jin being her father, can Ru-Min finally make her dreams a reality?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ace soldier Jeong Ji-No is assigned a top-secret mission to save the world - only to find out it involves becoming a magical middle-aged man. Things go from bad to worse when the transformation makes his fellow soldiers suddenly claim he smells amazing and start chasing after him. Just as Ji-No is about to lose his mind, a - ahem - "helping hand" arrives in the form of Eliah, his longtime rival and the army’s other ace. Saving the world was never supposed to be this embarrassing…or this complicated.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The women, aiming to rise in status, begin classes to conquer their family's assets.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Seol is a rising Go prodigy who built her career by memorizing every game she could find, but her play is empty. When she meets Sang-Hun, a self-taught player who defies all logic, her world begins to crack. To surpass the greatest player of her era and her own past, she must abandon everything she knows and step into the unknown. In a game with endless possibilities, can she create a move that’s truly her own?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: A Mouthful of Sweet Cream Baguette
description:
Roah Egleydon is an avid lover of bread, so when a conference takes her to the home of the famous Everrose Bakery, she is determined to get her hands on some delicious baked goods. After a day of waiting in line in the sweltering sun, she finally makes it to the bakery, only to find them all sold out! That's when she meets Klimt, a mysterious, sexy baker who offers her a sample of his sweet cream baguette. Roah is intrigued by this handsome stranger, but is she biting off more than she can chew?

(Source: Tapas)

Identical twins Joo Baek-Hee and Joo Baek-Naa share everything, including their obsession with one person: Jung Hae-Yoon, a seemingly ordinary friend caught between them. To one, Hae-Yoon is a precious toy; to the other, an irreplaceable treasure. As the twins’ twisted desires begin to blur the line between love and possession, can Hae-Yoon escape from their beautiful but dangerous grasp?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Rookie director Lee Suh-Rim is at his wit’s end. Lee Su-Noh, the hottest star around, joined Suh-Rim’s project but keeps skipping production meetings. Soon, the whole production might fall apart before it can begin. Out of options, Suh-Rim decides to cash in on a secret only he knows about the actor. Years ago, he paid Su-Noh for something special... something that Su-Noh has not yet delivered. So now, Su-Noh owes him... with 50% interest. Will this leverage help Suh-Rim? Or will it be the final nail?

(Source: Tapas)

Wi-Jeong left his hometown in agony after falling in love with his older brother’s fiancée, a secret he could never confess. Seven years later, he returns to Seorabeol and unexpectedly reunites with Jin-Hui, a boy he once knew but had long forgotten. As memories resurface, so does a promise from the past that Jin-Hui has never let go of.

 *"You said you would reward me if I waited patiently."

"Wi-Jeong, now...let’s become a real couple."*

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The One Who Never Leaves the Nest
description:
After his mother’s death, Gun-Woo moves in with his stepfather, Yi-Hyun—a man only fifteen years older, with whom he shares little more than a roof. Their relationship is distant, almost awkward, until Gun-Woo notices strange marks on Yi-Hyun’s body—too deliberate to ignore. A quiet curiosity takes root, and when he finds a vivid red rope hidden in Yi-Hyun’s room, he realizes there’s more to this man than he ever imagined.

The more he uncovers, the harder it is to look away.

(Source: Lezhin US)

At Dowonhyang, a secret luxury retreat for the elite, Cheong-Woo works as a server when he catches the eye of Won-Jae, a man of power and influence who always gets what he wants. Unfortunately for Cheong-Woo, what Won-Jae wants is him. Though Cheong-Woo tries to escape, the trap has already been set, pulling him into a dark, consuming spiral of desire and obsession he never saw coming.

(Source: Manta)

Katelyn Grint has spent her whole life pining for a man who's in love with her best friend. But a chance encounter with Terius Hert, the no-nonsense and infuriatingly attractive commander of her brother's order of knights, turns her world upside down.
