What was supposed to be a one-time mistake quickly becomes something much more complicated... and permanent. Katelyn is about to discover that not everyone is who they appear to be—and that some firsts lead to the most unexpected beginnings.

(Source: Tapas)

After sharing a short-lived relationship during college, Jang Taesan and Lee Sooyeon have gone their separate ways for the past ten years. But they are fatefully reunited when Taesan comes to Sooyeon’s hometown to fix their flooded reservoir. Despite being out of touch for a decade, the spark they once had hasn’t faded. But will it grow into something more meaningful this time around?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Reincarnated as a green-eyed brunette in the novel "The Murderer Targets Brunettes", Selenia knows that the murderer in question will be arrested within a year. To avoid being murdered herself, she holes herself up in her room until her adoptive father betrays her and has her sent to the mage tower. To her surprise, the master of the tower is Eon de Grandnoir, the very murderer she's trying to avoid! The tower is staffed entirely by green-eyed brunettes, who seemingly work there of their own free will. Can Selenia survive and solve the mystery in the process?

(Source: WEBTOON)

*"Sleep with the women living in this building- whether through blackmail, seduction, or even force."*

Lee Han accepts the sweet but dangerous offer that could turn his miserable life upside down...

*"Apartment 301, the married woman Su-Jin Han. I need to find this woman's weakness fast!"*

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Kwon Heemang is a jobless recluse living a shut-in lifestyle without a single friend to her name. Her mundane existence takes a supernatural turn after a freak accident grants her the ability to see ghosts, leading to a haunting encounter with Kim Sarang. The lingering spirit strikes a deal: she will leave Heemang alone only after fulfilling her final wish. Sarang died just one month into her first relationship, never having the chance to truly experience intimacy with her boyfriend. 

Before Heemang can protest, Sarang possesses her body and tracks down her ex, Choi Taemin, a popular, younger student celebrating his return to college after military service. In a bold, possessed frenzy, Heemang catches Taemin off guard with an intense kiss in front of everyone. Shaken and humiliated once the possession lifts, Heemang flees the scene. However, Taemin, who secretly admires assertive older women, finds himself completely smitten by the mysterious "crazy woman" who stole his heart.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jeong Ji-Ho is a low-ranking gangster faced with a life-threatening dilemma. He must have public sex with Choi Hee-Seong within three days, or he will die. But how is he supposed to get it on with a man, much less the underboss of a rival gang? He’ll have to find a way, even if it means opening himself up to new options...

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.*

As a child, Han-Joo was cherished and protected by Ki-Won, the man he thought was simply his father’s friend. Ten years later, they reunite and sit down for a long-overdue night of drinks. But in his drunken haze, Ki-Won whispers a truth Han-Joo cannot ignore.

 *“You and I… we were lovers. In another life.”*

Suddenly, the lines between family, fate, and forbidden desire begin to blur. Can Han-Joo and Ki-Won ever go back to the bond they once had, Or will this revelation pull them into a love that defies time itself?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Stuck between two men with the same face, I'm driven mad between them. Helplessly drowning in the pleasure they push upon me.

(Source: Lalatoon)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

From failed auditions to broken dreams, Ha-Yun thought his acting career was over before it began. Now a small-time streamer, he’s ready to give up on the spotlight for good…until a mysterious indie director makes him an offer that’s impossible to ignore. One risky role, one intimate frame, and suddenly, Ha-Yun’s world is about to blur the line between performance and desire.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Soyu Yang is better than you and he knows it. Even in his dreams, he is the chosen one. A martial arts grand master, Yukgwan, speaks to him in a dream and brings him into a parallel world with superhuman abilities and “errors,” mutations that turn you into a monster. One of these errors is a former disciple of Yukgwan, now a dragon, and terrorizing the parallel world. Soyu and Kara, his anti-romantic partner, are chosen to hunt the dragon, but Soyu meets another who says he’s the fake version of him…

(Source: WEBTOON)

When ordinary man Moo-Yeong awakens as an A-rank guide, he is shocked to find out he has been paired with his long-lost first love from high school: the elite S-rank esper Yoo-Hae. Although Yoo-Hae is delighted about their reunion, Moo-Yeong is determined to keep their relationship a professional one. And thus begins an endless amount of “work” as a guide. While it’s standard protocol for guides to heal through physical intimacy, Yoo-Hae’s demands are obsessively intense, pushing Moo-Yeong to his limits. Is this so-called business relationship going to work out?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.*

Hanbyeol possesses a unique, irresistible scent that acts as a powerful siren call to all wolves. This biological quirk has defined much of her life, but it finally leads to a dream come true: a political marriage to Taesan, the formidable wolf hybrid she has secretly pined for since youth. However, the initial euphoria of their union quickly dissipates as the harsh reality of their physical differences sets in. As a mere human, Hanbyeol finds herself overwhelmed by the sheer intensity and primal needs of a powerful predator like Taesan. Terrified that her inability to keep up will lead to their estrangement, Hanbyeol realizes that standard devotion won't be enough to sustain their bond. Driven by an obsessive desire to satisfy her husband and prove her worth, she makes a drastic, life-altering decision to push her human limits. To truly belong to the wolf she loves, Hanbyeol prepares to take on whatever she can to stay with Taesan.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Actor Gyeong Wu-Hyeon is a devoted fan of painter Do Han-Ah. When a treasured piece of Han-ah’s artwork is stolen from him, Wu-Hyeon is devastated, but fate steps in when he unexpectedly runs into Han-ah again at a charity event. To his surprise, Han-ah doesn’t remember him at all, and a small misunderstanding quickly snowballs into the two of them falling into bed. Determined not to let the moment slip away, Wu-Hyeon sets out to show Han-ah just how much he truly values his work. As Han-Ah slowly begins to open up, he finds himself drawn to Wu-Hyeon… yet every now and then, he catches a cool, unreadable side to Wu-Hyeon that he just can’t figure out.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Beom-Yun, a cursed prince, weds Chung-Hui, a lame, twice-wed woman used as a living talisman. The jaded prince finds himself consumed by love for this princess, who is nothing more than a pawn in a scramble for power. To protect her, he’ll seize the throne and drown the world in vengeance.

(Source: Manta, edited)

Valentina’s former fiancé appears before her, looking like a ragged vagabond and carrying a letter secretly ordering his death, sent by none other than his uncle and her future husband. Though Valentina tries to push him away, Aethelred seems intent on winning her back.

(Source: Manta)

*"I won't date anyone until I make it."*

Gerald started work as the assistant to one of the most successful adult webtoon artists. He doesn't want to date anyone, but women keep throwing themselves at him!

(Source: DAYcomics)

In this empire, the position of saint sees a high turnover... Because the saints just won't stop sleeping with the knights! So when the new saint Alisa finds out her personal guard is the very man who had her predecessors excommunicated, she's determined to keep her distance. But one day, the two find themselves trapped in a mysterious room forcing them to act out a rather risqué scenario in order to get out. How will the righteous holy knight deal with this decidedly sinful situation?

(Source: Tapas)

 *Note: Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae Danpyeonseon (순애 단편선) Collection.*

Princess Roxiana of Cantar seems destined for a life of happiness as she departs to wed her childhood fiancé, Prince Lucas. But when her carriage is ambushed by mysterious assailants, Roxiana finds she’s been betrayed. Branded a slave and stripped of her royal title, all hope appears lost…Until she is rescued by Grand Duke Floyd Lathean of Torcan. Roxiana must contend with dangerous forces, all while her feelings for the Duke grow. Betrayal or love, which will out?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Zerak, a bold and beautiful witch born from a gemstone, dreams of joining an official witch gathering. But her fiery fashion sense and unapologetic attitude don’t sit well with the more conservative witches, who quickly shut her out. Determined to find a place where she truly belongs, Zerak sets off on a journey to seek a gathering that will accept her. Along the way, she finds herself entangled with three very different men—each more complicated than the last. 

Will Zerak be able to claim her place among the witches, or will these unexpected encounters change her path forever?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Known as the weirdo of the Early Childhood Education Department, Ju-Yeong starts reviewing adult toys for cash—and gets caught mid-act by his junior and crush, Min-Hwan. Panicking, he blurts out, “Can you put it in? Please, just this once?” Surprisingly, Min-Hwan agrees… 

Could he like Ju-Yeong too?

(Source: Manta)

Despite his job as a corrections officer, Jeong-Won is terrified - but it’s not the incarcerated criminals that scare him. No, what Jeong-Won is scared of is the possibility of someone discovering the secret love he’s being harboring for his stepbrother, Ye-Jun. But when the two come face to face in the confines of the concrete cells, Jeong-Won will not be able to hide any longer. Forced to confront his past, will Jeong-Won be forever bound to his guilt? Or will he finally break free of the prison he's created for himself?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeo Eui-Yeon, once a respected figure within his martial sect, vanished without a trace after betraying his order—murdering his own master and fellow disciples in cold blood. Do Hae-Gun, one of the sect's most promising young warriors, was raised like a son by Master Eui-Yeon. But after being suddenly abandoned as a child, Hae-Gun grew up with a deep scar—feeling discarded, betrayed, and driven by resentment. Years later, under orders to track down the fugitive Eui-Yeon, Hae-Gun sets out on a mission fueled by a twisted blend of loyalty and vengeance. But on his journey, he crosses paths with a mysterious man—someone who looks uncannily like his former master, yet behaves in completely different, disarming ways. Is this truly Eui-Yeon reborn? Or a stranger caught in the shadow of another man's sins?

In a world of blades and betrayal, what will Hae-Gun do when the line between past and present begins to blur?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: When Pride Fell at My Feet
description:
The beautiful Duke Enrico Michele approached like a devil whispering sweet lies, offering a cunning deal. "Just dance for me like a living doll. In return, I'll tell you about your dead parents." Along with his mysterious patronage came a chilling question: "Don't you want to know the truth?" And so began my secret, dangerous entanglement with the Duke, a meeting that should never have happened.

(Source: WEBTOON)

From afar, it looks like Seren Lubave's set for a fairytale ending. Not only was she saved by the emperor from certain death, but it turns out she’s also his fated partner, the only one who can suppress his dragon blood. But Seren never asked for this, and now she can’t shake off the sense that something’s wrong. What is the emperor keeping from her, and why can’t she remember the attack that brought her here in the first place? She's about to discover fairytales should never be built on lies...

(Source: Tapas)

Not all powers are worth having. Dam-Cho Baek has never doubted that—in fact, she’d do anything to get rid of her ability to hear people’s emotions, a divine gift granted by a foreign god. At the end of her wits, she’s shocked to encounter an exorcist named Jin-Hu Do, who might just know how to do it. The catch? To get rid of her ability, she needs to lose her virginity—but hearing people's thoughts makes that impossible. And since she can’t hear Jin-Hu… maybe he could help her with that too. 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Incubus, the Saintess, and the Scumbag
description:
Saintess Serylta is tasked by God to marry the crown prince and continue the holy bloodline within the empire. Just before her wedding, a mysterious client hires two incubi to sabotage her divine mission. But Serylta is hardly a pure worker of God in the bedroom, as she quickly dominates them both with her “holy powers,” turning them into her submissive pets. And obeying their new master, the incubi reveal the perverted truth behind the scumbag who hired them...! 

(Source: Tappytoon)

In the near future, a small number of Alphas known as the Awakened are born with extraordinary powers. Diego should have been one of the strongest, but every time he uses his ability, his body betrays him with violent seizures. When he’s introduced to Shane, a quiet scientist who offers to create a stabilizer, Diego begins to feel an inexplicable pull toward him. As buried memories resurface, Diego starts to wonder if their meeting was fate, or the beginning of something that transcends time itself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Late at night, an unknown woman suddenly appears at In-Hyeok's doorstep. She claims she's the inheritance sent by his father. Obeying every command without question, her presence awakens the dark desires Dominic has been suppressing deep inside...

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

display_title: Odd Relations: Fan Letters From My Fake Mom
description:
Jae-Hee loves Jeong so much that he stays his friend even after Jeong gets married and has his son, Yoo-Ahn. Hearing little Yoo-Ahn calling his mom triggers Jae-Hee's jealousy, and he tells Yoo-Ahn to call him ""Mom"" when they're alone. Unfortunately, this becomes a kink that makes it impossible for Jae-Hee to be around Jeong and his family, and he ghosts them soon after. But when Jae-Hee runs into Yoo-Ahn 14 years later, Yoo-Ahn not only remembers Jae-Hee's shameful kink but also confesses his love for the older man! Could their impulsive night together be the start of a questionable romantic relationship...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: Do or Die: Play to be Gay
description:
Woo-Un is a member of an unsuccessful idol group about to end their contract for good. As a final bid to save their careers, the group resorts to enacting gay fanservice to boost their popularity. When Woo-Un is paired with fellow group member Jae-Sam to play-act as a couple, he’s secretly delighted. He has a crush on Jae-Sam, and this is the perfect opportunity to sneak in some justified physical affection. However, Jae-Sam seems reluctant to play along. Will they be able to save their careers this way? And is there more at stake than Woo-Un is aware of?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.*

Edwin Rocher and Leila Garwen grew up as childhood friends, but everything shifted the moment they became adults. When Edwin quietly asked, “Teach me how to touch myself,” Leila gave in to the request, thinking it would end there. Instead, he became addicted to the filthy pleasure Edwin fed him, and Leila found himself unable to escape the boy he once thought he knew so well. One night, Leila stumbles upon a creature with green eyes soaking in Edwin’s bath...a monster wearing the face he trusted most. In that moment, he realized he never truly understood what Edwin is, or what he wants. Caught between fear, desire, and the monstrous truth, Leila enters a den of corruption where escape is impossible and surrender may be the only path left.

(Source: Lezhin US)

College seniors Yeom Se-Min and Jo Yo-Han have just started dating, but between graduation, coming out, family differences, and even unexpected problems in bed, their relationship is anything but simple. As they stumble through love, guilt, and growing pains, can the two find their own answers and learn what it truly means to love each other?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Forced onto a team with her academy rival, Regan Clanford, Leona Everhart is stunned when the gods declare their future child the world’s savior. She’d rather slay the Demon King than marry Regan — but with meddling deities, resisting fate won’t be easy.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The Oil Seller's Butthole Is Slippery
description:
Heo Yoon is a humble oil seller, peddling his wares when he catches the eye of Gu Hyeon-Young, the scandalous youngest son of a noble lord. Hyeon-Young follows after Yoon and tries to seduce him multiple times, but the muscular Yoon is as innocent as he is brawny. Will Hyeon-Young successfully ensnare Yoon and have his way with him, or will Yoon's earnest character thwart him yet again?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.*

Chung-Won, a narcotics officer, goes undercover to stop "Pink Out," a new drug in Korea. The dealers slip away, leaving only Yeong. Every test comes back clean, yet after much doubt, Chung-Won takes home the bewildered 21-year-old who is so unworldly, it's as if he's been shut away his whole life.

(Source: Manta)

Yeong-Ha is a talented practitioner of traditional Korean medicine, but ever since word got out that he’s an omega, business has been at an all-time low. Meanwhile, his teenage neighbor, Pureum, is also struggling to stay afloat in the midst of college entrance exams… and a devastating crush on his hot, older neighbor. But after one of Yeong-Ha’s energy-boosting tonics turns Pureum from a beta into an alpha, the doctor will have to take responsibility for this medical miracle… in ways he never imagined.

(Source: Tappytoon)

After a tragic accident, Seokjae thought his life was over... that is, until he became Mr. Superconductor. Now, he's buzzing for revenge.

(Source: Toomics)

Tempted by the high salary, Lucy, a maid, goes to work at a remote mansion. Her new employer is Skar, a hot-headed half-dragon said to hate humans. Despite his initial skepticism of her, Lucy starts to grow on Skar. But with his fiery outbursts, can Lucy successfully cool the flames of his temper?

(Source: Manta)

Donghyuk's been missing his late wife terribly ever since she passed. But someone who looks just like her seems willing to take her place.

(Source: Toomics)

Na-Hee is sent to bring food to Hyun-Jin, the chaebol heir just back from England. She dreads seeing the boy she used to roughhouse with, yet feels sorry for how lonely his glittering penthouse seems—until he corners her and blurts, “How can I see you as just a friend when you’re so damn pretty?”

(Source: Manta)

display_title: My Secret Business with My Boss
description:
The man leading up So-Young's new team at work not only has a handsome face but is clearing packing something sizable in his pants. She can't help but steal glances at the prominent outline until one day, gazing at her like prey caught in a trap, Tae-Kyung asks, "Do you really like it that much?"

(Source: Manta)

*"You must have a big dick just like your dad. Show me!"*

Han-Gyeol is at risk of getting his pants pulled down by girls curious to see if his dick is just as big as his dad, who holds a Guinness record for having the biggest dick in Korea.

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

No one knows why these people are stranded here with death looming in the corner. As loneliness creeps in, it becomes all too easy to seek solace in others. But they must trust no one but themselves. Remember, the goal is to survive.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Mage Neoniah Ryan is hired to break the nightly curse afflicting Duke Syetry Demott Costas, a noble with dragon blood running through his veins. The plan works—until the cursed duke mistakes Neoniah for his mate. Trapped between spellwork, survival, and a monster’s instincts, Neoniah must end the curse before the night claims her...for good.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Ladies at Her Service: Give Love
description:
Tae-Kyung’s life has been in a downward spiral for a long time. Shouldered with the responsibility of paying the bills and the hospital fees of her only sister, she is barely surviving paycheck to paycheck. It’s hardly surprising that she resorted to borrowing from a loan shark. The true surprise, however, is when she discovers that the loan shark she owes money to is the father of her old high school classmate, Hae-Joo. Delighted with their reunion, Hae-Joo makes an irresistible offer: she’ll clear Tae-Kyung’s debt and take care of all her financial needs… in exchange for Tae-Kyung herself.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: Bunny, Leave the Door Open Tonight
description:
Chesterville’s resident romance novelist, Sweetpea Rabbithole, knows how to write desire—but she’s never tasted it. Determined to change that, she sets out to find someone who can show her what she’s been missing. But when her childhood friend Edward learns of her plan, he's determined to be her first and only lesson. With a mask, a mysterious identity, and a master plan to show her he can be more than the little boy she grew up with, will these friends finally realize what was there all along?

(Source: Tapas) 

 *Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae Danpyeonseon (순애 단편선) Collection.*

Bo-yeong and Haewon have been dating for ten years since they met at university. The two have been through thick and thin together, supporting each other every step of the way. But at some point, their relationship began to feel strained. They thought they knew each other better than anyone after a decade together. But they’re starting to realize that as time passes, it’s becoming increasingly difficult for them to understand each other.

*Source: WEBTOON*

It is the first freshman club retreat—the kind of night meant for excitement and budding romance. However, Kim Seon-Wu finds his heart sinking when he discovers that the senior he’s been pining for already has someone in her life. His jealousy flares toward Noh Sang-Yun, a fellow student with a rough, delinquent appearance who seems to be his primary romantic rival. The tension between them peaks during a reckless search for a local "haunted spot," resulting in Seon-Wu and Sang-Yun becoming stranded alone together in the wilderness. 

Seeking shelter from a sudden downpour, they break into a suspicious, dilapidated house, where Seon-Wu is unexpectedly possessed by a malevolent spirit. As his life hangs by a thread, Sang-Yun drops his rebellious facade and delivers a chilling ultimatum: "If you want to live, do exactly as I say from now on." Seon-Wu had no idea that this "thug" would soon become his literal lifeline.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Since their school days, Ki Tae-Hwa and Lee Yea-Ju have been known as inseparable friends. But after Tae-Swa loses his girlfriend because of Yea-Ju, he creates distance between them, using his enlistment as an excuse. After his discharge, they meet again at a drinking party. Yea-Ju confesses that he has remained single, quietly enduring the loneliness left by Tae-Hwa’s absence. Unable to turn away, Tae-Hwa lets himself drift into a moment he never intended, telling himself it is only temporary. As he moves forward, hoping to return to the friendship they once had, he begins to question whether that is truly what he wants.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After 20 years as a beta, Haon Jung is told that he's actually an omega with unpredictable heats. After suddenly going into heat at work, he wakes up in the home of a rich alpha. Now the alpha wants Haon to live with him, claiming he won't ask for anything, even sex. Can Haon trust this alpha?

(Source: Manta)

Every night, Jae-Hyuk is visited by an uninvited stranger who leaves him drained in more ways than one. The intruder is Mor, an incubus desperate to survive yet terrible at gathering the energy he needs. What started as nightly harassment ends in an unexpected reversal when Mor is trapped in a binding contract with Jae-Hyuk. One longs for freedom, the other wants a normal life, but their unwanted pact begins pulling their hearts in directions neither expected. With desire blurring every line between them, can they face their tangled feelings and uncover the truth behind their growing attachment?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ho-Jin has long harbored a deep affection for Gil-Tae, the kind neighbor who has looked after him since childhood. Unable to confess his true feelings, Ho-Jin’s clumsy one-sided love remains a secret, until one night he finds himself masturbating over a drunken, sleeping Gil-Tae. Despite the significant age gap, what began as a hidden desire is about to cross a line from which there is no turning back, forever changing the innocent bond they once shared. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kim Ju-ah just wanted to get to work on time, but one wrong turn onto her favorite baseball team's bus leaves her trapped. The "Home Team" is muscular, hungry, and has zero boundaries. Before Ju-ah can even apologize, she’s pinned down by the very athletes she cheers for, forced to listen to their filthy promises to ruin her for any other man. In the back of the bus, Ju-ah is about to find out exactly how much "stamina" professional ballplayers really have.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Psyche, an imprisoned royal, emerges after years in a tower to find his kingdom destroyed by rebellion and his family’s rule condemned as cruel and corrupt. Grieving his brother Michele, Psyche is seized by the Liberation Army that is led by Anteros, who proposes marriage to exploit an oracle and “destroy the kingdom” completely. Forced into this dangerous marriage, Psyche hides his hatred and plots revenge… But soon he discovers that perhaps his resentment is aimed towards the wrong man.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Having been given a second chance at life, Jin-U begins to take revenge on the women who deceived him.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Yeoreum is just a normal high school girl determined to find a cute boyfriend. But everything changes when she stumbles across a constellation shard and transforms into one of the Quprids -- warriors with magical powers. How is she supposed to date Gowon, the hottest boy at school, on top of protecting the galaxy? And why does her childhood friend Doyun seem to know more about the shards than he should? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

He may be from the boonies, but he's strong, he's kind, and he won't stop until you're satisfied. His name... is Kangsae the Strong.

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: How to Melt the Tyrant's Heart
description:
In a world of brutal politics and deadly curses, one woman's touch is the ultimate solution. When the reader wakes up as Lianna, a villainess in a fantasy novel, she discovers that she’s the only person who can touch the tyrannical Emperor Enoch without activating his fatal ice curse. As his only cure, she must heal him while surviving the imperial court and the schemes of her cruel family. But as she peels back the layers of Enoch’s cold facade, she finds a lonely man, and soon their roles as the cursed and the cure blossom into a world-altering romance.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Burned out from work, Yeon-Seul’s long-awaited vacation takes a disastrous turn when she finds herself stranded on an island. Her only company? A maddeningly handsome stranger, infuriating as he is irresistible–but with survival forcing them together, sparks fly and an impulsive marriage marked by a night neither can forget transforms their relationship into something rather intimate. But as rescue brings an end to their rendezvous, Yeon-Seul reluctantly resigns herself to the end of her castaway romance–except her island husband doesn’t want to, their love story far from over.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The End of an Imperfect Divorce
description:
After a life of neglect and a cold, loveless marriage to Duke Johann Leopold, Olivia Blanchett’s desperate attempts at love fail… until one day, Jian Han awakens in Olivia’s body. She seeks a divorce and flees to a rival kingdom, where she meets the charming but cunning Marquess Edgar Lancelot. Olivia is eager to start over and live her own life, all while her ex-husband secretly watches from afar. Will old flames be rekindled in this tale riddled with regret and revenge? Or will new love bloom?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Kwon Tae-Shin is a man worn thin by indulgence. A VIP at the exclusive members-only club Zeus, he buys fleeting nights with ease, yet never repeats the same encounter twice, forever chasing something that can cut through his suffocating boredom. Lee Won-Woo, a low-level club employee and the sole provider for his family, never expects to cross Tae-Shin’s path until he is assigned to drive him home one night. On a whim, Tae-shin makes him an offer that changes everything, proposing to buy a night with him instead. Stunned but tempted by the staggering amount of money, Won-Woo accepts, only to emerge from the experience shaken and regretful. He tries to avoid Tae-shin afterward, hoping to put it all behind him. But Tae-Shin is no longer bored. 

Fixated on the one man who managed to leave a mark on him, he begins to pursue Won-Woo with unsettling persistence, turning a single reckless decision into a dangerous and irresistible entanglement.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the hidden slums of Hong Kong, two rival powers dominate the underworld: The Grove Syndicate and The Lotus Syndicate. Their relentless territorial clashes plunge the city into chaos.

Song Ran, the underboss of The Grove Syndicate, is captured by members of The Lotus Syndicate but escapes, only to collapse in front of a modest flower shop. There he encounters Ja Woon-Young, the shop’s refined and gentle-looking owner whose presence feels strikingly out of place amid the shadows of the slums. 

What begins as a chance encounter soon grows into a dangerous entanglement. As the war between The Grove Syndicate and The Lotus Syndicate escalates beyond control, Song Ran becomes haunted by vivid, feverish dreams of fierce intimacy with Woonyoung. Drawn to him yet disturbed by the menace behind his beauty, he finds himself unable to resist. 

Beneath Woon-Young’s graceful smile lies a chilling gaze that conceals his true nature. Caught between desire and suspicion, Song Ran must uncover the secret of the mysterious florist before it consumes him entirely.

(Source: Lezhin US)

His mom’s a stunning, youthful beauty—and her college friends aren’t far behind. When he ends up tangled with one of them, things heat up fast… and more temptations connected to his mom keep showing up.

**Original Webtoon:**      
[Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/uplmscg/episode/toon/8506), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12384914), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/5700000263), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000069295), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=250239), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=05be), [Qtoon](https://www.qtoon.co.kr/toon/list.mg?tcode=gjbh) 

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://toomics.com/en/webtoon/episode/toon/8506)

display_title: The Cocky Brother Learns a Lesson
description:
Born into the prominent Lee family, Yeon has always enjoyed a privileged and comfortable life. However, his achievements and competence pale in comparison to his older adopted brother, Kangwoo. This disparity fuels Yeon's constant, barbed mockery toward him. While Kangwoo usually endures the insults in silence, Yeon finally pushes him too far with a particularly offensive remark. When Kangwoo unexpectedly extends an invitation to his bedroom, Yeon's sheer arrogance compels him to accept. What Yeon doesn't realize is that his big brother is about to deliver a very intense and unforgettable lesson. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Mighty Macaron Wants To Be Meek
description:
Born with monstrous strength, Macaron Spartan dreams of living as a proper noble lady, but her father insists she follow the warrior fate of House Spartan. Thanks to the unexpected help of a mysterious boy named Ganache, she briefly enters high society and tastes the life she longs for. However, that fragile dream fades as a dark plague spreads across the land, forcing her to wield the strength she wished to cast aside. Can Macaron save the world and still claim the gentle life she desires?

(Source: Tapas)

To the rest of the world, Ju Ha-Ram is the picture of innocence and grace, yet his nights tell a different story. From the vantage point of a stalker, Ha-Ram's modest reputation is a curated lie as he brings a revolving door of men back to his bed. Lost in a world of feverish fantasies, the observer has spent months imagining being the one selected for the night. The line between reality and obsession finally blurs when Ha-Ram makes his move, inviting his shadow into the very home he has been haunting for a year.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeo Chae-Woon, the top student in his department, constantly draws attention for his exceptional grades and striking looks. Unfortunately for him, that attention is nothing but a nuisance. When the new semester begins, an unknown stalker starts following him, turning his once-quiet campus life into a constant source of anxiety. Searching for a way out, Chae-Woon comes up with an unexpected idea. He approaches Bae Joo-Han, a classmate from the same department who has been persistently flirting with him, and makes a proposal. For a limited time, they will pretend to be lovers.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Raised in poverty, Kim Woo-Joon has done every kind of job imaginable just to survive. When he rushes back to his rural hometown after hearing about his mother’s car accident, he is crushed by the impossible weight of hospital bills and daily expenses. Desperate, Woo-Joon stumbles into an interview at a luxurious hotel hidden deep in the countryside, a place that caters to the ultra rich and keeps its most exclusive guests in sealed off VIP rooms. There, he meets the enigmatic owner, Kang Ra-Han, a man whose calm smile hides dangerous intentions. Instead of an ordinary job offer, Ra-Han presents Woo-Joon with a startling contract, one that blurs the line between employment and something far more intimate.

With his mother’s life on the line and no other options left, Woo-Joon must decide how much of himself he is willing to give up in exchange for survival.

(Source: Lezhin US)

As part of his pre-graduation internship, culinary student Lee Eun-Seong finds himself working at a sushi restaurant, where one familiar face shows up day after day. But when Eun-Seong accidentally stumbles upon his regular’s secret, things take an unexpected turn. Jeon Ho-Yeong is determined to keep it hidden, while Eun-Seong can’t decide whether he’s annoyed… or oddly drawn in.

(Source: Lezhin US)

One drunken night, I thought I finally slept with Ko Woon-Ha, the person I’ve quietly loved for years. At least… that’s what I believed.

 *“Was it really you? Please tell me it wasn’t…”

“If not me, then who were you expecting?”*

Turns out, it wasn’t Woon-Ha at all! It was his younger brother, Ko-San. Ko-San, the walking disaster. The charming troublemaker. The human hurricane who makes me want to strangle him every time he smirks. The more I try to escape his orbit, the more tangled up I get... like he’s pulling me into his chaos without even trying. Was that night really just an accident? Or is Ko-San deliberately keeping me within arm’s reach? One thing’s for sure. Whatever this is, it’s not going to be simple…and I can’t even look away.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: This Isn't What I Signed Up For
description:
The day of Hae-Seo's interview spirals into disaster—soaked in coffee, harassed, his ex on the panel, and some sleazy, too. He only wanted a fresh start, but instead, he collides with Gong-Woo. Marked by an Alpha before he can settle in, he now has to decide if he'll spend the night with Gong-Woo to undo the mark!

(Source: Manta)

Jun-Seok just started working after his military service. When he visited his uncle's funeral, he met his aunt, Hui-Ae, who he lived with when he was a kid. When he hugged her with his childhood memories in his mind, the scent of each other stimulated their nerves.

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

Seol Ha-Eun has always been puzzled by her long-time childhood friend, Yun Do-Jun. Despite his quiet, introverted nature and somewhat gloomy aura, Do-Jun is far from unattractive, he possesses a solid physique and a face that should easily draw romantic interest. Yet, strangely, he has remained perpetually single. Driven by a mix of genuine concern and relentless curiosity, Ha-Eun finally corners him for the truth, only to be met with a shocking confession. It turns out Do-Jun suffers from a debilitating secret: whenever he attempts to get intimate with a woman, he simply cannot perform. 

Stunned to discover her best friend is a "broken man," Ha-Eun impulsively resolves to take matters into her own hands to "cure" his dysfunction. However, what began as a clinical, hands-on lesson soon spirals into an unpredictable, heated entanglement. As the boundaries of their friendship blur, Ha-Eun finds herself whispering a daring proposal: "Yun Do-Jun... would it be okay if I’m the one to take your virginity?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Where the Golden Rose was Plucked
description:
Every rose has its thorn – even one so fair and bright as Karen Shanaire, a star ballerina in the Empire of Gloretta. Karen, who is secretly a spy for the enemy state of Qustia, must extract valuable intelligence from her latest target, Glorettan war hero and key arms manufacturer Duke Arcturus Kloen. Arcturus begins a relationship of convenience with Karen to ward off scandal, unaware that her intentions are anything but benign. Thus begins the deadliest dance of all: a ballet of love, death, and war.

(Source: WEBTOON)

River Marcel Rolland, a nude model, reveres world-renowned artist Daniel Decker, and secretly harbors a deep, burning desire for him. Through secretive means, River secures a coveted spot as the model for Daniel’s upcoming exhibition, "Le désir." As the sessions begin, River wraps his longing in the language of art, offering not just his body, but something far more vulnerable.

 *“You can use me as your material… As much as you want, in any way you like.”*

(Source: Lezhin US)

*"All I ask for is your evenings."* 

Soaked from the rain, Joo-ahn steps into a stranger's penthouse and enters a world of seduction, secrets, and a contract sealed with desire. He needs money, but what he gets is a man who wants far more than just his time.

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

The Dawson Group changed the world with their line of pheromone-regulating medications. The long line of alphas in the Dawson family has never failed to uphold that legacy—until now. Henry, the eldest son and successor, has a secret that could ruin his family’s reputation and bring down the company if it were ever to get out. He’s a beta, borrowing the alpha pheromones of his adopted brother, Raz. With so much at stake, will he be able to accept his illicit desires to keep this arrangement?

(Source: Tapas)

On a devastated Earth, the remnants of humanity dwell within the suffocating depths of underground bunkers, desperately preparing for a mass migration to a parallel universe. Su-Bin, a dedicated warp researcher, finds his only solace in his lover, Ki-Hyeok. Upon returning from a perilous surface expedition, Ki-Hyeok presents him with an impossible gift: a living, blooming violet. "It’s a miracle, Su-Bin! The Earth might finally be breathing again!" he exclaims, his eyes shining with newfound hope. It is Ki-Hyeok’s vibrant stories of the outside world that sustain Su-Bin’s spirit in the dim, gray halls of the bunker; for Su-Bin, this man is his solitary light and his only source of true happiness in a dying world. 

However, his fragile peace is shattered when Ki-Hyeok’s fellow soldiers arrive at the laboratory with grim expressions. They deliver a bolt from the blue—news so devastating it threatens to unravel everything Su-Bin believed about their future and his lover's survival.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Tim Owelly always showed an interest in the occult, though nothing he's ever reported on as an occult blogger has convinced him the supernatural actually exists. But when strange and paranormal reactions to the horror movie star Johnathan McStars begin bubbling up online, Tim's curiosity gets the better of him and sends him down a disastrous road towards the truth.

(Source: Tapas)

Hee-seo was on the fast track to success - until her luck took a sudden nosedive. Her shaman grandmother insists it’s because her yin energy is too strong, and the only cure is to find a man with powerful yang energy to balance it out. Hee-seo laughs off the superstitious advice…until the night she meets Gong Tae-su, the charismatic head of the planning team whose energy feels almost dangerously magnetic. One unexpected encounter later, her world starts to spin out of control - along with her heart. Maybe Grandma was right, after all…

(Source: Lezhin US)

After years of grueling study and a job that left her scarred by endless complaints, Iseo retreats to Apricot Hill for peace. There, she reunites with her first love, Hyuk — changed yet familiar. Amid blossoms and quiet hills, could her weary heart find healing and love again?

(Source: Manta)

Nine years with my girlfriend and counting... (?) Is she the one for me? Or...

(Source: Toomics)

When nobleman Lee Jung gets kicked out for defying his father's orders, he wanders until he meets the orphan Kwon Chan-Soo. Bewitched by Chan-Soo's resemblance to his first love, Jung finds himself drawn into Chan-Soo's world. But there's more to this orphan than meets the eye, and Jung is intrigued by the mysteries of it all. Will Jung figure out what he truly wants from life, or will Chan-Soo's many secrets trap him in a situation he can't escape from?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sian Lee is fated to die in May, the same month her family was massacred. As the curse draws near, a dangerous man named Gon Tae offers to save her. "Say it," he whispers. "Tell me you want to live." In his obsession, all he asks in return is a promise to share life and death with him.

(Source: Manta)

Shin-Ah’s love life has been...hands-free ever since her boyfriend left. Her favorite toy? Reliable. Discreet. Perfect. Until one night, mid–happy time, a glowing portal appears, and out pops a strange man...with his “wand” still inside her. Turns out, Shin-Ah’s favorite toy was magically linked to Kai McGreen, a cocky sorcerer from another world who’s very familiar with the sensation. Now stuck in a fantasy realm with a possessive (and ridiculously attractive) magician who refuses to let her go, shy Shin-Ah is in for a wild, magical ride.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After leaving behind his past as a failed idol from Meteor Boys, Seok-Wu returns to university hoping for a fresh start. Unfortunately, his timing could not be worse…because rising star Yeo-Wun, a rookie actor with a glittering career, also reenrolls. Seok-Wu is used to the contrast in how people treat them, but when Yeo-Wun starts provoking him in ways that feel far too deliberate, irritation turns into wounded pride. Just how far does Yeo-Wun plan to trample on Seok-Wu’s dignity - and why does it feel so personal?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Plagued with splitting headaches, Ji-Min finds a doctor who diagnoses him with terrible news: he will die in three days unless he consumes someone else’s load. Ji-Min dismisses this as a quack doctor’s perverted scheme… until he wakes up to a mysterious screen counting down to his death. Seeing that the screen also states the same cure as the doctor did, Ji-Min decides to swallow the truth and the cure. Thus begins a series of steamy encounters that will save and change Ji-Min’s life entirely.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.*

For struggling idol Hana, a late-night variety show invitation feels like a golden opportunity. Sure, the program is infamous for its over-the-top content, but exposure is exposure... Right? With cameras and staff all around, what’s the worst that could happen? The answer comes fast and shocking. The hosts and fellow guests clearly didn’t get the memo about “professional boundaries.” Suddenly, the games and skits spiral into outrageous territory, the kind of risqué chaos no public broadcast should ever attempt. Hana can only stare in disbelief as the so-called “entertainment” blurs every line between performance and scandal. Is this still a variety show or some twisted after-hours experiment? And most importantly, are the cameras really rolling right now?!Between shock, embarrassment, and unintended hilarity, Hana is caught in the most unpredictable “broadcast” of her life. One thing’s certain: this is late-night TV like no one ever imagined.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eun-Ha is struggling to balance multiple jobs and drowning in debt when she runs into her ex. It's been years, but Won-Seo drops a bomb: the two never actually ended things. Eun-Ha is shaken by her words, but walks away. When eviction looms, Won-Seo offers a lifeline laced with history. Torn by pride and buried feelings, Eun-Ha takes the bait.

(Source: Manta)

Ji-in Yang is just an average otaku until a boy who looks exactly like her favorite anime character transfers to her class. Mireu Shin is overly friendly from the start, and she eats up the attention, much to the dismay of her longtime friend, Bongjun Choi, who begins expressing his feelings more openly. Even Dongsu Mun, her quiet academy comrade, wants to spend more time with her. To complicate things further, swimming sensation Hyeonu Gwon appears, acting like they’ve known each other for years. Suddenly, it feels like every guy in Ji-in’s life wants to keep her all to himself!

(Source: WEBTOON)

The son of a brave warrior is pursued by an elf princess and a dwarf princess, each determined to secure his seed as the key to ruling their world.

(Source: Toomics)

Cha Yun-Ho can’t shake the feeling that a suspicious man in sunglasses is following him, shameless eyes glued to his bodacious backside. Just as Yun-Ho tries to get away, the man suddenly makes an outrageous offer. He wants Yun-Ho to become the model for his brand. To Yun-Ho’s shock, the stranger turns out to be Kwon Wu-Hyeok, his first love from fourteen years ago. Before he knows it, Yun-Ho finds himself working at what might be the best job imaginable, spending all day with Wu-Hyeok. There’s just one problem: Wu-Hyeok’s brand’s clothing is a little short, tight, and triangular for Yun-Ho’s liking… 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Genius. Champion. National treasure. Nam Woo-Joon has always admired Seo Si-Won, but only from afar. That is, until the night he woke to find his idol on top of him, completely lost in pleasure. Now, as the heat between them rises, Woo-Joon’s learning the rules of a new game, and he’s playing to win.

(Source: Lezhin US)

When hardworking student Wan ends up covering his father’s job at a wealthy estate, a run-in with the sprinklers leaves him soaked — and catches the eye of Jung-Hoo, the ruthless heir who’s never been denied anything. One look, and Wan’s fate veers off course.

(Source: Manta)

When Hester, manager at Collateral, is left in charge after the owner's sudden disappearance, she learns the bar is a spy hangout and every patron is after intel on a mysterious fugitive named Jackal. Problem is, Hester's now forced to bluff her way through as dangerously suave spies flirt in for secrets she doesn't have — and her life's on the line.

(Source: Manta)

Eun-Seong Oh’s school life was smooth until she caught Yoon-Do Cha’s eye. To endure his attention, she tried befriending him. Yoon-Do had everything yet felt nothing—until Eun-Seong. Maybe it was never friendship at all, but love from the start.

(Source: Manta)

The war around the Curtains at the center of the world came to a close. But war was not the only thing left after the Curtains fell. Those who pursue the Curtains, those who seek to raise them, those who wield special powers, living weapons of war, those who disturb the peace, those who bring hope, those who face the lives they’ve lived, and those who try to revive the corpses in the coffin on their backs. We call them Actors.

(Source: WEBTOON)

To avenge the murder of her sister, Theadora Calyx goes to war with Dorzen, a rival empire. But when a divine error kills Theadora, she awakens to find her sworn enemy, Theodore Dorzen, smitten with her, and her sister still alive! With a new divine power to stop time, can Theadora rewrite history?

(Source: Manta)

At the Royal Academy of Magic, Lariet Blackwood has it all. She has a brilliant mind, flawless looks, and unmatched magical skill. Her only flaw is Demian Dominique, her infuriating rival. One day, the two fall victim to the wicked scheme of a creature called Lustmouth and find themselves trapped inside a mysterious labyrinth with a deadly mission to complete. If they fail to carry it out, they die. Thus begins a dangerous game that tests their lives, their love, and their deepest desires.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Detective Park Do-Hyeon is a towering force of nature, known for his fiery temper and reckless determination to close cases fast. But his habit of throwing himself into danger without a second thought lands him in the hospital once again. Rushing to his side is fellow detective - and lover - Lee Seung-Woo, Do-Hyeon’s complete opposite in both temperament and approach. Exhausted from watching Do-Hyeon get hurt time after time, Seung-Woo finally reaches his limit and breaks things off. Can Do-Hyeon win back the heart of the man who’s always been his anchor?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sol, a college student, returns home for the first time in three years, only to find her mother Mi-ae living with a young guy named Romi Oh. At first, she thinks he’s Mi-ae’s boyfriend, but it turns out they’re just housemates. Sol somehow ends up living with them, although she doesn’t like Romi at all. She believes he’s too brazen and carefree. However, in time, she finds herself inexplicably drawn to him…

(Source: WEBTOON)

For the past 13 years, Lucia has harbored a not-so-secret crush on her childhood friend, Herwyn. After 99 rejected confessions, she’s determined to move on. But just as she prepares to accept her arranged engagement, fate takes an unexpected turn. When jealousy flares and hearts collide, Herwyn and Lucia are about to find out they’re not done with each other yet. They say third time’s the charm, but could this final chance be the one that changes everything?

(Source: Tapas)

Shyla accepts an arranged marriage to escape her father and travels to the North, only to find that her legendary Black Wolf husband is a prickly little pup who can't even take human form! With Calleon intent on chasing her away, Shyla must stand her ground to achieve her goal of becoming the duchess.

(Source: Manta)

While filming a TV animal program about feral dogs tearing up an apartment complex’s trash area, the crew stumbles upon a mysterious man living among them…who just so happens to be the boss of a gang of loan sharks. With no one able to train the man-beast, he is brought to Lee Ji-Ryong: star dog trainer in a heap of debt. In exchange for bringing their boss back to form, the sharks promise to eliminate all of his debt. Jumping at the opportunity, Ji-Ryong takes it on…only to find out that this wild “canine” companion has both bite and bark alike.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Rigid and blunt college student Kwon Jeong-Ha can’t stand Gwak Hyeon-Wu, a handsome, popular classmate who casually toyed with the senior Jeong-Ha secretly loved. The two clash every time they meet… until Jeong-Ha picks up a mysterious necklace and their relationship flips overnight. Claiming he’s a demon, Hyeon-Wu reveals that all the magic he’d stored in the necklace has been absorbed by Jeong-Ha. To make matters worse, Jeongha will die unless it’s returned. But the only way to transfer the magic back? Physical contact. Forced into an uneasy cohabitation with a demon he despises, Jeong-Ha’s quiet life quickly descends into chaos. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Lionel, raised in a violent and suffocating home, finds his first real affection when he meets Arthur, an immortal merman living in human form within an old castle. But Lionel’s family is obsessed with a legend that promises eternal life through the body of a merman, and they set their sights on Arthur. Torn between love and the chains of his family, Lionel must decide whom he will protect. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*"Everything you see and hear here must be kept a secret."*

Chi-Seong receives an offer to handle chores at a billionaire's secret pool party. He heads to the vacation house, hoping to build connections with the elite. But he soon gets caught up in some trouble as he encounters a series of unexpected events and temptations.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

display_title: Odd Relations: An Eye for an Eye
description:
After their troubled teen years together, Won-Seo thinks he'll never see his adopted brother, Joo-Hyeon, again. So his life is thrown off balance when Joo-Hyeon suddenly returns to Korea as an adult and shows up at Won-Seo's door. Not only does he act suspiciously playful around Won-Seo, but he even seduces him on his first day back, triggering Won-Seo's repressed feelings of lust and obsession. Even as their bodies mix, there's a question lingering in the air: What could Joo-Hyeon want with Won-Seo after all these years?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

Veteran actor Cha Jae-Hwan has built his career on discipline and perfection. So when a close director friend asks him to star in the historical film Ja-Hwa, he expects a challenge, but not this one. At the first script reading, Jae-Hwan meets his co-star, Shin Seong-Hyeon, a rookie actor with raw potential but zero polish. His delivery is flat, his timing off, and his presence all over the place. For someone like Jae-Hwan, who breathes precision, it’s unbearable. Yet instead of walking away, he finds himself guiding Seong-Hyeon, patiently at first, then with a curiosity he can’t quite name.

“Shin Seong-Hyeon is an invasive species,” the director jokes. “You can’t control him. You just have to let him adapt.” 

But as rehearsals blur into something far more intimate, Jae-Hwan begins to wonder who’s really changing whom…

The performance, it turns out, isn’t just on camera.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

display_title: This is What First Love Is Like, Your Majesty
description:
Once cursed to never love, Crown Prince Kalart stuns the royal ball by declaring his love… for a hefty black cat that looks more suited to a back alley than a palace. Determined to win the cat’s affection, he brings its seemingly ordinary owner, Roserikta, into the royal palace. But appearances can be deceiving—Roserikta is clearly hiding something… something magical. Thus begins a whimsical romance between a cursed prince, a mysterious woman, and one unforgettable feline.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Sung-Bin, a serial philanderer and public enemy number one of the male students at his university, is confessed to by Ju-Won, a gloomy young man who has recently returned from a leave of absence. Sung-Bin initially plays along to sate his boredom, but things start to develop in a way he doesn't expect.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Enemy I Met at My Engagement
description:
Two legendary sword clans are lifelong rivals. A former detective is reborn as the treasured daughter of one clan, only to be betrothed to the heir of the other to force a truce. At the engagement she meets someone tied to her past life, and the rival remembers that past as well. Jealousy from powerful allies turns the political match into a perilous, slow-burn enemies-to-lovers game.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68099894), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%9B%90%EC%88%98%EB%8A%94-%EC%95%BD%ED%98%BC%EC%8B%9D%EC%9E%A5%EC%97%90%EC%84%9C-%EB%A7%8C%EB%82%9C%EB%8B%A4/4721) 

**Official Translations:**    
[B.Portuguese](https://br.comikey.com/comics/meu-noivo-e-meu-arqui-inimigo-webtoon/949/), [Japanese](https://mechacomic.jp/books/251600), [French](https://www.webtoons.com/fr/romance/i-met-my-enemy-at-the-engagement-party/list?title_no=9913)

After being kidnapped, Class A Omega Yeon-Weo is rescued by Kang-Woon Joo, a Class A Alpha and CEO of Cheonsang Group. However, she's also attracted the interest of another Class A Alpha, Shin-Woo Lee. Now caught between the two Alphas of the Cheonsang Group, what fate awaits Yeon-Seo?

(Source: Manta)

When Tae-Yul moves to a quiet new town, strange things start happening — a bus drives itself, food is served in a restaurant with no staff, and the sky changes color with the flicker of a streetlight. And each time, a mysterious man chides and saves him before disappearing. But who, or what, could he be?

(Source: Manta)

The story of Yun-Ji, an innocent new teacher at Charlene Prep Academy. She wanted nothing more than to be kind and respectable. But before she knew it, she became the object of their darkest desires, and now she craves it too.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

After living the same life 12 times, Joo Gong-Hyuk has perfected the method for conquering the Tower of Babel. His only problem is that no matter how many times he climbs it, he is unable to stop the destruction of the world. But not this time! His 13th return is going to be his last, and he'll stop at nothing to save his friends and stop the apocalypse. Will his knowledge from climbing the tower 12 times be enough? Or will Gong-Hyuk be forced to watch as the world meets its end once again?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

In a world of superpowered heroes and villains, villain Peridot and hero Jackal strike a deal: Peridot pretends to be Jackal’s puppet in public to help boost his rank, and in return, Jackal shelters him. But Jackal’s growing obsession hints at a shared, hidden past…

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

display_title: Ladies at Her Service: Giving You My All
description:
Hershe is a brave hero who saves Princess Mel when she's kidnapped and taken to the demon world. Once the king assigns Hershe to Mel as her bodyguard, they fall in love. But because their kingdom is weak, Mel is fated to be married off to a powerful emperor and treated like a hostage. So Hershe sets out on the king's orders to bring back the demon king's sword and bolster the kingdom's military power. Although Hershe is determined to save Mel, can she thwart the demon king's mind games that try to use her desires against her?.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.*

Money can’t buy happiness, but without it, you’re a slave to poverty.

(Source: Toomics)

The woman I love, the one I’ve cherished above all others, is being taken by another man right before my eyes! My heart should be breaking, and my blood should be boiling with righteous fury at the sight of her in someone else’s arms. But as I watch from the shadows, a chilling realization begins to sink in, freezing the air in my lungs. Something is horribly, inexplicably wrong with this picture. Why does it look like she’s enjoying this? In fact, she seems more than just willing... She looks more captivated and thrilled than she ever was with me! Welcome to a world where conventional romance is turned inside out. This is a curated collection of fantasy short stories designed specifically for readers with "unique" and provocative tastes. Explore the blurry lines between betrayal, obsession, and unexpected pleasure in these daring tales.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Just one bottle of magical pills can turn you into an irresistibly attractive new version of yourself. But beware — it comes with a dark price...

(Source: Toomics)

It all begins with a meteor shower. Soon after, reports spread of so-called Immortals. Each time they die, their bodies reset to an earlier point in time, with every wound, scar, and even the smallest scratch gone. Humanity is thrown into chaos, unable to explain the strange phenomenon. Two hundred years later, scientists still haven't been able to uncover the mystery of immortality. The Immortals now live in hiding: hunted, captured, and exploited as test subjects. They are forced to live, unable to die. Then, a rumor begins to spread of a man known only as the Undertaker— the one who can kill the Immortals.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A-Yoon Kang hadn’t planned to stay at StreamTech for this long, and now they’re being bought out. With only three months to go until she can cash out, she decides to stay and help the incoming CEO. But now that she knows her new boss is none other than Soo-Hyeok Cha—the man she left waiting at the altar four years ago—she’s having second thoughts. Was four years enough time for him to move on? Can she keep the reason why a secret that much longer? Or will their past prove too much to leave behind?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Vivian, the daughter of Duke Karlsruhe, uses her influence to have her lover, the illegitimate fifth prince Alex, crowned emperor. But happiness soon turns to despair when Alex takes a mistress and has Vivian imprisoned. Driven to hopelessness, Vivian ends her life—only to awaken on the day of her wedding to Alex, this time with a burning thirst for revenge.

(Source: Manta)

Kwon Jiwu is a top actor blessed with perfect looks and talent, but there’s one strange problem: every male animal seems to be in love with him. After yet another chaotic day on set fending off animal admirers, he’s ready to snap when his cheeky junior co-star Ju Yeongwon starts picking a fight. Just as Jiwu is about to put him in his place, something catches his eye. Cat ears? Wait a second, was Yeongwon one of those “male animals” all along?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kim Gyo-Joo is a cult leader, a scammer, and a man who likes his money easy and his work easier. But one day, a bizarre quest is dropped on him by the heavens: get ravaged by ten of his own believers in three days or die. He has no interest in men, but he has even less interest in dying. Now he’s bargaining, scheming, and gritting his teeth for the most humiliating survival mission of his life.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.*

Yoo Hae-Young was a child star with a bright future, but now, at 29, he just drifts through life. However, everything changes when the famous actor Jung Yeo-Woon asks Hae-Young to be his manager and even suggests that they live together! Though Hae-Young has spent his life avoiding the spotlight due to his past successes, he accepts the job and things seem to go well until he catches Yeo-Woon touching himself. Now, Hae-Young can't get Yeo-Woon off his mind, and it doesn't help that they're together all day and night long. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

After quitting her high-pressure job, Seo-Ri returns home and reluctantly joins swimming lessons at her brother’s urging. There, she meets instructor Yu-Jeong — her brother’s friend, who instantly recognizes her as his first love. Under summer’s heat and rain, a heart-fluttering romance begins.

(Source: Manta)

Just before dying, Princess Lillyn learns her perfect twin sister had deceived her all her life. Shocked by the betrayal, she opens her eyes to find she’s returned to childhood. This time, she's determined not to repeat her fate—and with a talking bird warning of ruin, she must fight to stay alive. 

(Source: Manta)

A prince with no claim to the throne, Yi Tae-Rok lives a quiet life removed from power. At thirteen, he is entrusted with raising his nephew, Yi Nan-Yeong, a gentle boy with no talent for the sword and no expectations placed upon him. At first, Tae-Rok sees it only as duty. But Nan-Yeong grows up looking only at him. What begins as admiration slowly shifts into something deeper, something neither of them can easily name. Tae-Rok notices the change and chooses silence, drawing careful lines he refuses to cross. In the end, Nan-Yeong seeks clarity in the only way he can, by testing his feelings with another man. And Tae-Rok sees it. 

*“Then you become my scandal. And I become yours.”*

In a court bound by rules, blood, and reputation, their bond teeters on the edge of ruin, where desire threatens to turn into something neither can undo.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Get In My Bed, Supporting Male Leads!
description:
Sure, I was reborn as the villainess, but her life seemed like a hassle, so I chose peace. But even though I’m keeping my distance from the main plot, the sub male leads keep showing up on my doorstep. They all want the same thing: to share my bed! Whatever the reason, I don’t want to get involved… but how could I refuse?

(Source: Tapas)

On the surface, life flows through a series of mundane daily routines and ordinary social connections. Yet, beneath this veneer of normalcy lies a hidden world of unspoken desires and strictly forbidden emotions. What begins as a mere accident ignites an uncontrollable spark that quickly rages out of hand. The magnetic attraction between them, once a subtle pull, now spirals into a deeper, more intoxicating pursuit of pure pleasure. 

A single, misguided choice has birthed a taboo relationship that defies all social boundaries. As the stakes rise, the characters find themselves sinking further into a treacherous mire of ecstasy from which there is no escape. The path back to their former lives has been utterly severed, leaving them to drown in the very sensations they once feared. This is a story of the thin line between restraint and the point of no return.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ángel once served Enzo Lars, heir to the powerful Lars family, as a servant, but he's now an esper and Enzo is his guide. From the very beginning, Enzo is outlandishly demanding. He wants something personal, intimate, and far beyond protocol. Twisted feelings that should’ve stayed in the past begin to surface again, fueled by power, obsession, and secrets. Behind Enzo’s calculated arrogance lies a dangerous longing, capturing Ángel in a bond he never agreed to and may not be able to escape.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After another soul-crushing day at the office, Chae-Su wakes up inside the world of Campfire Friends, a cartoon he used to watch as a child. As he spends more time with his colorful woodland pals every night, he begins to regain his lost childhood innocence. But behind their cheery kindness hides a chilling secret...

(Source: WEBTOON)

If only progressing in life were as easy as leveling up in a game. That’s what happened to James, a game developer who thought his life had hit rock bottom—until his creation began to blur the line between the game and reality.

(Source: Toomics)

One winter evening brings Se-Won and college senior Woo-Hyun together — and a night of passion leaves the omega with a secret child. Six years later, Woo-Hyun returns, unaware of the truth. As old feelings resurface, Se-Won must protect his son... even if it means pushing away the alpha he never forgot.

(Source: Manta)

Se-I Lim spends time with her mother, Hye-Jeong, at Taeseung Mall, where they meet Myeong-Hyeon, the mall’s CEO. Myeong-Hyeon asks Se-I to tutor her son, Seung-Hyo. However, Se-I accidentally walks in on Seung-Ju, Seung-Hyo’s older brother, naked. Seung-Ju accuses Se-I of being a pervert, but Myeong-Hyeon doesn’t believe him. Seung-Ju insists Se-I is the only one who has seen him naked, and Myeong-Hyeon, confused, wonders if Seung-Ju might be gay. Concerned, Myeong-Hyeon asks Se-I to investigate Seung-Ju for three months. Will Se-I uncover the truth?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Once tormented, a man returns rich and powerful to destroy his teacher—using her own daughter.

(Source: Toomics)

A broke, exhausted Jin-Yeon accepts a secret role — becoming the double of a dead woman who looks just like her for a man who refuses to move on. What starts as a temporary performance soon turns into addictive illusion... But when love is built on a lie, how long can it survive?

(Source: Manta)

One week before Laurea’s wedding, her fiancé disappears. So she marries his brother instead — a former monk sworn to God, now bound to her bed. What begins as a contractual marriage descends into nightly temptation... until Laurea learns how thoroughly her husband has forsaken his vows.

(Source: Manta)

Welcome to the modern era, where someone’s life can be ruined over a malicious online rumor. Armies of trolls known as Cyber Wreckers gleefully tear apart every part of their victim’s existence for views, while Drivers stand ready IRL to steer the latest topic of online gossip to the Wrecker’s liking. When 17-year-old K-pop idol Ari Lee becomes the latest victim, it falls to her older brother Ajin to take revenge against those who drove her over the edge; a task that seems impossible until he meets a mysterious girl named Seol…

(Source: WEBTOON)

Joo-Yeon calls off her engagement and is taking back her wedding invitations at work when her ex-boyfriend, Yoo-Hyeon, strolls in and introduces himself as the new director. As if this situation isn't mortifying enough, he tells her no other woman could get him aroused ever since she dumped him and that she should take responsibility. Despite his crude proposal, Joo-Yeon can't help being drawn to her first love and recalling their happy memories together the more their bodies mix. She knows the obstacles that caused their breakup are still there, but could the second time be the charm?

(Source: Tappytoon)

College freshman Da-in Kim enters Myeongmun University determined to craft the perfect campus life: top grades, meaningful friendships, and even a handsome boyfriend. However, her plans unravel quickly after meeting her stunningly beautiful namesake, Da-in Kang, and a reserved guy named Su-hyeon Cha. When Su-hyeon publicly rejects her in favor of the “prettier” Da-in, her carefully built vision begins to collapse. Surrounded by students chasing their own ideal selves, can Da-in figure out what perfection really means?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Late at night in a secluded park, Ha Do-eon and Ahn Sae-Byeok move through an intimacy so natural it feels almost unreal. To anyone watching, they are the picture of a flawless couple: effortless, synchronized, complete. But their story didn’t begin there. Three years earlier, a chance encounter drew them together, setting the stage for a relationship that only seems perfect on the surface…

(Source: Lezhin US)

While decoding an ancient manuscript, two hunters fall under a suspicious curse, and there’s only one way to break it — a true union of bodies. Will the stoic, eccentric Ha-Rim and the dapper yet inexperienced Do-Yoon succeed in this awkward and intimate operation?

(Source: Manta)

After the fall of the Kingdom of Solaris to the Demon King Zermes, a princess and her queen mother are captured and branded with a cursed Pleasure Mark. To protect her daughter, the queen embraces corruption, while the princess loses her last hope. And day by day, both are broken down and forced to submit to the Demon King's pleasure.

(Source: TOPTOON)

Delivery driver Kang Han-Gil has spent every waking moment trying to save his father, who has turned into a zombie. Poverty and exhaustion weigh on him, but he refuses to give up. Then someone from his past reappears, Shin Mi-Dum, a man Han-Gil hoped never to see again. Calling himself a “zombie caretaker,” Mi-Dum claims he can cure Han-Gil’s father with a new experimental drug. But there is a price, and his demand is unsettlingly simple, he wants Han-Gil in his bed. Before Han-Gil can decide whether to accept, disaster strikes. His zombified father escapes, the apartment complex collapses into chaos, and the entire building becomes a nest of the undead. Trapped together, Han-Gil and Mi-Dum have no choice but to rely on each other. 

With personal grudges simmering and survival on the line, can these two men escape the nightmare closing in on all sides, or will the past consume them before the zombies do?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Raya Famiira, princess of a small kingdom conquered by the Sultan. In reality, she is a modern doctoral candidate who was writing her thesis on Arabian Nights when she suddenly awakens inside the very tale she was studying. Being reborn as a princess should have been a stroke of luck. Instead, within three days of her possession, she is taken captive as a prisoner of war, thrust into the role of a doomed heroine fated for tragedy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Do or Die: How the Madam Awakens
description:
When her husband passes away, So-Jin is left behind as a young widow with her prestigious in-laws. Pressured into maintaining her chastity, So-Jin lives a quiet life as a loyal daughter-in-law. That is, until she wakes up to a mysterious warning that she will die if she does not make sexual contact with the household’s newest farmhand, Woong-Sae. Left with a shameful mark on her forehead that proves this warning to be true, she takes action to save herself. Little does she know that Woong-Sae will awaken a whole new part of her along the way…

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.*

Da-in never expected to reunite with her first love, Seojun, under such bizarre circumstances. Claiming that marriage is the only way to escape his supposed fated death, Seojun proposes a 100-day contract marriage. Refusing to be at a disadvantage, Da-in negotiates her own terms and plunges into an unconventional newlywed life. What starts as a calculated agreement slowly unravels into something deeper, as unresolved feelings resurface and the countdown to day 100 threatens to change everything.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yang Gi-Dam, a freshman at Soleum College, has always been fascinated by and drawn to the occult. It is only natural, then, that he finds himself joining the on-campus Ghost Story Club. Unbeknownst to him, however, his involvement in such activities has already been noticed by Seo Neul-Ham, an upperclassman with a cold aura who can see ghosts. One day, as if by fate, the two become entangled and are drawn into a spooky turn of events. How will this unlikely pair fare when the ghost stories that Yang Gi-Dam so enjoys are no longer just tales?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After her mother’s remarriage, Lee Hyeon-ah gains a new stepfather, Cha Kangjun: young, composed, and unsettlingly perfect. Though they share no blood ties and Hyeon-ah is already an adult, Kangjun’s attention toward her grows increasingly intense after the wedding. When her ailing mother leaves overseas for treatment, the house becomes a sealed world of watchful silences, unspoken threats, and boundaries that erode one by one. Trapped between fear, dependence, and a pull she doesn’t fully understand, Hyeon-ah must confront how far obsession can go when love, power, and secrecy twist into something dangerous.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Don’t Be Obsessed, Let’s Get a Divorce!
description:
Edelis Brill, the beloved only daughter of a countess, sees herself stabbed to death by the emperor's sword in a book she discovers in her study. Seeking to change her fate, Edelis rescues the book's sole main character, the slave gladiator Lehan, and pours her endless affection into him. But! Lehan, whom she believed would protect her from the emperor's blade, has returned as the emperor, intent on her heart?! Edelis tries to escape, but Lehan's obsession grows ever stronger...

Stop obsessing, divorce me!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Maria, Empress of Rastonia, is betrayed by her husband Emperor Henry after his mistress gives birth to a son. King Helland the Great, ruler of a neighboring kingdom, takes her as collateral so that Henry can have one more year to repay a considerable debt. King Helland is actually Gunther Preisley, a former slave for Maria’s family. He has loved her a decade and is determined to woo her. Meanwhile, back in Rastonia, two different women vie to replace her as Empress. Will Maria survive the year so that she can avenge herself, and will Gunther win her heart?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Byeong-Gwan, who hates being bored, got a job in the security department of a college and started peeping girls through CCTV. One day, he sees a cowardly girl getting naked in public.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

What started as a blind date takes a dark turn when Hayes finds out his date is a mob boss. Now, he’s trapped in a dangerous relationship he can’t escape.

(Source: Toomics)

Raised in darkness, Ji-An learned early that giving up was the only way to stay alive. Then Hwan arrives: bright, irresistible, and dangerously easy to love. Their relationship feels inevitable, intoxicating, and fleetingly perfect. Until everything falls apart when Hwan takes Ji-An’s place in a hit-and-run accident. Desperate, Ji-An rushes to the hospital, only to be met with unfamiliar eyes and a cruel voice.

*“You smell like an omega. It’s disgusting.”*

(Source: Lezhin US)

To the world, Ivan Park is an impeccable CEO. To Ye-Geon, he is everything. The devoted secretary hides his all-consuming obsession behind quiet professionalism. But when a rival appears to steal Ivan's attention, jealousy drives Ye-Geon to dangerous extremes. Passion, power, and desire collide in a love that cannot stay hidden, leaving Ivan to question whether Ye-Geon's devotion is salvation or ruin.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.*

After being cast out of the royal palace, three court ladies find themselves at the mercy of the streets. With nowhere left to turn, they seek refuge at a high-end brothel run by the legendary former courtesan, Seo Hakgeum. Among them, Yeoni and Solmae immediately draw every eye in the house, not just for their beauty, but for their untouched innocence. While the shy Yeoni hesitates, Solmae decides to embrace their new reality, awakening to her own desires as she takes the lead. In a world where beauty is currency, these former palace flowers must learn to bloom in the dark.

(Source: Lezhin US)

One dive shattered To-il’s future. Once a rising star on the 10-meter platform, a brutal fall forced him into eighteen months of recovery. Now he returns to the pool, where rivals have surged ahead and every leap carries the shadow of his past. Along the way, he discovers teammates who lift him up, rivals who test his limits, and the fragile but unyielding hope of youth. In the air, seconds feel eternal. Will To-il soar again or will the water claim him once more?

(Source: WEBTOON)
