There is a land where elves and wizards roam, where warriors and demon kings clash for the fate of the world—and the name of this fantastical land is none other than… Seoul, South Korea?! Sent by magic from his fantasy world to modern Seoul along with his party of colorful heroes, will former warrior and very ordinary student Hui-Won be able to gather his party and save it from the “evils” of the Demon King?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Crushed by academic pressure, ambitious Han-Eul treats her fleeting moments with the floundering Mir as an escape... until she walks away without looking back. Years later, he returns an Olympic gold medalist and she comes back desperate, dreams dashed. When ambition, regret, and desire collide, who truly holds the power?

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Do or Die: Girls Get Along Great
description:
When Pat-Ji discovers that her new stepfather is cheating on her mother, she develops a secret loathing for both him and his biological daughter, Kong-Ji. Unfortunately, as a red-blooded lesbian, Pat-Ji also feels a strong attraction to her stepsister. Driven by both hatred and desire, Pat-Ji ends up harassing Kong-Ji despite the latter’s efforts to form a friendly bond between them. Perhaps that’s why karma comes for her hard in the form of a mysterious warning: Pat-Ji will die in 3 days… unless she has sex with a man.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.*

I never knew the weight of the words "I'll protect you." I hated the fact my father said he'd protect us but left. I despised those words. But I never knew I'd be saying the same thing, to none other than the daughter of the jerk who killed my dad.

(Source: TOPTOON)

Woo Eun-Jo is an airport employee who’s secretly sleeping with the hottest and youngest plane captain, Ki Su-Ho. Eun-Jo is convinced their friends-with-benefits arrangement won’t ever become something more, but Su-Ho’s sweet gestures make it impossible to keep his feelings from growing. It doesn’t help that Su-Ho feels anxious himself at Eun-Jo’s constant mixed signals and actually wishes their relationship could take off as well. Buckle up, as this romantic flight will be experiencing A LOT of turbulence!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Despite repeated attempts, the young King Si-Hyun and Queen So-Young struggle to conceive a child as Si-Hyun seeks to strengthen his position. Under pressure to take a concubine by the Queen Dowager, they try once again. But a perfumed sachet given to So-Young unknowingly ignites the normally cold Si-Hyun's buried desire.

(Source: Manta)

For fourteen years, Yi-Hyun Han has hidden her love for her childhood friend, Yu-Jin Jo. But when the two suddenly end up living together, Yi-Hyun is forced to confront her buried feelings for him — feelings that soon take a sensual turn. With Yu-Jin harboring sparks of his own, will their friendship finally ignite into romance?

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The Ghostly Grind at Cuvershaiden Manor
description:
Laura Highen needs a way to support her siblings and hears that House Cuvershaiden is hiring... except that the manor is haunted! Tempted by Duke Cuvershaiden's lucrative offer, Laura takes the job anyway. Who knows, with her ability to see ghosts, perhaps she can be of service!

(Source: Manta)

display_title: To You Who Will Ruin Me
description:
Unloved and unemployed, Laeyeon's only joy in life is the mobile game "Salvation." After spending all hours playing the game, her body gives out. When she comes to, she's now Irel, a character in "Salvation." As Irel, she can now enjoy things she never had: beauty, wealth, privilege, but most of all, unconditional love from her family. However, Irel is aggressively pursued by Barkan, a cruel, and extremely violent man who asks for Irel’s hand in marriage. She knows that in the game, Irel’s family rejects Barkan’s offer to protect their daughter. This will lead to Barkan slaughtering Irel’s entire family. Now Irel must do whatever it takes to change the narrative.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Dearest Fiancé, I Know You Despise Me
description:
When they were first engaged, Janet and Rihanel were in love. However, after Janet’s three years in prison for burning down the chapel that Rihanel grew up in, their engagement is nothing more than a sham they keep up for financial reasons. Eventually, Rihanel says he will marry Janet on one condition: she will allow him to injure her ten times. Rihanel actually has the ability to see a person’s memories by touching their blood, and he wishes to seek out the secrets that run in Janet’s veins, including whether she truly loves him. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: This work was pre-released in English before releasing in Korean.*

After years of being pushed around by his so-called friends, Jeff hatches a bold plan to hit back where it hurts most.

(Source: Toomics)

Eun-gil Gong’s used to seeing her name in the news. As volleyball’s problem child, she’s seen it all, but the world discussing her upcoming marriage to Hahyeon Seo, eldest son of JaeKyung and owner of her former team, is another matter... Especially since Hahyeon only offered the contract marriage to clean up the rumors about Mina—his sister and Eun-gil’s only fan—being gay. Between the money and helping Mina, it was easy to accept, but one question remains: What’s he getting out of this? 

(Source: Tapas)

Obsessed lab hermit Han Woojin has a scandalous secret: his passion for science is literal. When he hits a breakthrough, his body reacts with an uncontrollable, physical intensity that has earned him the nickname Mad Woojin. Driven by cold logic, he treks to Deokmu Mountain to debunk rumors of a gold-granting goblin. Instead, he finds Baekbaek, a breathtaking god of wealth. Forget the gold, Woojin has found the ultimate specimen...and he’s ready to experiment until they both reach their limit.

(Source: Lezhin US)

On the island he arrives at to find his younger brother, he is tempted by women of a suspicious cult.

(Source: DAYcomics)

One day, the protagonist wakes up in the body of Charlotte, a gentle healer living in a world of magic and nobility. Her new life seems peaceful, until she discovers that Charlotte had just accepted a suspicious commission: to create a love potion. The problem? Charlotte isn’t a witch, just a misunderstood herbalist mistaken for one. And before she can figure out who requested the potion, the Crown Prince himself shows up at her door. Convinced he’s the mysterious client, Charlotte panics. If she refuses now, she might lose her head for disobedience! So she decides to fake it till she makes it, brewing potions by instinct and stumbling into one awkward royal encounter after another. But the more she tries to survive, the more tangled her fate becomes with his.

*“Wait… isn’t this one of those classic romance clichés?”*

Apparently, it’s now her life.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*"It's adorable how you keep whimpering."*

She's the perfect office worker in the eyes of others, but to you, she's the queen bitch who nags you every day. One day, Si-U walks in on his boss masturbating in the bathroom.

*"You crazy bitch. You were nothing but a slut after all."*

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

Born an omega, Ha Ian lives a quiet life focused on modest goals and day-to-day survival. But his peace shatters when he reunites with Jeong Hyeon, a man tied to the sins of his past. Hyeon demands that Ian work as his secretary to repay an enormous debt, binding him once more to a fate he thought he had escaped. As the weight of guilt and old wounds resurfaces, Ian must face the question: can true atonement ever be found in the shadow of his past?

(Source: Lezhin US)

For years, Ju Seong-Min has lived in the shadow of his late father’s memory, treating the man’s legacy as his only gospel. But his isolated world is shattered when Baek Yo-Han, the stepbrother he hasn’t seen in years, suddenly reappears. But Yo-Han doesn’t come seeking a family reunion; he comes bearing ugly truths that threaten to dismantle everything Seong-Min believed about his father. As the cracks in his reality widen, Seong-Min finds himself trapped in a house with a man who hates him as much as he desires him. In this house of sins, the only thing more dangerous than the truth is the person telling it.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jihun, once part of an elite secret special forces unit, returns from overseas duty to the devastating news of his sister Jiyun’s death. Her boyfriend Minjun is blamed, but Jihun soon learns Minjun entered Yeokseon Prison under a false charge to uncover the real killer. When Minjun is found dead inside the prison, Jihun refuses to accept the official story. Taking on the role of a correctional officer, he infiltrates the prison to expose the truth behind both murders—and the hidden forces controlling the facility.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Spring is in the air, the flowers are blooming…and the freshmen are thirsting. It’s the start of the semester, and everyone’s dreaming of the perfect campus life. But college isn’t all sunshine and cherry blossoms. It’s also packed with scandalous hookups, secret flings, and outrageous rumors that spread faster than midterm anxiety. From the library to the lecture halls, these tantilising tales are being whispered behind every closed dorm door. Want to find out what really goes down on campus?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Wolf of the Full Moon
description:
As the daughter of the premier of Joseon, Han Wolyeong had a happy life. That is, until her father's political enemies killed her clan and took her prisoner—enter Doheon, a mysterious god who saves her and confesses his love. Now, Wolyeong and Doheon are set to spend 30 nights of passion with each other to fulfill their destiny and get a wish from the heavens. But with Wolyeong's enemies still searching for her, is she truly safe? Or will her happiness be destroyed once more?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae(純愛) Danpyeonseon (순애(純愛) 단편선) Collection.*

Kangjin, an unremarkable idol, seizes the chance to star alongside A-list actor, Heegwon, in a cliché-ridden cop movie. Though they start off on the wrong foot, when Kangjin’s secret crush on a fellow group member is on the verge of being exposed, Kangjin is forced to beg Heegwon to pose as his lover. 

(Source: Manta)

Famous actor Kim Seong-Jae follows a suspicious man claiming to be his temporary manager, only to arrive at a remote village he escaped from at fifteen - the compound of a cult that once consumed his life. As Seong-Jae attempts to flee the place haunted by his past, a fatal mistake leaves the cult leader dead by his hand. Moments later, the followers arrive, forcing Seongjae into an irreversible decision to survive. Trapped on a stage where faith, violence, and performance blur, Seong-Jae realizes the man who led him here has been directing everything from the shadows. Once the cameras begin to roll, there is no cutting the scene short. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Terminal Teacher in the Doomed Duke's House
description:
Livia Plington is out of luck. Not only was her fortune stolen, but she's caught a fatal disease, and the only thing that can save her is the mysterious heirloom of House Mercedes. Livia's solution? Infiltrate Mercedes Manor as the young lord's private tutor and find the heirloom herself! But as Livia plays teacher, she comes to care for her student and even the tragic Duke Mercedes too. Can she heal the hearts of this family as well as heal herself? Or is this terminal teacher doomed to die?

(Source: Tapas)

Tragedy hits art genius Hyun-Sung Kwon in waves as his sponsors betray him and he falls into a slump. At risk of losing everything, he is forced to stop investigating his mother's scandal, only to realize his ex is the new beneficiary. Amidst the chaos, three men approach with ulterior motives...

(Source: Manta)

*"Does sex feel that good?"*

Amanda is a girl who is interested in sex. With the recommendation from her friend, she meets a guy through online chat. After having her first taste of a guy, her life becomes full of naughty days.

(Source: TOPTOON)

*"Stocks are basically the same as sex."*

A miraculous second chance at life is granted to Chan-Uk, once the king of Wall Street. So-Ra, who had bragged about her rookie stock skills in front of him, ends up losing everything she owns. Left with nothing, she offers the one last thing she has to the man she despised more than anyone.

*"H-Hey... would you... buy me?"*

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

How do you get over a guy you've been in love with forever? Yun Sehee decides the answer is asking him to date her, even if it's just for three months. The only problem? The guy is the cold, confident Kang Taewook, Sehee's boss! Unwilling to lose his top secretary, Taewook agrees to Sehee's unorthodox offer—with a plan to show her just how unlovable he is. Can Taewook make Sehee realize he isn't such a good catch? Or will he find himself falling for a girl who just wants to give him up for good?

(Source: Tapas)

To protect her brother, Hari enters the royal palace disguised as a eunuch. Despite her worries, life as a male court attendant turns out to be surprisingly peaceful. At least, until she is suddenly assigned to serve Prince Sohyeon, Lee Ryeong, known for his striking beauty and well known attraction to men, in his private chambers.

*“From now on, you will attend to the prince at night.”*

That very evening, Hari is ordered to help arouse the prince, a task she has no way of fulfilling. Her panic spirals, and in the chaos, her greatest fear comes true, her true identity as a woman is exposed.

*“You, you are a girl.”*

Now discovered in the most dangerous place possible, Hari must find a way to survive the palace, its secrets, and the gaze of the prince who holds her life in his hands.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seol-A’s boyfriend dumps her over text for a woman with better standing, and now they’re getting married. Seung-Hu Ji, the CEO, witnesses Seol-A berating her ex for it, but to her surprise, he reacts by taking her out to dinner after. After a drunken night in bed, she finds out she was his first, but could he be her last? Seol-A must now manage dating her company’s CEO and the blowback of Seung-Hu spurning other women over her, one of whom is now dying to ruin Seol-A's life.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: How to Melt an Iron Wall
description:
Cursed from childhood with the “Power of Iron,” Ianne can’t feel joy, pain, or love, until a sacred bracelet binds her to the fiery and dangerous Katharsid. To break the curse, she must confront emotions she’s never known, and the reluctant bond between them quickly sparks desire, jealousy, and secrets. In a world of sacred powers, mysterious attacks, and hidden agendas, Ianne and Katharsid must navigate their growing feelings… before their fates are decided by forces beyond their control.

(Source: Lezhin US)

They say you always meet your worst enemies at military reserve training. When Yong-Taek runs into Wu-Chang in the training center’s restroom, he tries to offer a sincere apology for their messy high school past. But Wu-Chang hasn't changed a bit, throwing insults and mocking Yong-Taek’s family until something finally snaps. Yong-Taek decides it’s time for a different kind of "discipline." He never hated Wu-Chang; he just realized that sometimes, the only way to show love is through a very firm, very hard lesson.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Influencer Ji-Han has been chasing his first love Do-Jin since high school, after Do-Jin suddenly vanished without a word. Now in college, a mysterious account that always likes his posts might be the clue that leads him back. In a world where love hides in likes and fate rewrites itself in DMs, can Ji-Han and Do-Jin finally hit "post" on their destiny ending?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A man’s hobby is sleeping with female employees and making them quit one by one. He targets a new woman in the office for the same game, but when an unpredictable, insane girl starts messing with his plans, things spiral out of control.

(Source: Toomics)

Build a powerful house and restore the proud heritage of the vampires! But first, some desserts and shopping! Anne wakes up from her sleep when Eden, the alchemist of time, removes the spear that had put her in a 200-year slumber. The world has changed greatly during that time. Humans have won the war of the races, made great technological advancements, and created a wonderful thing called ice cream. She must now venture through the world of humans with Eden to build a house worthy of her name.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ten years ago, on an unusually cold winter day, Do-Eon’s father brought home a young boy. Given the name Mi-Yi, the child became Do-Eon’s younger brother in name, though they shared no blood. At eighteen, Do-Eon begins to care for Mi-Yi out of simple compassion, gradually becoming his sole protector and the only safe place in his world. Sheltered behind Do-eon’s quiet devotion, Mi-Yi grows up clinging to him as his one constant. Seven years later, everything changes when Mi-Yi is involved in a shocking incident that leaves their father at the bottom of a staircase. Haunted by guilt and secrets he cannot yet reveal, Mi-Yi asks only one thing of Do-Eon: not to hate him when the truth finally comes out. 

A story of protection that turns into dependence, The One and Only explores how love, guilt, and obsession blur when someone becomes the only person you have left.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jae-eun has one very specific type: hot, fit, nerdy guys. Too bad they’re as rare as shooting stars. Three years deep into single life, she’s focused on her studies until her totally transformed ex Hui-jun and her ideal type in the flesh, Seonwu, both walk back into her life. With Seonwu’s built chest and flawless nerd vibes, Jae-eun is instantly drawn in. But Hui-jun won’t stop hanging around, and after one of his provocations, Jae-eun blurts out that she’s dating Seonwu right in front of him. Flustered, she braces for disaster, but Seonwu surprises her with a calm reply:

*"Didn't you say that because you have feelings for me too, Jae-eun?"*

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeo-Reum Lee, a university student, unexpectedly reunites with her first love, Su-Yeong Ji, and his fiancée, Han-Gyeong Bae, the owner of the café where she works. Their relationship began in high school when Yeo-Reum's mother worked as a housekeeper at Su-Yeong's family home. After years of heartbreak, they meet again, but this time, Su-Yeong unknowingly drinks a potion that makes him fall in love with Yeo-Reum. With the potion's effects lasting one year, will their love become real, or will it fade once the potion wears off?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Haunted by her mother's life as a mistress, Minkyeong carries only bitterness toward her father. She builds a fragile peace away from him, until a stranger named Jinhyeok enters her world. With calm but forceful resolve, he declares that wherever she runs, he will always find her. What begins in fear slowly becomes a dangerous comfort. However, on the day she offers him a birthday gift, the fragile boundary between them collapses. What follows after is not happiness, but a love steeped in destruction.

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: I Opened an Illegal Werebeast Hospital
description:
Reincarnating after a life of tragedy, Shana's ready to live her best life. As the only child to a doting Duke, how hard could it be? That is until the Crown Prince claims she's his... and a handsome werewolf says only she can heal his kind! Well, time for Shana to open her (illegal) Werebeast Hospital!

(Source: Manta)

*"Welcome to Another World. Exciting adventures with millions of other users await you!"*

Or at least, that's what Jiseok was promised when logging in. Instead, he finds himself alone with nothing but an ordinary shovel to fend off ferocious beasts, evil dragons, and... some dude in tighty-whities? Now, Jiseok's only got two choices - dig or die.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Three Men and the Torn Princess
description:
30-year-old virgin Hong Sera is invited to join the beta test of a mysterious game, “Imaginary Sex Kingdom.” Once she presses “Play,” she awakens as Princess Chloe, surrounded by three irresistible suitors—Lucas, Aiden, and Maverick. With beauty and grace, she captures each of their hearts, but the more she indulges in their affection, the harder it becomes to choose just one. Little does she know that in this kingdom of desire and temptation, even her wildest fantasies can come true…

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae(純愛) Danpyeonseon (순애(純愛) 단편선) Collection.*

Harriet's sister returns with her stolen fiancé, demanding to stay at the estate. Enter Lennock Diorne, her brother's infuriating best friend.

 *"You'll really let her win this easily?"*

His taunt sparks a reckless game of pretend. Is it pure revenge, or something far more dangerous?

(Source: Manta)

Bongseo and his mom's friend, Miran, a single mother, are instantly attracted to each other, and so begins their risky, clandestine affair.

(Source: Toomics)

Seo-Yeon has lived next door to Doha most of her life. They went from childhood friends to lovers, but Doha's betrayal made Seo-Yeon leave him. They're home from university, and Doha won't leave her alone. Seo-Yeon doesn't want to like him after all she went through, but can she stay strong?

(Source: Manta)

Jeong Hae-Deun, a former high school competitive swimmer, now lives a quiet life working at a local swim center. His world is upended when Han Si-O appears, spinning a desperate web of lies about a career-ending leg injury that supposedly prevents him from ever swimming again. Moved by pity and a shared history, Hae-Deun falls for the deception and allows Si-O to move into his home. 

However, Si-O’s motives are far from innocent. Having harbored a dark, obsessive crush on Hae-Deun for years, he views this cohabitation as the ultimate opportunity. Si-O relentlessly pushes boundaries, his subtle manipulations eventually giving way to raw, unfiltered lust. He no longer hides his true nature, whispering feverish, provocative desires to his senior: "I want to spend all day tangled with you, kissing you... I want to sink into you and fill your inside with nothing but me."

(Source: Lezhin US)

While out at a trendy cosplay bar with a friend, Si-Yun finds himself captivated by a striking bartender named Ara, who is sporting a pair of plush bunny ears. The night takes a chaotic turn when Si-Yun accidentally splashes a drink directly onto her headpiece. Flustered and desperate to make amends, he reaches out to help her remove the damp accessory, but as his fingers graze the fur, he freezes. The texture isn't synthetic! It’s warm, pulsing, and inexplicably real. 

Noticing his shock, Ara quickly pulls Si-Yun away from the thumping music and prying eyes to a secluded corner of the bar. After a heavy, hesitant silence, she finally lets her guard down. She reveals the soft, snow-white ears that are a part of her very being, whispering a confession that defies all logic: "The truth is... I’m actually a real bunny."

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The White Tiger Princess Is Safe
description:
From the moment Princess Juciellia Brianna Panterin was born, she was surrounded by expectations. As the first white tiger beastkin to be born in a hundred years, she is destined to save the world from destruction. Despite growing up adored by many, Juciellia struggles with her powers and fears she may not grow strong enough to protect her loved ones. With time slipping by and calamity drawing near, will the White Tiger Princess rise to meet the hopes of all before it’s too late?

(Source: Tapas)

Yeona and her three longtime friends have shared an unshakable bond for years, one so familiar it feels safe from romance. Believing none of them see her as a woman, she lets her guard down and falls asleep at Taehyeok’s place. But in the stillness of the night, a lingering touch awakens desires that have been carefully hidden, and a single moment of weakness begins to unravel their friendship into something far more dangerous and irresistibly tempting.

(Source: Lezhin US)

To protect her village, Chohee is offered as a human sacrifice to the feared Choneun Peak. But instead of death, she finds herself face-to-face with the infamous leader of a band of outlaws—rumored to be more beast than man. Yet the more time she spends in his shadow, the more his brutal reputation begins to crack. Who is the man behind the mask of the wolf—and why does he seem more protector than predator? In the deadly silence of the mountains, a dangerous bond begins to form.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

After her noble family falls to ruin, Stella Embrose does whatever she can to make ends meet. But her departure from high society only sparks rumors about her supposed messy relationships with men. These false rumors reach the ears of Duke Callian Rochester, Stella’s unrequited first love and her to-be husband under the emperor’s ploy to keep him in check. Believing Stella to be unworthy of him, Callian hands her a contract stating they will divorce in three years. Will this be enough time for Callian to be unblinded by his pride and see Stella for who she truly is?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Once celebrated as a gifted shaman, Kwon Hae-Eon has fallen far from grace. Having lost his divine power, he survives by scamming clients and pretending his abilities still exist. Then one night, Mun U-Jin, a devout Christian man possessed by an unknown entity, bursts into the shrine and jumps him. The moment their bodies intertwine, Hae-Eon’s long dormant spiritual power suddenly returns. Sensing an opportunity, Hae-Eon manipulates the unlucky, possession plagued U-Jin into staying at the shrine. Each night, using U-Jin’s body as a medium, he engages with the mysterious being inside him, restoring more of his stolen energy. But when morning comes, U-Jin remembers nothing. All he sees are the unmistakable remnants of intense, forbidden intimacy that occurred while he was unaware. For a man who has lived his life with strict faith and purity, the truth feels like a divine punishment.

 *“How much worse can my luck get, Lord? Why must I endure this torment?”*

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kian dreamed of building a new life with his girlfriend, but fate had other plans for him.

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: I, Villainess Priestess, Am Not Asking for Redemption
description:
Crown Prince Ian and Priestess Rebecca were once in love, but for his happiness, she let him go. Yet on his wedding day, Ian is poisoned and dies in her arms. In despair, Rebecca sacrifices everything: her love, her life, her dignity, and even time itself to save him. She succeeds, only to be branded a traitor and executed. But as death closes in, she awakens… three years in the past. Except this time, everything seems different. Will she be able to defy fate and protect the man she loves, or will destiny claim them both again?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Chef Shanchuan Lin has always admired top model Haiming Sen from afar — a bright, confident star completely out of his league. But after a sudden accident costs Shanchuan his job and leaves him drowning in debt, his world collapses overnight. That’s when Haiming steps in, offering a lifeline...and a sickeningly sweet “special part-time job” only Shanchuan can do...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

At Pinky Pop, an innovative adult toy company, the corporate culture is anything but ordinary. Every month, a "New Product Tester" is chosen by lottery to wear the company’s latest invention for a full week at the office. The prize for keeping it a secret? A fat bonus and paid vacation. When the chronically unlucky Nari draws the winning ticket, she thinks she can handle the heat. But when sharp-eyed Manager Seo catches onto her suspicious behavior, he offers a deal: he’ll keep her secret, provided she gives him a very private demonstration.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Reborn with memories she never asked for, Jian Song wants nothing more than a quiet, ordinary life. But everything changes when she meets him again—the man she once loved beyond reason, and the one who shattered her. No matter how hard she tries to stay away, fate keeps pulling them together in ways she never expected. As her new life begins to mirror the tragic patterns of her past, she must face one question: can she rewrite her story this time, or is she doomed to repeat it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Doh Min-Hyeok is living a nightmare disguised as a fantasy. Forced to play the role of a cold-blooded tyrant by a relentless System, he’s one skipped "brooding session" away from a death sentence. But the icy exterior starts to crack when he crosses paths with Lee Wu-Yeon. Wu-Yeon is the perfect "clumsy darling" trope, and more importantly, he’s a walking dead zone for the System’s influence. Min-Hyeok begins to pursue Wu-Heon with a desperate intensity, but as the lines between survival and genuine attraction blur, he has to wonder if he’s chasing a lifeline or a life sentence.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Shy and unpopular Da-Som Park rushes to meet her only friend, the beautiful and adored, Iseul Chae. Instead, she finds Iseul's dead body, or rather, its hollow shell. Da-Som enters it and takes over Iseul's seemingly perfect life. But as Dasom discovers horrific family secrets, she wonders where her friend went, and if it was an accident she ended up in Iseul's shell.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Dianna Brienne frees the abused slave of her estate, Guiscard Lodbrog, only for him to return years later as a vengeful king who repays her compassion with a cruel, humiliating marriage that ends in her tragic death. But fate grants a second chance. Thrown back in time to her twelfth birthday, Dianna must now protect the very boy destined to become her monster before his hatred toward his masters grows deadly. In this life, Dianna won’t be his victim. She will face her future tormentor head-on to rewrite their bloody ending and find a better future together.

(Source: Tappytoon)

One night, a mysterious viewer named “Santa” drops over ten million won on Sunny (real name Sun Ikyung) in a single stream. The shock is real, the thrill is undeniable… and the donor’s identity is a total mystery. What Sunny doesn’t know? Santa is no stranger. As the extravagant donations continue, and Santa’s teasing, suggestive requests get bolder, Sunny realizes he doesn’t mind the attention at all. Caught between three potential suitors and one very rich secret admirer, Sunny sets out to uncover the truth: Who is the “Santa” showering him with money, and...is he boyfriend material?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Steamy stories that might be true...or totally fake. Hooking up with your married friend? A wild foursome out of nowhere? Who hasn’t fantasized about something a little out there? New episodes every day to tease your curiosity—until the big reveal. Can you tell what's fact and what's pure fantasy? Take your best guess...if you dare.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After two years trapped in the dull rhythm of daily life, Heesu has grown numb—disconnected from herself and everything around her. But when she stumbles across a cryptic online ad offering a one-day BDSM roleplay experience, something stirs. Torn between fear and curiosity, she agrees to surrender control—if only for a day. What begins as a fleeting escape soon becomes a raw plunge into desire, power, and vulnerability. As boundaries blur, Heesu must confront not just the limits of pleasure, but the aching emptiness she's been running from.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeji lives alone in a run-down apartment complex, where every day feels the same—until she starts noticing the man next door. Her neighbor, a jobless middle-aged man, keeps mostly to himself, quiet and distant but oddly gentle. Their connection begins in small ways: sharing instant noodles, watching movies together, trading casual words that linger a little too long. He never gives her more than that, never a promise, never his heart, but Yeji can’t help being drawn in by his quiet warmth and the mystery behind his eyes. One evening, the air shifts. A glance lingers too long, a touch lasts too much, and Yeji finally blurts out,

*“You couldn’t take your eyes off me… and you touched me, didn’t you?”*

Between the thin walls of their lonely apartments, a subtle tension grows, half yearning, half hesitation, where comfort and desire slowly begin to blur. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yoon Hyunwoo is a pharmaceutical salesman with a secret craving. By day, a diligent office worker, by night, a dom... or so he wishes. Unfortunately, his girlfriend, Soojin, has no interest in BDSM. Worse yet, she’s his top client, so breaking up is out of the question. Frustrated and seeking release, Hyunwoo turns to an app to find a willing sub. What starts as harmless online flirting soon leads to a meeting—and the surprise of his life. His chat partner is none other than his cold, no-nonsense boss, Park Gaeun. As their late-night sessions grow more intense, the lines between dominance and submission, work and pleasure, begin to blur beyond control.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

Dal-Ho is a sex therapist. One day, his best friend asks him a favor to reignite his wife's sexual desire. So begins an intense, eye-opening therapy session for the couple's sex life...

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Kwon Su-Hyeon lives life one heat at a time. With no real plans and even fewer morals, this shameless omega uses his devilish charm to seduce rich alphas, then cashes out by “invoking his rights” under the Omega Protection Act. It’s an easy, sleazy hustle. But when his newest “victim,” Ryu Hyeon, reveals he’s an omega too, Su-Hyeon’s foolproof scam suddenly gets a lot more complicated.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After the fall of the Kingdom of Jarthewer, Princess Lisselotte and her maid, Hannah, escape to the Grand Duchy of Ralus, home of the princess’s fiancé, Vincent Ralus. Though Hannah has lost her memory after nearly drowning, she stays strong, enduring Lady Charlotte’s daily abuse in hopes of a better future. But everything changes when Vincent asks her to pose as Princess Lisselotte for the 10th-anniversary ceremony of the Jarthewer Republic. Returning means certain death both for her and the princess, but if they can pull off the deception, it may be their only chance at freedom. Stuck between the handsome but cold Vincent and his mischievous and buff guard, Diego, can Hannah succeed in her dangerous role?

(Source: WEBTOON)

A simple clerk and customer routine becomes a rhythm neither wants to lose. In-Ha’s concern becomes habit, and Jae-On waits for it like breath. Convinced a beta cannot draw an alpha’s eye, he uses a pill that mimics omega traits. Affection grows, but so does the strain of a bond built on pretense.

(Source: Manta)

Dying and desperate for real love, Louis steals Phil—a lover dupe bound for disposal—for one month together. But when Phil starts falling for him, their fake romance becomes dangerously real.

(Source: Manta)

Park Tae-Won never expected to fall in love with an alpha, let alone one twice divorced with a teenage son. But when tragedy strikes, Tae-Won finds himself alone with that son, Ahn Sang-Woo, a boy he never managed to understand. Then Sang-Woo starts getting closer. Too close. And when Tae-Won unexpectedly presents as an omega, what was once grief and confusion curdles into something far more dangerous. Now entangled in a bond steeped in grief and sin, Tae-Won is consumed by guilt he cannot confess, and a craving he cannot cleanse. Some attachments aren’t born of love... 

They’re worn like a crown of thorns.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a war-torn future, a machine called the E.T.A., or Emotion Transfer Apparatus, is developed to rid soldiers of guilt and PTSD. Once A-Jin gets his hands on an illegal version, he modifies it to amplify the user's pleasure with the dream of selling it to make a fortune. When the military gets wind of his plans and captures him as an adult, A-Jin unexpectedly reunites with his childhood friend, Hyeon, who is now a military officer. Believing A-Jin abandoned him when they were young, Hyeon is hellbent on getting revenge by using the augmented E.T.A. on A-Jin himself...

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: I'm the Fake Bride Who Plans to Run Away
description:
Erika has endured countless slights at the hands of her mother’s charge, the wealthy daughter of the Blanche home. But when the girl falls ill, Erika’s mother is jailed by her father, the cruel Marquis Blanche. To free her, Erika must play the role of the Marquis’ daughter in a sham marriage with Lord Sebastian Aklief. Sworn to secrecy, Erika must rely on her kind heart and newly awakening powers to help her navigate this new world of intrigue, magic, and mystery to free her mother—and herself!

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Odd Relations: Blood of a Kind
description:
Do-Hyeon has spent years haunted by a lust-ridden crush on his stepbrother, Yu-Won. Yearning after what he can’t have, Do-Hyeon is growing increasingly desperate and daring with expressing his desires in private. Little does he know that Yu-Won is not only aware of these carnal desires, but also reciprocates them. The truth eventually comes to light after the arrangement of Yu-Won’s blind date with someone else… and Do-Hyeon discovers that while the two of them may not share the same blood, they both share the same obsession towards each other.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Ddeosari Cha, or Plankie, lost her family to an alien attack years ago and is bullied for her unusual name and obsession with aliens. When two mysterious Kudoomians– aliens with pink blood, disguised as humans– appear to capture her, she fights back using a strange power… the ability to control the stars. Outnumbered and outmatched, suddenly a blue alien steps into the fray, offering what might be the chance at friendship she’s been searching for her entire life. Will Plankie finally find the ally she needs?

(Source: WEBTOON)

According to the morning's fortune, Park Mu-Woon was destined for a fated encounter. Instead, the universe delivers Na Yeon-Taek, the childhood tormentor he spent nine years trying to forget. What was supposed to be a "lucky" day quickly turns into a nightmare as the architect of Mu-Woon's past misery resurfaces. Now, forced back into each other's lives, Mu-Woon must confront a complicated history and the lingering shadows of a man he never wanted to see again.

(Source: Lezhin US)

College student Jisu decides to spice up a quiet night alone with a bold new idea, only for everything to go wrong at the worst possible moment. Before she can even begin to enjoy herself, the key to her shiny new handcuffs slips away and disappears beneath the closet. Trapped, flustered, and out of options, Jisu realizes there is only one person who can help her: the handsome man living next door. Swallowing her embarrassment, she heads over in desperation, setting the stage for an unexpectedly intimate encounter that neither of them saw coming.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After contracting a virus, Bill becomes one of the Gifted, a secret group of humans with supernatural abilities.

(Source: Toomics)

When Ju-ah entered the work force, she was expecting her days to be hard and long…but much to her surprise (and pleasure), that’s not the only thing! Surrounded by three hot bosses who know what they’re doing both in the office and bedroom, this rookie’s first job is bound to be much more unique than most!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Dex has a dangerous gift: with a single touch, he can read the memories of others. For the past thirty years, he’s been bound by a lifetime contract with the Hero Association, forced into service to cover up a mysterious incident. Now, the Association makes him an offer - if he can uncover the criminal past of the notorious villain Jin, suspected of recent terrorist attacks, they’ll finally set him free. Determined to return to the people he loves, Dex accepts. But to dig into Jin’s memories, there’s only one way forward: intimate contact that blurs the line between mission and desire. Will Dex succeed in his task? Or is he going after something impossible…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Hae-Gyeong, a rabbit shifter, has spent years pining for the golden boy of the neighborhood, Jae-Hyeon. Everyone loves Jae-Hyeon, but Hae-Gyeong wants to be the only one. One impulsive, drunken night, the lines between them blur when Jae-Hyeon crosses the ultimate boundary, leaving Hae-Gyeong more deeply in love than ever. However, the morning after brings a cold reality: Jae-Hyeon is drawing lines again. Now, Hae-gGeong must see if he can finally break through Jae-Hyun’s walls, or if his true love will remain forever out of reach.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Worried about your marriage because you're a terrible cook? Don't worry and leave it to us! At The Cooking School, you will leave both very full and satisfied.

(Source: Toomics)

For her entire life in Joseon, Yun Jini believed there was only one man in the world, the king. As a newly appointed chambermaid guarding the royal bedchamber, she begins to awaken to forbidden desires she has never dared to name. But in a palace where love and freedom are luxuries no court lady can afford, her fate turns even darker. Accused of treason and forced to flee, Jini falls into a pond, sinking fast toward certain death.

*“I don’t want to die like this!”*

Her desperate plea is answered. The mysterious waters carry her not to the afterlife, but across time itself, into 21st-century Korea. Here, in a world bursting with freedom she never imagined, Jini experiences love for the very first time. Emotions long suppressed finally find release, and a woman who once knew only duty and fear begins to discover what it means to live... and to love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

While struggling with hardships in her life, Yu-Na meets mysterious I-Yun at a bar. The night she spent with him was supposed to be a fleeting moment. But fate, or rather I-Yun, had other plans—for his meeting with her was far from a coincidence.

(Source: Manta)

Five years ago, Winston and Yu-Jin fell deeply and irrevocably in love at first sight. But their passionate relationship shattered when Winston discovered the unthinkable truth: Yu-Jin’s was having an affair with none other than his own father. Consumed by betrayal, Winston channeled the love he once cherished into resentment. Yet no matter how hard he tries, Winston cannot extinguish the pull he still feels. Now, reunited by fate and unresolved wounds, passion and scorn intertwine… But can either of them truly escape what they once meant to each other?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Have you ever pretended you were good at sports to impress your crush? Enter high school student Haemin Oh, who desperately wants to catch the attention of Ina Jeong, recently elected president of the school swimming club. Ina is recruiting, and despite barely knowing how to float, Haemin somehow ends up making her think that he’s an expert at the sport. Before long, Haemin has to prove himself in the lane. Sink or swim, it’s time to make a splash!

(Source: WEBTOON)

A long-awaited getaway with childhood friends takes a dangerous turn when Yu Seol-Ah wakes in the dark to a touch she shouldn’t want, only to realize it belongs to Lee Tae-Geon, her best friend’s boyfriend. Caught between sleep and reality, her body reacts before her reason can catch up, blurring lines she’s spent ten years respecting. One forbidden moment is all it takes to threaten their friendship, their trust, and perhaps...to give her everything she's ever wanted.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Fresh out of the military, he learns his “innocent” girlfriend’s been playing him all along—and sleeping around, even with his tormentor. With the help of his childhood friend, he plots revenge to expose her true face.

(Source: Toomics)

On the remote island of Beomhae, Se-ju has spent years loathing the suffocating traditions of her home. As she becomes entangled with a man harboring a dark secret, the island she once considered a prison becomes the backdrop for a perilous affair. In a place where secrets are buried as deep as the sea, she must decide if he is her ticket to freedom or a beautiful trap.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Manny, a member the Seven Sins gang and a secret informant for the police, loses his partner to a brutal serial killer. Before he can even process the shock, his boss assigns him a new partner - Sean, the one colleague he can’t stand. To make matters worse, his contact at the police asks him to dig into Sean’s past, suspecting he’s hiding something. With no choice but to get close, Manny turns to the method he knows best: seduction.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After getting into college, Brian goes out clubbing to celebrate his acceptance and hooks up with a drop-dead gorgeous girl, unaware that he’ll soon be living in the same house as her.

(Source: Toomics)

When Hyun-Woo’s reckless brother wrecks an expensive car, Hyun-Woo scrambles to find money to clean up the mess. Jae-Yoon, his current boss and once his quiet admirer, steps in and offers to cover the debt for him. A single misunderstanding twists their intentions, pulling the two men into a complicated and unexpected new phase of their relationship.

(Source: Lezhin US)

One day, Do-Ha appears before Do-Hun, calling him hyung as if they were brothers. But something feels wrong. Do-Hun soon realizes that this visitor is not human at all, but a figure pulled straight from the recurring dreams that have haunted him for years. Since Do-Ha’s arrival, strange and unsettling events begin to twist Do-Hun’s once-normal life. His own parents turn against him, he can never seem to get any rest at night, and the line between dream and waking starts to dissolve. As fear takes hold, Do-Hun grows convinced that the only way to end this nightmare is to kill the thing wearing his brother’s face. But when he finally confronts Do-Ha, the creature only smiles and murmurs, “You can’t get rid of me, hyung. It’s impossible. So let’s stay together forever.”

Now Do-Hun must face a terrifying question: is Do-Ha real—or just the reflection of his own fractured mind?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*“You are under arrest as a suspect in the murder of Han Jong-In.”* 

I just went to see my grandfather, but why? Before the shock could even subside, Seo-Hui found out about her husband and cousin’s affair. 

*“From now on, I’m going to take what I want. Everything, including yours.”* 

Everything felt unreal, and the moment her eyes closed… she was transported back to 10 years in the past!? When Seo-Hui woke up again, she saw a college classroom. As she watched her cousin speaking to her in a hateful manner, Seo-Hui made a resolution.

 *“I won’t let you do whatever you want.”* 

She was going to live a different life. To do that, she had to delete her ex-husband first.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Brilliant in both looks and talent, Ryu Chan-Yeong is an elite violinist admired by everyone around him. For Joo Ha-Jin, he is not just a role model but the person he dreams of standing beside on stage one day. That dream feels painfully distant until Ha-Jin is suddenly given a rare chance to receive private mentoring from Chan-Yeong himself. But fate takes a strange turn when Ha-Jin accidentally overhears something he was never meant to hear. Before he can even process it, Chan-Yeong confronts him with a shocking proposal. For a limited time, they will become intimate partners, and when Chan-Yeong decides it is over, it will end cleanly. In exchange, Ha-Jin will receive the mentorship he has longed for. 

Caught between ambition, desire, and the dangerous pull of the man he admires, Ha-Jin must decide how much he is willing to risk for his dream.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Training in All the Right Ways
description:
The gym is a great place to get in shape… but some workouts feel better done behind closed doors.

(Source: Toomics)

After losing her father, Yeon-Su struggles to support her sick mother and little sister alone. Desperate for money to save her family, she accepts a life-changing offer to be the surrogate of a handsome rich man named Tae-Gun and his infertile wife.The contract seems simple at first, but Yeon-Su soon realizes she's trapped in an arrangement she’ll regret. By the time she's questioning her morality and self-worth, it's already too late to turn back. As forbidden intimacy blurs the lines, unexpected emotions begin to stir between Yeon-Su and Tae-Gun. But is anything real between them?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Tasked with guarding a demon hunted down by the villagers, Finn begins to doubt the truth he’s been told. Everyone swears the demon is a murderer, yet the demon insists it’s the villagers who are lying. Believed the wrong person could result in eternal damnation, but Finn can't help but be intrigued by the demon's claims...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Late-stage cancer. 3 months to live. How will retired detective In-Su Kang make the most of it? When seeing the death-row convicts he arrested all escape from a prison van, he finds his answer: finish the job. It’s something he could never do as an officer, but the law didn’t do its duty. The problem is all the escaped convicts are moving far too swiftly for it to be a coincidence. They have someone behind the scenes giving them a helping. And this someone also has In-Su’s daughter in their sights. This series contains strong themes and disturbing imagery.

(Source: WEBTOON)

For four years, Karen Prime von Mondreal thought of Erich as nothing but her brilliant disciple. However, all that changed when he turned 19 and suddenly confessed his love! He's persistent, and Karen is starting to waver... The only problem is that she'd been priming Erich to become the next monarch, and she has to leave the kingdom so he can build a solid political standing. Can Karen push Erich away when he's determined to stay by her side? More importantly, does she want to?

(Source: Tapas)

In the Kingdom of Ha, a land bordered by monster-infested wilds, an ancient law dictates that any Bearer. a male capable of conceiving the White Tiger’s heir, must be crowned King to prevent a seven-year famine. After decades of silence, Il-Oh, a lowly slave, suddenly manifests as a Bearer. Following the omen, the former King abdicates, and the Crown Prince, Jang Woon, is demoted to a mere attendant tasked with serving the new, unwilling sovereign. 

Within the palace, a grim secret lingers: once a Bearer bears an heir at age twenty, he is destined for death. Amidst this chilling tension, Il-Oh finds solace in Jang Woon, offering him his heart. However, as Il-oh turns twenty, the divine White Tiger, Geon-Yoo, descends to claim his prize. While Geon-Yoo seeks only to sire an heir and regain his freedom, Il-Oh faces a tragic fate. Caught between duty, survival, and obsession, where will this twisted trinity lead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eunju is a timid, slightly gloomy twenty-year-old with a secret she can never tell anyone. Whenever she holds hands with a man, her body reacts far more intensely than it should. Her quiet life takes a sharp turn when her sunbae Hyeyeong, a self-proclaimed expert in “adult matters,” discovers Eunju’s secret. From that moment on, Hyeyoung decides to take Eunju under her wing, and the two embark into a wild world neither of them came prepared for.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Born the cherished daughter of a noble family, Won’s life shatters when a sudden tragedy leaves her on the brink of being sold off as a courtesan. To make matters worse, the man behind her family’s downfall is none other than the father of her childhood friend, Wanhyeok. Just as she resigns herself to losing everything, Wanhyeok steps forward…paying the price of her freedom with his own two hands. Torn between a desire for revenge and love, does Won have what it takes to avenge her family’s name?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Since childhood, Pil Hyeonseo has dreamed of a fairy tale ending with a perfect prince, the kind she writes about in her picture books. Now 27 and still an unknown author, she believes she has finally found that happy ending, only for it to shatter when her long time boyfriend cheats on her after seven years together. Heartbroken and disoriented by the betrayal, Hyeonseo finds herself standing at a crossroads between the love she lost and the future she never imagined. Just as she is struggling to pick up the pieces, three very different men step into her life, each offering comfort, passion, and a new kind of possibility. Pulled into fresh, intense relationships that challenge everything she thought she wanted, Hyeonseo begins to question what a “perfect prince” truly means. Is it someone with the right looks, the right personality, and perfect chemistry, or is it someone who sees her for who she really is?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jacob's given the task of pairing up with a girl to act out scenes for a new game.    
Turns out, the game isn't the only thing heating up...

[Original Webtoon](https://www.toomics.com/uplmscg/episode/toon/7681)

**Official Translations:**    
[English](https://toomics.com/en/webtoon/episode/toon/7681), [Portuguese](https://toomics.com/por/webtoon/episode/toon/7681), [Spanish (LA)](https://toomics.com/mx/webtoon/episode/toon/7681), [Spanish (ES)](https://toomics.com/es/webtoon/episode/toon/7681), [Italian](https://toomics.com/it/webtoon/episode/toon/7681), [German](https://toomics.com/de/webtoon/episode/toon/7681), [French](https://toomics.com/fr/webtoon/episode/toon/7681)

"Princess" Renagia is a slave girl acting as the body double of Regnos, a prince masquerading as a princess for his safety in the Italos Kingdom. So when enemy soldiers from the Taringia Empire attack the royal palace, Renagia gets taken hostage immediately and is forced to sleep with Taringia's emperor, Godfrey. Knowing Regnos will come save her one day, Renagia decides to seduce the ruthless Godfrey and use him in order to survive. But that's easier said than done when their past connection resurfaces, blurring the line between revenge and attraction...

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

Moments before her execution at the Emperor's hands, Manae Frey makes a plea for their illegitimate daughter to be protected at all costs. But after a desperate pact with a mysterious monster, Manae awakens to find she now inhabits her young daughter’s body. Given a second chance as Lilina, Manae resolves to seize the life her daughter was denied — and prove to the Calvaria Empire that she’s more than just a forgotten child. She will claim her place as a true princess, no matter what it takes!

(Source: Tapas)

Cali is on a quest to discover her identity and must travel to see the elf queen of Sorte, who left her at the convent as a baby. After hearing Duke Lycan Warren and his knights are traveling in that direction, she disguises herself as the deadly duke’s fiancée and ends up in a political marriage. Although Cali plans to run away eventually, she finds herself being drawn to Lycan as their hearts and bodies grow closer. Can the unlikely couple forge a true bond despite their secrets and lack of experience in love?

(Source: Tappytoon)

As the son of a wealthy CEO and a recessive omega, Jeong-Won is constantly being pressured by his father to get married and prove his worth. But everything changes when his adoptive alpha brother, Yeong-Won, returns to Korea and declares that he was raised to be Jeong-Won's husband. Soon after, Jeong-Won's obsession with Yeong-Won leads to the pair forming a deep bond that defies their family ties...

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

My husband got kidnapped, and I need to complete the missions to save him... Will he be okay?

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/mission), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/webtoon/episode/toon/8614)

 **Official Translations:**  
English ([English](https://toomics.com/en/webtoon/episode/toon/8614), HoneyToon), [Spanish (LA)](https://toomics.com/mx/webtoon/episode/toon/8614), [Italian](https://toomics.com/it/webtoon/episode/toon/8614), [Spanish (ES)](https://toomics.com/es/webtoon/episode/toon/8614)

Isu Jin’s seemingly ordinary life comes to a violent end when he and his father are suddenly targeted by a powerful conglomerate. He survives. But his father does not. In a world where crime and authority are one and the same, Isu enters the underworld to hunt the truth. His fight is no longer just for revenge… It’s to expose a corrupt empire, no matter the cost.

(Source: WEBTOON)

In the sweltering heat of summer, seven office workers lose their way during a company workshop. They stumble upon an old mountain lodge filled with mysterious, unidentified bottles of alcohol. As if bewitched, they drink one glass after another slowly letting their reason slipping away. The boss then discreetly offers us a proposal. The lodge suddenly fills with desire and secrets.

*“Would you like to hear the story of my first experience?”*

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

When Hyeonu moves into Terrarium Apartments, the place seems idyllic—until he witnesses a man plunge from the building across his window. The residents dismiss the victim as a “misfit”, and Hyeonu soon notices their unsettling, scripted routines. Beneath the cheerful facade lies something far darker: a community that demands conformity and punishes defiance. As the walls close in, Hyeonu realizes that once you enter Terrarium, leaving may no longer be an option.

*Source: WEBTOON*

Jeong-Un, born into nobility, hides desires society would never forgive. After his former lover leaves him, he drags Sol-Gae, his family's servant, into a forbidden bond of passion and power. If discovered, they could lose everything. Will they continue or return to the roles society demands of them?

(Source: Manta)

Protected his entire life by his loyal butler, Se-Jin, young heir Lee Han-Eul is discovering the real world for the very first time. As he tastes freedom, friendship, and first love, long-buried secrets begin to resurface. Why does Se-Jin seem to care for him as much as he watches over him? The discovery of a terrible secret about his birth will fundamentally change Han-Eul’s view of the world—and his feelings for his butler.

(Source: WEBTOON)

In his hurried transfer to a rural school, Hyoun meets Seonhong, a bright and cheerful classmate who is everything he is not. As often happens with first love, the two quickly become each other’s whole world. But one day, Seonhong vanishes like smoke, leaving behind nothing but memories of a brilliant love at eighteen. Ten years later, they cross paths again by chance at a blind date arranged for Seonhong. Overwhelmed by the pain of being abandoned, Hyoun greets her not with joy, but with betrayal and vengeance.

*"Have you thought about it? Ten million won for one night."*

Their love is now tangled with resentment and regret. Can something so broken ever be mended into love again?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a brutal war between humans and merfolk, a dark curse settled deep within the royal bloodline. Plagued by agonizing phantoms, Crown Prince Wook flees to a remote coastal temple, only to be lured over the cliff’s edge by the relentless voices. Against all odds, he survives the fall - only to wake up facing an impossible reality, and a mysterious savior who promises to break the royal curse. Can this stranger truly save him, or is Wook simply diving into a deeper deception?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Joon-Hyuk’s only happiness in life is good food. So when, one day, he loses all taste he begins to wonder just what he has to do to fix things. When his sleazy colleague, Yoon Ji-Hoon slides over one day and tells him he knows what’s going on, Joon-Hyuk finds himself following blindly.

(Source: Lezhin US)

4 friends make a bet on who can complete the risky mission first. Why? Because it's fun!

(Source: Toomics)

When news anchor Eun-Seong Kang meets the enigmatic Woo-Jin Jeong, an unexpected connection pulls them into each other’s orbit. He’s a man trapped in a life that never ends; she chases meaning in fleeting moments. Their encounter feels less like coincidence — and more like fate.

(Source: Manta)

Mocked for having top-tier talent but the worst looks, Yeppeum Kim falls into despair, betrayed by those she trusted and robbed of everything she worked for. But then, a seeming miracle transforms her into someone breathtakingly beautiful. In the following days, she watches a dreamlike new life unfold before her eyes. Fame, attention, and endless praise are intoxicating, but something feels off. Soon, she realizes this beauty isn’t a blessing. It is a curse.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yu Bom has never cared for sweet boys her age. What stirs her is the fantasy of rugged older men, those with tanned skin, rough hands, and the raw masculinity of a hard life etched into their bodies. The construction site, filled with men who embody everything she craves, becomes the perfect stage for her secret desires. But fantasies have a way of bleeding into reality, and Yu Bom is about to step into a world that blurs the line between imagination and temptation.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After her father's treason led to the downfall of her family, Evelyn Ophrose lived in hiding until her childhood friend, Ian Callician, rescued her. While at first she's relieved, Evelyn slowly realizes Ian isn't the sweet boy she once knew, and is now trapped in his cradle of seduction and lies.

(Source: Manta)

After losing his sense of smell, genius perfumer Si-Bon tries to end his life but is saved by Ha-Eoon, the owner of a small antique shop. Planning to stay just 3 months before returning to France, Si-Bon takes a live-in job there and finds himself slowly drawn into Ha-Eoon's world with no escape.

(Source: Manta)

Once saved as a child by a boy who appeared like a flame, Jang Do-Ha reunites with his savior and confesses his love. But Kang Tae-Jun knows the truth. Do-Ha’s feelings are not love. He has returned for one reason only, revenge.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Su-Hyeon has a loving boyfriend, Hae-Min, but the passion’s gone cold. Haunted by dreams of being taken rough and without restraint, Su-Hyeon can’t shake the hunger that gnaws at him. Then one night at a bar, he meets a man who embodies everything he’s been craving: sharp eyes, a dangerous smile, and a touch that leaves him trembling. As Su-Hyeon falls deeper into the affair, Hae-Min discovers the truth, and what follows is a story of love, lust, and betrayal—perfectly arranged in threes.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Born with noble blood but stripped of name and freedom, Shin Hee was sold into servitude and erased from history. Then came the rebellion, a single night of fire and blood that wiped out her entire family. But death was not the end. Reborn as Hwa-Ryeong, a courtesan of the pleasure quarters and no longer fully human, she walks the border between the living and the damned. The past clings to her like a curse, whispering of vengeance and loss. Now, two men stand in her path: Yu-Heon, her former fiancé who still carries the weight of her memory, and Crown Prince Lee Kang, the man who sought to possess her from the start. Between love and obsession, mercy and revenge, Hwa-Ryeong must decide what remains of her humanity, and whose blood must be spilled for her to finally be free.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeon-Woo’s love life has been nothing but a series of runaway men - all thanks to his freaky fetishes. But just when he’s about to give up, along comes Jae-Hyun: a perfect face, silky baritone voice, and fingers that look like they were sculpted by the gods. He’s everything Yeon-Woo’s ever dreamed of…and more. Determined to make Jae-Hyun his own, Yeon-Woo pulls his usual rich-guy schemes; but try as he might, Jae-Hyun remains totally unfazed. One drunken night, however, Jae-Hyun lets the truth slip: this handsome hung hunk hungers for someone who knows who take the lead. A guy who checks all his boxes and wants to be trained? Yeon-Woo’s dream project begins now.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After losing his memories and home to a vampire attack, Rick is taken in by a hunter guild and later sent to search for a missing member, only to encounter a mysterious vampire who feels disturbingly familiar. Drawn to the very creature tied to his trauma, Rick finds himself caught between fear, desire, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Even a Wild Man Wants to Love!
description:
All Jung Hyun-Do wanted was a steady job, but he faced constant rejection. Determined to toughen up, he goes to Gwidu Mountain to improve his stamina, only to wind up hopelessly lost. In the midst of Hyun-Do's despair, a shaggy-haired man suddenly emerges from the shadows and whisks him away! The wild man introduces himself as Woo Jae-Chang, and a wary Hyun-Do knows this might be his only chance to escape. Will Hyun-Do and Jae-Chang make it off the mountain, or will it be their final resting place?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Five years ago, an accident erased Ha Do-Geon’s memories. Even so, his life has remained mostly smooth, calm, and manageable. He believes the past he lost no longer matters. That illusion cracks the night he returns home after a university alumni event. His designated driver, Yang Ha-Il, is a stranger, yet the moment their eyes meet, something deep inside Do-Geon stirs. A gaze that feels unfamiliar but achingly known, an attraction he cannot explain. From that night on, Do-Geon’s carefully balanced life begins to shift. Emotions he does not remember choosing start to resurface, pulling him toward a man who feels tied to a time he was sure was gone forever. Caught between erased memories and revived feelings, Do-Geon is forced to confront the possibility that forgetting did not mean letting go. 

As the past quietly pushes its way back into the present, Do-Geon must face the question he never thought he would ask again, what if the most important part of his life is the one he lost?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eun-Ha likes flirting with Woo-Geon at the office, but she knows their relationship can never be more than that. After all, he’s the heir to the huge conglomerate that owns the company they work for, while she’s nothing but an unwanted, illegitimate child. But when Woo-Geon catches Eun-Ha in an awkward position outside of the office, secrets and misunderstandings lead to Woo-Geon making an offer that is definitely “not safe for work”...

(Source: Tappytoon)

In a world that's been nothing but unfair to them, Yoo Jin and Yegeon have found love with each other. However, love is not without its hardships. One is plagued by addictions to gambling and alcohol, while the other has a crippling fear of abandonment, making their time together anything but boring. Others may not understand their rocky relationship, but they have their own special way of working out their issues. Things may not be perfect, but love conquers all, doesn't it?

(Source: Tapas)

 *Note: Part of RIDI's Natjyeobami Danpyeonseon (낮져밤이 단편선) Collection.*

Dragged into a host bar by chance, Minkyeong meets Sihyeok, a man whose savage charm awakens desires she never felt with her husband. As she becomes addicted to the thrill he offers, she drains her money, her pride, and herself, only for his demands to grow more dangerous with each encounter. But her fall is only beginning, because Sihyeok is merely a tool, and the true owner watching from the shadows intends to claim her completely.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seo-Wu survives by selling information, living every day on edge. One day, a suspiciously friendly operative who leads with emotion instead of caution shows up at his door. Yi-Jin is clearly dangerous, probably even from a rival organization. And yet… they talk far too easily. 

Between a high-strung informant and a disarmingly open operative, a risky connection forms... Is this pull part of the mission, or something dangerously real?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Cheating Wife’s Erotic Stories is a captivating collection of tales exploring passion, desire, and human intimacy. Each story delves into forbidden connections and the hidden emotions that ignite where they’re least expected. The collection invites readers into a world of secret fantasies, simmering tension, and temptation, where the line between longing and betrayal becomes dangerously thin.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/an_ill_advisde_book?p_id=pp_1601_001), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13227763), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3587013293), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/yaseolbogam), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/webtoon/episode/toon/8869) 

**Official Translations:**    
English, [T.Chinese](https://www.toptoon.net/comic/epList/81191)

display_title: How to Charm a Reluctant Fiancé
description:
Ordered by the Emperor himself to wed naval officer Edward, Yelodia is disappointed to find that her fiancé has doubts about the arrangement due to their age gap. Undeterred, she sets out to win his heart—but with imperial intrigue in play, can Yelodia overcome the odds?

(Source: Manta)

Se-Ra has never dated, but her curiosity about sex is boundless. Browsing a dating app one night, she stumbles across a shocking post: “Looking for a mistress who can tame me.” Intrigued, she digs deeper, only to discover that the man behind the post is none other than her university lecturer, Professor Baek. Now, with his secret desire exposed, Se-Ra can’t help but begin her own exploration — into both his private world and her own awakening.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After his wife dies in a plane crash, a widower falls into despair. But when a new neighbor moves in next door—looking eerily like his late wife—his world is shaken. Is it just a coincidence, or could she really be her reincarnation? As they grow closer, the mystery deepens.

(Source: Toomics)

Garam has a secret desire she can’t let anyone discover. She only ignites with pleasure when she’s pushed into submission. When Hasung, her brother’s friend, finds out, he makes a dangerous offer. “Want me to help? Then open your mouth.” From that moment, their secret affair begins. But soon, another younger man, Woojae, her friend’s brother, steps between them. Now trapped between two younger lovers, Garam can’t escape the forbidden triangle that has begun.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the secluded town of Riverwort, Jade and Oje grow up relying on each other as family. But when Jade is suddenly consumed by an uncontrollable rut, he loses control and hurts the person he loves most. Consumed by guilt, Jade chooses to disappear, leaving Oje behind with nothing but unanswered feelings, until news arrives that the ship Jade boarded has sunk, forcing the truth of their bond to surface in the most devastating way.

(Source: Lezhin US)

When I moved to New Village, I never expected to be immediately recruited into the local Women’s Association. Their strange rules and provocative ‘initiations’ pushed my husband to run away… but that’s fine — he’ll regret it soon enough.. And that’s how my story in the Wives’ Club began.

**Original Webtoon:**      
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3587012976), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12477620), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/daebongvillage), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/C000069064), [Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/Daebong_Village_Womaens_Association), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/webtoon/episode/toon/8622) 

**Official Translations:**      
English, [T.Chinese](https://www.toptoon.net/comic/epList/81176)

After nine years in a stable relationship, Park Ah-jung is on the verge of marriage, yet quietly restless. Seeking a change in her hairstyle, she visits a new salon and meets Kang Jikdo, a dangerously alluring stylist. 

Behind the ordinary facade lies a private VIP room where his demeanor shifts, and the air turns tense and intimate. There, she is met with a service she never expected.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: My New Mom Is My Friend's Mom
description:
Jake returns home from the military to a tense household where his stepmother, Susan, battles emotional distance from her husband. Forbidden desires grow between them through a series of intimate and awkward encounters. Their unresolved tensions threaten to shatter the fragile family dynamic.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3587012901), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12370307), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/C000068626), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/friends_mom), [Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/stepmom_is_my_friend_mom?p_id=pp_1601_001), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/webtoon/episode/toon/8588), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=ognq), [Qtoon](https://www.qtoon.co.kr/toon/list.mg?tcode=q8p1), Metoon

**Official Translations:**    
English (HoneyToon, [Coolmic](https://coolmic.me/titles/7310)), French, German, Spanish, B.Portuguese, Italian, [Japanese](https://toptoon.jp/content/%E7%BE%A9%E6%AF%8D%E3%81%8C%E4%BF%BA%E3%81%AE%E5%A5%B3%E3%81%AB%E3%81%AA%E3%82%8B%E3%81%BE%E3%81%A7/104210)

They might looks beastly, but inside they're all softies. Step inside this furry campus, and find out what these college animals are up to!

(Source: Toomics)

A rising young director sets out to cast his next project and becomes fixated on a particular actor who refuses to be easily won over. A bold casting offer turns into an even bolder counterproposal, pulling the two into a delicate negotiation where ambition and attraction collide. As their collaboration moves forward, the line between work and romance begins to blur, setting the stage for a relationship neither of them planned.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Raised under the harsh rule of an abusive father, Ju-ho has spent his life being compared to his perfect stepbrother, Hyeon-Wu. As his father’s cruelty deepens and Hyeon-Wu’s obsessive behavior grows more disturbing, Ju-Ho’s spirit begins to break. Then one day, he meets Su-Hyeok, a kind and gentle man who offers the warmth and comfort Ju-Ho has never known. For the first time, Ju-Ho finds himself relying on someone outside his family, falling into a fragile love that feels almost like salvation. But as he clings to Su-Hyeok, Hyeon-Wu’s fixation only festers. Years later, even as adults, Ju-Ho finds that the grip of his family’s twisted love and his own buried wounds are far from healed, and one lingering kiss may awaken everything he’s tried to forget.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ji-Won’s track record with men is horrible. It’s so bad that she’s nicknamed “the trash collector” amongst her friends. Unfortunately, the newest addition to the collection is Do-Kyung, her boss. Do-Kyung is rich, handsome, and… incredibly difficult in terms of personality. Ji-Won is very aware that her crush on him will lead to no good, and she’s proven correct after they impulsively spend a heated night together. His selfish and manipulative behavior is a glaring red flag, but she can’t help wanting him. However, even Ji-Won has her limits to how much pain her heart can handle…

(Source: Tappytoon)

He's the ultimate alpha male—the face of Korea’s best-selling male supplement, flying off the shelves every second. To Suyeon, he's nothing more than an annoying boss… until she discovers the one secret he never wanted anyone to know. Is the romance between a man who thinks he's perfect and the woman who can't stand him destined to spiral out of control? 

(Source: Manta)

Ever since he was a cub, Ryan has dreamed of adventuring across the world. But now that his parents--the King and Queen of Doong Doong Island--are missing, it falls on Ryan to rule the island as their heir...which means he can never leave. Rule or escape, which will Ryan choose?

**Original Webtoon:**    
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/66090732), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EA%B7%B8%EB%9E%98%EB%8F%84-%EB%9D%BC%EC%9D%B4%EC%96%B8/4431)

**Official Translations:**     
[English](https://tapas.io/series/ryan-begins/info), [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/174222)

When Seul-Yeong brought a puppy home, she never expected it to be an android — a sex android that looks exactly like her terrifying boss, Manager Seo! Now she's stuck hiding her look-alike manager at home while acting normal at work. But when her boss suddenly leans in for a kiss... chaos and temptation spiral out of control.

(Source: Manta)

Han Yoo has a little problem—namely Dami Lee, the daughter of his mentor. Now that she's an adult, Dami has made it her mission to win Han over, even begging him to let her be a teaching assistant at the academy where he works! To make matters worse, his body starts acting strangely whenever she's around...

(Source: Manta)

*“Is it big or small? My future husband’s… manhood, I mean.”*

According to the era's most scandalous bestseller, a truly great husband must be blessed with both a stunning face and a grand "package." Seo-Young, a bride-to-be, takes this advice to heart. In a bold move to vet her fiancé, she ends up asking a complete stranger—whom she mistakes for her future brother-in-law—about his brother’s size. When he suggests his own is a fair comparison, he leaves her with a tempting offer: "Meet me at the watermill tonight if you want to see for yourself." Driven by a curiosity she can’t suppress, Seo-Young steps into the shadows of the watermill, stepping into a trap of desire she never saw coming.

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae Danpyeonseon (순애 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: I Became The Heroine Obsesses Over Her Villain
description:
Da-in, ended up possessing the villain of a story. To make Stardust—the story's protagonist and his favorite character in a dystopian manga—happy, he resolves to become the villain Egoistic for her growth. Da-in deliberately causes terror to enhance Stardust's abilities and preemptively prevents all the tragic events from the original story, but in the process, he gains public support while also drawing Stardust's suspicion. Stardust, who initially opposed him, gradually opens her heart, and soon even begins to show signs of obsession toward him...?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Kang Min-A's daily life is completely turned upside down by the sudden acquisition of the ability to . Now, what unfolds before her are irreversible events caused by a single moment of choice. In the midst of anger, confusion, and suppressed sense of justice, Min-A begins a new journey, wondering where to use her power. In what direction will her power flow, and what choices will she make?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Four years ago, the idol group Dream Boy disbanded after being embroiled in some kind of scandal. And now... Jae-Young, formerly known as "Happy" in Dream Boy, was struggling financially and working a part-time delivery job when he heard that the group's leader, Su-Kyum, had passed out drunk at a club, and he rushed to him.
