Although they share the same stage name, Seung-Min, aka "Happy" and the most popular rapper and producer these days, saves Jae-Young from collapsing from photosensitivity syndrome and suggests they work together... 

*"You know who I am, right? Let's work together."*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

After killing his brother, Clois ascends to the throne. His desire to become emperor was not for personal gain but for the sake of his beloved wife and soon-to-be-born child. However, upon his return, the corpses of his wife and child greeted him, demonstrating the futility of his efforts. 

Seven years later, he couldn’t find joy in anything in the world. So, he didn’t care about the re-opening of the gifted academy’s admissions after seven years. Until he saw a wrinkled application form rolling on the floor. Instead of trying to enroll the child in the gifted academy, he offered various excuses. The document, thrown away like trash without even being considered due to being from a workhouse. 

“I approve this child’s admission.” 

He wasn’t particularly interested. It was just a warning to those who tried to act arbitrarily. So he couldn’t even remember the name of the child he picked. 

“My name is Ivy Alden.” 

The child he met in front of his wife’s and daughter’s graves resembled the daughter he had always imagined.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68053528), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%9D%B4%EC%A0%9C-%EC%9A%B8%EC%96%B4%EB%8F%84-%EB%90%A0%EA%B9%8C%EC%9A%94/4718)

**Official Translations:**    
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/200945)

After half a year on the run, the vampire Eugene was ultimately killed, offered up as a sacrifice to boost a holy knight's fame. Just as his life ended in bitter regret, a chance to return came to him.

*“I will never die like that again. If I’ve truly returned to the past, then I'll never regret anything a second time... no matter what it may take."*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The very last moment before the novel was about the end... The strongest villain met a pitiful fate. But that wasn't the end.

*"So, this is how I die."*

I, who was once the author, woke up as the fox-eyed villian who was never once understood. A fallen family. A life thrown away for revenge. A future sealed in tragedy. I'm going to rewrite it all. This villain's end... will be reversed.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Shuji, a soldier who danced with death many times while on the battlefield, was possessed by the grudges and resentment of those he had killed. He too was eventually killed, but somehow he awoke in a younger version of himself. He returned to a time when he was still an errand boy, inexperienced with war, but retained his memories. Remembering Kyo Aiyo, his comrade and savior, Shuji travelled to the ‘Tiger Pit’ Sect. However, instead of the strong and reliable woman, he was met with a cheerful and petite girl. He recalled the tragic past that had caused her to devote herself to the army, where in his previous life her family had fallen apart due to false rumors. ‘This time, I will protect you.’ He vowed to repay the kindness he received in his previous life by changing her fate. With a spear in his right hand, Shuji steps into the battlefield once again, becoming the Unrivaled Spear Demon.

Cha In-Woo, who is timid and has no presence, becomes partners with Kwak Ha-Jun, who looks exactly like his favorite student, among his new friends. While Cha In-Woo is excited to become friends with Kwak Ha-Jun while doing homework together given by his teacher, he suddenly gets caught up in a mean bet by Kwak Ha-Jun...

A fresh and bashful romantic comedy between two high school students!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

A world stained black. Driven by the Black Witch, humanity is forced into a vast city where light and color converge. To reclaim the world, humanity continues its pioneering efforts, and a boy named Kay aspires to join the expeditionary force. But he’s rejected because he is colorless, lacking any hue. Then one day, through an unexpected incident, Kay gains the color black....

(Source: Naver, translated)

*"I'll be your friend."* 

A chilling ghost boy, Hae-Su Lee, visits the outcast, Eun-Ha Ju. The moment she accepts this dangerous friendship, unexpected events unfold around Eun-Ha... 

Will this hand offered by her mysterious friend be salvation, or a curse?

(Source: Naver, translated)

As a child, Shin Woo-Jin was kidnapped and locked away in a warehouse, forced to live as a slave. But against all odds, he was rescued and finally stepped into the outside world. Though free, Woo-jin wasn’t like other children. He had an extraordinary gift—the ability to read people. By observing the smallest facial expressions and unconscious gestures, he could see through their thoughts, emotions, and intentions with near-perfect accuracy. Like a profiler, like a modern-day Sherlock, Woo-Jin learned to navigate the world, one observation at a time. But for someone who sees too much, living an ordinary life is the hardest thing of all. All he ever wanted was a peaceful, simple life. But the world had other plans.

 *“As I thought… living a normal life is far too difficult.”*

(Source: Naver, translated)

Long ago, a "door" connecting to another world opened, and those who gained special abilities along with a "mark" began to be called "wizards." After the incident of "that day," Ophion's first-class wizard "Blow" became very famous. One day, he receives a very special request. It is to protect the second son of the Artian Duke family, who is being called a "monster" and suffering at the "Magic School Helios"! Thus, Blow enters Helios as a student under the name "Rood Krisch" while hiding his identity... Will Blow be able to successfully complete the request amidst the whirlwind of unexpected events?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: The Sword God From a Fallen World
description:
The world was destroyed. A world filled with death and despair. The one who fought with a sword until the end — Sword God. Karselian Le Vandeyan. However, as if by fate, the door to another world opened, and this time… It was the Earth that had not been destroyed. There, monsters slowly appeared, and people were still living without knowing how great this disaster was. This world had not yet been destroyed. However, the moment they let their guard down, that terrible nightmare from the past would repeat itself. To prevent that Sword God takes up his sword again. He borrows the body of a weak human from the past and begins a new life. In exchange for taking over the body, he makes one promise. “I will protect your family.” And now, the real beginning. 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: Kim Jin's Adventures With Strange Animals
description:
Veterinarian Kim Ohjin was unexpectedly summoned by a dragon. After successfully treating the dragon's pet, he returns home... only to find himself in another world. "Animals in another world are still animals, right?" I was a vet barely scraping by in the real world, but now, in this strange new world, I'm a renowned doctor? With my old clinic on the verge of closing, I'm setting my sights on a new opportunity—my second clinic, and, hopefully, a big success!

(Source: Naver, translated)

*\[Welcome to Murim Online, the world where the strongest reside.\]

\[Your device has malfunctioned, and logging out failed.\]

\[Would you like to attempt to disconnect once more?\]

\[Yes or No\]*

When he tried returning to virtual reality, the place he logged into was instead the “real Murim.” A once-in-an-era psychopath fell into the Murim due to the Grim Reaper’s mistake. Dong Bongsu's merciless fangs cast a shadow over Murim, which is rife with schemes and malice.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Yu Ji-Tae, a regressor with unparalleled power. Even with that power and repeated regressions, he was unable to prevent the destruction of Earth. The cause of this destruction was four baby dragons who came to Earth to play. The story of a man who, rather than possessing absolute power, seeks to protect them and prevent destruction.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*“What will people call him?”*

Someone asked. But no one could answer. A transcendent being appeared in the world. Creating a new history in the film industry.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Twenty years ago, legendary player Lee Suhyeok was killed by a trusted friend during a tower raid. Now he’s back, reincarnated in a much weaker body and forced to restart from level one. Fueled by vengeance, he begins the climb again, but without money or his former abilities, there’s no way he can get his revenge… until he starts streaming. As his stats rise with his view count, Suhyeok turns his revenge into a viral spectacle that no one, not even his killer, will ever see coming.

(Source: Tapas)

*"A plain face, the illegitimate child of a viscount."* 

With no notable background to boast of, Leona managed to grasp power from the lowly position of a maid, thanks to her extraordinary intellect. But when the seemingly eternal empire fell to enemy invasion, she too met her end by an enemy soldier’s blade. 

A life spent harming others for ambition, scheming without hesitation it was a life full of regrets, and so she welcomed death. But then... she came back. To the very moment she first entered the palace as a maid. Surely, this is a chance to right the wrongs of her past life. 

*"This time, I won't live a life of hurting and taking but one of protecting and nurturing."* 

With that resolve, she chooses as the key to changing this life none other than the crown prince, the political rival she had personally dethroned in her previous life. As she serves him once more, now as his maid, everything seems to be going well... Until... 

*"Leona, let’s leave this place together."*

Something feels off. The cold, indifferent crown prince she thought she knew hides a secret. And as truths buried by the world come to light, a shadow of ruin begins to fall over the empire once again. 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Heroes of Gauri, conquer this world!

The most glorious name in this land, Gauri. He who protected that name. People call him the Steel Emperor! Go Jin-Cheon, the last general of the fallen Gauri (Goguryeo). At the moment of defeat, he and his elite unit, the "Mukapguima Squad," are cast into another world. It is an unfamiliar land inhabited by various races, including elves, orcs, dwarves, and wizards. If he cannot return, he has no choice but to establish a new Gauri. Go Jin-Cheon raises his flag once again to conquer the continent.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: The Counterattack of the Heroine's Friend
description:
The thrilling counterattack of the female lead's friend against the fabricated female lead! The pitiful Mia, who served as the villainess protagonist's handmaiden, died after being wrongfully accused. That was Chae Mia's past life. Always standing by the villainess's side, passively watching her wicked deeds, running away simply because she was afraid... Deeply disillusioned by her own weakness, Mia hears an unknown voice...

\[If you could go back, would you make different choices?\]

 *'Go back...? Could I really change if I went back...? But... if I don't even try, I'll never change for the rest of my life...!'*

Mia resolved to return to her past life and change her actions. And so, she regressed to the very moment she first met the female protagonist who had tormented her.

 *‘I will absolutely live a life I can be proud of.’*

Right then and there, Mia's counterattack began. 

 *“The thrilling counterattack of the ‘female lead's friend’ against the fabricated ‘female lead’!”*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: I'm Stuck on a Remote Island with the Male Leads
description:
I’m stuck on a remote island with the male leads in an R-19 novel. I possessed Margaret, the villainess destined to be killed by the male leads after tormenting the female lead. So to survive, I have to run away from the male leads…… “Marga…… ret?” The 1st male lead’s hand grabbed my ankle as I was about to run away. From the very beginning, my plans were ruined. \*\*\* A lot has changed after I went through the twists and turns on the remote island with the male leads who hated me.

*“Don’t get away from my side, it’s dangerous.”

“Please let me help you. I’m going crazy for fear of what’s going to happen to you.”

“Look at me, okay? Can you look at me, too?”*

The crazy male leads who were supposed to be obsessed with the female lead started to obsess over me. I just want to survive safely! Moreover, this strange tropical island seems to have a deep secret that we have not yet realized.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*"It isn't the strongest who survives. The one who survives is the strongest."*

After being discharged from the military, Jin Seowoon did nothing but play games like a loser. One day, he was invited to the world of "Cloyd Survival," which resembled a game he enjoyed. In that world were masters of martial arts, kings from other worlds, and notorious killers... It was a gathering of monsters that surpassed human imagination. Jin Seowoon had just one objective—to survive and become one of the top ten. Here lies a tale of survival with Jin Seowoon's life at stake.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: How to Survive as a Wandering Knight
description:
After dying due to an unexpected accident, Kim Yohan reincarnated as Johann Aitz of the prestigious Aitz Family. He may have been born a noble, but Johann Aitz ranks at the very bottom of the family hierarchy. To make matters worse, this world revolves around a ruthless medieval society. “The only person you can trust is yourself.” In a world ruled by the law of the strong, survival requires only two things: money and power. While training relentlessly using the knowledge he gained in his modern life, Johann ends up encountering Kaegal, the Master of Poison of the Empire’s greatest assassination guild, the Nesos Guild. This is the fierce struggle of Johann, who refuses to become just another prey of this brutal era.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Reborn as a side character in a novel, Marin swears she’ll avoid every major figure in the story. But when her family collapses overnight, she finds herself cast out onto the streets with nothing.

*" I need money—fast."*

Forced by circumstance, she accepts a six-month temporary position at the estate of the novel’s blind male lead, Duke Gerald.

*“How is life in the duke’s manor?”

“Thanks to Your Grace’s generosity, I’m living quite comfortably.”

“You like living here? Then we should get engaged.”*

Marin freezes. How does enjoying life in the manor suddenly connect to an engagement?

*“Congratulations. Now you can keep living in the place you like.”

“By any chance… do I have the right to refuse?”*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

After guiding his 10,000th soul, Kai the reaper asks Shinos, the God of Death, to erase his very existence. But rather than meeting his end, Kai awakens in the body of Seian, the disgraced second son of House Shureyton. Forced to live a twisted life of regret and buried secrets, Kai must confront a past that isn’t his and find a way to rewrite a fate never meant to be. Can this once unfeeling reaper find redemption, or will his lesson in humanity end in destruction?

(Source: Tapas)

After three regressions spent as a sacrifice for the “true child of destiny,” LeBlain decides that her fourth life will be different: she will escape. To fund her exile, she chooses adoption—only to be taken in by a notorious villain family. What begins as a desperate survival plan slowly transforms into something far more unexpected: a child who tames villains with kindness, resolve, and an unshakable heart. A healing romance fantasy about growth, redemption, and finding love in the most unlikely place.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: A Revenge Guide for the Terminally Ill Maid
description:
Framed for a crime she didn't commit, Isabel died leaving behind her little daughter. Ten years later, she awakens in another woman's body, with only one year left to live. But the world she returns to is even crueler. Her daughter is now married to the very man who murdered her, all in the name of revenge. With just one year, Isabel must find a way to save her daughter, no matter the cost.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Yong-U, a tiger-superhuman working as an actor in the superhuman community, rescues a cat abused on a film set for being an unlucky black cat and takes it in. He names it Dodong and grows attached to it, but one day, when he wakes up from a nap, Dodong has vanished without a trace. He's even robbed Yong-U of his wallet and valuables! The media is abuzz with reports that Yong-U abandoned his cat, and to quell the controversy, Yong-U proposes a roommate to Hae-Dong, the cat-superhuman who tricked him into thinking he's a cat...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: Happy Face: From Slave to Arena Legend
description:
Happy, who grew up as a slave in the arena, has survived with monstrous skills. When the arena owner is executed, Happy is freed and meets new family and friends, gradually learning about society. However, the world did not give Happy the chance to stop fighting. As his identity, war on crime, and the secrets of his birth continue to intertwine, Happy becomes a being who goes beyond a monster and stands at the top of the world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: I Became the Academy's Villain's Daughter
description:
After being electrocuted while entering a VR game capsule, the protagonist wakes up inside the game “Graduate from the Academy by Luck” as “OK NO DIE,” the daughter of the main villain. Although others see her as a pitiable child raised by an evil organization, she’s secretly a hardcore gamer thrilled with stat-min-maxing. She enjoys collecting stat shards, strategizing, and training in real-combat scenarios, all while everyone else misreads her as suffering. With comedy stemming from this misperception, the story follows her lively academy life, dedicated to maximizing her stats and enjoying every moment even as she navigates a world that sees her as a tragic figure.

**Original Webtoon:**     
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/67991554), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%95%84%EC%B9%B4%EB%8D%B0%EB%AF%B8-%ED%9D%91%EB%A7%89%EC%9D%98-%EB%94%B8%EC%9D%B4-%EB%90%98%EC%97%88%EB%8B%A4/4682) 

**Official Translations:**   
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/184958)

Kang Geon, 17, transfers to a prestigious high school for only the top 0.1% of South Korean students. Raised as a secret agent in North Korea since the age of five, he is a genius and a human weapon. He is tasked with infiltrating South Korea's upper class and building connections. However, making friends proves to be a much bigger mission. This spy action drama follows Kang Geon, who lives as a fake family with his hacker father, who is under international surveillance, and his legendary assassin mother, and finds true happiness!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The peak of strength in South Korea is the Esteemed Martial Lee Clan. In that martial clan, Lee Cheol was looked down on and chased out because of his status as an illegitimate child. In order to survive, he lived in shadows, but he was chased down and killed because of his family's schemes. He was then granted a second chance—regression. Using his "ability to absorb the memories of a weapon" as a foundation, Lee Cheol would train and go down a path of struggle. Persistent competition and schemes regarding the right to inheritance, attacks from other races and monsters in dangerous, unexplored lands, and even local clashes related to his family's internal struggles... His growth would bring about these things, bringing hardship upon Lee Cheol. Life itself would be a struggle for Lee Cheol, and this is his destiny. But in order to protect himself and his surroundings—in order to protect everything—as the fight continues, he'll unravel secrets from his past life, one by one...!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Tae-Ju, the youngest son of the GG Group, a conglomerate with a long history. Living in a family that forces crazyness, he is called 'the epitome of crazy and in fact loves cute dolls and sweet desserts. However, such a shameful taste is a secret that he must take to the grave! As the day approaches when he will represent the family, he knows better than anyone that he will have to put it all down someday. Tae-Ju, who consoles himself that this is really the last time, hires a new secretary, Eun-Na, under the pretense of researching a new business, and urges her to accompany him on his dessert cafe tour disguised as work. However, Eun-Na begins to misunderstand his actions in a completely different way...

A boss who hides his taste, and a secretary who has misunderstandings. A strange tension begins to flow between the two!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The largest theme park in America has been overrun by a zombie virus. Sung-heon finds himself trapped with his daughter among zombies and foreign tourists with whom he cannot communicate. In this unprecedented disaster where any moving living creature, not just humans, is turned into a zombie, Sung-heon struggles with his injured leg to save his daughter. They must survive - from the zombies, and from them.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Kim Yong, a Zainichi Korean boy from Osaka, accidentally gets caught up in a fight with the nephew of a yakuza. Kim Yong is given the mission of infiltrating a Korean village and stealing an ID card by order of the yakuza. The villagers, who seemed ordinary, seem to be up to something... At first, he only thought of completing the mission and receiving money, but Kim Yong gradually becomes one with the villagers and joins the village's goal of 'establishing a homeland in Osaka.

(Source: Naver, translated)

A guesthouse that 'must' provide delicious meals every day. College student Ha-Ri suddenly has to run the place all by herself. But the only thing Ha-Ri can't do is cook?! There are zero applicants for kitchen staff.. at the awkward moment, a suspicious applicant appears!

\[If We Break Up, We Die\] A new romantic comedy by Bom So-Hee X KYMA!

(Source: Naver, translated)

*“Let's date. For a month, intensely.”*

Chae-Won learns that her identical twin sister, separated since childhood, has been forced into divorce by her husband and treated with contempt by her in-laws. After her sister becomes a vegetable in a traffic accident, Chae-Won devises a plan to impersonate her sister and exact revenge on her family. However, Yu-Geon, a blind date she stood up due to her sister's situation, accidentally learns of her plan. Needing to date Chae-Won to inherit property, Yu-Geon proposes a contract relationship...!

(Source: Naver, translated)

**Original Webtoon:**     
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=841755), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13006704)

The god of the Jeongpa and the magic of the Sapa. Two legendary doctors are getting married? Father is the god, mother is the magic. An absolute master appears before Dan Ak-Seon, who inherited his parents' medical skills. That fateful meeting leads the young Dan Ak-Seon to the world of martial arts...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

In-Woo has been liking Ha-Jun Kwak, who lives next door, since he was little. However, Ha-jun Kwak has a different vibe from In-Woo and is more popular, so they even play in different groups at school. The only connection between In-Woo and Ha-Jun is that they live next door. They were able to become friends because they lived next door, and their relationship continued, but once the college entrance exam is over and they become independent, this relationship will naturally end—In-Woo thinks so.

 *“I wish I could be a senior in high school my whole life.”

“That crazy kid.”

“Really… ”*

However, on the day of the college entrance exam, a sudden scream and the sound of someone running away echo through the previously quiet hallway…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: Became the Husband of the Demonic Cult's Leader
description:
I became the first son of the Demonic Heaven clan—one of the Six Great Clans of the Heavenly Demonic Cult—Jin Yeomyung. I was ready to enjoy a sweet life with a silver spoon in my mouth, but thanks to that damn Murim Alliance, the Heavenly Demonic Cult was destroyed. But in my final moments, Cult Leader Cheon Yura turned to me and said...

*“Would you mind seducing me?”*

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: The Baby Doctor With a Deadline Doesn't Hide That She's a Genius
description:
In my third life, just before becoming the empire's top councilor and returning to my original world... I was deceived by the emperor, lost my life, and reset back to age three. I refuse to reincarnate again! In my past life, my abilities blossomed, but the problem was I had no one to protect me. My trump card was my uncle, the greatest warrior, who was exiled to the East after contracting an incurable disease...

...my father. Treating him would give me a powerful ally! I hate it with a passion, but it's my last resort. I have no choice but to meet that despicable father who never once came looking for me.

 *“Father, this is a contract and a deal. I'll cure you if you become my guardian.”*

Me... will I be able to return this time?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

I was transmigrated in a novel that was written by my older sister.
But.. the atmosphere of the novel is a little strange?

After My older sister got in a car crash, I was granted an opportunity to fulfill one wish in honor of her good deeds.

So I chose to become the character my older sister cherished the most in a novel.
I ended up possessing an antagonist named 'Satin', but the complications didn't stop there.. the main character 'Cain', the main protagonist who is a holy knight keeps interfering with me.

"Hey, why are you looking at me like that? It's giving me the creeps."
"Satin, just don’t talk to me. You might as well just go die."

Even though I was not really a big fan of novels.
I still tried to dig into the uncovered mysterious secrets of the novel, and play as the 'faithful villain'

But.. my relationship with Cain started to become deeper than anyone else's..
And now everything's spiraling out of control..!!

"Satin! I really thought you were dead... So, I was planning to kill everyone..." Kill? Seriously?
Who would have thought that as a child, he was actually like a little kitten — who was feisty and stubborn?!
This is really giving me a headache...

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/505090521), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12311658), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/possessionnovel), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/possession_novel_crisis), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000068323), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/66256564), [MComics](https://www.mcomics.co.kr/webtoonComic/12855), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=250144), Toon365, ZzangComic, [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H047587385), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H047587385)

*“You smell.”*

One day, Tae-Gyeol, a 20-year-old returning student, is suddenly told by a classmate he's never met before that he smells. Though flustered by this remark he's never heard before, he tries to brush it off as a minor incident. Offended by a teacher's remark comparing him to another returning student from a different class, Tae-Gyeol impulsively heads to the classroom. There, he encounters none other than Mu-Won, the very person who had told him he smelled. When Tae-Gyeol confronts him about the earlier comment, Mu-Won evades the question with an ambiguous, half-hearted response. Annoyed by this, Tae-Gyeol finds himself strangely unable to look away from Mu-Won. Finally, Tae-Gyeol approaches first and proposes they become friends.

 *“Want to hang out with me later?”

“No...”*

Even though he clearly said no, Mu-Won is waiting for Tae-Gyeol at the school gate after class. What exactly is this guy's true intention?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: I Became the War God’s Successor
description:
One day, I suddenly became the protagonist of a game. However, the more you look at this protagonist... the more you'll sigh. He's got the worst stats, the worst talent and zero connections. But still… You have acquired \[Heavenly Martial Physique\]. You have become the master of the \[Martial God's Tome\].

*“So what? I’m the ultimate veteran player!”*

He's not just a veteran player— he’s a full-blown obsessive maniac. Thus begins the legendary playthrough of a hardcore veteran!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Every Sunday, Hongju and Cheong get together to play board games.
That day, Hongju showed up with a brand new game in hand.
“Ooh, this looks fun. Easy games are always the most fun.”
The two of them started playing, buzzing with excitement.
“…It says to suck your finger like a lollipop?”
But then… things started to get weird.
[Massage the other person’s bum five times]
[Suck the finger of the person in front of you like a lollipop]
That’s when Hongju finally realised—
the Octopus Game she brought… was actually an R-rated board game.
She tried to stop the game, but—
“So you’re backing out? That means you’re the one breaking the pact, yeah?”
“Who said I’m backing out? It’s just sucking a finger, not a big deal.”
Falling right into Cheong’s provocation, Hongju decided to keep going.
“Read the final mission out loud yourself.”

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12742057), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1561015345), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/octopus_game), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000071406), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=250507)

display_title: The Perfect Plan to Avoid the Death Ending
description:
Reincarnated as Sienna Winter, a minor villain with a terminal illness, her only goal is survival. However, she accidentally awakens a sealed demon and gets trapped in a lifelong contract. But... she's already dying?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

In a world where monsters appear and the climate changes rapidly, the only place that maintains the form of a nation is the 'Special City'. There is the infamous esper unit 'Baekgun' that is dispatched to kill monsters and absorb the outside population. Baekgun's esper Shin Hwa-Jin lives being ignored because of his origin and weak abilities. Then one day, when he hears that his twin brother, a guide, was exploited and killed by his teammates, he goes on a rampage, kills his team, and jumps off a cliff. However, when he opens his eyes, he is in the 'Library' village where he is hiding from the Special City. Shin Hwa-Jin, who lost his memory due to the shock of the jump, is saved by Tan, a man who leads the library. Tan, who lost his home and family in the Baekgun's attack, dislikes Shin Hwa-Jin who speaks the Special City dialect, but he gradually grows affectionate towards him as he loses his memory and acts innocently, naming him Hima. As he spends time with Tan and deepens his feelings and contact, Hima gradually regains his original abilities...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: A Corporate Drone Who Excels at Work
description:
Chae Gyeong-jun, who gave up both college and his dreams due to the IMF crisis, once again faces despair in front of his grandmother’s sudden hospitalization fees. But then, a “Mysterious Benefactor” steps in to cover the hospital costs for his family… 'Who would provide support that doesn’t help them at all, and why?' In search of an answer, Gyeong-jun heads to Taeseong.

(Source: Naver, translated)

On the night of the slave hunt, Paya, a girl who lost her mother, becomes a voodoo priest and embarks on a path of revenge.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: I Became the Catnip for Ruthless Beastmen
description:
Reborn as the prophesied savior of a feline tribe, a former lab victim vows to atone by helping them survive, then leave. But her plans unravel when the tribe’s proud princes, who should’ve been distant, begin circling her like curious cats.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

I was always a good person. And with a smile on my face, I ran the country into the ground. Wasting a 500 trillion won budget to chase approval ratings plunged South Korea into its second IMF crisis. His life as the president who ruined the country over, Lee Seong-jun finds himself 30 years in the past. He returns to find a budget proposal—riddled with dirty tricks, corruption, and blatant self-interest—being pushed through the Ministry of Economy and Finance.

*"I have to block all of these budget proposals, even if I'm vilified for it. It's the only way to save this country."*

The dirty tricks, political strategies, and media manipulation I learned over years in politics... I will use every last one to become the gatekeeper of the nation's coffers.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Because of his fierce appearance, Kang Woo-Hyun has never had a girlfriend, let alone a proper friend. He confesses his crush to his club senior Chae Ji-Oh while drunk. Was it the aftereffects of the confession? After dreaming of a sweet night with senior Ji-Oh, he wakes up feeling good to find "Choi Ji-Ho" next to him instead of senior Ji-Oh?! Woo-Hyun thinks this is a dream, but Ji-Ho's one word shatters Woo-Hyun's hopes.

 *"You're the one who forced me to bed and touched me, right?"*

Will Woo-Hyun be able to safely break up with his club senior Ji-Ho, who has a foul personality? A campus romance between a prickly handsome guy and a goldfish-like potato embroidery!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Jun-ho inherits his late Uncle Deok-chun's food truck. He travels the country, cooking to make the name "Go Deok-chun" known nationwide. Starting with Se-hee, the heir to a conglomerate, Jun-ho gets involved with women who each have their own stories in every region he visits! They all fall for him, but the one thing that truly captures Jun-ho's heart... is cooking! Follow the irresistible Jun-ho on his nationwide romantic food truck journey-business, let's begin!

(Source: Naver, translated)

"I want to sleep with you." 

"...What?" 

"I want to do it with Sung Ji-Won."

The day I turned 20. I spent the night with you, trying to make a memory. That's how we met again after 10 years, Joo Sung-Hyun, still handsome...

"Interest-free loan, limit is up to you, you don't have to pay it back."

"...What?"
"Keep going, acting like a live-in girlfriend." 

You still threw the wrong fastball, and I caught it. Joo Sung-Hyun, what are your true feelings?

**Original Novel:**    
[Chapters](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=11244282), [Volumes](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=12414320), [Volumes (Side Story)](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=12414330)

**Original Webtoon:**     
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=840969), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12908635)

**Official Translations:**    
[Indonesian](https://www.webtoons.com/id/romance/my-first-love-confession/list?title_no=8799), [French](https://www.webtoons.com/fr/romance/my-first-love-confession/list?title_no=9108), [Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0004166)

“I really can’t hold back anymore.” With those words, a pair of hot, alcohol-scented lips suddenly claimed mine— before I could even gather my thoughts, my dazed lips were swallowed up. ‘Uh, this is a little…’ …No, this is completely wrong! Sasha finds herself possessed inside a romance-fantasy novel where the main plot revolves around the power struggles between nobles and royals. But the moment that story becomes her reality— the genre changes entirely. It was supposed to be a wholesome, all-ages story, one where the protagonists didn’t even share their first kiss until around chapter 100... “…Why does it feel like the genre here is way too different?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

To Lord Vincent, his favorite servant, Adonis, has always appeared weak and fragile. This thought is further reinforced when Adonis becomes permanently injured in a horse-riding accident. In order to protect him, Vincent starts to keep his distance from Adonis, but that only triggers the servant to desire his master even more. Although the two of them can’t ride horses together anymore, with his whip in hand, Vincent might be willing to ride something else...

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note:
\- Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.*
*\- Includes four extra chapters.*

Eunseol, who works as an accountant at a loan office in an old downtown district, suddenly finds herself face to face with a dangerous yet captivating man: Choi Woo-kyung.    

“I can take care of the guy who’s bothering you.”    

There’s something suspicious about him — a scent of danger wrapped in charm.    

“In return, you just have to give yourself to me once.”  

“Why are you saying this to me?”.   

“I like pretty people too. And also…”Woo-kyung steps closer to Eunseol as she tries to leave, leaning in to whisper softly against her ear: “I’m really good at it.”

**Original Webtoon:**      
R19: [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/3587013405), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13465725), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/inexpensiveromance19), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/cheap_romance), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000074784), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68900355), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/webtoon/episode/toon/9093)     
R15: [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/3587013414), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13465883), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/inexpensiveromance), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/cheap_romance_15), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000074788), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68900355), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/webtoon/episode/toon/9094)

Doyul, son of the world's top assassin organization leader, transfers to a Korean high school! Arriving as a penniless transfer student, Doyul takes on a request from Dong-gu, a victim of school violence, and starts taking down the surrounding bullies one by one!

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: I’m the Only Man on the Military Base
description:
*“I’m considering sending you to join the female soldiers.”*

Jae-Jun is a participant in the -Mixed Gender Operation Pilot Program-. He ends up transferring to a military base comprised entirely of female soldiers with himself as the sole male… Will he be able to complete his military service in a base where temptation lurks around every corner?!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

The main character, No Seona, impulsively picks up a snake on her way home from work. However, it turns out that the snake is actually a member of the Suin Clan.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Rebecca, who went undercover as a spy to eliminate the mafia, intentionally approaches Daniela, the only blood relative of the mafia boss. However, as Daniela grows up and her affection for her grows, she begins to lose her sense of purpose and starts to distance herself from her. However, she fails to notice the desire hidden deep in Daniela's heart, and after carrying out the operation, Rebecca's daily life becomes increasingly tangled...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

display_title: The Regressed Extra Becomes a Genius
description:
I, a mere extra, have to protect the main character?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: My Kidnapper Is My Arranged Marriage Partner?!
description:
Unable to fully transform into a human, Laria, the white fox beastman who was considered a failure among the fox tribe, finally succeeded in transforming into the form of a little fox with fluffy white ears.

However, her joy was short-lived as she became troubled when she couldn’t revert to her human form. At that moment, she was abducted by Zenox, the black wolf beastman.

After managing to escape, three years later, Laria is forced by the crown prince’s order to attend an arranged marriage meeting with someone whose name she doesn’t even know. Reluctantly, she goes to the meeting, only to find herself face-to-face with none other than Zenox Claseum—the very same one who had once kidnapped her!

(Source: AmazonJP, translated)

Kang Su-Ji, the righteous crusader famed in high school for her intolerance of injustice. After marrying and returning to her hometown, she encounters Baek Hui-Do, her senior from her school days, as her neighbor. Yet for some reason, he displays blatant hostility toward her...

A precarious reunion romance between a woman who cannot tolerate injustice and a man who cannot tolerate her.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Kang Moo-Jae inherited the best blood in the music industry. However, he was frustrated when he witnessed the overwhelming musical talent of Jin Yu-Seong, a hearing-impaired man... A fierce competition between two boys begins for a single spot. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

*"A slave who knows things only a noble would…Who is this girl, really?"*

Lilliette, once the Empress of the vast Pardinas Empire, was killed by her lover and found herself reincarnated in the body of a nameless slave girl, roughly 17 years in the past. Choosing death over a life of pain, Lilliette provokes a noble and collapses. When she opens her eyes again, standing before her is none other than Slarhan Bentiac, her greatest political rival in her previous life. Now bound as a slave to the same capable man he was then, Lilliette begins a strange new life. 

But… why is this man unexpectedly kind and considerate to me? 

Determined, Lilliette resolves to use the knowledge from her past to help Slarhan become king for the sake of the empire and to take revenge on the lover who betrayed and killed her: Clid. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

Tae-Ha, who was barely making ends meet working as a delivery man, accidentally wins the lottery, but gets into a motorcycle accident on the way home and loses consciousness. When he opens his eyes, he finds himself as he was 10 years ago when he was a student, and to make matters worse, he finds himself in a dating simulation game... 'Find the target characters and increase their favorability ratings!' Will Tae-Ha be able to gain people's favor and return to reality?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

*"If three people do it... it's not cheating, right?"* 

On the day I had sex for the first time with my boyfriend of two months, I also had sex with his older brother. I really love him, but his older brother is so delicious...! It seems like the pleasure is stronger than the guilt, and the pheromones are a little stronger than the love. 

 *"Can't we both do it together?"*

Two brothers entered one hole.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Hua Tuo, the highest-ranking Chinese doctor of the late Han Dynasty, is possessed by a modern-day surgical intern!

“It’s so vain.” Hua-bu, who was known as a divine doctor, dies in prison from a curse that wasn’t a curse of Cao Cao…

 *“Is he still alive?”*

When he opens his eyes in excruciating pain, what he sees are… unfamiliar objects and letters he’s never seen before! 

*“W-what’s going on? Am I, am I possessed by the body of a doctor from another world?”*

Memories of the body’s owner, Lee Min-Ho, flood into Hua Tuo’s mind. No matter how different the world is, how on earth does a world like this exist…! 

*“Who summoned me into the body of this young man?”*

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

display_title: A Beginner's Guide to Hiding Zombies
description:
After a carriage accident leaves her family in (literal) pieces, Emily Walker is desperate to bring her brothers and twin sister back. With the help of a demon cat named Lev and a dabble in dark magic, she succeeds — but something isn’t right. The Walker siblings are cold, weak, and, well... dead. Now that her siblings are zombies, Emily faces a new challenge: keeping House Walker’s secret safe from the evils that await. How can she hold her family together when it seems destined to fall apart?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: My Favorite Character Wants a Divorce
description:
When I realized I had transmigrated as the woman destined to marry my favorite character, Duke Euclid Ludion, I was over the moon. Only cloud on the horizon: I'm a villainess, and based on the storyline, we're headed straight for a divorce. But I won't let that happen! Time to undo all of my character's evil deeds, clear my reputation, use my generous dowry to save Euclid's house from ruin, and win over his beloved wards. Surely, this will be enough to guarantee our happily-ever-after... right?

(Source: Tapas)

Eun-San and Hae-Gyeong, who have known each other since childhood, begin to hold each other in childhood memories after Hae-Gyeong's manifestation. Yun-San, who has now manifested as an omega, accidentally reunites with Hae-Gyeong at an amusement park and continues to secretly communicate with him without the adults knowing. After a time when they felt each other through messenger messages and pheromones on clothes due to the pheromones of their still-imperfect adolescence, the two, now fully grown adults, meet again on Jeju Island...!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: An Art Student Who Lives Twice
description:
The protagonist, Lee Jae-Ha, dreams of success as a designer, but is falsely accused of plagiarism and suffers a setback. If only he could start his life over again like in a novel... The moment he had this thought, things took a turn just like in a novel!? He suddenly found himself in a world 10 years in the past. It's the perfect time to start over. Moreover, he has the experience he gained as a working adult in his previous life. Now he can make a name for himself at university, get a job easily, and clear his name from his previous life! He will never make the same mistake again!

(Source: Piccoma, translated)

display_title: The Lucky Plan of An Idol In His Second Life
description:
Won Yu-Ha, a trainee who was unfairly robbed of the chance to appear on a survival program that was expected to be a huge hit, became a 'loser'. After six years of struggling to lead the members who had no motivation, a series of scandals among the members and a sudden traffic accident resulted in him being declared ineligible for a comeback.

 *"If I were born again, I would never become an idol."*

Just when he was about to give up on life, determined to never dream of such a life again, "Appearing on Design Your Idol. You'll give it to me, right?" He returned to six years ago when he missed the opportunity of a lifetime... ?

『Tutorial: The Crossroads of Life! Spin the Roulette and Decide Your Life!』

And what is this thing that just popped up before his eyes?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: A Million-Sub Gym Influencer Becomes a Webtoon Loser?
description:
Take a look at this—!!

\[Saving the World at the Gym!\]

The year is 20XX. With the invasion of monsters straight out of a B-movie, humanity opens its eyes to a new power! Among the heroes who ooze strength and power without having to work out is a "tiger" who guards the Stronger Gym... No, it’s not a tiger, it’s a man wearing a tiger-patterned t-shirt and pants! Today, he greets his gym babies with joy like any other day.

*"What? A gym baby?! Don't be scared. Come on in!"*

Come watch the main character and his Stronger Gym friends cultivate a healthy mind and a healthy body!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Wrongly accused and left to die, a fallen queen opens her eyes ten years earlier—back at nineteen, just after her parents’ deaths. Given a second chance, she swears never to be used again. To protect her family, she sets her sights on the empire’s highest rank of knighthood: the \*\*Chevalier\*\*. Through relentless training and treacherous court politics, she forges herself into a true warrior—until the commander of the knight order appears before her, setting a new fate into motion.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: The Courtship of the Monster Princess
description:
Sereniel was once a beautiful princess beloved by her people, until she was struck by a curse that disfigured her face, which led to her becoming known as the “Monster Princess.” Her parents shunned her and isolated her from the public, and the only person who treated her kindly was the knight Cassel. 

Sereniel had given up on her love for Cassel because of the curse. But one night at a party, she runs into Cassel, who has been drugged with an aphrodisiac, and they end up spending the night together. Forced by marry by royal decree, Sereniel is haunted by a strong sense of guilt that she had deprived Cassel of a happy future. Sereniel wants to free Cassel, so she asks him for a divorce. However, she received an unexpected answer. 

"I have no intention of letting you go." 

Sereniel believes that she will never be loved, and Cassel does not want to lose her. What will happen to their painful love affair? 

(Source: Comico, translated)

A strange door appears in front of lawyer Han Beom-Sang. Beyond it exists a space where time does not flow.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Alex grew up lonely, forced to live as an Alpha. He likes Nathan, who comforted him regardless of his traits, but pushes him away coldly to protect him from a certain incident. Nine years later, Alex reunites with Nathan as a witness in an assigned case... Alex tries to offer a belated apology, but Nathan draws a firm line. Amidst this, Alex develops hormonal abnormalities due to side effects from his suppressant, and Nathan discovers this. Contrary to his cold demeanor, Nathan steps forward to help him. Within this relationship that began without emotion, the two begin to waver once more.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Yoo-Chan, a basketball player known for his impenetrable personality, is once the team's ace. He's unable to avoid the sophomore jinx, struggling with poor performance and falling into a slump. Taking advantage of his weakness, Hana, the cheerleading team leader, offers to help.

 *"Yoo-Chan, do you know that?"
"What?"
"They say if you have sex with me, your performance will improve."*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Geum Hae-mi transforms into a hamster. Go Woo-young transforms into a cat. The only way to break the curse? Physical touch?! An electrifying campus romance between predator and prey, packed with comedy!

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=844952), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13397735)

Modern-day culinary genius Ji-Yeong suddenly finds herself transported back to the Joseon Dynasty, trapped in the royal kitchens of the most notorious tyrant in history. To keep her head on her shoulders, she must satisfy the volatile cravings of King Yeon-San-- a man whose legendary temper is as sharp as the chef’s own knives. With political rivals plotting her downfall and a mad king watching her every move, can Ji-Yeong’s 21st-century recipes serve as her ultimate shield, or will her next meal be her last?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hwa-Seon, who desperately sought to overcome his severe appearance complex by saving up money, visits a plastic surgery clinic. Driven to despair by the annoying low-balance alarm, he visits a loan shark, his last hope. There, he meets a handsome, angelic-looking man named Shi-Gyeon.

 *"Even if I have to go, I have to lend him money at least once."*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

The dragon of the four seasons, summoned to bring balance to the world—among them, the winter guardian dragon, Seherbian Winterbell. Weary of a world that only prays for wishes of fear and curses due to winter’s nature, he falls into a deep ennui. But when Rowan, the dragon priest who had watched over him for so long, dies, Winterbell decides to honor his final wish and journey through the world…

*"I wish for you to know more of this world, my dragon… Winterbell."*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Hae-Young is a perfect career woman at work, but lives the life of a thoroughly hidden otaku after work. Her peaceful double life begins to shake due to a handsome cosplayer she encounters at a weekend game event. The identity of the flashy cosplayer is Ju-Yeon, a nerd who is always quiet and inconspicuous at work! The two who have never exchanged a single word with each other end up sharing a secret against their will, and Ju-Yeon makes an unexpected offer to Hae-Young, who asks her not to reveal it at work...

Will this relationship be safe until the end?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

"Your husband must be… ridiculously handsome…”

Leah Uzkal, who grew up obsessed with good looks due to her mother’s last wish, is shocked when her arranged marriage partner is King Mikrok of Fritan, the War Demon. Refusing to marry a man she’s never seen, she decides to run away—until she bumps into the most handsome man ever.

“Who are you? State your name and status.”

“I’m Leah Uzkal… your future wife. ♥”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Those who can draw a Mind Sword are called "Warriors." Ellon sets off on a journey to become one, but the warriors he dreamed of turn out to be nothing more than brutal killing machines. Will Ellon overcome this harsh reality and become a true warrior?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Cheon Taesan, the Scholar Specialist in Reforming Scoundrels. He gains renown by rehabilitating the most notorious ruffians in the Martial Arts World (Murim). Born with the Heavenly Martial Body, he faces a cruel fate where he must acquire the Seven Stars Primordial Qi just to extend his lifespan. As he interacts with the mysterious Ice Star Body, he draws closer to the hidden truths of the Martial Arts World.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: I'm a Villainess, but I Imprinted With the Male Lead
description:
I accidentally spent a night with a stranger. And it was the male lead! 

I've tried so hard to live differently from the original! Even though things have turned out this way, the fact that the male and female leads had to be connected remained unchanged. Luciana tried to run away, no, to let it be a one-night stand, leaving Licht behind. 

*"That's impossible."
"...Huh?"
"Because last night, Young-Ae and I were imprinted on each other."* 

Oh my. Her soul was already bound to the male lead, as if she were one body.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

One day, Eun-Chan Jung receives a confession from Seo-Yeon Kwon, a promising junior in Taekwondo who is in a slump. Because of his meddlesome personality, he cannot just ignore the promising junior, so he promises to accept her confession if she wins a gold medal in the next competition. Eun-Chan ignores his feelings, saying that it is a win-win relationship that helps both sides, and begins to pile up actions that he will regret more and more…

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

A mysterious wallet whose limit increases by 1 million won every second. But there's a catch: every time you withdraw money from it, something related to you decreases! The problem is, they say it's impossible to know what's decreasing...? Despite this, these people are determined to become the wallet's owners. Just for today, just for this month... Embracing the sweet reality of 1 million won every second, they withdraw money again and again, oblivious to the price they're paying. Can the astronomical sums of unearned income buy the happiness they desire? Or, perhaps what they're losing is true happiness itself?

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: The Eldest Son of the Marquis House Is a Martial Artist
description:
In a fantasy world in a novel, I am the only one using martial arts.

[Original Webtoon](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12980025)
*Note: Part of Metatoon's Sinbuncha Danpyeonseon (신분차 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: Not Just the Two of Us!
description:
Sul-i, who was ostracized because things got awkward when she was alone with someone, made her own rule to never be one-on-one with anyone. However, she ends up in a situation where she has to spend the entire day with...

**Original Webtoon:**      
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=838944), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12564220) 

**Official Translations:**     
[Indonesian](https://www.webtoons.com/id/romance/not-just-the-two-of-us/list?title_no=8283)

display_title: I Don't Like This Kind of Reverse Harem
description:
*"I don't need permission. I'm looking for a husband, not my brother or my father's husband."*

Natalie Ailesden was the most beautiful and dangerous thorny woman in the empire. I possessed her, the main character in the reverse harem game. I thought I could clear it quickly because it's a familiar game...

*"Did you clean up all the other women?"*

The flirtatious prince, Amon Luxor. Route completed; "I thought I had a purpose for my energy." The cold grand duke of the north, Roger Crawford. Route completed;

*"I taught you that if you cling to it while crying, you can have a woman's heart..."*

The crying psychopath mage, Igor. Route completed. I've captured all the male leads, but why hasn't the ending appeared?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

In South Korea, where the juvenile law has been abolished and rehabilitation centers for juvenile offenders have been established, Min-su, who has been wrongfully accused of murder and sent to a rehabilitation center, realizes that it is a hell from which he can never escape through normal means. Min-su's older brother, Yu-seong, infiltrates the rehabilitation center as a guard to save his brother in crisis... A desperate struggle for survival and escape unfolds as the two brothers fight against false justice! 

(Source: Naver, translated)

Finally, Go Eun-Woo has been appointed as the first health teacher. His job satisfaction is 100%. Stable, sweet vacation, relatively punctual work hours. 'A neat and handsome health teacher with a sad look.' All the fellow teachers and students look favorably on Eun-Woo. Oh, just one person. Except for the ethics teacher Im Seok-Ju who seems to have come from the Joseon Dynasty.

 *"What did you teach in sex education? Why are you handing out these things (condoms)?"

"Haven't you ever thought that you'd get complaints from the school administrators?"

"Sexual intercourse. It's a noble act that a man and a woman unite to conceive a life when they truly love each other after marriage."*

Im Seok-Ju, who advocates premarital chastity, and Go Eun-Woo, who pursues MAX sexual desire and free sexual relations, were fundamentally mismatched from start to finish. Of course, that was until he saw Im Seok-Ju masturbating in the bathroom.

 *"Teacher, should I help you?"*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

In a small town called Leo. Ruben, the wizard who isn’t just known for his title as the ‘Rising Star’ or for his powerful potions. He’s also beloved by the ladies in town for his gentle nature, charming looks, and single status. But one day, a rare creature suddenly rolls into his life. Ruben, thrilled by the thought of wealth and fame, even gives it a cute nickname: Squishy. But the next morning… 

What he finds in his bed isn't squishy, but a beauty?! 

*"From now on, I’m calling you Squishy. If you don’t like it, remember your real name."*

A genius female surgeon who hates humans, a germaphobe, emotionally detached, and terrified of physical contact, Irene Rios. The third prince of the Kingdom of Divoa, praised by all, the Grand Duke of the North, weary and bored with life, Diego Cassis. Two people who defy each other’s common sense, meet by chance, finding one another strangely intriguing.

*"Miss Irene Rios, would you become my personal physician?"

"No. I cannot be a doctor."*

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: The Neighbor Star Who Bewitched Me
description:
Lim Su-Jeong, a 27-year-old fashion magazine editor, has a special affection for her self-reliant life. She doesn't just find being alone comfortable—she prefers it. Finding reassurance in what she can control, she never considered fitting ‘romance’ into her life. She simply adored and loved SS Boys' Kang Chan, a celebrity with the perfect distance, as her ultimate favorite. Then, like a bolt from the blue, dating rumors about ‘Kang Chan’ hit Su-Jeong, who was going about her usual routine. And the woman involved was none other than ‘Sa-Ra’, a female celebrity constantly embroiled in scandals. After a grueling day in every way, she came home to find Kang Chan's merchandise scattered everywhere. Feeling overwhelmed about when she'd ever clean it all up, she heard the sound of piano music from the apartment above. Today, she absolutely couldn't take it anymore!!! With a “I'll kill you and then kill myself!!!” mindset, she ran up and pounded on the door of apartment 502 above.

 *“Seriously, playing piano late at night is not okay..?!”*

Creak. The door opened cautiously, and out stepped... Sa-Ra?! *“Wow, seriously... she's so freaking pretty.”*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

A strange debt repayment began. Ku Tae-Gam, manager of the illegal loan company ‘Takatsu’. The only female employee, accountant Chae Hui-On. Change comes to them—supervisor and subordinate, nothing more, nothing less.

 *“My grandmother's hospital bills are three months overdue.”

“Look elsewhere. I can't lend you money even if you starve to death today.”*

He refused outright, but Tae-Gam couldn't stop thinking about Hui-On's unexpectedly vulnerable side, something he'd never seen before. Then, he rescued Hui-On from danger and they ended up drinking together. While Tae-Gam slept drunk, he was kissed like a thief in the night.

 *“......You, damn it.”
“Why are you cursing? Was it that bad?”* 

Only much later did he realize that kiss was a ploy to learn the office safe's password, but Tae-Gam couldn't bring himself to abandon Hui-On, standing on the edge of a cliff.

 *“Write this down. Don't miss a single word.”*

A wretchedly scribbled loan agreement on a scrap of napkin. Twenty thousand won a day. To be repaid in cash, no exceptions.

 *“I'll chase the bastard who borrowed my money to the ends of hell.”*

Each exhausting day only ended after exchanging twenty thousand won. Days piled up where he couldn't tell if he was repaying debt or accumulating it. Those days gradually took root deep within their lives.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Ji-Woo, the owner of a car center and former racing car mechanic, has a strange regular customer who visits his shop after closing time: Bin, a former race car driver and former teammate. Ever since, Bin, who has had a crush on Ji-Woo, has a penchant for womanizing, and on race days, he uses the pretext of relieving his post-race excitement by having passionate sex with Ji-Woo at his car center. One day, Ji-Woo, who has been waiting for Bin, begins to feel resentful that Bin only satisfies his desires and then leaves without a trace, and the desire to torment her by having sex with her begins to sprout.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

display_title: Sex Games with the Youngest Son of a Chaebol Family
description: *Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

display_title: How to Live as the Tyrant's Wretched Older Brother
description:
On the day the empire fell to rebellion and invasion from another world, Valen met his end alongside his sister, the Emperor. But when he opened his eyes again, he found himself 40 years in the past. This time, he vowed to do whatever it took to prevent the world’s destruction and protect the Emperor. And his solution? To live an even wilder life than before. “If I was a scoundrel in my past life, then this time… I’ll be the ultimate menace!”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: Joseon Prince Went to America and Never Returned
description:
Due to a sudden natural disaster, Park Byung-Jun, a Korean-American lobbyist, finds himself reincarnated as Yi Kang, the second son of Emperor Gojong of the Korean Empire, at the moment of his death. Armed with his knowledge of original historical events, he travels to the United States and begins a new business venture to amass wealth!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

After her grandmother passed away, Na Su-Hyeon returned to her hometown after settling down in the city. As if drawn by something, Su-Hyeon climbs 'Obongsan', which her grandmother had told her never to climb while she was alive. When she gets lost in the mountains and is caught up in strange events and is in danger, Su-Hyeon receives help from a man named Seo Moon-Ju, who is still fine even after being beheaded... Moon-Ju tells her that Su-Hyeon is the reincarnation of her former divine mother, the shaman Kang Yu-Hwa, and that the strange events that are unfolding before her eyes happened because Su-Hyeon climbed Obongsan. Moon-Ju finds this very suspicious, but after she encounters ghosts who steal the weapons buried in Kang Yu-Hwa's grave and gain power, Su-Hyeon feels a sense of responsibility. Moon-Ju speculates that the 'evil spirit' that drove Kang Yu-Hwa to death in the past must have been moved by Su-Hyeon's energy and dug up her grave. In the end, Su-Hyeon decides to listen to the voices of the ghosts and retrieve the five weapons together with Moon-Ju.. 

Will the two be able to defeat the evil spirits and end Moon-Ju's curse of immortality?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Single dad Son Hui-Woo finds himself caught in an attack of unknown origin. The one who appears before this crisis is... his former lover, Mun Tae-Ha. Tae-Ha approaches, claiming he'll take responsibility now that his wife is dead, but his words feel suspicious. And then the truth is revealed. His relationship with Hui-Woo was a ‘planned approach’ from the start. Swallowing his betrayal, Hui-Woo resolves.

 *'I won't be fooled again. This time, I'll use you.'*

Their second relationship, born of lies, begins to flow in a new direction.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
*Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae(純愛) Danpyeonseon (순애(純愛) 단편선) Collection.*

Ours, a small idol group with talent but low recognition, recruits visual member X to enter the music charts. With X's appearance, Ours explodes in popularity! They are truly at the peak of their career. However, X dies in an unexpected accident... The protagonist, Luan, who can control corpses, must use his powers to protect his position as a top idol!

(Source: Naver, translated)

On-Ha, who has never left the palace. She has always been interested in sex, but is dumbfounded when she is told that she must marry a child who will soon be seven years old, unlike herself who is already an adult. On-Ha wants to experience various things before marriage, and a book falls in front of her, and from it jumps the nine-tailed fox Ain and the yellow-haired goblin Cheongrin.

 *"Release our seal, and I will grant you what you wish."*

As she dates the monsters under the pretext of seeing the world, On-Ha begins to feel a strange thrill towards Ain and Cheongrin...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The subcontractors were nothing more than robots I was grateful for. It was only natural to squeeze everything out of them. But after being betrayed by the group I worked for, I opened my eyes in a new body and finally saw the tears of those "robots." Having gained a second life on the brink of death, can my soul be saved?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Woo-Jin coincidentally encounters omega Yoo-Hyuk, who has milk-scented pheromones, at a house he visited for his delivery job. The two have no choice but to spend a night together due to Yoo-Hyuk's sudden heat cycle. However, something sweet is flowing out of Yoo-Hyuk's chest, who is a man...?

 *"Is this... milk?"*

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

*Note: Includes nine extra chapters.*

display_title: The Hero Saves Herself with Her Body
description:
I accidentally got possessed while working overtime! And it was in a game that was scheduled to be scrapped after being deemed harmful by the review committee. Now, in order to return home, I had to raise my ‘ability’ and become a hero. But the method to raise that ability was… 

*“Ability can be obtained every time you seduce a man with a ‘strategy card’. To be exact, it’s based on semen absorption.”*

She had discovered a new aptitude. One that she couldn’t find anywhere, at school or work. Its name was semen absorption.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Riyun Adinmir grew up being regarded as the disgrace of the perfect Adinmir family, a fact that deeply shaped her perception of herself. Constantly comparing herself to her relatives and those around her, Riyun considers herself twisted and flawed. Despite this, after three years of suppressing her temperament and enduring life at the Academy, her true character eventually comes to light. However, the consequences take an unexpected turn, diverging from what Riyun had envisioned.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Park Sang-Woo is a thoracic surgery chief who has lived without regard for means and methods for success. However, his life is turned upside down in an instant due to an unexpected accident. Unexpectedly, he returns to his rookie intern days and gains a special ability to see the remaining lifespan of patients. Using this ability, he tries to start the path of a true doctor that he had turned away from in his second life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Shin-Hae, South Korea’s one and only S-class guide, receives a secret request: to oversee an unusually young high-ranking esper. As five-year-old Tae-Hyun grows up under Shin-Hae’s care, he develops deep affection for him. However, due to an organization’s attempt to kidnap the powerful esper, Tae-Hyun loses all memory of Shin-Hae...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

display_title: I Brought the Male Lead to His Knees Before Me
description:
Before I died, I was reincarnated into my favorite novel as Iena, a supporting character and an actress — a profession scorned in the Empire. After reincarnating, I had to “discipline” a few pests who kept bothering me. 

Then one day, the Crown Prince approached me with a strange proposal… 

“I heard there’s no man who doesn’t fall from just one of your gestures.” 

I think we’re imagining very different kinds of gestures here. 

“They say no one can meet your eyes when you smile.”

That’s because they’re scared of me…

“Use whatever means necessary to make the Duke fall for you.” 

Excuse me, Your Highness… I think you’ve come to the wrong person!!! 

The Duke is the male lead, and he already has a destined female lead he’s supposed to fall in love with!! I agreed to the Crown Prince’s plan, deciding to just hang in there until the real female lead shows up.

...but something’s gone off track? 

“Your Grace, desire isn’t inherently bad. If you want something, speak up confidently. But if the other person says no, you step back. That’s all it takes.” 

“Is that so?” 

“Yes.” 

“Then allow me to be bold. Iena, I wish to hold you.” 

…Are you being serious right now?

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/남주를-내-밑에-꿇려-버렸다/4503), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/66555139)

**Official Translations:**    
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/190965)

Pil-Sang ends up living with Joo-Eon to treat the side effects of Sianacin. Joo-Eon, whose true intentions are unknown, secretly takes care of and protects Pil-Sang, even though no one knows what he's thinking. When asked, "Do you like me?", Joo-Eon tells him to say something reasonable and laughs until he's out of breath, but he doesn't tolerate Pil-Sang leaving his side even an inch. Then one day, he becomes unexpectedly affectionate. He wonders, "What on earth is he doing?" but a strange emotion blooms somewhere in Pil-Sang's heart... 

What will be the end of this fierce battle of cohabitation between Joo-Eon, the chairman who was born with a diamond spoon in his mouth, and Pil-Sang, a loan shark who lives at the bottom?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Edith—who lost her mother at the hands of the Reynolds marquis family—was branded a madwoman. She dreams of vengeance, but a chance comes to the powerless: marriage to the third prince, Duke Myers, who is rumored to be perfect in every way. It’s a marriage of convenience meant to use one another, and that’s fine. If I can make you live through hell without even knowing it’s hell, I will do whatever it takes. Keep smiling, Reynolds. Until I have paved the road to the very fires of hell right before you.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Back at school after a year. On her first day back, she thought it would be fun, but a miraculous turn of events landed her in the same class as her younger sibling. Then, a stranger caught her embarrassingly...! And why did that man have to be Seo Jin-Young?! Why am I getting involved with Jin-Young, whom I haven't spoken to all school year, now?

Da-Jung's school life is going haywire... Please, let her graduate safely!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Tang Mujin, a young physician hailing from the Tang Family Clinic of Sichuan, had a strange dream... one where he became the legendary blacksmith Ou Yezi and ascended to the heavens.

(Source: Naver, translated)

I'm going to tell you a story about a failed relationship. I didn't know it would turn out like this. But everyone has a story like this. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

Reincarnated as the daughter of a disgraceful marquis, she works hard to fix her father’s mistakes and earns the respect of her grandfather, only to find herself entangled in a web of obsession.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A survivor of a ruined family, 'Louise Idiana' was living in hiding as a maid. Then one day, "So this is where you were, my lady." The slave she had sold, 'Sed Rufus', returned as a duke.

"No, I believe you've mistaken me for someone else, Your Grace."

A cold voice, unlike in the past, could be heard.

*"I told you, I would never lose you again."

"As much as you have fallen, I have risen."*

(Source: Naver, translated)

*"The job is simple. You just have to be a dog."*

When his father's company went bankrupt, Dale Jackson was in debt. As he wanders helplessly in the midst of the Great Depression, a strange proposal comes to him. Unable to pass up the opportunity to work for the Baskervilles, the richest man in New York, Dale finally accepts the offer.

Seo Yue, who was forced to marry the barbarian King of Northern Wei instead of the legitimate princess, is now in the position of a false princess. The King of Northern Wei's reaction to Seo Yue is somewhat strange.

*"This ugly body. The mere smell of rain makes me horny..."

"Come to the bridal chamber quickly, my beautiful princess."*

How can they be having a wedding while the sun is still high in the sky?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

display_title: The Ugly Wife of the Shady Duke
description:
*"Please, do not leave me." 

"We should get a divorce. You don't love me, do you? We... only got married for our families' sake." 

"Why… Why are you saying such things? Did I do something wrong to you? If you want me to kneel, I will. If you don’t like my face, I will wear a mask for the rest of my life. So, please… please, do not leave my side."*

My husband, whom I married through an arranged marriage, is the second male lead who harbors an unrequited love for the heroine of The Saintess’ Wish, the novel I have possessed. And I, his lawful wife, am destined to endure a lonely marriage before meeting a mysterious death. For my own survival—and for his love—I decided to cleanly end our marriage. But…

*"Why is he holding onto me? Aren’t you supposed to love Aria???"

"This novel’s world… is different from what I knew. What is the truth?"*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A guild master, once ranked number one, wakes up 500 years in the future after winning a major siege. The guild is gone, the world feels strange, and everything has fallen apart. Determined to rebuild the guild and adapt to this unfamiliar time, they embark on a journey to restore their legacy and conquer the challenges of the new era.

*“Even after losing her memories, it’s still Jin Kyudo… What a cruel connection…”*

Jin Kyudo, in his attempt to start a new life, reunites with his long-lost lover Shin Danbi at the company where he has just been hired. While Kyudo is completely flustered, Danbi remains eerily calm. The truth is, an accident erased every bit of their past together from her memory. Not wanting to hurt her twice, Kyudo tries to distance himself. But Danbi keeps getting drawn to the warmth and strange familiarity she feels from this strange man. This way, a tangled romance unfolds. Kyudo struggles in his attempt to let go, Danbi refuses to, and Ahn Choi weaves herself between them like a thread in a messy knot. Into the empty space left by lost memories, new emotions slowly soak in.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Ael, a mermaid with a kind and upright personality, meets the lost mermaid Ort one day while swimming in the sea and takes him in. The young Ort grew up well under Ael's care, but his obsession with Ael became so strong that he continued to hover around Ael even after becoming an adult... Unable to stand by any longer, Ael tries to persuade Ort to become independent, but Ort is furious that Ael, whom he thought of as his companion, is trying to send him far away. In the end, Ort makes Ael feel firsthand how precious he is to him... Ael is gradually losing his body and mind to Ort, who was like a son and younger brother to him, and Ort does not want to let him go. What will be the end of their relationship?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

One day, “Rose” got lost in the forest and met the “Ghost” who lived there. She set out to prove that this “nobody”—a person the world said didn’t exist—was real, and ended up falling in love. But a “Witch” keeps getting between them…
Now I’ve become the “nobody” instead. 

Can our love ever come true?

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=844571), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13355629)

**Official Translations:**    
[S.Chinese](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/LOVE/bucunzaideren/list?title_no=2888)

display_title: Did Someone Forced You to Be the Heavenly Demon?
description:
Seo Ji-Hun, a 9th-grade civil servant, longed for a long, peaceful life. However, he was stabbed to death by a malicious complainant, and opened his eyes in the martial arts world where martial arts existed. He longed for a quiet life there, but an unavoidable figure appeared before him.

 *"Choose. Death here, or becoming my disciple."*

The old man, who suddenly thrust a knife into his throat, was the leader of the Cheonma Sect. Believing that survival was the only way to achieve success, Seo Ji-Hun, reluctantly, decided to become a Cheonma. Originally a capable civil servant, he grew into a unique talent within the cult with his powerful martial arts skills and exceptional wisdom—but why does his workload keep piling up?
