Why does he keep getting promoted? His original goal was simply a "peaceful life," but somehow, his second life spiraled into the path of the Cheonma. Will he ever find the life he truly desires in this world?

(Source: Naver, translated)

*“I am from the afterlife.”* 

Lee Do-Jin, who needs a huge amount of money to pay for his younger brother’s medical expenses. He contacts her after being led by a suspicious business card he found by chance, and meets a strange silver-haired woman named Cha-Sa at the meeting place. She offers Do-Jin a job as an afterlife dispatch worker to stop the predator Mokdugi, who preys on the souls of humans who have accumulated evil deeds…

(Source: Naver, translated)

*The silence is over. Now his fight begins!*

One day, Ji-Jun, a transfer student who never speaks, overpowers the bullies in his class with overwhelming skill. Because of this fight, Ji-Jun becomes the center of attention of the bullies inside and outside the school. And another silent female student begins to watch Ji-Jun.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Go Seunghwan, a former world champion in jiu-jitsu, wakes up to find the world has collapsed into chaos. Civilization is gone. The streets are overrun with zombies. And worst of all—he’s already infected. But that doesn’t matter. He has one goal left. To find and save his daughter, no matter the cost. Even if his body fails, his will won’t. A father’s final fight begins—against the undead, against time, and against himself.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Graduate student Shin Kang-Hyeok has his thesis stolen for years by his respected advisor Lee Jun-Tae. Kang-Hyeok, who is unable to protest to the academic community because of the professor's connections, accidentally discovers videos of all kinds of perverted acts on the professor's tablet and plans to use them as a weakness...

 *"From now on, I'm going to make you my slave, professor."*

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

Ji-Yu, a timid high school girl who wants to live an ordinary life, saves her childhood friend Do-Kyung from jumping off the rooftop on the first day of moving in. Together with Do-Kyung, who was a victim of school bullying, Ji-Yu begins an unexpected high school survival story.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Five hundred years have passed since Mu-Jin began praying for the lost souls' ascension. Then, his lover, Geum-Ji, who died 300 years ago, appeared before him, reincarnated. However, she was already dead in this life. Unaware of her own death, she returned to Mu-Jin.

(Source: Naver, translated)

For nine long years, the dynamic between them remained completely unchanged: Choi Yeong-Hyeon was the ruthless, unpredictable delinquent, and Lee Min-Woo was his submissive, personal toy. No matter how volatile Yeong-Hyeon’s moods became or how cruelly he pushed boundaries, Min-Woo always obeyed with a gentle, compliant smile. This toxic game, which had steadily consumed their youth since middle school, finally reached its breaking point. 

Deciding he had grown bored of the arrangement, Yeong-Hyeon abruptly declared an end to their twisted relationship. However, he gravely overlooked a crucial piece of the puzzle. The realization hits him too late when he wakes up bound and trapped inside a locked, unfamiliar room. Staring into the eyes of his supposedly docile captive, a terrified Yeong-Hyeon is forced to face a horrifying truth: he was never the master of this game. In reality, he was Min-Woo’s personal toy all along.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*"Jae-Hee, why do you always carry two copies of your script?" "Well, you might lose them."* 

That's a lie. One is for carrying around to the filming set and showing it to others. The other is. \[The drama 'Youth Train' can be absorbed.\] \[Would you like to absorb it?\] It is for my own consumption. I devour the script and make it mine alone. The story of Jae-Hee, an actor who can absorb a script 100%.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Tae-Jun, who has finally realized his dream of becoming a police officer, is full of high hopes of becoming a hero to the community, but he is assigned to a peaceful rural town. One day, while on patrol, he comes across Ji-U in a field and, mistaking him for a thief, arrests him…

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Despite his kind face and good reputation, Ha-Yun's hobby are one-night stands. One day, he becomes captivated by Seo-Jin, a new member of his club, and decides to try sleeping with him. Contrary to his thuggish appearance, with his tanned skin, muscular build, and bright yellow hair, Seo-Jin is the epitome of innocence. Ha-Yun manages to break through his innocence and have a one-night stand with him, but the next day, he tries to sort things out...

*"I agreed because I like you, hyung."

"This is my first time dating."*

How can he get this out of his head...?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

The protagonist, Kim Geon-Pyo, was left with her soul stolen by a rookie grim reaper's mistake. From that day on, everything in the world hates her. Especially that grim reaper!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Two years ago, Gyudam broke up with Myungjin because he was enlisting in the military. They run into each other again by chance at school, but because of ghosts, Gyudam doesn’t recognize Myungjin. Shocked that his hyung has completely forgotten him, Myungjin gets into a traffic accident and, in an out-of-body state, appears again in front of Gyudam, who can see ghosts…

*“What if I pass on without ever getting to put mine inside you, hyung?!”*

---

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/ExNoCism)

**Official Translations:**  
[T.Chinese](https://www.bomtoon.tw/detail/ExNoCism), Japanese (Jun 15, Beltoon)

*“Don’t you want to sleep with me just once?”

“I guess you forgot that this is a business marriage. Or do I look cheap?”*

Seol-Young was the one who brought up the subject as soon as the meeting was over. She knew that this was a political marriage. Marriage was an escape for her, and she wanted to get pregnant and see her biological mother. Beom-Hyeon, who was smoking a cigarette in the smoking room and clicking his Zippo lighter, took the cigarette out of his mouth and said, “Can’t you see this as an extension of business?”

*“What kind of business do you do with sperm?”*

(Source: Naver Series, translated) 

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

*Please let me spend one night with a sexy, handsome, charismatic man.*

Every Christmas, Lee An, the eldest son of the conservative Korean Lee family, would write down his secret sexual fantasy—one he could never share with anyone—in a wish, stuff it into his stocking, and then burn it away unseen. This Christmas returned without fail, and as usual, the only response to his lewd wish note was a sudden surge of work left for him to handle due to his boss's unexpected absence. Feeling restless and unsettled, Ian ended up attending a meeting in his place. There, dressed entirely in red, stood an overwhelmingly handsome man: Hakan Claus. Dragged along by this high-pressure, cold man, Ian barely finished the meeting and stood up. Suddenly, the man asked him what his Christmas wish was this year...

*Last year's Christmas wish... what was it again? Hmm, it was ‘I want to be tied up all Christmas and have sex like an animal,’ right?*

Was this man... really Santa Claus?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Oh, I'm the strongest demon cult member of the Nine Heavens, but I know how to return to the demon cult.

The absolute being who trampled the martial arts world and reigned at the top, Gucheon. He was the one who led the Demonic Cult to its peak, and to the Jeongpa, he was called the Heavenly Demon itself. The last Demonic Cult war fought by all the martial arts sects including Goopa. After a fierce battle, Gucheon was killed by an unknown being. 

The moment I thought it was all over... I opened my eyes not in the martial arts world, but in a weak body in the modern era?! 

*"What is this...? This strange place?! Send me back!!"*

Gucheon descends into the modern era...!!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: My Male Lead Is a Northern Dark-Haired Grand Duke
description:
I thought I had died in a car accident, but instead, I was reborn as the playmate of the Northern Duke’s heir. But this poor thing is always sickly and in ill health, and destined to have his love, the princess, taken away by another man. In that case, I’ll help him become the perfect Dark-Haired Northern Duke and achieve love! That was my plan, but… Why is our Setsu so cute and sweet? Can I really succeed?

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: Can You Turn Down Freshly Baked Bread?
description:
Oh Seong-Hwan, the owner of a bakery called 'Ppang Ppang Village' in a small provincial town. Since he was young, he has been linked up and down with all the gays in the neighborhood in search of true love, but has yet to meet someone he likes. Then one day, Seong-Hwan is insulted by his boyfriend and they break up. The scene is caught by Kim Ji-Woo, a part-time worker and disciple of the bakery. Ji-Woo immediately starts to confront Seong-Hwan, who is flustered, asking how he is?!

 *"I can do better...! Please date me!"*

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

display_title: Player of the Fallen Noble Family
description:
Lee Yun, the youngest son of the Sermin family, a prominent house on the Dreia Continent. The once peaceful family descends into ruin after the disappearance of his father and brothers. And in the moment everything collapses, Lee Yun is captured by the Paton family and meets his end after horrific torture. But when he opened his eyes, he found himself not in reality, but in Adeon; an endless battlefield and playground of the gods. In that place where countless players lost their lives, Lee Yun grew into the Ghost King, a master player who mastered all classes: Assassin, Necromancer, and Ghost. He challenged the gods. He met his end in defeat, but his story did not end there. The moment he awoke again, he had returned to his childhood at age twelve, retaining the power of a player. To prevent his family's downfall and reclaim everything lost, Ri-yun now begins transforming reality into his own game board. His first target is bloody vengeance against the Paton family, another great clan that destroyed the Sermin family and killed him.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

“I think… I might be able to get married.” Song Chaeyeon, who cannot be intimate with men due to past trauma. Yet for her, marriage was an inescapable destiny. At 28, when hope seemed nowhere in sight, Woo Taeseok’s “gift” appeared like a miracle. “Say no.” “Huh?” “Whether it’s to your future husband, or to me who’s crazy about you right now. Say no. You were hurt, weren’t you?” It couldn’t possibly be sincere—it was just words meant to teach her. But how could he act so much like a man in love? “If you understand, come here.” But this is as far as it goes. This relationship is only part of a lesson. And every lesson must come to an end.

**Original Webtoon:**     
R19: [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13133628), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/5285001603), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/metatoon069), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/dirty_class), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000073340), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68861090)    
R15: [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13133689), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/5285001604), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/metatoon070), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/dirty_class_15), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000073341), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68861160)

The emperor had murdered both of her parents. Since she was about to be claimed, Seo-Hae made up her mind: "In that filthy golden bed, I will bite off my tongue and die."Just as she was being brought into the emperor's chamber, word came that barbarians had invaded the capital. Those beast-like individuals have come to devour this country. The emperor has been replaced, and there came a new era. Even though she had never heard of a red-haired god, to her, the man everyone called beastly is one.

I have a friend. My night friend, whom I only meet at night. I don't know his name, age, or contact information. All I know is his sculpted, handsome face, his intense gaze that leaves me frozen, and his fierce movements that carried me to a pleasure I'd never experienced before. One day, a month into our relationship, I saw him by chance. During the day. At work.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The last guy you’d expect. The one suit that changes everything. Kim Jiwon grew up in the shadows with no parents, no guidance, and no future. To him, a hoodie is more than just clothing—it is armor against a world that never once gave him a chance. But when he’s pulled into a dangerous incident, something hidden inside him awakens. Now, recruited into Baekya, a covert spy organization that works in the shadows, Jiwon faces a world of secrets, suits, and silent wars. This isn’t just survival. It’s a battle to find the life—and the look—that finally fits.

(Source: Naver, translated)

How can one ever be satisfied with just one? That's Haru's life motto. As usual, he lures a younger guy who enters his strike zone and devours him whole. Not bad for a hetero guy being his first~ he thinks for a split second, Did this guy just eat me up??!! 

The more he thinks about it, the more infuriating it gets—that big-dicked, handsome, cute, infuriating bastard! He happens to run into him again in a college liberal arts class, but this time he claims not to know him... His speech and behavior are completely different. Is this some kind of concept thing...?

What...? He's a twin...? That's a lie, right...?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

display_title: Thud... Did I Fall in Love With You?
description:
Woobin, the popular boy at school, is secretly a huge fan of the anime "Love Love Me", especially its heroine, Yoi. The moment he meets Ah-yoon, a classmate who looks just like Yoi, he falls for her at first sight... A fluttering high school romance between Woo-bin, the popular boy hiding his otaku identity, and Ah-yoon, the ultimate otaku who dreams of sharing her favorite anime with everyone!

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: [Dirty Talk Anthology] I Asked My Sex Friend to Break Up
description:
*"I won't have sex with you anymore."* 

A long-time sexual partner is about to end their relationship. I can't do this kind of relationship where I only have sex with the person I have a crush on.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Deotitong Danpyeonseon (더티톡 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: In This Life, You Are a Dog
description:
*“The hunt is over, so the hound must die.”*

Belita, who became the consort of Emperor Kairos of Canavan to protect the Kingdom of Gores, loses everything—her husband, her child, her country—and is killed. But when she opens her eyes again, she finds herself back seven years in the past, and vows revenge against Emperor Kairos and Empress Drusilla, the root of all her suffering...

She finds herself in danger of being exposed as a rebel by the Empire's deposed Crown Prince, Aaron! 

 *‘Can I make Aaron my first hunting dog?’*

Will Belita succeed in taming Aaron and achieving her revenge? A perilous romance between Imperial forces and rebels!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Hong Yo-Han has finally realized his dream of owning his own home. On the first day of moving in, he invites his friends over for a housewarming party and spends his first night in his new home with excitement, but unexpectedly sees a ghost. Thinking it was just a nightmare, Yo-Han is tormented by the ghost appearing at random times. By chance, he discovers that the clue to solving the ghost problem lies with his awkward colleague, Go Philip, and in desperation, he invites Philip into his home...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
The second season of *Changcheonmusin*.

The protagonist, who had worked himself to the bone at the Murim Alliance, finally retires and heads back to his hometown to fulfill his dream of becoming a sect leader. Due to his meager savings, he ends up purchasing a manor that was suspiciously cheap, and rumored to be haunted. But then, an unfamiliar system suddenly appears before him. Though startled at first, the protagonist soon begins to use the system to efficiently recruit disciples and manage the sect’s finances and resources. In time, with the help of the system, his sect grows rapidly, so much that it starts drawing the attention, wariness, and hostility of other Murim factions…

(Source: Naver, translated)

A girl whose wish is to see the ocean. A boy who is afraid of the outdoors goes on a school trip that was canceled to fulfill her wish.

(Source: Naver, translated)

A quiet rural village. Alec, a handsome transfer student from the city, spots So-Ho, shunned by everyone for "shooing away even forest monsters." Alec, who was trying to unravel his own hidden, twisted complexes toward So-Ho, is overcome by an inexplicable emotion the moment he meets So-Ho's eyes behind his glasses. The forest he and So-Ho went to escape his father becomes their private nest.

 *"You will become my monster."*

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

*“Don’t you think we’re missing that heart-fluttering feeling?”*

From elementary school all the way to high school, Nam Do-yeon and Jeong A-rin have gone from childhood friends to lovers. For a couple who strives for a perfectly rational relationship, a plan to reclaim that one missing piece of excitement. Operation: Heartbeat begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)

In Murim, four of the most feared criminals were known as the "Bloodstorm Lions"—ruthless, merciless, and utterly irredeemable. But one day, they were given something unbelievable: a senior disciple. And not just any master... Their new "Grand Senior Brother" is an 8-year-old boy: Geom Woo-bin. Armed with an undeniable charm, handsome looks, and unshakable confidence, Woo-bin isn't here to reform these villains... He's here to rule Murim in his own way! Follow the chaotic and hilarious journey of this unlikely brotherhood, as the villains who once terrified the world now find themselves under the rule of an 8-year-old prodigy!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Butler Kim is the leader of the virtual reality game "Metaria" and the guardian of two cats in real life. One day, a mysterious boss monster appears in the game and forces him to change his job to "Butler." Forced to serve the monster, Butler Kim discovers an unbelievable truth.

 *"Oh my... a cat has logged into the game?!"*

His pet cat, Pichiu, has entered the game. But the shock doesn't end there. The "master" who chose Butler Kim as his butler and has been communicating with him is none other than Kalinas, the embodiment of darkness. He, who should be the center of this world, is trapped in the body of Pichiu, unable to do anything! Now, the butler's duty becomes clear: Butler Kim must carry out the dark mission in his stead. But does the incarnation's mission really matter to Butler Kim? Is he simply happy that he can embark on a fantasy adventure with Pichiu?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

display_title: I Am the Commander of the Second Male Lead's Knights
description:
After a monster attack kills her family, Nina is sold to House Louvoirennais, where she meets Adrian—a tragic secondary lead destined for abuse, betrayal, and death. Determined to rewrite his fate, Nina becomes his friend and protector. As she rises through the ranks of the Black Knights, her simple plan is to save the sub-lead. But when Nina accidentally summons a powerful elemental named Sol, she realizes her destiny may be greater than just saving Adrian... She might have to save the world. 

(Source: Tapas)

GTR Games, notorious for its "black" image in the industry, is introducing an unprecedented welfare system: a dating subsidy. Simply registering someone you like earns you 100,000 won, and if you connect with them, you'll receive a whopping 10 million won in bonus money!? For Seong-Eun, who considered dating a luxury and was consumed by work, this system was nothing more than a joke. However, after work, while chatting with her childhood friend and coworker, Cha Woo-Yeon, she overhears an unexpected confession.

 *"I just used you roughly. I don't have anyone special to use..."*

She initially dismisses it as sympathy, but on a whim, she checks to find 300,000 won in support money in her account. Three people in the company have expressed their feelings for Seong-Eun—!?

An office romance survival story where work, friendship, and unexpected excitement intertwine ♥ "Whose true feelings are yours?"

(Source: Naver, translated)

Born an alpha, entertainment agency CEO Chae Jae-woon suddenly becomes an omega after eating a peach.
Having lost more than half his assets in a divorce settlement, Jae-woon is thrilled when rising star Lee San-woo signs an exclusive contract with him - like a winning lottery ticket walking through his door ... But his joy doesn’t last long.

*“President, can I just sleep with you once?”*

San-woo turns out to be not only scandal-prone but also shamelessly lusting after his divorced boss, propositioning him every time their eyes meet.

*“Don’t you dare put it in! I’m allergic to alphas!”  
“Yeah, right.”*

Now an omega with the added curse of alpha allergy, Jae-woon desperately tries to fend off San-woo’s relentless advances…

**Original Novel:**  
[RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/3885005008), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13631766), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/E000085007)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/3885042112), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/BLteukgang_4gyosi), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/omega_job_ethics), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000074988)

Jang Jin-Myeong, a master of Gyuhwabojeon. He is accused of being a traitor and falls off a cliff right before he dies. He realizes his two mistakes. One is that he read the secret Gyuhwabojeon, which gives you strength but loses your masculinity, and the other is that he did not kill those cowards, Wang Jin and Seop Pyeong, earlier. When he opens his eyes in an unknown space when he is about to die, he sees the real Gyuhwabojeon and regresses to 32 years ago, just before he was castrated. Fortunately, in his second life, Jin-Myeong protects his belongings, and the power of Gyuhwabojeon still remains in his body!!!

Jin-Myeong decides to go back to the choice he regretted in his past life and take revenge on Wang Jin and Seop Pyeong who drove him to death.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: Beloved Contract Lady of the County
description:
Unloved by her family and alone to her last breath, she reincarnates into a novel’s world as a girl raised in hardship. One day, the heir apparent of a count’s house appears, claims to be her father, and proposes a contract father daughter arrangement. Confused but desperate to escape, she accepts. She may be his real daughter, but their bond starts as a contract what future awaits this unusual

(Source: Piccoma, translated)

Five years have passed since he left his beloved hometown for the city. With no one to depend on, Mihail wanders everywhere, ultimately unable to settle down anywhere and returns home. A remote mountain village where even a cart won't take him. Upon arriving in the village, he visits the cabin of his childhood friend, shepherd Caleb, and greets him warmly. However, all he gets in return is a warning to get out of the village immediately. Mihail tries to win Caleb's heart and settle down in his long-awaited return home, but things aren't as easy as he thought...

Freelance killer (assistant) Joo-Won, in his 8th year, gets caught up in a big problem when he meets a new assistant, K.

(Source: Naver, translated)

I-Sol Yeon, the school’s top student and biggest outcast, gains the ability to see people’s true feelings about her through the Hashtag Lens, which she acquires after making the ten‑quintillionth wish. Through the lens, she discovers that Shin-U Seong, her former middle‑school best friend she had a painful fallout with, has tagged her as “#my\_first\_love\_and\_trash.” Can I-Sol mend their broken relationship and overcome the pain of being betrayed by her first love?

(Source: WEBTOON)

The shaman “Manshin Kim Seo-Ryeong” of Yeongwoldang. The client “Noh Seung-Rae” who was born into a shaman family and lives rejecting the spirit rope, receives a request from Seo-Ryeong to visit her daughter who is blind. However, due to Seung-Rae’s attitude of not believing in shamanism and ignoring it, Seo-Ryeong does not accept the request and returns. However, from that day on, Seung-Rae’s past is reflected in Seo-Ryeong’s dreams. In the end, Seo-Ryeong follows Seung-Rae’s family…

The daughter of this family has an unusual aura?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Seo-Woo and Ji-Hyeok used to be in a cult relationship. However, Seo-Woo breaks up with Ji-Hyeok and pursues his dream of becoming a teacher, avoiding relationships with men. Seo-Woo finally becomes a teacher, but Ji-Hyeok, who appears next to him as a fellow teacher, keeps on worrying about him. Seo-Woo thinks about his past with Ji-Hyeok and even orders adult products, and Ji-Hyeok catches him. Ji-Hyeok threatens Seo-Woo, not really threatening, and this leads to their reunion...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

In September 2015, Kwon Min, a top 0.1% student, accidentally uncovers the truth about Cha Yubin, the phantom student from the next class who stole 20 minutes of his mock exam. For 30 minutes a day, the two unravel a mystery of luck and fate more complicated than the toughest exam questions. A story of all the shining moments we want to hold onto—which also came to us at nineteen, an age that was ending in the blink of an eye as the final day-count dwindled.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: The Duchess at the Butler’s Mercy
description:
Duchess Ines, married to the Duke of Edward, a man more affectionate than anyone else. However, Ines harbors a secret she cannot tell. It is that she is more aroused by men who would humiliate her than by affectionate men. When her butler Leon learns this secret, he begins to abuse Ines to his heart's content while the Duke sleeps...

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

Catherine, the daughter of a count and a psychic, discovers that La Noire, a fortune teller who can even predict death, is actually poisoning people to do so. She also discovers that her husband is plotting to use La Noire's poison to poison herself and her father. Will Catherine be able to eliminate the witch's poison and exact revenge on her husband, Jerome?

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: Part of YLAB's Gold String universe.*

Yoo-Seong loves Skinship, but he can't allow it with his childhood friend. Han-Su has a crush on Yoo-Seong. Will the two be able to cross the line?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

*“My boyfriend's... well...”*

Wang So-Dam, heartbroken after breaking up with her boyfriend who lacked confidence in that area, spends the night drunk with her boss, Yun Jun-U. But after that night, Jun-U contracts a strange illness: no matter how many times he sings the national anthem, his confidence won't waver. The only one who can cure him is So-Da!

 *“I'll try to fix you, Team Leader. But you have to prove something for me too.”
“What do I have to prove?”
“I want to know if I'm attractive to men.”*

Can So-Dam truly break Jun-U's overflowing confidence?

(Source: Naver, translated)

A newly appointed site supervisor is particularly rude to a female heavy equipment operator. Despite this obvious trick, the men on site defend the driver. In reality, the driver is a seasoned veteran, respected by the men, and a powerful figure on the site. The supervisor, seeking to gain their approval but instead incurring their wrath, becomes even more ashamed and wants to kick the driver out. While everyone else is away for an after-work party, he corners the driver and, when they're alone, crosses the line by engaging in sexual contact. He stages a situation bordering on attempted rape, thinking he's won, but then realizes something is amiss...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

The arrival of a 167.8cm short guard!

 *"You say you can't play basketball if you're short? Bring a 2m or 3m player. No matter how tall you are, if I knock them over, they're all inferior to me."*

Can Kang-Hwi, the main character, become the final puzzle piece for the Jeon Kwang High School basketball team, which dreams of winning the competition with his run-and-gun style?

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: Please Love Even a Rat Like Me
description:
Cat hybrid Yi-Jun has long harbored a crush on his senior from the same department, Kwon Na-Ra. Simply watching him from afar was enough to make Yi-Jun’s days at school feel happy and full. But when Na-Ra suddenly starts getting close to him, Yi-Jun can’t help but feel confused by the sudden change. Every time they’re together, Yi-Jun’s heart flutters uncontrollably, and just as their relationship seems to be moving forward—right at the moment they’re about to kiss—Na-Ra suddenly transforms into… a fat rat?!

 *“What the hell is this rodent?! Where’s my sunbae?!”

“W-wait, Yijoon! I can explain!”

“I hate lying rats the most!”*

Can cat hybrid Yi-Jun and rat hybrid Na-Ra overcome their species gap—and the chaos that comes with it?

When Jeong-In hears that his long-time crush is getting married, he ends up having a one-night stand to forget the pain of his heartbreak. But he remembers having sex with a handsome man... What's this strange pattern on his tongue? The man Hwa appears again to Jeong-In, who is confused, and makes a bombshell announcement. He says that he is a vampire and that he has imprinted on Jeong-In. But more than anything...

 *"You will continue to feel excited because of the imprint. So... Won't you meet me until you find a way to release it?"*

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Hitman Lee Ja-Gyeong. His gun never misses, piercing the heart with pinpoint accuracy. It doesn't matter how despicable the target is. He took the job, killed, got paid, and that was the end of it. All he believed in was his skill and money. Then one day, a sudden, large-sum request came from a regular client. The condition for the $5 million payment was one thing: Kill Kang Il-Hyeon and retrieve one item from his safe. The target was ‘the son of a Korean gangster godfather’. Kang Il-Hyeon was a man with eyes as sharp as a snake's. Ja-Gyeong found himself slowly being strangled by the trap Kang had set, cornered...

 *“I heard a very interesting story while on a business trip to Hong Kong.”
“......”
“Aren't you curious? What that interesting story is?”
“Someone's trying to kill me. Right in my own house.”
“Explain it. I'll decide whether to believe you after hearing it.”*

Can Ja-Gyeong kill Kang Il-Hyeon and complete the job? Or will he die a dog's death? The fight between men who wouldn't look out of place dying right now had begun.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: I Became the Villain's Lost Daughter
description:
I possessed an extra who didn’t even have a name in the novel. Her features are black hair and purple eyes that means that she is cursed. And I’m the lost daughter of the villain in the novel?! I thought I was a passing by extra, but she was actually the lost daughter of the villainous Grand Duke.

*“Erita, my beloved daughter.”

“My precious little sister. I’ll protect you.”*

……are these the bloody villains I’ve seen? My father and brother, who people said to be cruel, were too sweet to me. But the villain has a death ending! It was the first time I received love and warmth, and I decided to change the cruel ending of my friendly family since I possessed it 10 years earlier than the original. Yeah, I will definitely change my family’s future……

*“Erita, I love you.”*

What’s wrong with the Male Lead?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A travelogue of a lover walking their life's journey, chasing after the falling stars of humanity.


**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=843318), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13226515)

Jin-geon, who entered a prestigious high school for basketball, becomes frustrated when he sees his friend playing as the team's ace on the bench, but he cannot give up basketball, so he transfers to Siwoon High School. The problem is that Siwoon High School's basketball team is the worst team in the country, having lost 17 games in just two years since its founding. The sweaty challenge of the last place teams begins! 

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

On a scorching summer day, two youths scarred by loss and pain find an unexpected refuge in each other. Yu Chan, burdened by the torment of hearing the thoughts of others, and Ha Jio, struggling with loneliness and the weight of a broken family fate, cross paths by chance. What begins as mere curiosity soon grows into a profound bond that compels them to confront their hidden wounds, unspoken fears, and untold stories. Amid a closed-off village and a world that refuses to understand them, they learn that every choice brings loss—but also the chance for true change. That summer, which they thought would be nothing but painful and scorching, becomes the brightest and most transformative season of their lives: the summer they discover hope and love.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/6000000003), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14092780), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/_summer_bite), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=260288), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/taste_of_youth), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/69283715)

Kang San is a bottom 1% tanker with no talent, abilities, or skill. Misfortune follows him until a divine messenger appears before him one day.

*"You were the Blood Demon in your past life."*

To atone for his past life's sins, he must endure harsh trials. But in return, he will receive immense rewards?

*"Fine. I'll do whatever it takes."*

Can a weak F-rank tanker drenched in blood change his fate?

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: My Dear Grand Duke on a Leash
description:
Seduce a man you just met and marry him in a week? 

On the eve of her sister's wedding, Princess Liët of Chalonne meets the imperial prince sent as a congratulatory envoy. But instead of gifts, this prince delivers a threat.

 *“Marry my cousin, Cain, and uncover his weakness.”

“If a princess about to marry were to pass away... wouldn't that be a tragedy?”*

To protect her sister, Liët attempts to seduce Cain, the Iron Archduke known as an ice pick, an artificial being. But she hits a wall from the start.

 *“Please refrain from approaching me.”*

Cain effortlessly deflects all of Liet's efforts. Eventually, Liet even proposes a contract marriage, determined to become his wife... 

 *“You seemed quite exhausted last night, so I'll be gentle today.”*

The impenetrable fortress that was Cain vanishes without a trace, and he begins to cling to Liet like a dog...?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Hwarin, a woman in her thirties raising two children in a very poor family, struggles to make ends meet. One day, she swaps bodies with her friend, who is happily married to a wealthy senior colleague—her first love. However, the joy of finally living the life she had long desired is short-lived, as the family’s dark secrets are revealed, and Hwarin finds herself caught in an inescapable trap.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*"I didn't write it!"*

Popular idol Jung Ha-Jin's school violence revelations explode. The world, with detailed information seemingly gleaned from her memories, points to victim Min-Ji as the "author." The mysterious author is stealing my memories and strangling the perpetrator. Is this the perfect revenge for me? Or is this another trap?

(Source: Naver, translated)

*“It’s not the CEO’s child.”*

Noh Hye-Ji, a dirt spoon who is bitter about being homeless. But I’m a guide spoon! And I’m a S-class contact guide. I’ve been working as the dedicated guide and secretary for Han Kang-Hyun, the strongest S-class esper in existence, and I’ve been saving money for 6 years. Ta-da, I’m pregnant!

\[If A neglects contraception and becomes pregnant with B’s child, this contract will be terminated as soon as B finds out.\]

\[B can claim damages from A for violating this clause.\]

So that means the CEO just needs to not know?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/5479000128), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13364377), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/love_confession), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/ajjilhan_gobaek), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000076825)

*"I got thrown into this godforsaken world?!"*

The infamous web novel Chronicles of the Seven-Colored World ran for over 800 chapters, gaining notoriety for being an absolute mess—with absurd plot twists, overpowered monsters, and yandere heroines who kill the protagonist on a whim. And now... I've reincarnated into that very world. As who? Some nobody named Rudian. A literal background character with zero plot relevance. But then I stumbled across two game-changing companions: a weird, googly-eyed monster named Adi, and a cursed sword known as Diablo. If this world wants to be crazy? Fine. I'll go full crazy with it. It's time for the ultimate chaotic run, and this time, the so-called "extra" is flipping the whole story on its head.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: I Am Being Loved by the Dead
description:
I was just enjoying my favorite web novel when the unthinkable happened—Castian, the male lead and my ultimate favorite, died in the most ridiculous way. Before I knew it, I found myself possessing Lydia, the necromancer who pulled him back from the dead! Whether it’s because I refuse to be falsely accused of harming my beloved character, or because even in his lifeless state, he remains as stunning as ever, I’m determined to save Castian no matter what. I ended up pretending to be his lover and officially joining his expedition team…

*"Don’t leave my side, not even for a moment."*

But wasn’t he supposed to distrust me? Why is Castian growing more and more affectionate toward me…?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The female diver, Somyeong, has an unexpected encounter with Yeo-Hae, a merman, in the depths of the sea. While wielding a sickle, she accidentally strikes him. In the chaos, Somyeong loses consciousness, only to later awaken and discover that Yeo-Hae, despite the injury, had saved her life. Stricken with guilt for causing him harm, Somyeong decides to bring the injured merman back to her home, hoping to tend to his wounds and make amends. However, as she begins to treat him, she finds herself swept up in Yeo-Hae's rut. What started as a rescue soon transforms into an unexpected and irresistible encounter.

*Note: Part of Lezhin's Sunaemul Danpyeonseon (순애물 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: How to Live as a Civil Servant in Murim
description:
One day, Yeon Woo-Hyeok fell into the world of martial arts and became a civil servant in the martial arts world.

Yeon Woo-Hyeok, a veteran of the martial arts mystery game \[The Great Revolutionary King's Great Pokai\], one day finds himself possessed by a Po-Kwai in the game without warning. Fortunately, he realizes that the events in the game that he had memorized are exactly as they appear, and begins to adapt to being a Po-Kwai in the game while solving the cases. However, the joy is short-lived as Yeon Woo-Hyeok's ability, 'Young-An', is actually an upper chamber opening, and because of this, he is in danger of dying. No, being a Po-Kwai is difficult, so he has to learn martial arts to become a powerful master?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Did he even steal from his older brother, who grew up in the same boat? Han Ji-Chan was different from birth, and it felt natural to be superior to others. Unchanging routines breed boredom. As usual, Ji-Chan was cleaning up after his brother's missteps and heading home when he saw a strange man, Su-Hyuk. And he was having sex with his older brother.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

display_title: The Loser Is the First Lady
description:
Korea’s most infamous power couple—now running against each other for president. One’s conservative, the other progressive. One’s an early riser, the other a night owl. They fight over everything—from house chores to national policy. And unfortunately for the nation… they’re both members of the National Assembly. But when a major political scandal explodes right before the presidential election, they both decide to run. Against each other. “Let’s settle this in front of the entire country. Winner gets the Blue House. Loser? Enjoy being First Spouse.” A satirical, high-stakes political rom-com of love, rivalry, and democracy. Let the 21st presidential election begin.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Seo-Woo Yoon, the secret daughter of a politician, hides a bold nature beneath her obedient facade. Eun-Hyuk Kim, heir to WM Group, tries to control her—but her quiet rebellion draws him in. Their clash deepens into love, and when she breaks free, they begin a strange yet sweet married life.

(Source: Manta)

As the talented leader of the ESG team at Soya Group., Minsu always leaves work on time. However, his work life takes a dramatic turn when the daughter of the chairman joins his team. The ESG team gets entangled in the power struggle between the higher-ups, and Minsu’s overqualified abilities put his team in the eye of the storm. Can Minsu protect his off-hours from all this corporate chaos?

(Source: WEBTOON)

*"When I become a real writer, let's meet again."*

Five years after I boldly confessed to Sujin, I became a truly popular writer. But I can't tell Sujin about the comics I draw. Because the comics I draw are... erotic comics!!!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Han-Sol, a 24-year-old kindergarten teacher, has one ultimate goal in life: to snag a wealthy Prince Charming. Enter Yu-Shin—the tall, handsome, and successful father of one of Han-Sol's students. After an awkward first date, the two are soon caught up in a fairytale romance with a kinky twist!

(Source: Manta)

Eun-Rin, who was imprisoned in the darkest and most remote northern palace in the palace after receiving the imperial order to become the concubine of the crown prince who is said to have fallen into madness, decides to follow her heart towards Do-Ha, even at the risk of death... 

*“You became a woman because of me, so please make me a man.”*

The secret romance between the crown prince Do-ha, who hides his identity, and the fallen noble Eun-Rin, blossoms in the deepest part of the palace.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

In the early 1960s, a major transformation of food culture took place in South Korea. After the war, starvation became a daily occurrence for the people, who had to make do with a bowl of honey-porridge made by picking out leftovers from US military bases. Jeon Joong-Yoon was worried about the lives of the people struggling in poverty and providing them with a proper meal. Kim Hang-pil, a new employee who finished his service as a KATUSA and got a job, thinks of his loved one and wants to join Joong-Yoon's cause. Hang-Pil's unrequited love, Lee Young-Hee, sells honey-porridge in an unlicensed shantytown, carrying the pain and sorrow of war. Loved ones and neighbors abandoned everywhere in the field of starvation. Through devotion, patience, and effort toward them, 'Ramen', a symbol of the common people's food, was born.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The lowly ‘leaf’ of an Italian mafia organization. He secretly harbored an admiration for ‘Camellia’, the boss's brother-in-law. He was like a sacred place, an absolute domain he must never trespass upon, yet every night, he couldn't help but express his intense desire for him. Yes, it was like a fever... 

 *'Your desire will lead you to ruin. He who dares reach into the untouchable realm shall be struck by divine punishment.'*

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Kang Jihyuk was the eldest grandson of Taesung, South Korea’s largest conglomerate. He should have inherited everything Taesung had to offer, but due to someone’s conspiracy, he lost his parents and was abandoned in an orphanage. 20 years later, he returns to Taesung under the name 'Seo Jihyuk'... and his revenge begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

\[Unique Trait ‘Skill Master (EX)’ has been activated.\]

▶ ‘Skill Copy (EX)’ is now enabled.

*“Whoa… your skill’s insane!”*

\[Skill has been copied.\]

From now on, there’s no skill he can’t have. Yours is mine. Mine? Still mine. The rise of the ultimate cheat-class protagonist begins now. All Skill Master Yoo Ju-yeon’s explosive saga is just getting started!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Choi Woo-Ju, who has been imagining his first love for a long time because he couldn't forget it, suddenly sees his first love, Yu Hye-Sung, in front of him after 8 years. Hye-Sung expresses his interest in Woo-Ju's being a band member, and this gives Woo-Ju a chance to realize his imagination that he has always had... 

The moment the stage lights turn on, all the truth is revealed?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

When Yi-hwan woke up, the world had changed. Zombies craving the blood of the living, Humans running for their lives. But then...

*"Why aren't the zombies biting me?"*

Unbelievable strength, One eye turned red, just like the zombies, And a strange hunger every time he sees blood.

*"What the hell happened to me?!"*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The regular bar owner at a favorite local pub turns out to be a former legendary hunter. Ordinary patrons are stunned as their unassuming “boss” reveals overwhelming strength and skills that go far beyond the typical bartender. The story unfolds as this retired powerhouse navigates life behind the bar, sometimes confronting threats from their old hunter days and protecting the establishment (and its guests) in ways only a true legend could—blurring the line between peaceful civilian life and the hidden world of superhuman hunters.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=845024), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13398288)

I am a wanderer martial artist. I don’t shy away from blood, but I’m ready to retire. Should I take one last job? or not? For many long years, he has roamed as a wandering martial artist's, living as a hired blade to make ends meet. But now, he finds himself utterly penniless, living in poverty with nothing to his name. As a master of martial arts at the peak level, he makes a decision, to take on one final, high-stakes mission, earn a fortune, and put an end to his life as a wanderer. The story follows his journey as he takes on this last assignment and the unexpected twists that unfold along the way.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: I Possessed an Extra in a Childcare Story
description:
I possessed a mere maid in a Northern Duke’s household, just a background character in a romance-fantasy novel. A lifetime job with stability, as long as I keep my head down and stay out of trouble? Sounds perfect! 

I planned to save up quietly and one day escape for a peaceful life... But then. 

*“You went to… a Korean cyber university?”* 

*“How… how could Annie know that…?”* 

The heroine — reincarnated from modern Korea — found out I’m a transmigrator too! Now I’m stuck to her like glue, constantly in her spotlight… And worse, her overprotective brother starts to take notice. 

*“You want to quit your job? Who said you could?”* 

The male lead of this childcare story — the one I thought would ignore me — has become obsessed! Help! I’m just an extra! 

Annie’s chaotic survival tale as an ordinary extra in a not-so-ordinary childcare drama begins! 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Kim Sang-an is a cold-blooded loan shark. When his younger sister, a schoolteacher, takes her own life after relentless bullying from her students, he becomes the homeroom teacher of those very students to collect the price of her life. A merciless loan shark who will collect his debts even if it means descending into hell and a class of devil-like students... A vicious, twisted teacher-student relationship.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*“Get close to the only son destined to inherit the crown. That is your mission, River Winsted.”*

River Winsted, a suspended FBI agent, receives an opportunity to be reinstated… under one condition: she must accept an undercover infiltration mission. She must become the lover of Alessandro, the son of her enemy—and her first love—in order to steal information.

*“You’re not the only one who’s changed, Alessandro. I’ve changed too.”*

Using the false identity of Lily Gray, River manages to get close to Alessandro and eventually enter his home… a place where, according to him, he had never allowed any of his lovers to step inside. But the deeper she goes into the mission, the more she finds herself irresistibly drawn to this enigmatic man, and it torments her. However, after an unexpected accident exposes her identity, River barely survives. Regretting the moment she hesitated, she swears she will take Alessandro down with her own hands. But the more she follows his shadow, the more shocking secrets come to light… “There is something I have to do. Just give me a little time. When I’m done… you can stop my breath as much as you want.” Alessandro. The only feelings that should ever have been tied to his name were hatred—perhaps resentment. Any emotion other than those should never, under any circumstances, be called love.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Yeong-Do, a poor woodcutter living alone who longs for a family. And Imugi, who must kill its companion to become a dragon. Yeong-Do hears a rumor that if he throws an axe into a mountain pond, the mountain spirit will turn it into a golden one. He throws his axe to prepare for his wedding. But what emerged from the pond was Imugi, enraged beyond measure by the humans who kept hurling axes at it. Imugi, intent on killing the human before it, becomes drawn to the scent emanating from Yeong-Do and gradually fixates on him...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

display_title: To Me, Who Does Not Love You
description:
Her twelfth life arrived after passing through eleven regressions. What awaited her every time she turned back the clock was her husband’s unilateral demand for a divorce. 

Max Russell. The grandson of a great revolutionary hero, the son of a notorious con artist, and a successful young businessman who overcame his shameful past. 

Freya Russell. The only daughter of a Duke, who voluntarily gave up her high-born life because she was madly in love with that very husband. In every past life, whenever Max declared he wanted a divorce, Freya would cling to him like a madwoman. But this time, she lays down her obsession and accepts Max’s “sincerity” for the first time. 

“Fine. Let’s get a divorce.” 

Facing Max, who is visibly shaken by her unexpected answer, Freya sets just one condition. 

“But in exactly two years.” In the time remaining, Freya engages in a final battle against a new

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=845689), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13471913)

Kang Ha-Na, a former girl group trainee, gives up everything and has a baby due to an unexpected pregnancy. She leaves the baby in a baby box until she can save up for a house deposit, but she finds out that a famous actor and director couple have adopted the baby, and she goes to work as their babysitter to get the baby back. However, the wife, Angela, is transfusing the baby's blood. Like a vampire. Kang Ha-Na decides to kill her.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.*

Fifteen years ago, his father, fighting against unfair dismissal, took his own life amidst the indifference of a conglomerate. Before the shock had even subsided, his younger brother vanished without a trace. Faced with a series of tragedies, his parents ultimately passed away, leaving Do-jun alone. Since that day, when everything was taken from him, Do-jun has lived for revenge and truth. Realizing that he could not change anything without standing at the center of power, He endured his lonely days with the sole goal of becoming a politician. And on the day he finally received his diploma, he swore before his parents' urns:

*"I will find Yu-ri and bring her here to this very place."

"And those bastards...I will make them shed tears of blood."*

That night, Do-jun had his first "dream of the future." A vision too vivid to be a coincidence. And that dream foreshadowed the brutal path he would take in politics.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Kim Seol lives as an ordinary high school student in South Korea, unaware that she is actually the daughter of North Korea's next leader. To protect her daily life, an elite agent is sent undercover to her school, creating a school romance comedy! 

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: Black Fox: Sword Master of Mount Kunlun
description:
Ten years after his master vanished while hunting a cult that unleashes yokai, young Taoist Dangchan saves Jin Seorang, a woman pursued by the ruthless Maewoldang sect. Known for enslaving people by turning them into yokai, Maewoldang is Jin Seorang's sworn enemy, and she seeks Dangchan's aid in destroying them. As they fight against dark sorcery, Dangchan discovers a startling truth—Maewoldang's leader holds clues to his master's disappearance. With the world still in turmoil, Dangchan wields his mystical arts, determined to restore order and fulfill his destiny.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

In the near future, severe environmental pollution has led to the extinction of numerous livestock species, plunging humanity into a food crisis. Humanity's only salvation lies in the mutants created by pollution and genetic modification. Some humans began producing milk like livestock, prompting the government to establish a system called the ‘Human Dairy Farm’...

 *“But... why did I end up like this?”*

Eui-Je, who reported the school's obnoxious popular guy, Cassie, as a human cow, somehow finds himself entering that very ranch.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

A kindergarten where superpowers are a daily occurrence. The temporary teacher who was assigned here, Oh Sae-Ong, has no superpowers, no experience, and no physical strength. He endures each day among the children who light fires, call for water, and see the future, and gradually learns about their world. A kindergarten routine that is more special than special abilities, Super Power! Care Diary

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*“Guide, first we need to tie up this ill-mannered hand.”*

SS-class Esper Pil Hyun-Seo, whose gentle face hides his contempt for all humanity. And S-class Guide Jeong U-Yeon, whose sense of justice is MAX whenever he sees injustice. Their ordinary first meeting unexpectedly derails with U-Yeon's unhesitating punch. After that incident, Hyun-Seo tries to keep U-Yeon by his side through a forced pair matching, and his curiosity gradually turns into obsession. U-Yeon tries to escape, while Hyun-Seo refuses to let go. Amidst their constant clashes, their wounds and true feelings slowly begin to surface, subtly altering their relationship. 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

At the university's opening assembly, Do-Hun unexpectedly encounters ‘ae-Hyeon, a special person from his middle school days with whom he shared a deep bond during a brief period. However, Jae-Hyeon not only fails to recognize Do-Hun but also carries rumors of sleeping around with multiple men. Hearing these rumors, Do-Hun impulsively joins Jae-Hyeon for drinks and ends up having a one-night stand with him. Using the one-night stand as leverage, Do-Hun blackmails Jae-Hyeon into agreeing to have sex only with him. He then demands various acts like using sex toys and cosplay, humiliating him and marking the beginning of their twisted relationship.

At just 23 years old, he becomes the head of the Jongnam Sect, once a proud and powerful clan, now reduced to only eight remaining disciples and barely clinging to survival. Once a sect that dreamed of dominating the martial world, it is now a shadow of its former glory. Yet Sanwol cannot afford to grieve or hesitate. To honor his master’s dying wish, to keep the sect alive, and to carve a new path — Jin Sanwol must step into the ruthless world of martial arts, where only the strongest survive. The battle for supremacy begins anew, and he must stake everything to reclaim his sect’s former greatness… and conquer the martial world.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: An Extra's Accidental Main Character Syndrome
description:
Espin never meant to get main character syndrome, but what choice is there when you wake up in a romance fantasy world? Now the unnamed extra of a novel, Espin knows that by the law of cliches, she's destined to become the main character… But the three male leads aren't getting with the program. Every attempt young Espin makes to help them ends in trouble, and soon she starts to doubt her so-called destiny. Is Espin really this world's new heroine, or does she belong in the sidelines after all?

(Source: Tapas)

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Anytoon](https://www.anytoon.co.kr/webtoon/landing/episode/10659), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3587012599), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/big_and_sugar), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12266915), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/C000068145), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=250111), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/webtoon/episode/toon/8534)

A disastrous beginning—god-tier progression! The protagonist, a jobless man barely scraping by with part-time work, drifts around like a wandering orphan. His only joy in an otherwise dull and unchanging life is the online game God-Forsaken World. To him, it’s more than just entertainment—it’s an escape from reality. Then one day, while immersed in the game, he hears a mysterious voice from nowhere. When he comes to... he finds himself inside the world of the game! You’d think that after being transported into a game, he would become a cool, powerful protagonist... but no. He wakes up as the Empire’s disgrace and failure of a third prince: Gilroshan Elro de Valt. And if things couldn’t get any worse, the moment he opens his eyes, someone tries to kill him! Trapped in the body of an overweight, pathetic prince scorned by all, the protagonist has one secret weapon—a strategy guide, the key to survival that only a veteran player like him possesses! With the stumbling prince, his loyal knight Carls, and his fearsome yet reliable mage mentor Tirvaen, a new adventure begins—one more intense than reality itself!

*“Survive in the body of a good-for-nothing prince? It’s not going to be as easy as playing the game.”*

This is an unpredictable fantasy full of laughs, battles, and non-stop survival action!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Ice, space, power, and wind. A continent guarded by witches who inherited the four Great Magic Stones. When the 7th generation who inherited "Wind" dies, summons are issued to select a successor,and the candidates gather at Winfred Academy. The disaster "Erosion" spreads. And Anzu, a boy who conceals the power of his cursed blood. Who did the wind choose? The story of Anzu, a boy who lives his life guided by the wind.

(Source: Naver, translated)

After days of starvation, my vision blurred, and a shadow spoke to me.

That night, I made a pact with the shadow. By eating the sins of others, I gained a life where I would never have to starve again. Since gaining my powers, I've lost the ability to taste ordinary food, and I've accumulated a bit (a lot?) of a criminal record… But you know what? Sin tastes better.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

She once saved the world as the fearsome Archmage of Despair. Her reward? Being reborn as Lesia Elphinad, child saint and unwilling subscriber to a pay-to-live reincarnation subscription where missing a payment could cost her life. Instead of enjoying toys and naps, she must complete divine quests, collect Heaven Coins, and live under the same roof as her former rival, the powerful light mage. With the help of old friends and new, can she turn a cursed second chance into a life worth living? 

(Source: Tapas)

In the north, Duke Lennox Carlyle, born with blessings and misfortune, always lived by simple rules: take what he wanted and discard what was no longer useful. Among the discarded was his contract with Juliet Monad, the fallen young countess who, seven years ago, came to him offering love at first sight in exchange for revenge. Now, after a farewell that hurt him like the sharpest dagger, fate grants them a second life marked by secrets, betrayals, and a new contract. This time, Juliet is not looking for love, but to use and be used until she ends the relationship on her own terms. But in a game of cat and mouse, neither the past nor forgotten promises will remain hidden for long.


**Original Novel:**     
[Chapters](https://page.kakao.com/content/54002523), [Volumes](https://page.kakao.com/content/67506643) 

**Original Webtoon:**      
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/67482339), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%9E%8A%ED%98%80%EC%A7%84-%EC%A4%84%EB%A6%AC%EC%97%A3/4597)

**Official Translations:**      
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/190417)
*Note: The first story in Metatoon's Yeonhagong Danpyeonseon (연하공 단편선) Collection.*

One day, Jeong-Woo can't sleep because he sees a ghost that appears every morning at 3 a.m. and bites his fingernails. Tormented by sleep deprivation and fear, Jeong-Woo tries to figure out when this phenomenon began, and is reminded of an incident that occurred after a drinking party with his childhood friend, Hee-Won.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Secretary Yeon-woo flees to her hometown of Moksan County, facing the harassment of Vice President Yoon-seok. There, she meets Seong-heon, the executive director of Seolyang Construction. Seong-heon's once icy heart melts and seeps into Yeon-woo, who resembles the warmth of spring. Meanwhile, Yoon-seok sets out to find Yeon-woo...

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: How to Use the Knight Commander: Monster Capture
description:
Leonhard, the noble commander of the Knights of the Kingdom, sets out to subdue monsters, only to be captured by them instead. The beast-like monster, "Kelles," takes the Knights hostage and makes Leonhard a despicable and obscene offer...

 *"You'll soon be XXing me. Shaking your butt like a horny boar."*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Born seeing ghosts, Jong-Eon grew up in a world of shadows. His grim reality flips when he pairs up for a college project with Hye-Seong, a cheerful underclassman who somehow acts as a literal human ghost repellent. Desperate for a peaceful life, Jong-eon starts following Hye-Seong everywhere to keep the spirits at bay. But when he gets caught red-handed, Jong-Eon panics and blurts out the first excuse he can think of: he’s hopelessly in love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

A college dinner. A drunken early morning with friends. It was a day no different from any other day, but when I opened my eyes, I found myself being delivered to me by a man.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

"I'll be your girlfriend, Doctor."

Kang Jia has been secretly in love for three years with Gi Tae-oh — a genius in cardiothoracic surgery and blessed with a face to match. She's been enjoying a blissful hospital intern life just watching the man she adores... until one day, she hears he's going on a blind date. Eavesdropping at the venue, she overhears something shocking…!

“If that's the reason, then I can't give up on you, Doctor.”

“…That reason?”

“I-I mean… even if you're, um, impotent… it doesn’t matter to me. I’ve liked you for a long time.”

He doesn’t say a word. Only the soft hum of classical music fills the lounge through the silence.

“Ha… this is crazy.”
