*R15:* [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/66875816)

**Official Translations:**    
*R19:* [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/188442)    
*R15:* [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/188441)

display_title: I Tried to Rewrite the Original Story, But Ended Up Seducing the Northern Grand Duke
description:
*“I think I’ll… fail if I try to twist the original work?!”*

I'd been reincarnated into my favorite romance novel, which I'd reread countless times, even down to the spinoffs. And to top it all off, I was a pathetic, villainous princess who'd been engaged to the crown prince and met a tragic end. To avoid dying, I decided to twist the original story. But...

 *"I brought you the engagement letter to the Northern Grand Duke, Lily!"*

A few days later, this crazy dad arrived with the Northern Grand Duke's engagement letter instead of the crown prince's. 

*"You've loved me for a long time, Princess."*

And he even included a real-life version of the Northern Grand Duke. The bigger problem is... The Northern Grand Duke, the original male protagonist, is determined to seduce me.

 *"Do you know? How much those eyes confuse my heart."*

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Jae-Si, a legendary first-team idol leader who has fallen into mannerism, and Tae-Hwi, a five-year veteran idol leader who dreams of having a fan meeting just once. The two participate in the bizarre survival variety show "Special Mission! Man's Challenge!" Only the final one who passes the five stages will ascend to the honorable throne and get what they want...

A desperate "erotic" variety show like you've never seen before! Starting right now in a fiery heat!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

Born with incredible luck, Jeong-Yeon always has good things happening to him. Then, the most perfect-looking guy, Lee Yun-Seong, appears before him. Yun-Seong, who had always received attention for his good looks since birth, didn't like people who only approached him for his face. So, he wasn't thrilled when Jeong-Yeon expressed his interest right after meeting him.

 *"Can I call you hyung? Yun-Seong: “Heeeey~ I hope we see each other often from now on.”*

After their awkward first encounter, Yun-Seong gets annoyed whenever he keeps bumping into Jeong-Yeon wherever he goes. But Jeong-Yeon, completely unfazed by his irritation, keeps pestering him. Before he knows it, Yun-Seong finds himself quietly falling for him...

 *“Were you satisfied with my role as your living dildo last night?”*

The story of Jeong-Yeon and Yun-Seong, who bicker and clash every time they meet.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Ji-An and Han Jeong-Won, best friends since their school days. The two naturally developed into lovers as adults, but Ji-An realizes at some point that the future she thought would always be happy is not the girl she knows...

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

My boyfriend announced his marriage to me. And that too... to another woman. That's how our four-year relationship crumbled in an instant. To make matters worse, he proposed she become his mistress. Do-Eun refused and they broke up. Later, while on a business trip to Hawaii, Do-Eun met a man with exotic looks named Ian on the beach. Feeling overwhelmed by the intensity of their relationship, Do-Eun continued seeing him under a pseudonym.

 *“Mo...Ana. My name is Moana.”*

They spent passionate nights together, neither knowing the other's name or age, considering it a fleeting encounter destined to be just a memory of Hawaii. Until he reappeared. 

*“Long time no see, Moana. Or should I call you Director Eun Do-Eun now?”*

(Source: Naver, translated)

One day, the worst serial murder case occurred. While investigating the case, Dan accidentally discovers the suspect at the scene... and even confirms its identity. The offer is that he will not kill anyone anymore, and the only price is that Dan stays by his side. Shocked and confused, Dan eventually accepts the offer... Was it for the sake of a greater cause, or... was it out of pity? 

*"I'll give you a reason to do so. A reason for Dan to be with me."*

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

*Note: Part of Daiwon's Neungyonk BL Danpyeon (능욕BL단편) Collection.*

display_title: [Colorful Night Short Story Collection] The Dragon King's Favor
description:
"You little worm." 

That's what Yeon's master always calls her. Yeon is a water snake, and her master is the Azure Dragon, the guardian of the East. A pure-blooded dragon who valued lineage and station above all else. 

"You know you'd die instantly without me, don't you?" 

A water snake's typical lifespan is only 10 years. The reason why Yeon has lived for over 100 is because the Azure Dragon shares his life force with her. And so Yeon has no choice but to serve him well, whether she likes it or not. Until one day, while undressing the heavily drunk Azure Dragon, he pushes her into a one-night stand. Of course, it happened while he was so intoxicated that the damned dragon doesn't remember a thing. But then Yeon finds out that she's pregnant. 

If the pure-blood Azure Dragon finds out that a worm, no, a water snake, is bearing his bastard child, he will surely kill them both. What should she do? 

She has to hide it. She has to hide that they slept together and the pregnancy. But the more she tries to hide, the more the dragon becomes suspicious of Yeon. 

"Whose child are you carrying?" 

Finally, Yeon's pregnancy is discovered…! 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Notes:
\- Includes one extra chapter.
\- Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: I Accidentally Raised My Childhood Friend to Be an Obsessive Man
description:
Erina, the only daughter of a huge merchant corporation, lost her voice completely after the shock of losing her mother, and her childhood friend Noel, whose growth has stopped due to a curse and who remains in the form of a boy. For 15 years, the two lived like a family, and Erina was only able to speak to Noel. One day, Erina, who believes in the superstition that "if you kiss a man of the opposite sex on the day before your 20th birthday, you will be happy for the rest of your life," kissed Noel, but the next day, Noel was in his adult form! This incident triggered Noel, who had originally had feelings for Erina, to grow even more obsessed with her...!

 *"I wish she would choose me instead of the other man..."*

A status-disparity romance that begins with a kiss between a young lady who has never known true love and a secretary who can't stop doting on her!

(Source: Comico, translated)

What does the "Wu" in Wuxia truly mean? It is the power to enforce one's chivalry—to wield justice not just for oneself, but to shape the world by sheer strength. And if that strength transcends the self, flows through others, and reaches to the ends of the world... Then that power is none other than divine. So what does it take for a mere human to ascend to such godhood? To reach the realm of the divine through martial might? Thus begins the epic tale of Pi Wol-ryeo, a warrior in search of that very answer—one forged in blood, will, and iron discipline.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Alien species from outer space have started participating in Earth’s broadcasts, and Ale, a Demon King from the Demon King Planet, teams up with the human Dohyun to become the Best Streamer, encountering and getting entangled with various other alien species along the way...

Hyeon Seong-Min, who has already turned 40, looks around and becomes acutely aware of the reality that he is alone. Hyeon Seong-Min faces a crisis not only in his life but also at work and decides to struggle to find true happiness. It's not too late to reach that age.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Nineteen, a boy who has endured a life worse than hell. In order to seek revenge, he eventually conspires with the evil spirit within him and is reborn as a monster.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Eunho is on the verge of receiving an academic warning due to Seoyoung, his childhood friend's, excessive pranks. Facing the threat of losing his allowance and tuition, Eunho decides to operate a (fake) couple YouTube channel with Seoyoung to earn money. Their first content: 'What happens when you spend a night with your female friend'! They fall asleep together, insisting nothing will happen... but...

*“Since it's come to this, should we…?”*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

After working like crazy at X small company, Jeong Seon-Woo finally succeeded in moving to a large company. With a clean face, the flattery skills honed at X small company, and top-notch social skills, Jeong Seon-Woo was confident that he would not be outdone no matter where he went. However, that confidence was shattered within 30 minutes of his first day at work...

The new employee whom I had scolded with 200% of my old-timer power turned out to be in a higher position than me?! He made a good first impression.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Hui-Su, who has been single for 24 years and has grown up normally, finally has the love she has always dreamed of, but her fantasy is shattered by her first sleep with her boyfriend. So, she goes to a lesbian bar with her lesbian friend Jae-Yeon while drunk and meets Ju-Hui there. They are attracted to each other and end up kissing. Hui-Su feels confused about her sexual orientation and feels guilty about her boyfriend. 

Confused, Hui-Su visits the lesbian bar several times to meet Ju-Hui again, and finally meets Ju-Hui again. Just before the two leave the motel and head out, Ju-Hui sees her boyfriend's KakaoTalk message on Hui-Su's phone. Ju-Hui, dumbfounded, leaves. Hui-Su thinks she left because she couldn't do it, and breaks up with her boyfriend because she feels sorry for him. However, Joo-Hee already misunderstands that Hui-Su is still dating her boyfriend. Even while in a relationship with her FWB, Min-Young, Ju-Hui continues to be concerned about Hui-Su. 

Will Ju-Hui and Hui-Su be able to properly convey their feelings to each other? 

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

After her brother gambles away the money owed for his marriage, Louise is offered as payment under the so-called Right of the First Night. The man who claims her is Richard, Lord of Evron—a ruthless war hero feared for his icy heart. Trapped in his castle, Louise must survive the night... and the man they call a monster.

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

Go Yi-Young, a mystery game enthusiast, is walking down the street while leaving a review for the popular mystery game *The Sin of the Blue Silhouette* when he fails to avoid a bicycle and gets hit by it. When he regains consciousness, he realizes that he has entered the mystery game he was playing just a moment ago, and in order to survive, he tries to prevent the murder of the culprit he saw in the game, Cha Gyeon-Woo...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

display_title: Can You Catch Mermaids While Fishing?
description:
Sea, an entertainment company employee who is always tired from overwork and social life, has fishing as her only hobby.

*"I want to get stranded on a deserted island and spend the rest of my life fishing alone!"*

She thinks as she picks up her fishing rod today... and words become seeds! She panics for a moment, but thinking that her companions will report her, she starts fishing on the deserted island with a complacent mind... The heavy taste of the catch makes her excited, thinking it's a big catch, but what Sea has caught is a person... no, a mermaid?! Suddenly, she ends up uncomfortably cohabitating with a mermaid on a deserted island, but this mermaid seems to have a deep story...?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

In a world where animal hybrids represent the ultimate elite, Kim Cheol-Su is content living vicariously through his favorite simulation game, "Wooly Woods". But his digital hobby becomes a chaotic reality when he finds an abandoned hybrid kitten on his doorstep that looks exactly like his in-game companion. Cheol-Su takes the little one in for temporary protection, but as Na-Bi starts calling him "Daddy" and hits an unexpected growth spurt, the responsibilities of a hybrid owner get a lot more hands-on.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The tiger I saved as a child suddenly appeared as two companions?! And they say we three must sleep together for their souls to become one again?

*"Our wife is truly clumsy, trapping her husband between her legs like this-"

"You wanted to touch it, didn't you...? A man's body."*

Living as newlyweds with two divine beings who pounce on me at all hours - can my heart really endure this?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

display_title: The Young Lady Has a Vulgar Secret
description:
After being rescued by the young lady of the house, Rose has felt indebted to Alice. Unfortunately, fate would keep them separate as Alice is sent to the Grand Duke's estate for an arranged marriage. Years later, the time has finally come for the two to reunite. Rose would be foolish, however, to assume the same young lady awaits her. 

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: The first story in Metatoon's Gyeryak Danpyeonseon (계략 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: A Man Who Became a Eunuch
description:
Mansuk, a low-born slave, was abandoned in the mountains right after birth, supposedly for stealing the energy of the Samsin Halmae (goddess of childbirth). Fortunately, he was picked up by a peddler and wandered through the eight provinces of Joseon. Thanks to his natural eloquence and quick wit, Mansuk achieved great success as both a righteous hero and a swindler. Believing that 'a swindler starves if he becomes famous,' he prepares for his last big score. His final goal is to steal the blue and white porcelain belonging to Lord Park, Hanyang's wealthiest man. However, he fails and is caught. Under Lord Park's command, he becomes a 'fake eunuch' and infiltrates the palace – as the exclusive eunuch for Queen Gyeongye, who is said to be even scarier than the King!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Bill Bark, the blacksmith who forged the Hero’s Sword, is content with his ordinary daily life. However, as unrest begins to rise throughout the kingdom, it starts to shake even his life, and as the situation worsens, he is drawn deep into a series of uncontrollable events.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*"Look carefully at what you asked."*

Hong Cha-Eun, the only daughter of the owner of the Kkulkkul Gamjatang restaurant. Kwon Hae-Gang, a national swimming team member and the son of the chairman of the Seun Private School Foundation. The only thing they had in common was that they were in the same school and class. However, after Hae-Gang accidentally discovers their secret, a tenacious and vicious feud begins...

Eight years after a terrible breakup, they reunite. From feuding to coworkers, what's next?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The grandson of the first king who unified the First Continent, Cain von Euclid, was told in his childhood by his revered grandfather that he was destined to become a notorious villain in the future. Unable to bring himself to kill his grandson with such a fate, the grandfather decided instead to raise Cain as a strong child capable of defying destiny, taking him on a journey.

Over the course of 13 years, as they traveled across the Second, Third, and Fourth Continents, Cain acquired extraordinary power. Finally, he sets off on an adventure alone.

Having met and been influenced by many people, will Cain be able to defy fate and avoid becoming the villain he was destined to be?

[Original Novel](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=8861832)      

**Original Webtoon:**    
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/65871749), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12480986), [Blice](https://www.blice.co.kr/mw/detail.kt?novelId=100452)

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/176291)

Friday, humanity's only superhero with overwhelming power, has appeared! Earth faces a crisis of apocalypse due to a single hero. Is it Friday who will destroy humanity, or is it their own evil nature?

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: Bari, the Thunder That Awakened the Star
description:
Abandoned at birth, Ba-Ri is a young girl with a mind-reading aversion. Cursed by the world, she comes to believe herself a monster. Then, the monster hunter Mu Ure appears before her.

 *"You are not a monster. I need you."*

The moment she believes those words, her destiny awakens. The path connecting the afterlife and the human world, her journey to becoming a god, begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*“Don’t you enjoy being punished too much?”

“Ha! Ah! Good, good…! There, so much, huh, it feels good! Eung!”* 

The word she let out, anticipating the pleasure that was about to come to me, was ‘good’. That word inflamed Seong-Baek even more. I had held back a little, but now I like it like this. He also realized how foolish all the affectionate sex he had given her so far had been, out of consideration for her.

 *“You should have told me sooner.”* 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Bimil Danpyeonseon (비밀 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: Adjusting the Gangster Male Lead's Intensity
description:
To adjust the intensity of the gangster male lead on the verge of going dark!

Alone and isolated, Baek Yi-Hae finds herself possessed by a depraved 19+ romance game.

 *“No way... I didn't get targeted by the gangster male lead, did I?!”*

Baek Yi-Hae unexpectedly moves into the Seo family, a notorious gangster clan. To protect her peaceful, safe life as a supporting character, she must prevent baby gangster Seo Do-Gyeom from going dark and secure a happy ending. Amidst the intersection of school life, romance, and the game's threatening rules, the relationship between Baek Yi-Hae and Seo Do-Gyeom grows increasingly complex...!

*“Why are you only kind to me?”*

A sweet yet deadly survival romance where you can never let your guard down!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Min-Woo, who has a complex about not having any muscles on his body, enrolls in a men-only gym. Min-Woo, who believes that if he follows the gym's "special program," he will build muscles like the trainers. He tries to get used to developing his butthole...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

For five years, did you have fun without me? 

There was one thing my husband, Joo Tae-jun, said to me on our wedding day. 

“…Smile. You got what you wanted, so why the long face?”

 Our marriage, built on nothing but cold calculations and a contract, felt like an endless, dark tunnel. Then, at the end of that tunnel, like a ray of light, a child came into my life. But I had no choice but to run. There was no way my child could grow up safely in a household where treating people like objects was the norm. So, I left him with a lie—that I had found another man. 

Five years passed. 

And then— 

“Five years. Did you enjoy yourself?” 

The moment I heard his voice, my whole body froze. 

“You should’ve at least made the most of it with that bastard before I found you. But that won’t be an option anymore.” 

I forced my stiff body to turn—and there he was. 

“My turn now. This time, I’m never letting you go.” 

My ex-husband. My first love. The man I once left behind.

**Original Novel**:   
R19: [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/961105873?srsltid=AfmBOopJXWAhnD_ZWYKHnS7hGqLrkQ3L7KOY9UECp2Uy9jK2HyMloiwz)   

**Original Webtoon:**    
R19: [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12270515)    
R15: [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12270512) 

**Official Translations:**    
R19: [French](https://www.webtoons.com/fr/romance/impure-reunion/list?title_no=8805)

In the eight years since he disappeared, Choi Kang-Woo has become a notorious gangster in the neighborhood. That cold and scary Choi Kang-Woo still likes me.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

A dangerous love triangle between twin brothers.

People call Seo-rin “the Cinderella who turned her life around,” a scandalous woman who walked a tightrope between two brothers and came out on top. 

After losing her parents, Seo-rin was adopted as the foster daughter of the powerful Taegang Group, where her most precious person became the eldest son, Tae Ha-jin. When Ha-jin falls into a coma after an accident, his twin brother Tae Si-jin approaches Seo-rin, and the perilous triangle begins. 

“Amazing. Tae Ha-jin still has that much influence over you.” 

“Ha-jin is… the most precious person to me.” 

“Ah, your first love.” 

To continue Ha-jin’s life-support treatment, Seo-rin needs Si-jin’s consent. But the only thing Si-jin offers in return is a gaze full of impure intentions. 

“There’s only one thing you can sell to me.”

In the end, to save Ha-jin, Seo-rin agrees to marry his twin brother Si-jin. Yet on their wedding day, Ha-jin miraculously opens his eyes…

*"Even if I eat poison three times a day instead of rice, I won't die?"*

No matter how hard he tries, he won't die, the immortal saint. Finally succeeded in dying... I thought it was just a day, but he turned out to be a third-rate bodyguard of Han Gi-Ru in Shandong Province? But his powerful internal energy from the past is still dormant within him. The endless strife in the martial arts world, the secret struggles of the princes surrounding the throne, and the evil Taoist path acting secretly behind it all. The third-rate bodyguard Cheongpung stands against all this chaos.To make matters worse, enemies with whom he had a grudge from the past begin to show up one after another, and the confusion reaches its peak. Will he be able to regain the martial arts skills from his days as a saint and finally reach nirvana?

In 2025, the grand drama of the imperial palace that tears the martial arts world apart begins!!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Under the dazzling lights of the host bar "Kirin," Woo-Seung, who lives as a player, one day runs into the bar's owner, Tae-Jeong. Woo-Seung's bizarre behavior piques Tae-Jeong's curiosity, and Tae-Jeong begins toying with him, using money as bait.

 *"It tastes good. You...should subscribe."*

However, unexpected feelings gradually creep into their relationship, and their fractured inner selves and secrets begin to slowly reveal themselves...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*45-year-old mother of twin sons Jeong Suk-Hui X 25-year-old heavy-smoking lesbian queen Min Se-Ra.*

Crazy lesbian Min Se-Ra who enjoys promiscuous sex. Drunk Se-Ra spots 45-year-old auntie Jeong Suk-Hui living in the same apartment complex. Jeong Suk-Hui becomes Min Se-Ra's perfect prey... 

 *"Wait for me, my heart!"*

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

display_title: This Is My Favorite Secretary Who Defected From Morality
description:
I dropped the series the moment I met my favorite character. Mia Lisicha found herself transported into the novel she loved to read. Her younger sister, of all people, was destined to become the empress. It was supposed to be a life where she could just sit back and reap the benefits of her sister’s success as empress... But to do that, she had to become the secretary to the novel’s mastermind, “Asad Uliel.” She managed to land the job somehow, but Asad Ulriel was a relentless workaholic, and Mia was tormented day after day. One day, having been biding her time as the empress’s older sister, “I’ll lose, Chief. Then I won’t have to put up with this anymore.”

It seems my boss has gone completely mad.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

“I’ll do my best. When I’m with you, oppa.”

“Oppa… I really don’t have the courage, but…”
“What is it? Just say it.”
“Would you sleep with me?”

Is it okay to make such a request to my friend’s older brother?
But… if not today, if it’s not Jang Tae-gyeom…

“I’ll do my best. When I’m with you, oppa.”

**Original Webtoon:**

display_title: What, a Hole Inspection is Homework?
description:
Eun-chae, a freshman, dreamed of a fun campus life at university, but on the school's orientation day, she received an unexpected assignment.

*"From now on, there will be a regular assignment once a week. The assignment's content is..."

"A hole inspection."*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

The two selves of one human being come face to face with each other.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: To You Who Cannot Hear My Misery
description:
Su-Ho has had a crush on Dae-Young since he was little. As soon as he becomes an adult, he confesses to Dae-Young, but is rejected. With the words, "Get a grip, Seo Su-Ho. I raised you. You're my little brother, my only family." But Su-Ho is certain. Moon Dae-Young likes him. He just doesn't realize it. Since then, Su-Ho pretends to be a minor, wears a school uniform, and uses dating apps to meet men who only prey on minors. His only goal is to piss off Moon Dae-Young. And sure enough, Dae-Young, who has been keeping tabs on Su-Ho, raids his scenes every time. Su-Ho is convinced once again. Moon Dae-Young is watching him. He likes him. He's obsessed with him! But why does he keep saying it's not love?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

A man who secretly observes his beautiful sister-in-law, 'Dohyeok'. One day, 'Suji', his sister-in-law's close friend, comes to visit. However, something unexpected happens, and in this situation, the man develops a strong desire for 'Soyeok'. Trying to ignore his feelings, he finds himself increasingly drawn to her, culminating in a passionate encounter that leads to unexpected consequences...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Lee Chan, who started living with his best friend Ban Hwi-Seo on the condition that he watch over his sleepwalking. At night, Hwi-Seo calls himself Do Yu-Shin and lusts after his body, causing Lee Chan to fall into a confusing yet stimulating relationship...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

*The 9th work in the Grand Cross Universe.*

Special agent Transcendent Artemis is on a mission to protect humanity from threats from other Transcendent beings like herself, and as she begins to doubt her own identity and the group she belongs to, this is the story that unfolds.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Tae-Kyung, the CEO of Sona Cosmetics, is perfect and cool. Secretary Yoo-Joo, who had a crush on Tae-Kyung, is fed up with his attitude of only treating her as the head secretary and submits her resignation with a confession. But...

 *"What can I do for you to keep working? I'll give you as much incentives as you want."* 

Tae-Kyung begins to seduce Yoo-Joo in order to win her heart. What will be the end of his seduction?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

*"Once you're in, the only way out is death!"*

Former hitman Jeong Do-gyun thought he'd left that life behind. Now retired, he keeps a low profile, working at a café run by Gu Sang-hyeok—the closest thing to family he has following their days spent in an orphanage. But one day, Sang-hyeok vanishes without a trace. Following his trail, Do-gyun finds himself on a remote, mysterious island—only to discover a horrifying truth. The island is a prison, filled with kidnapped victims forced into slavery, watched over by merciless killers. And to make matters worse, the man who murdered his family is here, too. With a vengeance burning in his veins, Do-gyun prepares for the fight of his life. It’s him against an army of ruthless assassins—only one side is making it out alive.

(Source: Naver, translated)

In an age where love and marriage are 'calculated' and you don't want to lose, a fresh love comes to two men and women living in the smoke of modern society. Hyun Da-Young, a 35-year-old career woman who has followed the elite course but is anxious because marriage is not going as planned. Choi Woo-Jin, a 35-year-old single man who thinks his older sister's failed marriage is due to their age difference. Will they, who are past the ideal age for marriage and are impatient, be able to overcome the 10-year age difference under the pressure of reality and become pure in the face of provocative love?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

The boy in your class you have a crush on turns out to be a butler at a butler cafe! Bang Go-Woon's struggle to win his heart with 999% sweet desserts! 

A romantic comedy combining sweet desserts and innocent love.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*"Milk... Milk is flowing."*

A direct junior who accidentally acquired a sweet(?) body due to a fragment of a curse. Undine feels that her life is not going as planned after being caught up in the milky(?) junior's... no, not the dick... no, the milky(?) junior...!!!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Lee Hyo-Min, the very embodiment of debauchery, relying solely on his looks to secretly throw parties while his wife is away. One morning, suffering from a hangover as usual, he encounters his new son, Choi Hyuk, for the first time in ages. Just as he marveled at how quickly his child had grown, with this unfamiliar build and expression, Hyo-Min felt strange after drinking the water Hyuk offered him. Only then did Hyo-Min notice the unnatural glint in his son's eyes...

*“I bought this because you drink this stuff often.”

“It's only natural for a father to love his son.”*

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

My Funeral Has Begun. 

After her death, Deborah awakens in her sister Irene’s body. To clear Irene of murder charges and change her fate, she sets out to uncover the truth. But three men stand in her way—her stepbrother Abel, ex-fiancé Henry, and the persistent Duke Lahan.

**Original Webtoon:**

**Official Translations:**

On his lonely birthday, he makes a wish on an old family talisman — *“Please let me meet someone I can love.”*

Moments later, a man appears at his door, holding a cake.

*“Don’t fall for me. That feeling… it’s fake. The charm made it.”  
“You made the wish. So now, you’re responsible for it.”*

A fateful meeting bound by a charm... but is their love really just magic, or something real that bloomed in its wake?

---

*"From today on, I will never see you again."*

Helena, abandoned by her husband on their wedding day, is about to break the vicious bond. But just as she's about to sever ties, her and her husband's bodies switch.

 *"One year from now. If you don't reconnect your fate, you will die as the natural course of events dictates."*

With this profound prophecy, the fates of the two begin to waver.

(Source: Naver, translated)
*Note: Part of Playtoon's Play Danpyeonseon (플래이 단편선) Collection.*

Ye-Ji, an 18-year-old student at Hana Arts High School, wants to win the world's best classical international violin competition held in Korea. She wants to fulfill her older sister Ye-Seo dream, who died a year ago. Ye-Ji practices repeatedly on the expensive violin "John Webster" that her older sister had borrowed from the DK Music Foundation, but Ye-Ji's mother, Su-Jin, has conflicts with Ye-Ji, who does not hesitate to abuse herself for practice, and eventually returns the violin to the music foundation. Ye-Ji, who believes that neither the competition nor the victory are meaningful without Webster, is about to give up everything when she receives a text message saying she has passed the final round of the competition. Will Ye-Ji be able to get John Webster back and win the competition? Ye-Ji's adventure in the city to get John Webster back begins now!

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Based on the original short story by novelist Kim Young-Ha, the first page of a tragedy entangled between three men and one woman begins. The webtoon's unique interpretation and writing style fills in the blanks that were not revealed in the original.* 

The first story, The Origin of Life, is Seo-Jin's first love, In-Ah, who appears like a miracle before his eyes. Surprisingly, she is the same as when she was a teenager. New truths are revealed in front of the love between the two people who seemed like they would last forever. "Seo-Jin, I'm married."

The second story, A Christmas Carol, is the death of 'Cho Jin-Sook', a Korean living in Germany who returned to Korea after 20 years. All three men surrounding her are murder suspects. The more you dig into the charred love between the four men and women, the more it heads toward destruction. What truth will be revealed at the end of these two stories that were reborn as webtoons?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Once known as the ultimate killer, "Knife Rabbit" retired and lived a quiet life under the name of chef "Goya." One day, he senses an indescribable, enchanting scent from a girl named "Jin Seo-Nu" who visits his restaurant. Pursuing her are his former colleagues, former killers, and "natural enemies." These enemies, intent on completing their mission, and Goya, the chef, desperate to monopolize the scent, their desires and instincts surrounding the girl become intertwined.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: With My Hated Alpha Male Friend
description:
When Sia opens her eyes in the emergency room, she hears something unbelievable — after living her whole life as a Beta, her genetic type has suddenly changed… she’s now an Omega. And her lifelong rival, Jihoon, suddenly starts acting suspiciously. Their relationship takes a dark turn as long-buried tension, desire, and obsession come to the surface — forcing Sia to face a truth she never wanted to acknowledge.

display_title: Shall I Pierce It For You?
description:
Raised under strict parents who constantly threw harsh words at her, Yeonjin would sometimes visit a piercing shop as a small act of rebellion. The handsome shop owner, who had always given her a curious look, finally asked her on a rainy day when they were alone in the shop.

"So, do you really want me to pierce you today?"

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/wanna_pierce), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/wanna_pierce), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000077998), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14073662), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=260327)

*"1 billion won, loan approved."*

A large loan is deposited into the account of a father who has decided to commit suicide, claiming it's for a future bank account. It's unclear when the money will arrive or where it will come from. One thing is certain: the moment the deposit is made, his life will plunge into an irreversible hell.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Mysterious Slick Scumbag X Prickly Straight-Laced Idol*

Kang Beom, currently the hottest idol in South Korea. One day, after drinking a beverage given to him in the waiting room, he dozed off. When he came to, he found himself being assaulted by a huge man. The man, who introduced himself as Seong Wui-Teon, used this incident as leverage to start demanding increasingly unreasonable things from Beom...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

display_title: I Want To Hug Dad Today
description:
One day Sangha was suddenly kidnapped on her way home and murdered. During her final moments all she could look at was the wishing bracelet she had, the one she used to wish that someday she could be with the person she loves the most. With that being her last memory before fainting, Sangha suddenly wakes up four months before her death, Knowing that her death is already set, she decides to fulfill her wish and be with the man she loves, Her "Dad" which has a particular relationship with her.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Tilda Vallinea Belmont, the elegant and perfect saint. The only daughter of a sacred family that produced a pope, Tilda was a perfect woman of both brilliance and beauty. However, burdened by the guilt of causing her mother's death in a childhood explosion of divine power, she lived a dull life. Tilda's husband, Windsor, suddenly demands a divorce, declaring his intention to marry her stepmother, Aclair. Aclair, who had been disguised as a kind stepmother, reveals her true colors to Tilda. Driven to the brink by Aclair's scheme, Tilda, consumed by a desire to live, makes a dangerous choice...

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: When You Open the Door, There Are Monsters
description:
Ordinary student Mogyeong receives a mysterious package from an unknown sender: inside is a longsword, followed by a text message saying, “You’ll need this soon, so be prepared.” Not long after, strange “doors” appear inside his home, and intruders with bizarre abilities break in, claiming they’re looking for “that guy’s bloodline” as they kidnap his mother. Chasing after them, Mogyeong discovers that he is a descendant of “immigrants” who crossed over from another world to Earth and that those doors connect to this other realm. Together with newly found allies, Mogyeong begins a desperate fight across worlds to rescue his mother from the monsters and factions that lurk beyond the doors.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=845387), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13468800)

display_title: It’d Be Nice to Do It in Prison
description:
*"Correctional officer, please help me."*

Taehui confesses to the correctional officer about being molested by the leader for a week. The correctional officer, who had been listening silently with cold eyes, opens his mouth...

*"Take off your clothes and show me. Proof that your breasts were sucked."*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

July 1999: What befell the people was not the apocalypse, but superpowers?! Thanks to this, the 21st century became an era where heroes and villains clashed. The loner villain Pyeong-Hwa runs into the hero Sa-Rang while on the run. In a tense situation, Sa-Rang unexpectedly proposes to Pyeong-Hwa with a ring... 

A love story unfolds between Sa-Rang and a Benz with a broken steering wheel, living in their own romantic comic book, and their chase-and-betrayal.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

From childhood, Heinrich was raised by his father, the emperor, as nothing more than an instrument of the imperial household, subjected to abuse. Such treatment caused Heinrich to become obsessed with Theo, who had shown him even the slightest bit of attention. As an adult, Heinrich succeeded in seizing the emperor's power and commanded Theo to submit beneath his feet... 

 *“I am delighted that Theo is now in my grasp.”*

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

So-Hwa, a goblin living in an old library. Yun-Woo, who is in love with So-Hwa, makes a contract to share his soul in order to be with her. Repeated reincarnations, an uncontrollable and mismatched relationship. Will Yun-Woo and So-Hwa be able to love again?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's Sunaemul Danpyeonseon (순애물 단편선) Collection.*

Adrian, a vampire who accidentally bit a witch while trying to suck blood and broke his fangs, ends up living with the witch Hilda, who loves lust, against his will until his fangs fully grow back.

 *"I'll have to cater to your style of play. I'll use all those disgusting tools to make sure you're taken down."

"I won't let a pervert like you get away with it, even if I die!"*

Despite these words, Adrian begins to crave for a more intense... play...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Inoe Danpyeonseon (인외 단편선) Collection.*

Yeon-Woo, the son of a hero who protected the country, is the number one candidate for groom among the village girls because he excels in both scholarship and martial arts. His only worry is that his lower body cannot stand due to erectile dysfunction. In order to solve his worry, he hears a rumor about a rock that grants wishes and climbs up the mountain behind the village, where he finds a young man being raped by a monster. As he hurries to save him, Yeon-Woo notices something wrong with his own body first...!

 *"Why is it standing up all of a sudden?"*

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Korea’s top star. Actress Seo Sa-Ra.

 *"What do you think I've improved the most in my ten years as an actress?"
"Hmm… my acting?"
"Nope. My patience and mental illness."* 

After surviving ten years in the entertainment industry, she thought she'd been through everything. But then—

 *"I’m Yoon Seung-tae."* 

A capable and handsome third-generation chaebol shows up with an unexpected offer! 

*"Can we meet again next time?"
"That sounds almost like a threat. I’m misunderstanding, right?"
"It’s just a proposal. Something mutually beneficial."*

A man trying to cast Sa-Ra into his own life.

 *"You’re like a real Cinderella. You left behind your earring, just like the glass slipper. I may not be a prince, but I’m looking for the Cinderella who left this behind."*

The genre of the story he’s plotting is—

 *"Good thing, I guess. Anyone with pierced ears can wear them, after all."*

Is this really a romantic comedy…?

display_title: Who is the Northern Grand Duke's pick?
description:
The Grand Duke who rules the North, Lawrence Celet. A beautiful young man named Luke who doesn't fit in with the North comes to visit him. Luke introduces himself as the 'Administrator'. However, this is the territory managed by Laurence. What on earth does this young man manage? 

*"A possessed person."
"I am the Administrator who came to save you who was possessed by this BL game."*

Lawrence Celet, who fell into the 2-on-1-offense Academy BL game, intuitively feels that he cannot postpone his choice now that the Administrator has arrived. An inevitable ending. And the Grand Duke's choice. Who will the Northern Grand Duke pick?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

What? You can meet girls once you get into college?! Summoning up the courage, he confessed during the freshman MT trip— only to get slapped in front of the entire school… Ugh… I want to be reborn already—AAAAAH!! %@#?!@#!! —Snap. After an accident, his soul is swapped with the most popular, king-of-the-campus pretty boy at school. But… I didn’t even do anything— so why are classmates, underclassmen, and even a female professor throwing themselves at me?! Was meeting women really this easy? Damn looks-obsessed society… Heh… hehehe… hahaha— Fine. I’ll enjoy this properly.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Gae-Hwa, an evil spirit who pretended to be the lord of the ancestral home, was born. However, his peaceful days were shattered when the eldest son, Yu-Hyeon, destroyed the lord's altar. Faced with the threat of being defeated by Yu-Hyeon, Gae-Hwa lies, saying he can only ascend to the throne if he resolves his grudge.

 *"What grudge is yours?"

"...that you died without ever having sex?"* 

Yu-Hyeon then offers to help Gae-Hwa, and begins touching him "there."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

display_title: An Exorcism With My Childhood Friend
description:
Before heading off to college, best friends Do-hui and Hui-Yeong visit an abandoned mall rumored to grant wishes. The place feels like a dud until Do-Hui returns home and begins experiencing terrifying nightly visitations. What starts as ghostly touches soon escalates into overwhelming, carnal sensations he can't ignore. Driven to his breaking point, Do-Hui begs his "reliable" friend for help. He thinks he’s found a safe harbor, but he’s actually walked right into a trap. In this game of shadows, the ghost isn't the one Do-Hui should be afraid of, it's the friend who’s been waiting years to finally make his move.me!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

Eunwon, who has a one-sided crush on their older brother, Woosuk, has been living with him for a year. Actually, Woosuk is not their biological brother, but their older step-brother...however, to be close to him, Eunwon even cross-dressed and became his roommate. They anticipated a heart-fluttering campus life, but everything changed after a night with a drunk Woosuk at a club gathering. Woosuk acts like nothing happened, having no memory of the event, leaving Eunwon confused. Finally, Eunwon decides to sleep with the drunk Woosuk again...

*“Brother...no, oppa, do you want to sleep with me?”*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

display_title: [Class Difference Anthology] If You Steal the Duke's Treasure and Run Away
description: *Note: Part of Metatoon's Sinbuncha Danpyeonseon (신분차 단편선) Collection.*

Noah, a nameless stage actor, struggles to get by while living with her younger sibling.

One day, while rehearsing with the troupe as usual, Noah notices a man she’s never seen before.

Assuming he’s a new member, Noah doesn’t think much of it—until she realizes that she’s the only one who can see the man.

The mysterious man hands Noah a string of prayer beads, and as soon as Noah touches them, she’s overwhelmed by unfamiliar memories.

In her confusion, she accidentally drops the beads.
As the beads scatter in all directions, the man utters an ominous phrase:

“Baek Noah, you’re going to die soon.”


[Original Webtoon](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/bf_dream)

description: *Note: The first story in Daewon's Neungyong Romance Danpyeon (능욕로맨스단편) Collection.*

The physics club “Tachyon” is on the verge of disbandment. A Korean literature student who they fall for at first sight wants to join the club to build a time machine. So… they built one. Can the Tachyon members actually travel to the future with this time machine? A story about the ‘process’ of building a time machine using modern physics.

**Original Webtoon:**

display_title: Seoul Ghost Stories - Civil Complaints Department
description:
From the ghost in the bathroom at Outback in Sinchon to the local god of the neighborhood shrine, we handle complaints about "everything" in Seoul. Ranked #1 in resident satisfaction! The complaint log of Jeong-Sol, a new civil servant at the Seoul Strange Tales Complaints Division. Seoul is a sacred land. A land of strange tales and myths, a land where all these sacred and strange beings coexist with humans. Heejoo decides to confess after hearing that the junior she has had her eye on as a 'sex wannabe' is taking a leave of absence. However, contrary to her plan to subtly use alcohol as an aid, things get twisted, and she ends up confessing to the wrong guy...

[Original Webtoon](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/sorry_not_you)

display_title: A Reward For the Crying Child!
description:
*"Because you keep crying... I'm so attracted to you."* 

Poor college student Kang Si-Woo gets into a huge fight with Han Do-Woon, a top student at a group gathering, whom he usually dislikes. Then, Si-Woo accidentally witnesses Do-Woon crying while drunk. At that moment, Si-Woo's body starts to heat up uncontrollably, and he finally asks Do-Woon, "Have you ever had sex with a guy?"

(Source: Lezhin, translated) 

*Note: Part of Blühen's Ssasek Danpyeonseon (싸섹 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: About the Fact That My Friend Being a Man
description:
A sad otaku who always catches only minorities. To her, she finally meets her SNS friend, Mang-I, offline. Mang-I, who has a delicate drawing style and soft emotions… is actually a guy? As if that wasn’t enough, he caused an accident on the first day they met…!!

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

We shouldn't be like this.

*"Lane, let's get married. With me."*

Lane, the CEO of Good Couples, a matchmaking company, finally secured a contract with the incredibly popular single man, Ethan Lakers!! But with me... what? Marriage?!

 *"We shouldn't be like this."

"Why, because you're my couples manager? Then you shouldn't have driven me crazy."*

Lane doesn't dislike Ethan like this...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The Korean War. The story of Korean soldiers fighting together in a foreign legion of different nations and races.

During the Korean War, the Korean soldiers and civilians assigned to the French battalion transported supplies as the 'Porter Unit'. At first, the French soldiers seemed distant, but as the battles continued, they became close and eventually became comrades who were more relied on than anyone else. The story of them fighting as one despite being from different countries and races.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

When I threw up in front of my first love who confessed to me, the one who came to me was... my first love's older brother?

I have this habit of throwing up when I get nervous. One day, my first love, whom I'd liked for so long, confessed to me, and I ended up throwing up right in front of them. I was drowning my sorrows in alcohol when someone appeared before me. It was my first love's older brother, Hyun-Seok. After pouring out everything I could and couldn't say to him, the alcohol made my memory fade... 

When I opened my eyes again, lying next to me was... none other than my friend's brother, completely naked?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
*Note: Part of Blühen's Ssasek Danpyeonseon (싸섹 단편선) Collection.*

Song Da-Na is a planning PD of a webtoon production company and a makeup YouTuber with 240,000 subscribers. During a makeup live for a movie, her boyfriend suddenly comes to her house and shows her shocking appearance. With a sore head from the aftereffects of a breakup, a hangover, and even rude coworkers who rush at her as soon as she gets to work, her team junior, Kim Seok-Jin, showcases her videos during a meeting and announces that he will plan a webtoon centered around YouTubers ! 

"Did he do it on purpose because he knew it was me ?"

She gets really drunk and ends up confessing her double life to him. The next day, Seok-Jin blackmail her to cooperate on the project.

**Original Webtoon:**       
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/65780593), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%82%98%EC%9D%98-%EC%9D%BC%EC%BD%94%EB%A5%BC-%EB%8F%84%EC%99%80%EC%A4%98/4373)

**Official Translations:**      
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/179895)

Ji-Yu-Young is being used as a stand-in for her crush, but she can't stop her unrequited love. Her inconvenient boss, Kwon-Kyo-Won, interferes in Yoo-Young's daily life, which is struggling with loneliness. The teacher, who has been piercing Yoo-Young with his uniquely persistent gaze, eventually gives up his body and tells her to forget her first love...


[Original Webtoon](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/melting_points)
*Note: Part of Metatoon's Bimil Danpyeonseon (비밀(秘密) 단편선) Collection.*

Top idol 'Kwon Jae-Sung' suddenly returns to his hometown to take a break from his prime, and there, his childhood friend 'Lee Soo-Ah', who he had separated from when he was young, is preparing to become an adult. Kwon Jae-Sung, who had a hard time parting ways, wants to impress his presence on Lee Soo-Ah again before they go their separate ways as adults.

(Source: Naver, translated)

A younger brother who is a student at Seoul National University and an older brother who is a repeat student. The two identical twin brothers are so different. Jun-Seo, who has been compared to his younger brother Jun-Su his whole life, ends up wearing his younger brother's pajamas at his mother's suggestion, and thus begins his precarious campus life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: The Life Tips of a Pretty Girl
description:
In 2006, Kang Hae-Na, known as the troublemaker of Beomchon High School, is actually just a young girl who dreams of love! One day, while reading the comic book , Hae-Na suddenly finds herself possessed by the body of 'Kang Hae-Na, a normal student at Beomchon High School' in the year 2025. If she wants to return to her original body, she is told to find her destined partner here... Destined partner?? Here?!! 

(Source: Naver, translated)

Yeong-won, who once again failed to secure a full professorship, gets drunk in a fit of rage and ends up sleeping with Ui-hyeon, her closest friend. Yeong-won soon discovers that she can only escape the pressure of her professorship when having sex. She then spends a passionate night with her colleague, Louis, who suggests that Yeong-won use Ui-hyeon for a...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Dragons are considered the most sacred of all natural creatures. It's said that the dragon's Yeouiju can grant any wish. The fairy Seolha, who stumbles upon a dragon's offspring, welcomes it into her home, hoping it might grant her wish. However, the longer she spends with Yooseong, the more she finds herself drawn to him...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

The genius astronomer 'Woo Joo-Hyeok' dies. 15 years later, his resurrection android 'Ryu Seong-Woo' is created. Ryu Seong-Woo, who possesses Woo Joo-Hyeok's face and memories, loves Woo Joo-Hyeok's wife 'Ryu Byeol', but Ryu Byeol rejects him as just a robot... A twisted love story between a pianist who can no longer play the piano due to the trauma of losing her husband, and an android who lives forever despite being lifeless.

(Source: Naver, translated)

**Original Webtoon:**     
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=837522), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12358050)

Woo-Yeon (27) has been dedicated to the company for 7 years, but is passed over for promotion because he is a high school graduate. He postpones cleaning with the excuse of working overtime, and his one-room apartment becomes a garbage dump. Woo-Yeon, who has become lethargic due to the fatigue and stress of the past, cannot get up from the garbage dump. Until a strange woman, Ha-Ra (28), comes and cleans the garbage dump... What is her true identity?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Do Ha-Neul is an ordinary college student living a bright and carefree life. Her only complex is that she has difficulty making choices due to the trauma of her parents’ divorce. One day, when she was bored and ordinary, she meets a famous art student, Kang Seon-Han, who is famous for being handsome… “Don’t you remember me?” Kang Seon-Han approaches her suspiciously as if they know each other, and while she gets entangled with him, her first love Seo Hae-Yang comes to visit her, and somehow she ends up living with her first love in the same house. Kang Seon-Han, whose future is certain, and Seo Hae-Yang, who unwaveringly follows her own path. The two people are strangely similar. “I like you.” The same confession from the two people who look similar. “Think about it carefully. You like me too, right?” Both of them are sure that Ha-Neul likes them. Who do I really like? I like them both so much. But there is only one choice. You or you. At the moment of choice that comes, they realize true love.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

There's a perennial aspiring hero, born with the makings of a hero, but never given the opportunity to truly realize his talents, leaving him gripped by feelings of inferiority and defeat. He dismisses other heroes as mere populist kitsch and prides himself on becoming a true hero. Then, after a fraudulent loan from a loan shark, he's forced to enter the hero audition he so loathed—the very height of kitsch. Will he become kitsch or a true hero, the Übermensch?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

 *Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Young Mary fell into the sea. At the moment when his consciousness faded, he saw a dazzling silver-haired man. Was he the one who saved him? He couldn't forget that image. He looked exactly like the mermaid princess in the fairy tale. From that day on, Mary became obsessed with mermaids. In order to create a mermaid just like the man he saw as a child, he ended up going to a human auction house...

 *"Why did you buy me...?"*

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

*Note: Part of Bomtoon's Kkulman Danpyeonseon (꿀맛 단편선) Collection.*

Ji-Han, a doctor who specializes in treating patients, meets a new patient, Lee Hyun, who is full of problems. Their first meeting was not so good, but as they continue to receive mysterious treatments, the two become closer. Ji-Han gives Lee Hyun, who longs to go out, a drug that is still under development, and Lee Hyun, who sneaks out in the middle of the night, gets caught by a mysterious person...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

*Note: Part of Bomtoon's Kkulman Danpyeonseon (꿀맛 단편선) Collection.*

Eun-Soo is forced to go on a blind date with a 60-year-old loan shark to finance her adoptive father's presidential campaign. However, the person who shows up for the blind date is not the old man, but his grandson, Un-Ho. Un-Ho is Eun-Soo's unforgettable first love, but to Un-Ho, Eun-Soo is just the daughter of his enemy... 

At that moment when love and hate intersect, dangerous emotional sparks begin to bloom.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

display_title: My Male Servant, Let's Meet Just Once
description:
*"I'm curious about men, and since you're the only man in this house, I should at least see yours!"* 

Yeon-Seul became a widow after her husband died violently before they could even have their first night together. Yeon-Seul's curiosity about men only grows as she lives alone as a quiet, little housewife. Meanwhile, the good-looking and handsome servant Dol-Soe keeps lingering around her... 

Now that her mother-in-law is away! Yeon-Seul can't hold back her curiosity and decides to drag Dol-Soe along.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*"Sir, please be my husband for just one night."*

Born into a noble family, Su-Woon is the often-overlooked second son. But he grows into the ideal husband candidate—passing the national exam as the top scholar at age 20. Perfect from head to toe, many women try to approach him, yet Su-Woon has no interest in women or marriage. Until one day… Su-Woon, who had been enjoying a comfortable and elegant life as a refined scholar, is suddenly kidnapped— and loses his virginity to a complete stranger! Now, the abducted Su-Woon sets off in search of the crazy woman who stole his first time…!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Seonbi Danpyeonseon (선비 단편선) Collection.*

"Hey, dating me is seriously a steal."

"No, hngh. Once I pay off all my debt, then..."

"You're gonna just drop dead?"

Nod, nod, I nodded my head at Gu Taehwi's words. That's right. Once I cleared this damn mountain of debt my dad left behind, I planned to just drop dead. And with a completely peaceful heart.

If I died leaving behind debt, I didn't know who my debt would torment next. Mom, aunt, uncle, niece/nephew. Those gangster bastards think anyone with shared blood is family. I didn't want to be a nuisance even in death. While I was frowning with such serious thoughts, Gu Taehwi, who was stuck to my back like glue, snorted.

"Bullshit. I'll pull you out of hell." 

"Ah…. Hngh, why hell?" 

"Then what, you expected a bitch who's messing around with a gangster to go to heaven?"

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12376822), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/5285001056), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/metatoon037), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/moonlight_sequence), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000069100)

*“Isn’t this world a little strange?”* 

A world where everyone has their own clichés. Baek Seo-Na’s wild school life where she wants to be successful in life and avoid boring clichés.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Humanity suddenly falls into a winter hibernation for an unknown reason. In order to minimize social losses, a "hibernation period" of humanity occurs where everyone hibernates and wakes up. Seo-Woo, who does not hibernate, spends the hibernation period every year with people like himself. And hibernation as usual. This time, something is different. While people are sleeping, strange things are happening.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*"Would my friends have felt regret or envy as they watched me suddenly transfer to Seoul?"*

Shin-Bi, a neighborhood resident who's lived in the same place for 17 years, is forced to leave her beloved neighborhood and move to Seoul when her older brother, Shin-Hye, transfers to a preparatory school. Leaving her familiar surroundings and encountering new people...

Shin-Bi, who has never met anyone before, yearns for her old neighborhood. Will she be able to navigate this sudden shift in her mindset? A tumultuous coming-of-age story of high school students on the brink of adulthood!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

A blizzard falls from the sky and tears open the ground, and with it, a giant unidentified monster, “Agwi,” appears! A story about three siblings who protect each other in the endless winter after the apocalypse.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The main character, Hee-Seo, works at the robot pet company 'Dogpet'. Hee-Seo, who has been interested in animal rights for several years, begins to doubt the company's ethics. At that time, she witnesses illegal dumping of trash in an alley...

(Source: Naver, translated)

In the southern part of the Queen Amar Empire continent, a small rural village bordering the sea, 'Ober'. After the war, Nixie, a former soldier who bought a house in a corner of Ober with all her savings, wants to become a farmer and live each day happily. There, she meets Benjamin Richter, a deserter and painter from the enemy country, the Earth Empire...

 *"Painter, I'll give you all my savings, 260 gold, so paint a picture for me."

"...Yesterday, your savings were 500 gold?"

"Wow, I got caught."*

Nixie, who lives with the modifiers of crazy and mad, follows Benjamin around and harasses him(?) as befitting those descriptions. 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: A Brother Who Hugs Me With His Chest
description:
What if the ideal type from your dirty dreams appears in real life? And... as a nude model?!

Ryu Kwon, a freshman in the painting department and a genius painter who only knows how to draw, receives public attention for a piece he created that captures the person from his secret dreams. Kwon, who was completely infatuated with a man with a healthy body and a cheerful personality, meets a model who looks exactly like him, Michelle, in a nude painting class, and erotic events begin to unfold between the two...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

*“Did I become a muse because I had a heart, or was I a heart from the beginning because I was a muse?”*

Jeong Da-Eun, who had been obsessed with pure literature. A novel for adults that she came across by chance shakes up her daily life. She feels an unfamiliar thrill and stimulation for the first time. She decides not to just read, but to write it herself. However, the sentences she was familiar with kept slipping in front of the unfamiliar genre, and something was lacking. She returned to an old bookstore out of frustration. And there— Jeong Da-Eun meets someone. Emotions that must never be revealed, and an unbearable love for her muse. This should never have started.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

The protagonist, %%, graduated from college with a degree in chemistry, but struggled with repeated job failures. But then, an advertisement for the civil service exam appeared before his eyes. Passing in just eight months. Guaranteed retirement and a pension. And with all the benefits and the respect of those around him. For %%, the Grade 9 civil service job seemed like the perfect fit. The low pay, the high competition, and the challenging exam didn't matter to him. And so, %% embarked on the civil service exam.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Three years ago, a poisoning murder occurred in a luxury apartment. Hwa-Young, who lost her mother in this incident, begins collecting a large sum of money to find the culprit. Believed to make a fortune, she engages in a crime known as "fishing," but soon realizes she's the target of human trafficking... As she struggles to escape, "If you're going to run, take me with you." "Smile Bear," filled with memories of her mother, appears, wielding a blood-dripping hatchet.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Crazy school life continues, survive Kang Haram!

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: A Man Who Must Live to Die
description:
So Tae-Seong chose death because life was difficult. Through a mysterious group, he switches bodies with a terminally ill person and tries to die quickly without going to prison for suicide. However, there were rules that must be followed while changing bodies, and those rules put us in crisis. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: The Cake You Make Is the Cake You Eat
description:
Deoksun, who makes rice cakes in a courtesan house, one day meets her destined partner, Taemi. But that’s not all… her ideal type, the person she’s always dreamed of, also wants to “make rice cakes” with her…

“Wait, the rice cakes you wanted to make with me weren’t the ones you actually prepare… you meant me?!”

Will they be able to clear up this misunderstanding and make the rice cakes they both desire so much?

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/what_kind_of_dduk), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/what_kind_of_dduk)

*"This is Sparrow Tour, a saltwater fish processing specialist."*

One day, Baek Han joins a suspicious company that hunts saltwater fish. Saltwater fish are monsters created by humans in the past, preying on human life. Saltwater fish, preying on human life, are said to lurk throughout the country. This Korean-style fantasy adventure follows Baek Han on a journey across the country, following tales and legends to catch them.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: A God Is Better Than a Ghost
description:
As the second son of a shaman family, Su-Ho was born with insufficient yang energy and has been plagued by ghosts since childhood. He was able to be free from ghosts as long as he wore the family heirloom ring he received from his grandmother. However, on the first day of college, he lost the ring. He ran away from the ghosts that had started appearing again and found himself in an alley. There, he encountered a man wearing his ring…

 *“Give me back the ring.”

“I can’t give you the ring. I have to be with you.”*

Su-Ho is flustered by Shin-Woo, who uses the ring as a hostage and manipulates him as he pleases. It seems clear that they shouldn’t get involved any further—but why does he keep getting drawn to Shin-Woo? What will be the end of this strange relationship that started over a single ring?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The chaotic cohabitation of Ailee, an alien who came to Earth to experience love, and Go Sun-Do, a relationship counseling YouTuber, begins ! Ailee tries to infiltrate human society while hiding her identity... Will she, who came from a world where love does not exist, be able to feel the emotion called love ?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=840874), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12891537)

The newest rising star captivating all of South Korea: Kim Younghan.\
Ji-ye, a film section journalist, desperately wanted to pretend she didn’t know him.\
"Hi, I’m..."\
"...Sunbae Ji-ye?"\
"Ji-ye, didn’t you just say you didn’t know Kim Younghan?"
Back in college, he was the junior who almost threw himself at her while drunk...\
How is she supposed to say she came here to interview him?\
"If you don’t have a boyfriend, how about me?"\
"Want to do it with me?"\
"That’s not what I meant at all!"\
"So what? You’re into me, aren’t you?"

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/elusive_touch), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/ELUSIVE_TOUCH), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13317337) 

**Official Translations:**    
[Japanese](https://mechacomic.jp/books/239244)

Kwon Seok was suffering from hair loss. 'Hair subscription service' appeared like a ray of light to him. With this amazing technology, Kwon Seok's life began to change.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Jae-Hui luckily lands a job at a major corporation's design team. Jung-Hun, a fellow employee, was everyone's favorite for his handsome looks and friendly personality. Jae-Hui, too, found himself attracted to Jung-Hun, who was close to his ideal type. However, soon after, Jae-Hui witnessed Jung-Hun gossiping about him. Instead, he shamelessly confronts Jung-Hun, and decides to test him with a bold proposal. Jung-Hun unexpectedly offers Jae-Hui an unexpected answer. Instead, Jae-Hui finds himself swayed by Jung-Hun...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

There's always at least one person in every classroom... Everyone curses, but if you look closely, it's a story from our surroundings that's not like someone else's.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=841501), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12981120)

**Official Translations:**    
[Indonesian](https://www.webtoons.com/id/drama/that-one-kid-in-class/list?title_no=9050), [Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0004170)

Illece is sold to a man she doesn't even know because of her gambling-addicted father. She eventually runs away from home and evades her father's pursuit, where she receives help from a man named Cassis. He seems familiar, but it turns out he's a boy she knew from childhood. Cassis has grown into a handsome man and shows her endless kindness, and Illece feels compelled to lean on him... but can she completely trust him?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*“Father, please go to prison in my place."*

On the day before his wedding, Ryu Seo-ho, a team leader in insurance assessment, kills someone in a drowsy‑driving accident. The person he turns to in order to cover up the incident is his father — a man he cut ties with 15 years ago. But from that day on, their false conspiracy begins to dredge up the long‑buried truth of the past that had been hidden for those 15 years.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Go Miso, a beautiful influencer admired by everyone. Paeng Miso, the girl who has always wanted to be like her.

One fateful day, a strange being in a closed-down school bathroom offers a ten-day deal. Paeng Miso borrows Go Miso’s body—and steps into the world she’s always dreamed of.

The lights, the applause, the love…all finally within reach. But as the days pass, desire turns into obsession. Paeng Miso begins searching for a way to keep living as Go Miso—no matter the cost.

Because to have everything… she must give up everything.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=842624), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13098964)

**Original Webtoon:**

Choi Sung-Hyun looks like the perfect catch, handsome, brilliant, and effortlessly privileged. In truth, he’s barely getting by, clinging to a carefully crafted illusion funded by the wealthy men he dates. That fragile life begins to unravel when Kang Joon reenters the picture. Unable to accept being forgotten, Joon’s fixation turns dark. His presence closes in, his control deepens, and before long, Sung-Hyun finds himself trapped in an obsession he can’t escape.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A spoiled nobleman, a vengeful servant, and a house lost in the fog. Sang-Ro thought money could buy him anything, but it can’t buy his way out of this nightmare. After falling from a cliff, he is "rescued" by Du-Gyeon, the servant he spent years abusing. Now, with no one to hear his cries, Sang-Ro must face a terrifying truth: Du-Gyeon has been nursing a dark obsession since they were children. The master has become the plaything, and the servant is finally ready to collect his dues.

When a moment of impulsive violence leaves Victor with a corpse on his hands, he expects his life to end. Instead, he meets Nathan, a man who seems to have been waiting for this exact moment. Nathan promises total immunity in exchange for one simple wish: Victor’s heart and body. Trapped in a contract with a man who is clearly not right in the head, Victor realizes that being rescued might just be the most painful thing that’s ever happened to him.

However, his constitution only allows him to absorb male sexual energy, which he finds utterly repulsive. After enduring it for so long that his health deteriorates, he gets scolded by her older brother. Terrified by his threat to hand him over to a perverted old man if he doesn't consume someone's sexual desire, Ga-Ram promises to try consuming the sexual desire of the classmate sitting next to him at the academy he'll soon attend. But wouldn't you know it, that classmate happens to be Jae-Chan, his childhood friend he's grown distant from...?

What would you do for me? Despite possessing everything—money, looks, and popularity—

Su-Hyun, a delinquent, yearns for love, driven by an inferiority complex. He's exposed and trampled by Na-Yeon, the model student who's the polar opposite of him. Su-Hyun vows revenge, but gradually falls for Na-Yeon's unconditional love. Na-Yeon tests Su-Hyun's heart...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Gyul, the protagonist of a divorced family, is shocked one day to discover that her mother is considering remarriage. Even the other family seems a bit strange...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Mojebi, a palace maid, was enjoying a peaceful life serving Nam Moran, the Crown Prince's chambermaid. Then one day, Nam Moran's whereabouts become unknown after she moves. Anxious, Mojebi sneaks into the Crown Prince's chambers to inquire about Moran's whereabouts, but there she uncovers an unexpected secret. Faced with the horrifying truth hidden within the Crown Prince's chambers, Mojebi struggles to survive in the treacherous palace, paralyzed by the horrific truth. Yet, she cannot turn a blind eye to the court ladies who fell victim to the Crown Prince's secrets. For she sees their spirits in her eyes.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

display_title: Replay: The Fancam That Turned Me
description:
By chance, Seunghyun stumbles across a fancam of the idol his girlfriend adores. The video, already at 5.48 million views, is the ultimate bias-making fancam, and the star of it is none other than his former next-door neighbor, Seohyun, who once confessed to him back in grade school. Ever since seeing that video, Seunghyun can’t get it out of his head. Even in the middle of being with his girlfriend, Seohyun’s image keeps flashing before him.

*“Am I… actually losing to Seohyun right now?”*  
*“N-no, that’s not it…”*

Overwhelmed, Seunghyun flees back to his hometown, only to run into the very person who once jump-started his private fantasies.

*“Hyung, it’s me. Seohyun!”*

Now reunited, Seohyun begins to tease Seunghyun with increasingly bold and intimate flirting…

(Source: Naver, translated)

A series of tests from birth. Diagnosed with childhood cancer and heart disease just days after birth. This is the story of Kongi, who began life in the hospital immediately after birth, and the family who stayed by his side.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The official history glosses over the romantic affairs. The Queen Dowager schemes to establish the collateral prince Lee Gon as a puppet ruler in place of the ailing king, aiming to establish the Kim clan of Hando as rulers. She also attempts to suppress Gon through a political marriage to Yeon-Ji, a woman from an insignificant family. However, the neglected couple consummates their marriage unexpectedly and gradually develops affection for each other. The once-ignorant Lee Gon gradually matures into a virtuous ruler through Yeon-Ji's steadfast support, both inside and outside the palace, and begins to build his power...

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

*“I... know the boss's secret.”*

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

display_title: The Celestial Fairy Has Me Bound
description:
Samdol, a woodcutter known for his strange bad luck — his clothes always end up torn — is saving money to buy an expensive silk outfit said to never rip.    

One day, while working in the forest, he rescues a deer being chased by a hunter.    

As a token of gratitude, the deer leads him to a mysterious hidden pond — the secret place where celestial fairies bathe.    

After an unexpected accident, the fairies hurriedly return to the heavens, leaving behind only one of them, Danhwa, who has lost her celestial robe and can’t go back. With no other choice, Danhwa ends up staying at the woodcutter’s house.    

However, to make matters worse, she enters the “mating season that comes to celestial fairies once a year” and begins to throw herself at Samdol.     

And so begins a cohabitation filled with misunderstandings, magic, and situations as amusing as they are dangerous.

[Original Webtoon](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/let_eat_bi)

Each time, in those life-threatening moments, a benefactor appeared to save her. But before they could exchange even a single word of thanks, he would vanish like mist.

\[Why not test whether meeting him was chance or fate?\] Then one day, as a train fell from the sky and crushed her—A strange, uncanny man, seemingly not meant to exist in this world, appeared once more and saved her life.

 *“Would you at least tell me your name now?”

“Adrian. Call me whatever you like.”*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Hye-Su and Kang-Ho meet at a film club.
Kang-Ho, dreaming of becoming a successful actor, spends his days obsessed with auditions and drinking, relying on Hye-Su for support. Seeking to understand Kang-Ho, Hye-Su begins acting lessons and gradually begins to forge her own path. However, upon learning that Kang-Ho landed a role by sleeping with a staff member, Hye-Su leaves him and hatches a plan for revenge.

Wanting to end his crush, Gyeol uses a talisman to connect with Ho-Young, but the talisman, which promises to grant love, keeps getting them into strange situations. *“I asked if I could take her place tonight.”*

He waved his hand dismissively, but she took a step closer instead.

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Office Danpyeonseon (오피스 단편선) Collection.*

Dreaming of a happy family with his fiancée, Hui-Kyung, Lee Yoon-Woo moves to a quiet, rural village where he has no connections. But one day, Hui-Kyung leaves home, leaving only a short text message saying goodbye. Abandoned by his fiancée and struggling to adjust to his new school, Yoon-Woo is struggling when her younger brother, Chae Jeong-Min, his first student and a friend from their college days, shows up... 

*"Hello, teacher. It's been a while."

"Oh, not teacher... Should I have called you brother-in-law?"*

Despite Yoon-Woo's protests, Jeong-Min invades his precious home, which he hadn't even cleaned, fearing any trace of Hui-Kyung would disappear. He then rummages around, proposing to live together...

 *"I have no one to turn to, so I'm just chasing after my ex-girlfriend who left me."*

Yoon-Woo and Jeong-Min cannot refuse, but will their cohabitation be ok?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Model Lee Hwi-Hyun is a sadly impotent virgin. One day, he meets famous photographer Jeong Mi-Eul. Her first impression is of a calm and collected person, but as soon as the shoot begins, she transforms, overwhelming Lee Hwi-Hyun like a predator hunting its prey. Perhaps due to Jeong Mi-Eul's fiery gaze enveloping his entire body, Hwi-Hyun begins to feel a growing heat within him. Jeong Mi-Eul, who has always been aroused by the camera lens, also continues to shoot in a state of intense excitement...
