Kwon Taeseo, a third-generation chaebol heir and the second son of Namgyeong Group.
Living a tedious life, he is dragged down to Seongwoo City, a place without even a single café.

After meeting Ahn Yoona, who is surviving one harsh day after another, Taeseo begins to feel emotions he has never once felt in his life.

Four years later, that once incredibly gentle woman has changed, becoming fierce, and finally, she vanishes from Taeseo's life.
Is the pain of Yoona's absence so sharp because of all the affection that has grown between them?

Or is it because it was a love like destiny?

[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=844061), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13285921)
*Note: The second story in Metatoon's Gyeryak Danpyeonseon (계략 단편선) Collection.*

Loan sharks, tycoons, even my dream first love... everyone wants my body. Why?

Emblyn, the princess of the castle tower, has lived a life of scorn and ridicule, shunned by the king. Driven to her limit by the king's violence, she dreams of freedom, and one day, at the queen's behest, she sets out for the Redian territory. However, powerless and alone, she impulsively writes a letter to Triss, the heir to the Aek ducal family, asking him to be her guardian, having witnessed his devotion to her younger sister. Then, after clashing with her father over her sister's marriage, Triss runs away from the ducal family and heads without hesitation to the Winter Garden of the Redian territory, where Emblyn is staying...

Do-Won tells Se-In, an art academy instructor and aspiring Oriental painter, that he needs her paintings. Feeling uneasy, Se-In wants to avoid entanglement with Do-Won, so he tells her to stop coming to him and give him the paintings. Jegal Hyun, the youngest team leader at a design company. With a blessed(?) personality, he's been living by nagging those around him for 32 years. One day, he's suddenly kidnapped by a UFO! After her foster father turns into a serpent monster and dies, Nokhee is taken in by a noble household.

Overnight she becomes a treasured young lady, but in truth she’s nothing more than a charm-absorbing servant meant to ward off misfortune.

The only one who allows her a breath of relief is Kiju, a servant boy suffering the same fate.

But Nokhee’s life grows increasingly miserable, and she eventually learns that the family heirloom she swallowed is actually Kiju’s reversed scale — the one taboo that can set him off.

“Can’t you take these disgusting things back?”

Simultaneously, he hears strange rumors about Su-Hyeon among his peers, and thus begins Do-Yun's desperate, reckless pursuit to get involved with him.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Exhausted from work, Yu-Young reluctantly followed his boss up the mountain. There, he was unexpectedly kidnapped by the mountain god, a tiger deity who rules the mountain.

 *“From today, you are my husband.”*

He attempts to escape failed time and again, and Yu-Young began to be swayed by the mountain god, San-Ho's, unexpected side...! 

Will the two of them be able to hold their wedding?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

A powerful political heir and a corporate heiress meet on a blind date arranged in her sister’s place. Pressured to win his favor, she tries to stay composed, only for him to boldly suggest taking things to bed. Mocked all her life as “defective,” she refuses to back down determined to prove exactly what this so-called flaw can claim once desire and ambition collide.

**Original Webtoon:**      
R19: [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68203485), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%A7%80%EB%8F%85%ED%95%9C-%EC%9C%A0%ED%98%B9-19%EC%84%B8-%EC%99%84%EC%A0%84%ED%8C%90/4703)    
R15: [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68203827)

**Official Translations:**    
R19: [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/200522)     
R15: [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/200521)

Every summer, she suffers nightmares of snakes slithering into her home. Like a dream that pursues her even when she flees, the past she believed forgotten knocked on her door once more. Having lived as a cold-hearted lawyer in Seoul, she returns to her hometown, Geumnak-ri, after 11 years, using consulting on a redevelopment association dispute as her excuse. To the place where her father's death had erased from her memory, where the hollowed-out past remained. There, a man held all of Hui-Jae's past in his grasp. Kim Se-Won, CEO of Geumseong D&C. A figure standing on the opposing side of her client, and simultaneously the one who left an indelible wound on Hui-Jae. Every time she faced him, Hui-Jae was overwhelmed by scenes she couldn't tell if they were dreams or memories. Red roses, an old side door, a school uniform, and the low voice that called her name.

 *"No matter how many times I see you, you're truly beautiful, Hui-Jae."

"If I kill your father for you, what will you give me?"*

What happened in Geumnak-ri eleven years ago? Why does he remember everything, yet lost only himself...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Three people experience a strange phenomenon of unknown origin. Thanks to this, they gain everything they ever wanted... but they soon realize that what initially brought them only joy gradually seeks to control their daily lives. What is the purpose of "it"?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ha-Seong had a dirty dream about having sex with Tae-Han, her childhood friend who he had been with since childhood. Ha-Seong had never considered Tae-Han a romantic interest, so she told him honestly about his dream, but Tae-Han's reaction was somehow strange...?

 *"Is it because of me? Because I like you..."*

While her feelings were complicated, freshman Ga-Eul aggressively approaches Ha-Seong, even risking trouble with Tae-Han...!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

A world shattered by an earthquake. A girl seeks to identify her psychopathic father, a man pursues him, and a killer revered as a god.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Seo Jae-Ha, the illegitimate son of a wealthy family, aspires to become the heir to his family. After a failed investment, he becomes a debtor, betraying his former classmate, a stranger named Yu-Jin, by offering him a sexual partner. He is then manipulated into becoming a debtor. A chance encounter transports him back to his high school days. To escape this predicament, he begins to treat Yu-Jin kindly. Will Jae-Ha be able to overcome this predicament and ascend to the throne? The protagonist, a second-generation chaebol who has always sought success and disregarded human connection, discovers true love with a man with whom he had a bitter past.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*"Get down on all fours like a dog. I'm gonna fuck you good."*

Web novels were her life and her truth. And among them, love was the most corrupting. It was only natural that Maeng Hae-Eun was bewitched by Nam Ju-Kang, who bore an uncanny resemblance to the male lead in her novel. A gangster organization disguised as a corporation. Tall, broad shoulders, thick muscles. A cold tone and charisma to boot. To capture the ideal man she'd longed for in her dreams, Hae-Eun decides to become the female lead in a tragic romance.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: Lessons for the Lazy Young Master
description:
Worried about his son Bi-Young living like a ne'er-do-well, Lord Bae asks Jin, the capital's top assassin and errand boy, to discipline his son. Sneaking into Bi-Young's bedroom for the mission, Jin unexpectedly witnesses him masturbating. His playful side kicks in, and he teases the terrified Bi-Young.

 *“I'll do anything you want...”*

Young master, when you cry with such a pretty face, it makes me want to give you a proper scolding.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: Happily Ever After with the Second Male Lead
description:
Who would ever believe a cat could talk? All I did was vent a little frustration to a stray cat on the street, but then...

\[This is a reward reserved only for kind humans! Quick, tell me! Is that your wish, meow?\]

 *"I mean, if it were me, I would’ve done it like this! I would’ve...!"*

\[Done! I shall grant your wish, meow!\]

Suddenly, I’ve been transmigrated into my favorite novel—ten years after its ending! But since I’m here, I might as well live happily ever after with my "bias"! Will she be able to claim her happy ending?

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.*

*“You took my virginity, so you better take responsibility.”*

One night of drunken mistakes with her younger brother’s friend, and now Ji-Woo is completely trapped! Wait, weren't you always the quiet one? Weren't you the guy who had zero interest in women, let alone me? From acting out of character to suddenly playing the role of her "boyfriend," Seung-Hyun’s behavior is driving Ji-woo crazy. She’s realizing all too late—it only takes a single moment for your life to spiral out of control.

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Dongjeongnam Danpyeonseon (동정남 단편선) Collection.*

Su-Rin is the office’s cool beauty, until an unexpected moment with her coworker Gang-Woo makes her let out a shockingly intimate moan. Now she can’t stop imagining him — though he’s far gentler and shyer than she thought. When their hidden desires finally collide, what sparks will fly?

(Source: Manta)

Andra Aveline and Dustin Ayrac were born sworn enemies just because their families are at odds. Andra has a passion for the pursuit of knowledge, while Dustin is the epitome of physical prowess. As they both try to complete their academy graduation assignments, they fall into a dungeon. There, in the darkness, an ancient spell that brings out their carnal urges takes hold of them. Now, they have to find a way to break this spell, but can they hold back their desires long enough to do that?

(Source: Tapas)

Ordered by the king to end a century-long feud between two families, Joo Ha-Yeong is forced to marry Yeon Moo-Eun, a man surrounded by nasty rumors. Surprisingly, after a brief misunderstanding on their wedding night, they quickly form a warm relationship as wife and husband. However, as their bond grows, Ha-Yeong starts questioning the rumors regarding her husband, who hardly seems like the wayward hooligan he is described as. Is Moo-Eun truly a man to be feared? Or is he a man who deserves to be loved?

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Sweeten the Deal: Believe in Love
description:
Jaeyeon has been in love with Nana ever since she started looking after him as a kid, but he’s always kept it a secret. One drunken slip-up finally exposes his feelings, turning playful teasing into something far more real. On a warm summer night, a one-sided crush spirals into a sweet, chaotic rom-com romance neither of them saw coming.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seo-Woon is an omega left jaded after countless failed romances. Enter Yi-Jn: an alpha with the face of a model and the personality of a robot. What starts with an instant marriage proposal due to Yi-Jin's desire for efficiency, soon becomes something more. Can this unlikely pair find true love?

(Source: Manta)

display_title: This is a Work of Fiction
description:
Seong-In spent his life drawing webtoons that mocked women… until a fatal accident forced him to walk a mile in their heels. Waking up as a young woman, Seong-In thinks he’s unlocked "Life on Easy Mode," but the illusion quickly shatters. From dodging the predatory advances of a "respected" instructor to facing an marriage ultimatum from a conservative father, Seong-In must navigate a world he once ridiculed. Can Seong-In learn to reconcile the fantasy of a world catering to women and the reality of the exhausting life women face on a daily basis?

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Little Red Riding Hood Devours the Wolf!
description:
Once upon a time, there was a young woman who had to make a journey. As she was walking alone through a dangerous forest, she came upon a werewolf. Alex is used to his life of seclusion. The forest he lives in may be dangerous, but considering the fact that he is one of the things that makes it so dangerous, he’s doing just fine on his own. Or at least he was, until the day he rescued a young woman in a red hood… 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Let Me Enjoy the Extra Life
description:
Rosehip has lived through the story of the same novel many times in multiple roles, starting from the female lead to the villainess to even a farmer. Now, she’s a duke’s daughter who is hardly mentioned in the original novel. Determined to spend this extra life in lazy comfort, Rosehip stays out of the main story’s plotline. That is, until the male lead, Ashton, comes knocking on her door. Between her father’s scheming to kick her out and Ashton’s need for a politically convenient fiancee, Rosehip is forced to take a leading role to recover her life outside the spotlight.

**Official Translations:**    
[English](https://www.tappytoon.com/en/book/let-me-enjoy-the-extra-life), [French](https://www.lezhinfr.com/detail/daf_1000970)

display_title: OOTD: He Might Not Be My Husband
description:
Before going off to war, Penelope's father marries her off to a man named Ulric so she can legally inherit his assets in the event of his death. Frustrated with this decision, Penelope doesn't even look at her husband's face at the altar, nor when he leaves for the battlefield along with her father. When Ulric comes home years later, he turns out to be a kind and caring husband, but he seems different from how he portrayed himself in his letters. Is he really the same man Penelope married? If not, who on earth could he be...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.*

Adrina has lived as her dead twin brother since she was eighteen. Known as the Mad Dog of Palesa Palace, she's assigned to guard Duke Julius. One problem: he should be older than her. So why does he look like a child?

(Source: Manta)

Goh Wun is back from the brink of death, but the man who loved him is gone. Waking up with total amnesia, Wun finds that his only lifeline is Kwon Hui-Jae: a guide who looks at him with equal parts longing and loathing. As they navigate a dangerous web of secrets and supernatural stakes, Wun realizes that forgetting the past didn't make the pain go away. He still has his powers, and he still wants Huijae. But in this game of redemption, the truth might be more dangerous than the loss of memory itself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Wolf Who Tempted the Black Serpent
description:
After serving the kingdom for 300 years as the wolf goddess, Lauren is brutally abandoned once she is no longer deemed useful. But instead of a death sentence, she is secretly given a second chance to live as a normal beastkin. And like all female beastkin, she soon experiences her first heat, which results in a spontaneous night with a serpent stranger by the name of Alexander. Although Lauren wishes to put this mistake behind her, Alexander is desperate to find the wolfish woman he has now marked as his mate...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Star doctor Soh Baek-gil is the perfect Alpha, but only on paper. In reality, he’s pheromone-blind and incapable of arousal. When he meets Kim Rohee, an Omega nurse with a massive complex about her own overwhelming scent, he thinks he’s found the perfect research subject. He expected a data sample, he didn't expect to lose his mind.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Workaholic Tae-Sung Kim quits his corporate job to drive a taxi. After helping his first passenger catch her cheating husband, he turns his cab into a makeshift detective agency. That's when gangster Jin-U Hwang gets in, seeking help to find his unfaithful missing boyfriend.

(Source: Manta)

Hot on the outside, soft on the inside, the sizzling Mibel Bakery. Try your favorite bread right now!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Si-Won dreams of becoming a fashion designer. He meets his perfect model in Seo-Hu, the famous “bucket-hat guy,” from campus. With his angelic face and perfect proportions, no one else will do. But the closer the two become, the more a strange feeling of temptation creeps in...

(Source: Manta)

Bethia, the poor baron's adopted daughter, has spent her life as a mere tool, enduring cruel abuse. But one day, she unexpectedly crosses paths with a mysterious duke at the temple. Upon hearing her name, the duke desperately pleads with her to become his daughter-in-law! 

To make things even crazier, her supposed fiancé is willing to hand over all his wealth to her. Wait, what? Is everyone around here out of their minds? Why is all this happening to me?

(Source: Manta)

Jung-Seo reunites with Hyo-Sin, the boy he once admired in high school, only for a drunken accident to leave Hyo-Sin with a broken nose and under Jung-Seo’s roof. As they begin living together, Jung-Seo realizes Hyo-Sin is nothing like the person he once idolized… and decides to help him find the courage to chase his dream again.

(Source: Manta)

*“Forget the haunting. From now on, your only job is to make me climax. Got it?”*

Exhausted by endless overtime, Yeon-Hee’s love life is non-existent. Was picking up that discarded mattress on her way home drunk a mistake? Because ever since that night, a mysterious virgin ghost has been crawling into her bed, pinning her down. But behind his chilling aura lies a touch that’s unexpectedly searing. As his inexperienced yet persistent hands find her most sensitive spots, Yeon-Hee feels herself melting into a pleasure she’s never known before. Her initial terror soon shifts into a wicked anticipation. She decides it’s time to properly train this ‘useful’ spirit….

(Source: Manta)

Life with her handsome, caring boyfriend feels less perfect as every night becomes the same. Craving change, Mi-Ji follows a strange message on her TV. But what she gets isn’t just different—it’s him. Hyeon-U Lee. Only not quite the one she knows.

(Source: Manta)

Miji’s life is a comedy of errors: exploding headphones, train accidents, the works. Her theory? She's cursed. Her solution? Summoning a powerful demon. But the price for breaking the curse is her future partner's life! A fantastic deal, Miji thinks. Who needs love anyway? Right?

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Please Assist with This S-Class Mission
description:
After a decade stuck as an E-Class hunter, Hara is suddenly hit with an S-Class Awakening Quest: date the nation’s beloved news anchor, Seheon. There’s just one problem—he’s tied to an embarrassing event from her past she’d rather forget. Still, the promise of S-Class power is too tempting to ignore, so Hara proposes a contractual relationship to Seheon. What starts as a desperate deal for “Official S-Class Mission Assistance” quickly turns into a strange, unpredictable romance.

(Source: WEBTOON)

For her entire life, Dohee has lived under the suffocating control of others, first repressed by her overbearing parents and later by a restrictive husband. To the outside world, she is the picture of grace, gentle, polite, and perfectly submissive. Yet, beneath that polished exterior, there is a constant, palpable tension, as if she is perpetually on the verge of breaking under the weight of her own restraint. 

Her carefully constructed world begins to crack when she crosses paths with Kim Hyeon. With a single, provocative observation, he pierces through her mask and sees the raw, simmering desire she has fought so hard to bury. This chance encounter acts as the key to her long-guarded cage. Tempted by Hyeon’s boldness, Dohee begins to unlock the chains of her controlled existence, venturing into a world of liberation and forbidden passion where she finally takes what she wants.

(Source: Lezhin US)

An unusual family or ideal family? Dangerous relationships within a family living under one roof. 

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

What should have been a simple surprise turns into a forbidden encounter, leaving both of them caught between guilt, thrill, and irresistible desire.

(Source: Lezhin US)

As a successful courtesan, Hwayoung believes she’s seen every kind of man the world has to offer. That is, until a nameless new servant arrives at the house. Hwayoung can’t help her curiosity about him, and her flirtations seem to turn him into putty in her hands. But pretty soon, Hwayoung will be the one unable to resist the seductions of this not-so-innocent beast. Just who is the one getting tamed here?!

(Source: Tapas)

However, if they serve under the imperial house, they are recognized as their property. The Empire and The Imperial house demand their royalty in exchange for protection.

Hae-In and Do-Hyun have been friends since they were in diapers. Majoring in Kinesiology in college, Hae-In asks Do-Hyun, now a baseball player, to be the subject for her sports massage practical assignment. But during the massage a little incident threatens their friendship with hard times ahead.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: How I Ended Up Seducing My Childhood Friend
description:
*“Ellion, we’re close friends, right…?”*

Rosaline never actually wanted to go to the monastery, but after a careless childhood promise, she’s stuck with no way out. In desperation, she turns to her childhood friend, Ellion, to vent her frustrations. As they brainstorm ways to escape her fate, she reaches a bold conclusion: she must break the vow of chastity that the monastery prizes so dearly. The only question is, who should be her partner in crime? Just then, her eyes land on the perfect candidate sitting right in front of her.

When Song-Ju Han learns that her best friend betrayed her and is getting married to her first love, she's devastated. Wanting comfort, Song-Ju has a drunken one-night stand with her childhood friend Do-Han Baek. A month later, Do-Han demands that she take responsibility and marry him!

(Source: Manta)

My boyfriend was secretly planning to marry my best friend. In an instant, I lost both the person I'd promised my future to and my friend. It felt like all the misfortunes of my life had hit me at once. But then, my brother's friend, Seo-Yoon, showed up and gave my life hope.

description:
Looking to make new friends in a new neighborhood, Jihyun joins a club of young married women, only to find herself pulled into secret rendezvous with hidden members.

**Original Webtoon:**

*“Are you… completely lacking in reproductive capability?”*

Baek-Rim, the Emperor of the Ye Kingdom, lost all carnal desire after being poisoned in his youth. When his royal physician heads deep into the mountains to find a legendary medicinal herb, he suffers an injury and sends his younger sister, Seol-Young, to serve the Emperor in his stead. “I have one request, Your Majesty.” “Speak.” “Please allow me to… personally verify your body’s physical response.” The Emperor, known to many as a "Ghost" for his coldness, welcomes Seol-Young with an unexpectedly beautiful smile and chilling kindness. Despite her role as a temporary physician, Seol-Young finds her heart wavering in his presence…

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Yeongjeong Danpyeonseon (연정 단편선) Collection.*

This high-octane, provocative CG-toon is meticulously crafted for adult audiences seeking an intense, sensory-driven experience. Moving far beyond the boundaries of traditional storytelling, this anthology dives headfirst into the lives of thrill-seekers who have utterly abandoned their moral compasses. The collection features a diverse array of taboo scenarios that explore the darkest corners of human desire and the raw electricity of forbidden encounters. 

From the bittersweet yet dangerously seductive reunion with a long-lost first love to the adrenaline-fueled, illicit risks taken by a subway predator, every chapter is designed to push limits. These are stories of individuals who live for the moment, indulging in deviant escapes that regular society dares not mention. With stunning, high-definition CG visuals that bring every scandalous detail to life, this collection invites you to witness a world of uninhibited passion and absolute deviation. Prepare yourself for an unapologetic descent into the deepest, most exhilarating depths of adult fantasy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hee-Jin and Seung-Jo were inseparable best friends for fourteen years, but one night was all it took to end their friendship. A year later, they are strangers again, separated by unspoken love and unresolved misunderstandings. When their paths cross once more, will they be able to bridge the space between them?

(Source: Manta)

Do Wong-Yeol, an illegitimate son desperate to end his half-brother’s tyranny, enlists the help of a mysterious butcher named Gong Hyeon. Known for his uncanny archery skills, Gong Hyeon becomes the lethal weapon in Wong-Yeol’s plan for revenge. However, as they navigate a world where betrayal is the only currency, a forbidden heat begins to stir between the master and his assassin. Their path toward vengeance is paved with a misery neither can escape, leaving them to wonder if their bond is a source of salvation or their ultimate undoing.

(Source: Lezhin US)

He's now a private tutor for his old crush's daughter... tension, flirtation, and messy misreads set the room on fire.

(Source: Toomics)

The Wife Game follows Park Sangcheol, a simple employee on the apartment facility management team. He spends his days fixing various breakdowns around the complex, but his true focus is the married women who live there. What starts as curiosity soon turns into a dangerous game of desire and secrets.

After betrayal ruins his family, Inmun Kim plans his revenge... and revenge is a dish best served cold, with no mercy.

(Source: Toomics)

Yuri lived an ordinary life with his parents and grandfather until a blinding light reset the world. Everyone returned to the physical age of nineteen, death vanished, and society collapsed overnight. In the chaos, Yuri’s grandfather disappeared without a trace. As violence becomes consequence-free and justice turns personal, Yuri enters Chicken Blood, a lawless battleground where revenge and secrets collide. In a world where no one can die, Yuri risks everything to uncover what happened to the only person he cannot afford to lose. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Hong-joo is a third-year Physical Education student who has a crush on her classmate Won. Afraid that confessing her feelings might ruin their friendship that dates back to high school, Hong-joo decides to distance herself from Won. From that day on, she ignores Won's messages and avoids him in classes. Meanwhile, Do-hyun, a senior who has always been interested in Hong-joo, starts to approach her more actively. How will the relationship between Hong-joo, Won, and Dohyun unfold?

[Official Webtoon (Pre-serialisation)](https://comic.naver.com/challenge/list?titleId=841835)

One day, when her mother falls ill, Minseo finally has to step up and take on the role of the family's caregiver.

display_title: The Guy Friend Right Under My Nose
description:
Hae-Young is smart, independent, a minor celebrity, and a virgin. It’s not like she hasn’t been trying—she just hasn’t found the right guy. She’s dated plenty of guys, even rising stars, but none of them have quite stacked up. After an awkward night of drinking, she discovers that her childhood friend is packing everything she wants and more. Will her bid to lose her v-card to her friend destroy their relationship, or will it lead to something more?

(Source: Tapas)
Collection of series published under [My First XXX] theme.

To bring his mother back to life, Saeron dedicated his life to finding the Twilight Mirror, a legendary artifact said to grant any wish. But Erie, a powerful half-demon, stands in his way. Though Erie easily defeats him, she lets him pass, certain the mirror’s barrier will stop him. To her shock, Saeron breaks through—only for the mirror to shatter, its shards scattering across the land. Now, bound by fate, Saeron and Erie must retrieve the lost pieces and restore the Twilight Mirror’s power.

**Official Translations:**        
[English](https://tapas.io/series/half-demons-on-the-borderline/info)

display_title: Saving My First Time Handsome Knight
description:
*"I might have to live without a handsome husband, but I refuse to throw away my first time like this!"*

Cielo is about to be sent into the palace as a concubine for an aging king. She’s determined not to let her precious first experience be wasted on someone she doesn't desire. Her target? Her steadfast and loyal guard, Caelum. She throws every seductive trick in the book at him, pressing her body against his in a bold attempt to break him. Yet, the stoic knight remains infuriatingly composed, ignoring her wicked temptations. But is he truly as indifferent as he seems, or is there a hidden fire burning beneath that cold armor?

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Part of Metaoon's Noecheongsun Danpyeonseon (뇌청순 단편선) Collection.*

Yoo Seo-rin is the youngest team leader in the marketing team, and she’s headed straight for the top. Skill, looks, charm—she’s got it all and won’t slow down for anything... or anyone. Yoo Seo-rin’s love life is the only thing not going her way, especially not after her fiancé dumped her. She's sworn off men entirely, but when a handsome new rookie joins her team and makes his interest known, Yoo Seo-rin just might find herself in a man’s arms after all…

(Source: Tapas)

After she gets caught up in a scandal and is exiled to a remote provincial hospital, all Hyo-Weon wants is to live a quiet life as a resident doctor. But her peace is soon shattered by Hae-Joo, a flirty patient notorious for seducing everyone in his path. Following a particularly stressful week, Hyo-Weon hooks up with Hae-Joo on the spur of the moment. As they continue their secret fling, the unlikely pair learn that they have more in common than they thought...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Collection of series published under [OOTD] theme.

display_title: Until You Say My Name Thrice
description:
At the tender age of five, Shin Jae-Won first met Park Sang-Eon at his parents' funeral. Taken in and raised together, Jae-Won’s gratitude eventually blossomed into a deep, secret yearning by the age of fourteen. At twenty, fueled by liquid courage, he finally confessed his feelings—only for a miracle to occur. His love was reciprocated, and Jae-Won believed he had secured a lifetime of domestic bliss with his incredibly devoted and skilled lover, a man fifteen years his senior. 

However, the fairy tale shattered at age twenty-seven when Jae-Won spotted Sang-Eon in a place he should never have been. The man he thought he knew was gone, replaced by a stranger shrouded in secrets. Staring down the man who had been his entire world, Jae-Won demands the cold, hard truth with a trembling heart: "Explain yourself. From the very beginning. Everything." Their lifelong bond now hangs by a fragile thread.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A collection of pure love short stories by NAYAK.

**Original Webtoon:**    
R19: [Novelpia](https://novelpia.com/comic_episode/939)     
R15: [Novelpia](https://novelpia.com/comic_episode/943)     

**Official Translations:**    
[English](https://global.toptoon.com/content/103838)

Kim Jae-Han, a brilliant and ambitious young magistrate newly appointed to the Sangju district, arrives with a hidden agenda that threatens the local status quo. Shortly after his arrival, he crosses paths with Choi Yeon-Ho, the eldest son of the powerful and influential Choi clan. Despite his lineage, Yeon-Ho lives a miserable existence as a social outcast held in utter contempt by his own family. Jae-Han finds himself strangely drawn to the innocent, suffering soul hidden beneath Yeon-Ho’s ragged exterior, and he begins to offer the young man a rare, genuine kindness. 

For Yeon-Ho, this handsome magistrate is a beacon of light in a lifetime of darkness; he falls deeply in love with the first person to treat him with dignity. However, their burgeoning bond is built on a precarious foundation. Unknown to Yeon-Ho, Jae-Han is meticulously orchestrating a plan to dismantle the corrupt Choi family entirely, placing their hearts on a collision course with tragedy. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Verde, once a renowned gourmet restaurant, is now on the verge of ruin. One day, famous food critic 'Pido-young' visits, leading to a literal sensation. However, Pido-young visits daily and leaves his food untouched, causing the restaurant's reputation to hit...

[Original Webtoon](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/vampire_ready)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://www.lezhinus.com/en/comic/bloodyorderup)

After suffering a heartbreak due to her ex-boyfriend's betrayal, Do-Hui vows to enjoy casual relationships from now on. Two men appear before her. One is her prickly, cold-hearted boss, and the other is a cute, handsome, popular actor. Do-Hui, meeting two men with contrasting charms and sexual preferences, realizes she's a "switch." In a month, she must choose between the two. Who will she choose?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

display_title: A Year in Confinement for 100 Million Won - Deal?
description:
Late one evening, a large sum of money was transferred into her account.

*“Any questions about the transfer? Talk to the bank directly! That's all I'm saying!”*

There was no way he could just give it back. It wasn't that he wanted to pocket someone else's money—that's just how the world works these days. Did you think I'd fall for voice phishing? But the moment the shadowy group stormed into her home, Song-Yul realized something was terribly wrong. One man stood out distinctly from the rest. Model-like tall stature and striking features. Even his loosely worn suit seemed charming, such was the intensity of his presence. He delivered his demand to her in a cold voice.

*“One hundred million.”
“Yes? Yes?”
“I'll give you 100 million won if you stay locked up like a corpse for a year.”*

A year of confinement for 100 million won? It's far more dangerous than expected, and far sweeter.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Cornelia Meitner’s husband is dead. She should be celebrating her newfound freedom, but with no heir to inherit the Marquis title, she’s at risk of losing her estate and the community of staff-turned-friends. To protect her lifestyle, she has only one option: get pregnant as soon as possible. Luckily, a few eligible bachelors are visiting for Marquis Meitner’s funeral, including a dashing young doctor, a lascivious poet, and a callous duke. Who will come out on top in this game of seduction? 

(Source: Tapas)

Do-Jun has a crush on the affectionate and mature college senior Han-Eul, but Han-Eul is always accompanied by the bustling popular kid Shin-Woo. Do-Jun, who is reluctant about the seemingly frivolous Shin-Woo, tries to approach Han-Eul, but Han-Eul is a heterosexual to the core, and even Shin-Woo finds out about his feelings for Han-Eul. But what's this? Shin-Woo suggests to Do-Jun that they should be partners since they both like guys anyway. Do-Jun is conflicted, but ends up in a relationship with Shin-woo, who is honestly a "good guy."

Will Do-Jun, who suddenly becomes the best friend and sex partner of his unrequited love, be able to maintain a clean, selfless relationship?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Seo-Won, who has been a beta all his life, suddenly experiences a heat cycle when he manifests as an enthusiastic omega one day. Because of this, he ends up spending a night with her stepbrother's son, Yo-Han... Unlike Seo-Won, who tries to pretend the 'accident' never happened, Yo-Han gradually reveals his hidden obsession.

*"I like you, Uncle."*

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Park Soo-Yeon has been in a long-term crush. And that's someone who isn't interested in love or romance. All he can do is become a 'slightly special person' who is different from others. He doesn't like this relationship, but he thinks it's the best he can have. Until he hears, 'Let's have a go.'

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

A YouTuber with 700,000 subscribers proposed a collaboration to me, the youngest of the family. But wait... The contract conditions are 10:0?! 

Kwon Ji-Ah, who is attracted to Gu-Chan, and our oldest Gu-Chan, who needs more money! Their impromptu yet ticklish and thrilling scheme, the couple YouTuber Channel Name: Gu-Chan Ji-Ah

We... Can we overcome countless obstacles to achieve our respective goals and become true 'couple YouTubers'?

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: To You Who Will Die Alone in Paradise
description:
Dandelion, the quirky, time-limited prince. He occasionally sees "a fragment of the future." Sometimes it's a crucial moment, sometimes a trivial one... but once he sees the future, it inevitably becomes reality. One day, at a party, he meets Kelewen, the high elf who will save the world—and that fragment unfolds before his eyes.

 *"Tell him you won't leave, Leon."*

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

A luxury store. A new customer arrives at a run-down rural supermarket: Na Kang-Ju. With his muscular physique and tall stature, he instantly steals Hye-Won's attention... Despite his perfect appearance, he possesses a somewhat shady personality. Hye-Won discovers the man's secret: he's cursed to turn into a bear when he drinks alcohol! Hye-Won decides to help him, willing to sacrifice herself, to break the curse. 

*"You said you'd help me, to lift the curse. So, hold on a little longer."*

Despite his harsh voice, his back is brimming with patience.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: [Pure Romance Anthology] Sold-Out Chili Pepper Man
description: *Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: To You, Who Kneel Before Me
description:
"I will make the world kneel at your feet." 

Malgeum, a young girl who takes the beating in place of a noblewoman, is struck down. One day, Crown Prince Jeongmun appears before her humbled self. He reveals the secret of her birth and bids her become his sword. Having lost everything, Malgeum accepts the offer to survive. 

"Jinseoha, that is the name you will be called from now on. And become the successor to the prime minister." 

Her first task is to become a man, avenge her father, and bring down her family. Only then can she make Jeongmun emperor. As their perilous journey unfolds, their love for each other deepens...

**Original Webtoon:**     
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=842784), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13114262)

**Official Translations:**    
[Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0004235)

*"Am I a bad friend to you?"*

Ji-Min, who is now in the same class as Ki-Jung, the source of all kinds of rumors and an object of avoidance. Contrary to expectations that it would be a difficult year, ordinary days pass by. Then one day, he spots Ki-Jung approaching a stray cat he was taking care of, and this becomes the opportunity for the two to gradually become closer...

Ji-Min skips school for the first time in his life and goes to a karaoke room. He knows it's an important time, but for some reason, he can't refuse to be with Ki-Jung.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

display_title: The Fairy Bath Theft Case Side Story
description:
After remembering his past life, Beom-Ryeong spends his time at the house of the chief of the household while training to ascend to heaven. However, there was something more important than training: the wedding. Will Beom-Ryeong be able to successfully complete the wedding with the chief of the household and spend their first night together?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes prologue.*

Her first love died in a carriage accident. Irina still misses him,
but she is forced into a political marriage. On top of that, the other person is her dead first love's twin brother, Duke Schneider.

Irina resents him for proposing and forcing her into marriage without permission, and vows never to open her heart.

"I still love Michael."
"It doesn't matter."
"What...?"
"It doesn't matter. Whoever you like."

A year after marriage.

"I won't hide it anymore since it's come to this. I like you."

He starts to reveal his true feelings. With such boldness that Irina is shaken. However, Irina didn't realize at the time that she was being deceived by her husband... 

**Original Webtoon:**    
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/66180247), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%82%A8%ED%8E%B8%EC%9D%B4-%EC%B2%AB%EC%82%AC%EB%9E%91%EC%9D%84-%EB%8B%AE%EC%95%98%EB%8B%A4/4424)

**Official Translations:**    
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/182908)

display_title: The Only Way to Achieve World Peace
description:
On the war-shadowed continent of Melas, Pope Heziana seeks a way to bring peace. A prophecy from the Creator God warns that the continent will soon be engulfed in war—and reveals a shocking solution to prevent it. Tasked with an outrageous divine mission in the name of peace, Heziana must prepare for peace talks with six handsome representatives from different nations. Can she fulfill her overwhelming holy duty and truly secure peace for the world?

**Original Webtoon:**     
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13114327), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/1561016695), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/only_peace_way), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000075790), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=260129) 

**Official Translations:**  
[French](https://www.webtoons.com/fr/romance/the-only-way-to-world-peace/list?title_no=9820)

*"Please let me write a masterpiece like no other."*

Yun Sang-Yeon, an aspiring writer who prayed to the monkey paw, who grants three wishes, is falsely accused and imprisoned. After 20 years in prison, he completes his book, "The Writer in Solitary Cell," and receives recognition, but the void in his heart remains unfilled. Then, the monkey paw reappears, saying, "I still have two wishes left."

(Source: Naver, translated)

Oh Kyung-Tae, who is gentle and likes children, but is always bullied by the girls around him. One day, Kyung-Tae is chosen as a beta tester for a dating simulation game for pretty girls. However, the joy is short-lived. The game does not run or install properly, so he ends up thinking it is a bad game... All the girls around him start to show favoritism! And he even starts to show favoritism toward Min Ji-Ah, the queen bee of the same university who has bullied him since his school days...

(Source: BookCube, translated)

display_title: How to Savor Your Childhood Friend
description:
*"No. You'll regret it. You and I... It doesn't make sense."

"Engagement? That's ridiculous. Is it some kind of arranged marriage or something?"*

It's not like it's a chaebol family or some unavoidable business merger or anything. They're just neighbors who lived in the same apartment building. How could she have gotten involved with a guy like this? It wasn't her intention. It was entirely her parents' will! With the campus romance she'd been dreaming of right in front of her, Da-Kyung suddenly gets engaged to her childhood friend. Huh? An engagement at this age? And to Ma Seong-Jae, who's her testicle friend and a notorious slut?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Dongjeongnam Danpyeonseon (동정남 단편선) Collection.*

Ten years into his career. Eui-Hyeon is an unknown actor who takes on any role given to him without complaint. One cold autumn night, after enduring another grueling shoot without a single word of complaint as usual, Eui-Hyeon happens to meet the world-famous star Cha Il-Ju.

 *“That's right. You're Eui-Hyeon, aren't you?”*

Top star Cha Il-Ju, an issue-maker since his debut, felt like someone from another world to Eui-Hyeon, even though they were both actors. It was clearly meant to be just a fleeting encounter...

 *“If you're free, wanna grab a drink?”
“I don't waste effort on people I'm not interested in either.”*

Cha Il-Ju's unhesitating approach gradually begins to shift Eui-Hyeon's world. A precious person who comes to him first, without needing any special effort. A benefactor who recognized his unwavering passion and relentless effort, even after years of obscurity. 

 *“It'll be fine. I promise I won't get greedy.”*

But the feelings that had begun to stir were steadily changing, contrary to Eui-Hyeon's resolve.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*"Should I eat him?"*

Orca Ware, the young master of the killer whale family "Ware," returns from a slaughter-ridden battlefield. He prefers slaughter to peace, and finds the battlefield more comfortable than comfort, so the Orca Mansion is simply boring. Then, a lowly and foolish servant, Nia, appears before Orca. Nia, who has been bullied by the other servants because he is a goldfish beastman, fills his hungry stomach by the lakeside of the mansion in the middle of the night... and encounters Orca.

 *"Master, I was wrong... Please, please, save me..."

"You are more insignificant and weak than anyone else, and yet you try to live... It really bothers me."*

I try not to pay attention, but my eyes keep going to the small and fragile Nia... The once boring mansion is soon filled with an inexplicable thrill.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

College student Yeonwu can’t stand Ohn, a campus senior wrapped in dark rumors...but fate keeps forcing them together. When Yeonwu rescues a vulnerable, intoxicated Ohn from a dangerous situation, their dynamic shifts overnight. Intrigued by the only guy who treats him with icy disdain, Ohn launches a relentless, seductive charm offensive. Yeon-Wu tries to resist, but Ohn’s intoxicating flirting soon has his heart racing. Can Yeon-Wu guard his heart, or will has love struck far too fast? 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

display_title: The Lady Is Possessed by the Demon of Lust
description:
*“Serena… seems to be possessed by a demon.”* 

Nathaniel, a priest of lowly birth. After returning to his hometown, the Earldom of Graves, after ten years, he found that Serena, the young lady he had served, was possessed by a demon. Unable to resist the earl’s pressure, he went to check on Serena’s condition…

 *“Ah, ahh… ugh.”*

Serena moaned strangely and slowly kneaded her ample breasts.

 *“Ugh, hah, Nate.”*

A very low-level demon had possessed his former master who had been treated so badly. The demon of lust.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Astraea, the strongest swordswoman in the world. One day, she realizes that she has reincarnated as a character inside a novel. And that role is the one who gets killed by the Evil God, the final boss...

During a mountain hike, she saves a child from assailants, only to learn that this very child is destined to become the Evil God.

 *"Well then, since it’s come to this, how about I raise him properly and reform him?"*

So she takes the child in and begins to raise him. But then... 

 *"Rea. Where are you going? Are you meeting that guy again?"* 

The boy has grown into an obsessive man who follows her everywhere, watching her every move. Somehow... it feels like she raised him the wrong way. 

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Han Ye-Rim, a video production major at an arts high school, can hear the inner thoughts of those captured in photos and videos. Ye-Rim, who's reluctant to film anything because of her talent, encounters Cha Jin-Ho, a famous model from the entertainment department. But what? Can you hear their inner thoughts too? A bumbling school romance between the prim Ye-Rim and the affectionate Jin-Ho!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Kim Min-Su, a 35-year-old salaryman at an ordinary company, lives a monotonous life. He has a girlfriend, but his days blur together as he endures a borderline-abusive boss and trudges through work. One day, while on a date, he runs into a middle school classmate. Luxury car, beautiful partner, glamorous lifestyle: everything Min-Su isn't. Consumed by feelings of inferiority, he impulsively makes an investment that, against all odds, becomes wildly successful. Now a multimillionaire, he reinvents everything: his job, his relationship, his home. A new life begins. Yet somehow, the dream life he's obtained feels strangely hollow. Then, out of nowhere, a young girl appears claiming to be "Min-Su's daughter". What is her true purpose? And what lies ahead for Min-Su?

In a world where the boundaries between realms blur, Choi Kangwoo and his companions have finally achieved their Awakening, unlocking extraordinary powers. As newly minted heroes, they find themselves thrust into an epic conflict that spans across the mortal world, the divine realms, and the demon realm.

With the fate of multiple world hanging in the balance, Kangwoo's team must navigate treacherous alliances, face off against legendary figures from various mythologies, and master their newfound abilities. As they delve deeper into the war, they uncover a sinister plot that threatens the very fabric of existence.

From summoning ancient beasts to wielding the power of creation itself, our heroes must push their limits and overcome seemingly insurmountable odds. With each battle, they inch closer to uncovering the true nature of their role in this cosmic struggle.

Even when he gives a presentation in front of the company president, he only ends up making a fool of himself, leaving his manager and colleagues exasperated.
The only one who warmly reaches out to him is his teammate, Sear.
However, Yongde has another identity—he is the only son of a crime syndicate leader who controls the underworld.
After his father is murdered, he takes over as the head of the organization. Yet, despite everything, Yongde continues to go to work at the company as if nothing has changed.

display_title: In the Shadow of the Family
description:
It's been more than 10 years since Hae-Ju, who became alone, became Se-Ryeong's family. Se-Ryeong had feelings for Hae-Ju that he shouldn't have, and he started to feel resentful toward Hae-Ju, who was paying less and less attention to him. Unable to bear it any longer, Se-Ryeong crosses the line he had been keeping and asks Hae-Ju to help him masturbate. Hae-Ju can't refuse Se-Ryeong's request...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Joo-Heon and Seo Kang-Woo met at a university drinking party, were drawn to each other, and became lovers after a one-night stand . Kang-Woo expected a normal relationship, but Joo-Heon's rough and unruly behavior, seemingly devoid of emotion at crucial moments, ultimately leads to a breakup. 

*"You're the kind of person who can't love anyone, so live alone and never see anyone again."*

Joo-Heon tries to appear calm, but Kang-Woo's absence makes him increasingly worn out, and he finally seeks out Kang-Woo in a precarious state and holds him captive.

 *"I'll fix that, even though I was sometimes harsh. I won't do it again... Just stay like this for ten minutes, no, just one minute."* 

Kang-Woo can't refuse Joo-Heon's desperate plea, almost pathetic, and ends up accepting him. The painful regret and intense love of two people who have lived completely different lives— and the law of cause and effect.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Then Sa-Yoon received a sponsorship offer. Sa-Yoon refused, but because of the debt that had to be paid by tomorrow, he had no choice but to accept the sponsorship that he had refused until now. I haven’t done anything yet, but the Emperor started to cling onto me first.

***A fantasy action webtoon inspired by the myths of the legendary island of Jeju.*** 

After a great catastrophe, the world is divided into small tribes. Each tribe possesses mysterious individuals known as "Powerful Ones," who serve as both offensive and defensive forces for the tribe. For a long time, wars and conflicts between the tribes continued, but these Powerful Ones intervened and made a pact not to invade each other, leading to a period of lasting peace. A century later, a small tribe in the north proclaims itself the "Nation of the Herd," establishes a "nation," and begins subjugating other tribes by force. The tribes are colonized, and their children are taken away. These children undergo rigorous education and training to become "Fighters" of the Nation of the Herd, and are then deployed in battles to conquer the colony. 

The Fighters subdue the Sanbu Tribe, which boasts two Powerful Ones, and swiftly defeats the surrounding tribes. During a battle with the Wild Tribe, they capture Garo, a boy with the potential for destruction, and Garo's mother, a Powerful One, and subdue the Wild Tribe. Mo-Hun, the youngest prince of the Land of the Herd and a warrior at the forefront of the conquest war, leads Garo and the Fighters on their quest to conquer the Island of the Beginning. Encountering storms and stranding, they eventually reach the Island of the Beginning, where they encounter the Prime Tribe. Living among these people, who have a completely different way of thinking and lifestyle, on the peaceful Island of the Beginning, Mo-Hun, the Fighters, and Garo gradually begin to change. 

Meanwhile, the Land of the Herd succeeds in developing Ancient Power (Explosives), and Prince Kaitan heads to the Island of the Beginning with his army, carrying the explosives. Having set foot on the Island of the Beginning, they launch a war of aggression. The "Those Who Remember the History of the Gods (Simbang)" of the Beginning tribe summon "Gwanegitto (God)" and fight back. And Mo-Hun and the Fighters begin a battle to protect the Primordial Island and the Primordial Tribe against their homeland. On the Primordial Island, a fierce battle unfolds between empire and colony, technology and spirit, invasion and peace, competition and cooperation.

There, she met the kind and genuine Grand Duke, Yuraha. He respected Liberté's feelings, stating he would postpone the marriage if she did not wish it. Dr. Jonathan, an eccentric genius with no interest in anything but research. Yet, he has come up with a groundbreaking invention that will change the landscape of human mating: the "love potion," aka the "pheromone cocktail." Excited by the prospect of becoming rich, Jonathan orders his research assistant, Sabrina, to hold a press conference. Sabrina asks Jonathan to include her name as a collaborator, but Jonathan flatly refuses. Furious, Sabrina lunges at Jonathan, and after a fierce struggle, the pheromone cocktail douses them both. Drunk on the pheromone cocktail, Sabrina seduces Jonathan, handcuffs him, and ties him up so he can't attend the press conference. With four hours left until the press conference... “Do you feel guilty thinking I’m Kang Jaehun? I actually like it more.”
Chaeyoung had loved Jaehun quietly for a long time — the kind, confident man who was always warm to everyone.
Even though she knew from the start there was no hope, when she heard the news of Jaehun’s marriage, her heart ached all over again.
In the middle of that unbearable despair, she found herself drawn to Jaejun, Jaehun’s younger brother and her childhood friend.
“What about me? I look just like my brother.”
“Isn’t that good? You’re so obsessed with Jaehun’s face anyway.”
Jaejun’s soft, coaxing voice — paired with a face so similar to Jaehun’s — felt as if he were tempting her on purpose.
“You’re saying you’ll give yourself to me. That’s what you’re saying right now.”
“…We’re friends, aren’t we.”
At those words, Jaejun laughed faintly.
As if to say, she was the only one who ever thought of them as “just friends.”

On a rainy autumn night, a knight who died under a false accusation opens her eyes again. “Dame Hiderin Viche. Please kill the king.” Hiderin, the resurrected knight, is given only twelve weeks to live—along with a single objective: assassinate the king. …And somehow, raise a child, too. Wandering for a way to complete her mission before time runs out, Hiderin reunites with a holy knight who once despised her. But what happened to the man who used to be so noble and righteous? He’s fallen to rock bottom—a drunken wreck scraping by day to day. “I’m not interested.” “Then what are you interested in?” “You disappearing.” “What a shame. Looks like you won’t get what you want.” Worse still—he’s been missing her. “What good are honor and glory… when she’s not here?” “Dame Viche.” “I told you to call me Hith.” “Am I allowed to?” “Allowed? Just call me Hith. You were doing fine a few hours ago… but after a little drink, you’re a mess. Or was it not ‘a little’?” Sarg hesitates. She’s given him permission to use her nickname, but he isn’t sure he can say it naturally. He’s whispered that name to himself countless times when she wasn’t around—yet in front of her, not even once. Still, he’s always wanted to. So once should be fine. Just once. After a long moment, Sarg finally parts his lips. “…Hiderin.”

But their once unshakable bond crumbled overnight because of one reckless mistake. "I liked that day. Didn’t you, too?" "I…" They’re neither lovers nor just friends. Han Gyeom, who wants to keep this ambiguous relationship going, looked unusually bright today. "Make your choice. Either we go on like this, or we never see each other again." "If we can’t stay partners like this, are you saying we should cut ties completely?" Thirty years of friendship were hanging by a thread. Seoyoon’s face turned pale at the weight of those words. "Still confused? Then let’s check again." "Check what?" "Whether I can still be just a friend to you." The moment Seoyoon looked into Han Gyeom’s burning gaze, he realized with certainty— they had already crossed a river they could never return from.

One day after the company party, after drinking just a little too much, with the background, the personality, and the unrealistic CEO and his juniors, Eunwoo ends up in an awkward situation. The CEO was also clearly drunk enough not to notice, so if Eunwoo pretends not to know, she could get away with it… that was the hope. Wake me up.” On that day, he knew all the truth. “I know this isn’t an excuse, but I… I was too drunk that day… I’m sorry.” “Well… I don’t know if there’s anything I should apologize for, or if you should be apologizing to me…” “…I thought everything that happened that day was unfortunate.” “Really? display_title: I Refuse an Ending Where My Mother Dies!
description:
The moment I blew out the candles on my 7th birthday cake—

I realized I had reincarnated into the world of a novel. And not just as anyone, but as the daughter of the main characters! The problem is…

[The heroine ■ □ dies, and the male leads… cause the world to end?]

So, in the side stories, my mother dies and my fathers cause the apocalypse? Is this for real…?

‘No way. I’ll stop it no matter what!’

I’m a brave seven-year-old now! So, I set out to lead my fathers and twist the original story by any means possible.

“You know what? You and I are destined to fall in love someday.”

I’m busy enough trying to save my mother, so who the heck are you?

After successfully twisting the original plot, I was planning to finally enjoy my youth, but —

“A son-in-law? Sure. I’ll accept anyone, as long as they meet one condition.”
“What condition?”
“They have to fight us and win.”
“Whatever the reason, any guy who lays a hand on my daughter is as good as dead.”

It seems my fathers have no intention of living peacefully.

“That’s easy. Just tell them to come at me all at once.”

Why are you agreeing to that so casually?!

Unpredictable! What will be the ending of this heart-pounding feeling?

When she gets a “hunch,” she’s right 100% of the time!

Boyoung, known as the “master of hunches,” is a couple manager who ranks first in matching success thanks to her almost supernatural sixth sense.

But, as the saying goes, “a monk can’t shave his own head.” Her own love life fails again and again. On top of that, because those hunches come to her anytime and anywhere, people often treat her like a strange person. That is why her first meeting with Eungi was, in short, a complete disaster.

A handsome face, but a personality that doesn’t match.

Eungi, famous as a divorce lawyer, does not believe in love, which he considers nothing more than an empty emotion, after witnessing the unhappy end of his parents’ marriage during his childhood.

Then, while handling a divorce case, Eungi is attacked by a stranger and loses his memory. When he sees Boyoung, who comes to visit him at the hospital, his heart begins to race like crazy.

When his memories suddenly return upon seeing her, Eungi starts looking for her every day, using his memory as an excuse. However, at the same time, he hurls cruel words at her, saying that “once he regains his memory, this heart-pounding feeling will disappear too”...

What will be the ending of this romance that began by chance?
